import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC2 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the brief, preservation half: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) are preserved by every labelled step `LStep` taken under the
encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC2 C22, C23), together with two auxiliary invariants that are
not WC2 clauses (`GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`). The kernel facts about the states before and after
a step (`KInvC` before, `ConcurrentWF` after) are hypotheses supplied by theorem 2 (preservation of
the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` shows the role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPreBase.control` (WC2
C12, C13.3): a positional controller that is not a leaf would break `SyncInv.control`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Auxiliary invariants (not WC2 clauses) -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause (needed by `unlock`, WC2 C17): while the recorded grant
of a live entry is active, every active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf is the
grant or one of its descendants. -/
def GrantSubtree (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j

/-- Auxiliary invariant, not a WC2 clause: every registered `guarded` identity exists (an entry
cannot become live by the creation of a fresh authority). -/
def RegBound (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The preserved conjunction: `SyncInv` (WC2 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) with the
auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg ∧ GrantSubtree s reg ∧ RegBound s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC2 C21.1–C21.3, C22, auxiliaries). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The global clause of `SyncState` (WC2 C21.5). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j

/-- `SyncState` is the per-entry clauses and uniqueness (WC2 C21, C22). -/
theorem syncState_iff {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    SyncState L s reg ↔ (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hg, ht, hb⟩
    exact ⟨fun e he => ⟨hi.guarded e he, hi.grant e he, hi.control e he, hg e he, ht e he,
      hb e he⟩, hi.unique⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => (h e he).guarded, fun e he => (h e he).grant,
      fun e he => (h e he).control, hu⟩, fun e he => (h e he).disc, fun e he => (h e he).sub,
      fun e he => (h e he).bound⟩

/-! ## Controller -/

/-- Unfolding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_spec {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : ∃ y hp m, s.A[e.guarded]? = some y ∧
      y.holder = .place hp ∧ parentOf s.P hp = some m ∧
      (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp ∧ (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? = some ctl := by
  unfold ControlOf at h
  cases hy : s.A[e.guarded]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; simp at h
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at h
    cases hh : y.holder with
    | frame f => simp [hh] at h
    | place hp =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, hh] at h
      cases hm : parentOf s.P hp with
      | none => rw [hm] at h; cases h
      | some m =>
        rw [hm] at h
        by_cases hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp
        · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact ⟨y, hp, m, rfl, hh, hm, hk, h⟩
        · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at h; cases h

/-- The controller of a live entry is usable when the place holding `guarded` is (WC2 C12: the
fields of the mutex value share its owner and death marker, Spec 1 §49.2). -/
theorem control_usable {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hl : e.Live s) (h : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) : s.flat.Usable ctl := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hh, hm, hk, hc⟩ := controlOf_spec h
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya⟩ := hl
  have hy' : s.flat.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
  rw [hy'] at hy₀; cases hy₀
  have hu : s.flat.Usable hp := by have := hw.holders _ _ hy' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hc)).2
  have hpar : ∀ q, parentOf s.P q = some m → ∃ pl pm, s.P[q]? = some pl ∧ s.P[m]? = some pm ∧
      pm.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead m = s.dead q := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [parentOf] at hq
    cases hpl : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [hpl] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl =>
      rw [hpl] at hq
      obtain ⟨pm, hpm, -, ho, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl m hpl hq
      exact ⟨pl, pm, rfl, hpm, ho, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨ph, pm, hph, hpm, ho, hd⟩ := hpar hp hm
  obtain ⟨pc, pm', hpc, hpm', ho', hd'⟩ := hpar ctl hcm
  rw [hpm] at hpm'; cases hpm'
  exact S3.Usable.of_same hu hph hpc (by rw [← ho', ho]) (by
    show s.dead ctl = s.dead hp; rw [← hd', hd])

/-! ## Abstract effect of a step on authorities -/

/-- What a step does to authorities, read on the effects of Spec 1 §60–§75 re-indexed and of WC2
C4, C7, C8, C15: authorities are only added; an old authority keeps its footprint and mode, is
never reactivated, keeps an origin that stays active, and its origin chain only loses elements
(and keeps those that stay active, when it stays active); an added authority is a root or is
derived from an active authority within its footprint. -/
structure Skel (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  len : s.A.length ≤ s'.A.length
  old : ∀ j y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → j < s.A.length → ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧
    y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
    (∀ o, y.origin = some o → s'.flat.Active o → y'.origin = some o)
  ancsSub : ∀ j, j < s.A.length → ∀ x ∈ s'.flat.ancs j, x ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  ancsKeep : ∀ j, j < s.A.length → s'.flat.Active j → ∀ x ∈ s.flat.ancs j, s'.flat.Active x →
    x ∈ s'.flat.ancs j
  new : ∀ j y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = none ∨
    ∃ o, y'.origin = some o ∧ o < s.A.length ∧ s.flat.Active o ∧
      (∀ l ∈ y'.footprint, l ∈ s.flat.afp o) ∧ s'.flat.ancs j = o :: s.flat.ancs o

section SkelLemmas

variable {s s' : SC}

/-- An index below the length has an element (Spec 1 §38: identities are indices). -/
theorem getElem?_of_lt {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} (h : i < l.length) :
    ∃ x, l[i]? = some x :=
  ⟨l[i], List.getElem?_eq_getElem h⟩

/-- Footprint of an existing authority (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem afp_of {t : SC} {j : Nat} {y : Authority} (h : t.A[j]? = some y) :
    t.flat.afp j = y.footprint := by
  show (match t.A[j]? with | some x => x.footprint | none => []) = _
  rw [h]

/-- An active authority exists (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem active_lt {t : SC} {j : Nat} (h : t.flat.Active j) : j < t.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := h; exact lt_of_getElem? hy

/-- Activity after a step implies activity before it (no reactivation). -/
theorem Skel.active (hsk : Skel s s') {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) (h : s'.flat.Active x) :
    s.flat.Active x := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, ha, -⟩ := hsk.old x y' hy' hx
  exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩

/-- Footprints of existing authorities are kept by a step (Spec 1 §42). -/
theorem Skel.afp (hsk : Skel s s') {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    s'.flat.afp x = s.flat.afp x := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hx hsk.len)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hf, -⟩ := hsk.old x y' hy' hx
  rw [afp_of hy', afp_of hy, hf]

/-- A covering descendant (WC2 C22) after a step was one before it. -/
theorem Skel.covering (hsk : Skel s s') {g j : Nat} (hg : g < s.A.length) (hj : j < s.A.length)
    (h : CoveringDesc s' g j) : CoveringDesc s g j := by
  obtain ⟨hanc, hact, l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hsk.ancsSub j hj g hanc, hsk.active hj hact, l, by rwa [← hsk.afp hj],
    by rwa [← hsk.afp hg]⟩

/-- A covering descendant created by the step is derived either directly from `g` or from a
covering descendant of the state before (WC2 C22). -/
theorem Skel.covering_new (hsk : Skel s s') {g j : Nat} (hg : g < s.A.length)
    (hj : s.A.length ≤ j) (h : CoveringDesc s' g j) : ∃ y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.origin = some o ∧ (g = o ∨ CoveringDesc s g o) ∧ s'.flat.ancs j = o :: s.flat.ancs o := by
  obtain ⟨hanc, ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩, l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
  have hy'' : s'.A[j]? = some y' := hy'
  rcases hsk.new j y' hy'' hj with ho | ⟨o, ho, hoA, hoa, hfp, hanc'⟩
  · have : s'.flat.org j = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
    rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hanc; simp at hanc
  · refine ⟨y', o, hy'', ho, ?_, hanc'⟩
    rw [hanc'] at hanc
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hanc with rfl | hanc
    · exact .inl rfl
    · refine .inr ⟨hanc, hoa, l, hfp l (by rwa [afp_of hy''] at hl1), ?_⟩
      rwa [← hsk.afp hg]

end SkelLemmas

/-- One entry keeps its clauses across a step with an unchanged registry record (WC2 C21.1–C21.3,
C22, auxiliaries). `hsrc`: no authority added by the step is derived directly from `guarded`
(from `Encap`); `hhold`: a place-held `guarded` stays place-held; `hctl`: the controller stays
a leaf; `hw'`: `WF3` after the step (theorem 2). -/
theorem entry_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (he : EntryOK L s e)
    (hsrc : e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o →
      o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y → s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' →
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : EntryOK L s' e := by
  have hb := he.bound
  have hlive : e.Live s' → e.Live s := hsk.active hb
  refine ⟨fun hl => ?_, fun hl g₀ hg₀ => ?_, fun hl => ?_, fun hl hn => ?_,
    fun hl g₀ hg₀ ha₀ => ?_, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb hsk.len⟩
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    have hy'' : s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' := hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hm, -⟩ := hsk.old _ y' hy'' hb
    have h1 := he.guarded (hlive ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩)
    simp only [OptP, hy] at h1
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hhold ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ y y' hy hy'' h1.2
    simp only [OptP, hy'']
    refine ⟨hm ▸ h1.1, ?_⟩
    have := hw'.holders _ y' hy' ya'
    rw [hq] at this ⊢; exact this
  · have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
    unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
    · rename_i z hz
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_getElem? hz) hsk.len)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hf, -, -, ho⟩ := hsk.old g₀ z' hz' (lt_of_getElem? hz)
      rw [hz] at hz₀; cases hz₀
      simp only [OptP, hz']
      refine ⟨ho _ h2.1 hl, fun l => ?_⟩
      rw [hf, hsk.afp hb]; exact h2.2 l
    · exact h2.elim
  · have h3 := he.control (hlive hl)
    unfold OptP at h3; split at h3
    · rename_i ctl hc
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc', hleaf'⟩ := hctl hl ctl hc h3.2
      simp only [OptP, hc']
      exact ⟨control_usable hw' hl hc', hleaf'⟩
    · exact h3.elim
  · intro j hj hcov
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn j (List.mem_range.2 hjA) (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, -⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho rfl
      · exact he.disc (hlive hl) hn o (List.mem_range.2 (active_lt hcov'.2.1)) hcov'
  · intro j hcov
    have hg₀A : g₀ < s.A.length := by
      have h2 := he.grant (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀
      unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
      · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
      · exact h2.elim
    have ha₀' := hsk.active hg₀A ha₀
    by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
    · rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' j (hsk.covering hb hjA hcov) with rfl | h
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr (hsk.ancsKeep j hjA hcov.2.1 g₀ h ha₀)
    · obtain ⟨y', o, hy', ho, hor, hanc⟩ := hsk.covering_new hb (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) hcov
      rcases hor with rfl | hcov'
      · exact absurd rfl (hsrc (hlive hl) j y' _ hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hjA) ho)
      · rw [hanc]
        rcases he.sub (hlive hl) g₀ hg₀ ha₀' o hcov' with rfl | h
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        · exact .inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

/-- Uniqueness across a step with an unchanged registry (WC2 C21.5): liveness only decreases. -/
theorem uniq_step {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s') (hb : RegBound s reg)
    (hu : Uniq s reg) : Uniq s' reg := fun i j e e' hi hj hl hl' hg =>
  hu i j e e' hi hj (hsk.active (hb e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)) hl)
    (hsk.active (hb e' (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)) hl') hg

/-- A step with an unchanged registry preserves `SyncState`, given the per-entry hypotheses of
`entry_step`. -/
theorem kernel_step {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded)
    (hhold : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y →
      s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' → PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q)
    (hctl : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s' → ∀ ctl, ControlOf L s e = some ctl → isLeaf s.P ctl →
      ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl') : SyncState L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨he, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hst
  exact syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun e hm => entry_step hsk hw' (he e hm) (hsrc e hm) (hhold e hm)
    (hctl e hm), uniq_step hsk (fun e hm => (he e hm).bound) hu⟩

/-! ## Holders and places -/

/-- A place-held authority keeps its holder (every step but `transfer`). -/
def HoldSame (s s' : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y y' : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[j]? = some y → s'.A[j]? = some y' →

  P.length ≤ P'.length ∧ (∀ q, q < P.length → parentOf P' q = parentOf P q) ∧
    ∀ r q, parentOf P' r = some q → q < P.length → r < P.length

/-- A filter rejecting every element is empty. -/
theorem filter_nil {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, p a = false) →
    l.filter p = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    rw [List.filter_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)]
    exact filter_nil fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)

/-- Children of an existing place are kept (Spec 1 §63.2 `kids`). -/
theorem PSkel.kids {P P' : List Place} (h : PSkel P P') {m : Nat} (hm : m < P.length) :
    kids P' m = kids P m := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, P'.length = P.length + d := ⟨P'.length - P.length, by have := h.1; omega⟩
  unfold Ern.MemoryModel.Access.kids
  rw [hd, List.range_add, List.filter_append]
  rw [filter_nil (l := List.map (fun x => P.length + x) (List.range d)) (fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr
    cases e : decide (parentOf P' (P.length + i) = some m)
    · rfl
    · have := h.2.2 _ m (of_decide_eq_true e) hm; omega), List.append_nil]
  exact List.filter_congr fun r hr => by rw [h.2.1 r (List.mem_range.1 hr)]

/-- Leaf-ness of an existing place is kept (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem PSkel.isLeaf {P P' : List Place} (h : PSkel P P') {l : Nat} (hl : l < P.length) :
    isLeaf P' l ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h' r hr hp
    exact h' r (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hr h.1) (by rw [h.2.1 r hr]; exact hp)
  · intro h' r hr hp
    have hrP := h.2.2 r l hp hl
    exact h' r hrP (by rw [← h.2.1 r hrP]; exact hp)

/-- Unchanged places satisfy `PSkel`. -/
theorem pskel_refl (P : List Place) : PSkel P P :=
  ⟨Nat.le_refl _, fun _ _ => rfl, fun r q hp _ => by
    simp only [parentOf] at hp
    cases hr : P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at hp; cases hp
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hr⟩

/-- Appending a well-formed shape satisfies `PSkel` (Spec 1 §71.1, §72.2 `ShapeOK`). -/
theorem pskel_shapeP {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {sh : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hsh : ShapeOK P.length sh) : PSkel P (shapeP P hd sh) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [shapeP], fun q hq => ?_, fun r q hp hq => ?_⟩
  · simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_left hq]
  · refine (Nat.lt_or_ge r P.length).elim id fun hr' => absurd hq ?_
    simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right hr', List.getElem?_map] at hp
    by_cases hi : r - P.length < sh.length
    · rw [List.getElem?_range hi] at hp
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some] at hp
      have := (hsh (r - P.length) (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
      rw [hp] at this
      exact Nat.not_lt.2 this.1
    · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)] at hp; cases hp

/-- Folding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC2 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_of {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {y : Authority} {hp m : Nat}
    (hy : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y) (hh : y.holder = .place hp) (hm : parentOf s.P hp = some m)
    (hk : (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp) :
    ControlOf L s e = (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? := by
  simp [ControlOf, hy, hh, hm, hk]

/-- With the same holder for `guarded` and kept parents, the controller is unchanged and stays a
leaf (WC2 C12). -/
theorem ctl_same {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hb : e.guarded < s'.A.length) (hh : HoldSame s s') {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) (hl : isLeaf s.P ctl) :
    ∃ ctl', ControlOf L s' e = some ctl' ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl' := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hk, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hb
  have hhp : y'.holder = .place hp := by rw [hh _ y y' hp hy hy' hph, hph]
  have hpP : hp < s.P.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at hm
    cases hq : s.P[hp]? with
    | none => rw [hq] at hm; cases hm
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hq
  have hmP : m < s.P.length := (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm).2
  have hctlP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
  have hm' : parentOf s'.P hp = some m := by rw [hP.2.1 hp hpP, hm]
  have hk' : (kids s'.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some hp := by rw [hP.kids hmP]; exact hk
  refine ⟨ctl, by rw [controlOf_of hy' hhp hm' hk', hP.kids hmP, hkc], (hP.isLeaf hctlP).2 hl⟩

/-- `kernel_step` for steps keeping holders of places and parents. -/
theorem kernel_step_same {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hh : HoldSame s s') (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hst : SyncState L s reg)
    (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : SyncState L s' reg :=
  kernel_step hsk hw' hst hsrc
    (fun e _ _ y y' hy hy' hu => by
      cases hq : y.holder with
      | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
      | place q => exact ⟨q, by rw [hh _ y y' q hy hy' hq, hq]⟩)
    (fun e hm _ ctl hc hl => ctl_same hw hP
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hst.2.2.2 e hm) hsk.len) hh hc hl)

/-- `Skel`, holders, places and the encapsulated sources of new authorities after a step with an
unchanged registry. -/
structure StepFacts (reg : SyncReg) (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  skel : Skel s s'
  hold : HoldSame s s'
  pskel : PSkel s.P s'.P
  src : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
    y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded

/-- Constructor of `StepFacts`. -/
theorem StepFacts.of {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (h : Skel s s' ∧ HoldSame s s')
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' →
      s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : StepFacts reg s s' :=
  ⟨h.1, h.2, hP, hsrc⟩

/-- No authority is created (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_none {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (hlen : s'.A.length = s.A.length) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded :=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ hy' hj _ => absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by omega)

/-- Appended authorities are roots or derived from `src` (source condition from `Encap`). -/
theorem src_append {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {N : List Authority} {src : Nat}
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ N) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none ∨ z.origin = some src)
    (he : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → src ≠ e.guarded) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e hm hl j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right hj] at hy'
  rcases hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy') with h | h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h; exact he e hm hl

/-- Appended authorities are roots (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_roots {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {B N : List Authority} (hA : s'.A = B ++ N)
    (hlen : B.length = s.A.length) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e _ _ j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy'
  rw [hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy')] at ho; cases ho

theorem viewStep_ok {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : ViewStep R c s (.ok s')) : ∃ t, R (s.view c) (.ok t) ∧ s' = s.set t := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  cases o₃ with
  | ok t => cases ho; exact ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩
  | reject => cases ho
  | fail => cases ho

theorem opStep_facts {k : K} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : SC}

    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hd := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd; split at hd

        show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).A = _; simp [storeEff, hy]; rfl
      have hP : (storeEffC s c a p).P = s.P := by
        show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).P = _; simp [storeEff, hy]; rfl

      rw [hd.2.2] at hq; cases hq

    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; rfl)

/-- Position in a strictly increasing list (Spec 1 §63.2 `posIn`). -/
theorem posIn_of_getElem : ∀ {l : List Nat} {i x : Nat}, l.Pairwise (· < ·) → l[i]? = some x →
    posIn x l = i
  | [], _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | a :: l, 0, x, _, h => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; simp [posIn]
  | a :: l, i + 1, x, hp, h => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h
    have hax : a ≠ x := Nat.ne_of_lt ((List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 x (List.mem_of_getElem? h))
    simp only [posIn, hax, ↓reduceIte, posIn_of_getElem (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).2 h]

/-- Children are listed in increasing order (Spec 1 §63.2 `kids`). -/
theorem kids_pairwise (P : List Place) (m : Nat) : (kids P m).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
  (Frames.range_pairwise_lt _).filter _

/-- A child of a part of `src` is a part of `src` (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_child {P : List Place} {r m src : Nat} (hr : r < P.length)
    (hm : parentOf P r = some m) (hlt : m < r) (h : partOf P m src) : partOf P r src := by
  refine ⟨hr, .inr ?_⟩
  rw [chain_cons hm hlt]
  rcases h.2 with rfl | h
  · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h

/-- `transfer` keeps children (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_kids (t : S3) (src dst m : Nat) :
    kids (transferEff t src dst).P m = kids t.P m := by
  unfold Ern.MemoryModel.Access.kids; rw [transfer_len, transfer_parentOf]

/-- `transfer` keeps leaves (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_isLeaf (t : S3) (src dst l : Nat) :
    isLeaf (transferEff t src dst).P l ↔ isLeaf t.P l := by
  unfold isLeaf; rw [transfer_len, transfer_parentOf]

/-- The controller after a `transfer` whose source is not the place holding `guarded` (`Encap`):
either the mutex value does not move, or it moves as a whole and both fields move to the same
positions of the destination (Spec 1 §63.2 `corr`, WC2 C12 positional `ControlOf`). -/
theorem ctl_transfer {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {c src dst : Nat} {e : SyncEntry}
    (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hss : SameShape s.P src dst)
    (henc : (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src)) {ctl : Nat}
    (hc : ControlOf L s e = some ctl) (hl : isLeaf s.P ctl) :
    ∃ ctl', ControlOf L (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)) e = some ctl' ∧
      isLeaf (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P ctl' := by
  obtain ⟨y, hp, m, hy, hph, hm, hk, hkc⟩ := controlOf_spec hc
  have hP : (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P = (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).P := rfl
  have hpar : parentOf (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P = parentOf s.P :=
    transfer_parentOf (s.view c) src dst
  have hkids : ∀ x, kids (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P x = kids s.P x :=
    transfer_kids (s.view c) src dst
  have hleaf : ∀ x, isLeaf (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).P x ↔ isLeaf s.P x :=
    transfer_isLeaf (s.view c) src dst
  have hA' : (s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)).A[e.guarded]? = some
      (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y) := by
    have hy2 : (s.view c).A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[e.guarded]? = _
    rw [transfer_A_get, hy2]; rfl
  have hmlt := WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hm
  have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
  have hcP : ctl < s.P.length := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).1
  have hmc := (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hcm).1
  by_cases hin : heldIn s.P src y.holder
  · rw [hph] at hin
    -- the mutex value is a part of `src`
    have hne : hp ≠ src := fun e' => henc (by simp [hy, hph, e'])
    obtain ⟨o, ho, -, hor⟩ := mem_chain (hin.2.resolve_left hne)
    rw [hm] at ho; cases ho
    have hmsrc : partOf s.P m src := ⟨hmlt.2, hor.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩
    have hcsrc : partOf s.P ctl src := partOf_child hcP hcm hmc hmsrc
    have hss1 := hss.1 m (List.mem_range.2 hmlt.2) hmsrc
    unfold OptP at hss1; split at hss1
    · rename_i m' hm'
      have hgp : posIn hp (kids s.P m) = L.guardedField := posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hk
      have hcp : posIn ctl (kids s.P m) = L.controlField :=
        posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hkc
      have hlen : L.controlField < (kids s.P m').length := by
        rw [hss1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hkc
      have hlen' : L.guardedField < (kids s.P m').length := by
        rw [hss1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hk
      obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hlen'
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc'⟩ := getElem?_of_lt hlen
      have hcorr : corr s.P src dst hp = some h' := by
        rw [corr_step hne hm hmlt.1, hm', Option.bind_some, hgp, hh']
      have hcne : ctl ≠ src := fun e' => by
        have := Frames.partOf_le hmsrc; omega
      have hcorrc : corr s.P src dst ctl = some ctl' := by
        rw [corr_step hcne hcm hmc, hm', Option.bind_some, hcp, hc']
      have hh'm : parentOf s.P h' = some m' := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hh')).2
      refine ⟨ctl', ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [controlOf_of (y := { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder }) (hp := h') (m := m')
          (by rw [hA']; simp only [show heldIn s.P src y.holder by rw [hph]; exact hin,
            ↓reduceIte])
          (by rw [hph]; simp [mvTo, hcorr])
          (by rw [hpar]; exact hh'm) (by rw [hkids]; exact hh'), hkids, hc']
      · rw [hleaf]
        have hsc := hss.1 ctl (List.mem_range.2 hcP) hcsrc
        rw [hcorrc] at hsc
        simp only [OptP] at hsc
        rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hl] at hsc
        exact kids_nil_iff.1 (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hsc)
    · exact hss1.elim
  · refine ⟨ctl, ?_, (hleaf ctl).2 hl⟩
    rw [controlOf_of (y := y) (hp := hp) (m := m) (by rw [hA']; simp only [hin, ↓reduceIte]) hph
      (by rw [hpar]; exact hm) (by rw [hkids]; exact hk), hkids, hkc]

/-- `transfer` preserves `SyncState` under `Encap` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed). -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c src dst : Nat}
    {s s' : SC} (h : opStepC k (.transfer src dst) c s (.ok s'))
    (he : Encap (s, reg) (.kernel c (.transfer src dst))) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hget : ∀ j : Nat, (transferEffC s c src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun (y : Authority) =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y :=
    fun j => transfer_A_get (s.view c) src dst j
  have hlen : (transferEffC s c src dst).A.length = s.A.length := by
    show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A.length = _; simp [transferEff]; rfl
  have hsk : Skel s (transferEffC s c src dst) := by
    have horg : ∀ i, (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.org i = s.flat.org i := by
      intro i
      show ((transferEffC s c src dst).A[i]?).bind (·.origin) = (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
      rw [hget]; cases s.A[i]? with
      | none => rfl
      | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl
    have hancs : ∀ j, (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.ancs j = s.flat.ancs j :=
      fun j => chain_congr fun i _ => horg i
    refine ⟨by omega, fun j y' hy' _ => ?_, fun j _ x hx => by rwa [hancs] at hx,
      fun j _ _ x hx _ => by rwa [hancs], fun j y' hy' hj => by
        have := lt_of_getElem? hy'; omega⟩
    rw [hget] at hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy'
    refine ⟨y, hy, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> exact id, fun o ho _ => ?_⟩
    split <;> exact ho
  refine kernel_step hsk hw' hs (src_none hlen) (fun e _ _ y y' hy hy' hu => ?_)
    (fun e hm hl ctl hc hleaf => ctl_transfer hw hpre.sameShape
      (he e hm (hsk.active (hs.2.2.2 e hm) hl)) hc hleaf)
  rw [hget, hy] at hy'
  simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy'
  subst hy'
  cases hq : y.holder with
  | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
  | place q => split <;> simp [hq, mvTo]

/-! ## Frame steps (WC2 C4, C7, C8) -/

/-- Facts of a `spawn` step (WC2 C4 effect, Spec 1 §72 effect). -/
theorem spawn_facts {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (h : SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s')) : StepFacts reg s s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact .of (skel_enter rfl hpre.params) (pskel_shapeP hpre.localsOK)
    (src_roots rfl (length_mapI _ _ _) fun z hz => by obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; rfl)

/-- Facts of a `terminate` step (WC2 C7 effect, Spec 1 §73 effect). -/
theorem term_facts {k : K} {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (h : TermStep k s c (.ok s')) : StepFacts reg s s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact .of (skel_exit hw rfl) (pskel_refl _) (src_none (by
    show (exitEff (s.view c)).A.length = _; simp [exitEff, length_mapI]; rfl))

/-- Facts of a `join` step (WC2 C8: state unchanged). -/
theorem join_facts {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} (h : JoinStep s c d (.ok s')) :
    StepFacts reg s s' := by
  cases h; exact .of (skel_sameA rfl) (pskel_refl _) (src_none rfl)

/-! ## Library operations (WC2 C13, C16–C18) -/

/-- The clauses of an entry that do not read its grant, across a step (WC2 C21.1, C21.3). -/
theorem entry_static {L : MutexLayout} {s s' : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hsk : Skel s s')
    (hh : HoldSame s s') (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (he : EntryOK L s e) (gr : Option Nat) :
    ((⟨e.guarded, gr⟩ : SyncEntry).Live s' → OptP (s'.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y =>
      y.mode = .modify ∧ PlaceUsable s'.flat y.holder) False) ∧
    ((⟨e.guarded, gr⟩ : SyncEntry).Live s' → OptP (ControlOf L s' ⟨e.guarded, gr⟩) (fun ctl =>
      s'.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s'.P ctl) False) := by
  have hb := he.bound
  have hlive : (⟨e.guarded, gr⟩ : SyncEntry).Live s' → e.Live s := hsk.active hb
  refine ⟨fun hl => ?_, fun hl => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ := hl
    have hy'' : s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' := hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hm, -⟩ := hsk.old _ y' hy'' hb
    have h1 := he.guarded (hlive ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩)
    simp only [OptP, hy] at h1
    cases hq : y.holder with
    | frame f => rw [hq] at h1; exact h1.2.elim
    | place q =>
      simp only [OptP, hy'']
      refine ⟨hm ▸ h1.1, ?_⟩
      have := hw'.holders _ y' hy' ya'
      rw [hh _ y y' q hy hy'' hq, hq] at this ⊢; exact this
  · have h3 := he.control (hlive hl)
    unfold OptP at h3; split at h3
    · rename_i ctl hc
      obtain ⟨ctl', hc', hleaf'⟩ := ctl_same hw hP (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb hsk.len) hh hc h3.2
      have hc'' : ControlOf L s' ⟨e.guarded, gr⟩ = some ctl' := hc'
      simp only [OptP, hc'']
      exact ⟨control_usable hw' hl hc'', hleaf'⟩
    · exact h3.elim

/-- A place-held `guarded` stays place-held under `HoldSame` (WC2 C21.1). -/
theorem hold_of_same {s s' : SC} (hh : HoldSame s s') (e : SyncEntry) : e.Live s' →
    ∀ y y', s.A[e.guarded]? = some y → s'.A[e.guarded]? = some y' →
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder → ∃ q, y'.holder = .place q := by
  intro _ y y' hy hy' hu
  cases hq : y.holder with
  | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
  | place q => exact ⟨q, by rw [hh _ y y' q hy hy' hq, hq]⟩

/-! ### Registry updates -/

/-- Members of an updated registry (WC2 C16–C18 record updates). -/
theorem mem_set_cases {reg : SyncReg} {i : Nat} {e' x : SyncEntry} (h : x ∈ reg.set i e') :
    x = e' ∨ ∃ j, reg[j]? = some x ∧ j ≠ i := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Frames.exists_getElem?_of_mem h
  rw [List.getElem?_set] at hj
  by_cases e : i = j
  · subst e
    by_cases hi : i < reg.length
    · simp only [hi, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hj; exact .inl hj.symm
    · simp [hi] at hj
  · simp only [e, ↓reduceIte] at hj; exact .inr ⟨j, hj, Ne.symm e⟩

/-- An entry of an updated registry has a counterpart with the same `guarded`. -/
theorem set_old {reg : SyncReg} {i j : Nat} {e e' x : SyncEntry} (hi : reg[i]? = some e)
    (hg : e'.guarded = e.guarded) (h : (reg.set i e')[j]? = some x) :
    ∃ x₀, reg[j]? = some x₀ ∧ x₀.guarded = x.guarded := by
  rw [List.getElem?_set] at h
  by_cases e₀ : i = j
  · subst e₀
    simp only [lt_of_getElem? hi, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h; exact ⟨e, hi, hg.symm⟩
  · simp only [e₀, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact ⟨x, h, rfl⟩

/-- Uniqueness after a record update keeping `guarded` (WC2 C21.5). -/
theorem uniq_set {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {i : Nat} {e e' : SyncEntry} (hi : reg[i]? = some e)
    (hg : e'.guarded = e.guarded) (hu : Uniq s reg) : Uniq s (reg.set i e') := by
  intro j₁ j₂ x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ hl₁ hl₂ hgg
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, hg₁⟩ := set_old hi hg h₁
  obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂, hg₂⟩ := set_old hi hg h₂
  exact hu j₁ j₂ y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ (by unfold SyncEntry.Live; rw [hg₁]; exact hl₁)
    (by unfold SyncEntry.Live; rw [hg₂]; exact hl₂) (by rw [hg₁, hg₂, hgg])

/-- Entries of an extended registry (WC2 C13). -/
theorem append_cases {reg : SyncReg} {e' x : SyncEntry} {j : Nat} (h : (reg ++ [e'])[j]? = some x) :
    (reg[j]? = some x) ∨ (j = reg.length ∧ x = e') := by
  by_cases hj : j < reg.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_of_not_lt hj)] at h
    cases e : j - reg.length with
    | zero => rw [e] at h; simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h
              exact .inr ⟨by omega, h.symm⟩
    | succ n => rw [e] at h; simp at h

/-- Uniqueness after registering a fresh identity (WC2 C13.7, C21.5). -/
theorem uniq_append {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {e' : SyncEntry} (hu : Uniq s reg)
    (hfresh : ∀ x ∈ reg, x.Live s → x.guarded ≠ e'.guarded) : Uniq s (reg ++ [e']) := by
  intro j₁ j₂ x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ hl₁ hl₂ hgg
  rcases append_cases h₁ with h₁' | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;> rcases append_cases h₂ with h₂' | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hu _ _ _ _ h₁' h₂' hl₁ hl₂ hgg
  · exact absurd hgg (hfresh x₁ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₁') hl₁)
  · exact absurd hgg.symm (hfresh x₂ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₂') hl₂)
  · rfl

/-! ### `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` -/

/-- `newMutex` (WC2 C13) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem newMutex_preserves {L : MutexLayout} {adm : List Nat} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg}
    {c g : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : NewMutexOk L adm s reg c g st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hes, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have hg := hpre.guarded
  unfold OptP at hg; split at hg
  · rename_i y hy
    have hnew : EntryOK L s ⟨g, none⟩ := by
      refine ⟨fun _ => by simp only [OptP, hy]; exact ⟨hg.2.1, hg.2.2⟩,
        (fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun hl => ?_, fun _ _ => hpre.available,
        (fun _ _ h => by cases h), lt_of_getElem? hy⟩
      have hctl := hpre.control
      cases hc : ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩ with
      | none => rw [hc] at hctl; exact hctl.elim
      | some ctl => rw [hc] at hctl; exact ⟨control_usable hw hl hc, hctl⟩
    refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun x hx => ?_, uniq_append hu fun x hx hl => hpre.unique x hx hl⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
    · exact hes x hx
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact hnew
  · exact hg.elim

/-- `acquire` (WC2 C16) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem acquire_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : AcquireOk k L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, e, hi, ⟨hl, hn, -⟩, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hes, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have heo := hes e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
  have hA : (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some e.guarded,
      (s.view c).afp e.guarded, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := rfl
  obtain ⟨hsk, hh⟩ := skel_append hA rfl (fun j y' hy' => ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩) fun z hz => by
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hz; subst hz
    exact .inr ⟨e.guarded, rfl, active_lt hpre.active, hpre.active, fun l hl => hl⟩
  have hP : PSkel s.P (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).P := pskel_refl _
  refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun x hx => ?_,
    uniq_set hi rfl (uniq_step hsk (fun x hx => (hes x hx).bound) hu)⟩
  rcases mem_set_cases hx with rfl | ⟨j, hj, hji⟩
  · obtain ⟨hg1, hc1⟩ := entry_static hsk hh hP hw hw' heo (some s.A.length)
    refine ⟨hg1, fun _ g₀ hg₀ => ?_, hc1, (fun _ h => by cases h), fun _ g₀ hg₀ _ j hcov => ?_,
      Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le heo.bound hsk.len⟩
    · cases hg₀
      have hnew : (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).A[s.A.length]? = some
          ⟨.modify, some e.guarded, (s.view c).afp e.guarded, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩ := by
        rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _)]; simp
      simp only [OptP, hnew]
      refine ⟨by first | rfl | trivial, fun l => ?_⟩
      show l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded ↔ l ∈ (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded).flat.afp e.guarded
      rw [hsk.afp heo.bound]
    · cases hg₀
      by_cases hjA : j < s.A.length
      · exact absurd (hsk.covering heo.bound hjA hcov)
          (heo.disc hl hn j (List.mem_range.2 hjA))
      · have hjl := active_lt hcov.2.1
        rw [hA, List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hjl
        exact .inl (by omega)
  · have hxo := hes x (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)
    refine entry_step hsk hw' hxo ?_ (hold_of_same hh x) fun hl' ctl hc hleaf =>
      ctl_same hw hP (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hxo.bound hsk.len) hh hc hleaf
    intro hxl j' y' o hy' hj' ho
    rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right hj'] at hy'
    have : o = e.guarded := by
      have hm := List.mem_of_getElem? hy'
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hm; subst hm; cases ho; rfl
    subst this
    exact fun hg => hji (hu j i x e hj hi hxl hl hg.symm)

/-- `unlock` (WC2 C17) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem unlock_preserves {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : UnlockOk L s reg c i st') (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, e, g₀, hi, hl, hg₀, hpre, -, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hes, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have heo := hes e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa⟩ := hpre.active
  have hx' : s.A[g₀]? = some x := hx
  have hA : (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).A = s.A.set g₀ { x with active := false } := by
    show (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀).A = _; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; rfl
  have hP : PSkel s.P (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).P := by
    show PSkel s.P (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀).P; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; exact pskel_refl _
  obtain ⟨hsk, hh⟩ := skel_set hx' hA (same_deact x)
  have hlen : (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).A.length = s.A.length := by
    rw [hA, List.length_set]
  refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun y hy => ?_,
    uniq_set hi rfl (uniq_step hsk (fun x hx => (hes x hx).bound) hu)⟩
  rcases mem_set_cases hy with rfl | ⟨j, hj, -⟩
  · obtain ⟨hg1, hc1⟩ := entry_static hsk hh hP hw hw' heo none
    refine ⟨hg1, (fun _ _ h => by cases h), hc1, fun _ _ j hj hcov => ?_, (fun _ _ h => by cases h),
      Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le heo.bound hsk.len⟩
    have hjA : j < s.A.length := by rw [← hlen]; exact List.mem_range.1 hj
    rcases heo.sub hl g₀ hg₀ ⟨x, hx, xa⟩ j (hsk.covering heo.bound hjA hcov) with hjg | hanc
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hcov.2.1
      have hz' : (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g₀)).A[j]? = some z := hz
      rw [hA, List.getElem?_set, hjg] at hz'
      simp only [lt_of_getElem? hx', ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz'
      rw [← hz'] at za; cases za
    · exact hpre.noActiveDesc j (List.mem_range.2 hjA) hanc (hsk.active hjA hcov.2.1)
  · have hxo := hes y (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)
    exact entry_step hsk hw' hxo (src_none hlen y (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)) (hold_of_same hh y)
      fun _ ctl hc hleaf => ctl_same hw hP (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hxo.bound hsk.len) hh hc hleaf

/-- `resetLock` (WC2 C18) preserves `SyncState`. -/
theorem resetLock_preserves {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (h : ResetLockOk s reg c i st') (hs : SyncState L s reg) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨-, e, hi, -, hnc, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hes, hu⟩ := syncState_iff.1 hs
  have heo := hes e (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
  refine syncState_iff.2 ⟨fun y hy => ?_, uniq_set hi rfl hu⟩
  rcases mem_set_cases hy with rfl | ⟨j, hj, -⟩
  · exact ⟨heo.guarded, (fun _ _ h => by cases h), heo.control, fun _ _ => hnc,
      (fun _ _ h => by cases h), heo.bound⟩
  · exact hes y (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)

/-- A raw `deriveSync` under the library instantiation targets the `guarded` of a live entry,
which `Encap` excludes (WC2 C14, C15; only `acquire` derives from `guarded`). -/
theorem deriveSync_excluded {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat}
    (h : DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L reg) s c g (.ok s')) (he : Encap (s, reg) (.deriveSync c g)) :
    False := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨e, hm, hg, hl, -⟩ := hpre.authorized
  exact he e hm hl hg.symm

end SyncPreserveAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Theorem 4, preservation half -/

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C21–C23), preservation: every labelled step taken under `Encap` preserves
`SyncInv` (WC2 C21, items 1, 2, 3, 5),
`GrantDiscipline` (WC2 C22) and the auxiliary invariants `GrantSubtree` and `RegBound`. The kernel
facts `WF3` before and after the step are parts of `KInvC` and `ConcurrentWF` supplied by theorem
2. Fragment: the concurrent kernel with the reference synchronization library. -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap st lbl)
    (hw : WF3 st.1.flat) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat) (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves h he hw hw' hs
    all_goals
      have hf := opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw
      exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    have hf := spawn_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | @join s s' reg c d h =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) h
    exact kernel_step_same hf.skel hf.hold hf.pskel hw hw' hs hf.src
  | deriveSync h => exact (deriveSync_excluded h he).elim
  | newMutex h => exact newMutex_preserves h hw hs
  | acquire h => exact acquire_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | unlock h => exact unlock_preserves h hw hw' hs
  | resetLock h => exact resetLock_preserves h hs

/-- Theorem 4 (WC2 C22, C23), trace form: along an encapsulated trace (`EncapsulatedTrace`),
`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the auxiliaries are preserved, given a state invariant `Q` that
implies `WF3` and is preserved by every labelled step (theorem 2 provides it: `KInvC` with its
auxiliaries). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (Q : SC → Prop) (hQw : ∀ s, Q s → WF3 s.flat)
    (hQ : ∀ lbl st₀ st₁, LStep k L lbl st₀ st₁ → Q st₀.1 → Q st₁.1) (hQ0 : Q st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    exact ih (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)
      (lstep_preserves hst he (hQw _ hQ0) (hQw _ (hQ _ _ _ hst hQ0)) hs)

/-! ## Role of the leaf clause of `newMutex` -/

namespace SyncPreserveWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- A mutex value `m` (place 0) whose fields are `data` (place 1, a leaf owning the root `T`,

## C4. Context Creation — `spawn`

`spawn` is a proposed concurrent transition modeled on O6.

**Preconditions**

1. The creating context and its current frame are live.
2. The new context and frame identities are fresh.
3. Every transmitted access parameter is an active derived authority held by the creating frame.
4. Parameter transmission yields the authority to the new frame without duplication.
5. O6's applicable origin, mode, footprint, anchoring, and protection conditions hold in the resulting state.
6. `AnchorOrderHeld` and the global authority invariants hold in the resulting state.
7. Any transmitted value satisfies the separate value-passing contract in C5.

**Effect**

A new context is created with an initial frame parented to the creating frame.

Local places and their corresponding root authorities are created for the new frame, consistently with the applicable effects of O6.

Transmitted authority parameters change holder to the new frame. The creating frame does not simultaneously retain those same authority instances.

The origin-protection requirement corresponding to O6.3 is evaluated with the new context as the executing context.

This does not replace the protection provided in the creator by effective-right restrictions: transmitting an active `Modify` derivative suspends incompatible exercise through its origin on the covered leaves.

**Outcome:** `ok` or `reject`, according to the candidate's structural and authority preconditions.

## C5. Provisional By-Value Transmission at `spawn`

A `spawn` may provisionally transmit an owned value into storage created for the new context.

This is a candidate composite transition, not an ordinary execution of O6 followed by O4.

**Preconditions**

1. The source is usable, and the creating frame has exercisable `Modify` over its relevant footprint, preserving the source-side authority requirement of O4.1.
2. The destination is a freshly created local root in the new context's initial frame. All its leaves are `Uninit`, and it initially holds no derived authorities; its root `Modify` authority is held by that frame under `RootHeld`.
3. The ordinary destination-side exercise requirement of O4.1 is replaced by the special destination-construction and transmission condition in item 2. This grants no ordinary authority to the creator over child-owned locals.
4. All other preconditions of O4, namely O4.2–O4.9, apply to the composite transmission, with resulting-state conditions evaluated on the final state.
5. The source and destination have matching ordered shapes, and their footprints are disjoint.
6. No exclusive authority, owned resource, or dependent right is duplicated.
7. The source is consumed, and the destination receives the value, held authorities, ownership relationships, and dependencies according to the applicable effects of O4.
8. The entire composite transition preserves `WF3`-corresponding requirements, I1–I4, `AnchorOrder`, `AnchorOrderHeld`, `NoDangling`, and `NoOrphan`.

**Effect**

Successful transmission marks the corresponding source leaves `Moved` and destination leaves `Init`, transfers held authorities and ownership relationships as required by O4, and establishes the destination value in the receiving context.

The operation creates no additional copy of the transferred value's exclusive authority.

**Outcome:** `ok` or `reject`.

The detailed by-value calling convention remains subject to Spec 3. This provisional composite is included to test cross-context ownership transfer and is not a final calling-convention decision.

## C6. Frame Exit and Reparenting

Concurrent frame exit applies the safety conditions and validity effects of O7 to the global authority state.

For a non-base frame `f` whose surviving parent is `p = parent(f)`:

1. O7's applicable conditions must hold.
2. All surviving active authorities and dependencies must remain valid.
3. Each surviving context-initial frame whose direct parent is `f` is reparented to `p`.
4. The extended ancestry relation is updated accordingly.
5. The resulting frame structure must remain well-founded and preserve all applicable authority and dependency invariants.
6. Reparenting does not create or elevate rights and does not revive dead storage or dead anchors.

The reparenting target is the immediate surviving parent `p`, not an arbitrarily chosen ancestor.

The ordinary effects of frame exit on local places, authorities, and reanchoring remain governed by O7.

A frame cannot exit merely because reparenting would restore structural ancestry. Its surviving resources must independently satisfy the validity requirements.

The exit operation introduces no implicit wait for another context.

## C7. Context Termination — `terminate`

`terminate` applies the corresponding O7 validity requirements to the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have legally ended.

Its effects include:

- ending the terminating context's initial frame;
- performing applicable releases and legal reanchoring;
- reparenting surviving context-initial frames as specified in C6;
- removing the terminating context from the live-context set;
- establishing its completed lifecycle state.

Completion does not automatically end resources independently and legally owned by surviving contexts.

The initial base context remains subject to its distinct base-frame restrictions.

## C8. Reference Completion Operation — `join`

`join` is a proposed reference operation for observing completion of a previously created context.

For this abstract candidate, the argument is a context identifier. No separate completion-capability mechanism is required.

The identifier must designate a context known to the execution, and its completed lifecycle state must be established.

Successful `join` requires that the target context has terminated. Merely finding an identifier absent from the live-context set is insufficient unless the corresponding completed state is known.

At this abstract authority level, successful `join` does not modify `P`, `I`, `A`, or `D`.

If the target remains live, completion cannot yet be returned; the operation may await completion rather than produce an authority-discipline rejection.

The complete event-ordering consequences of successful completion observation are deferred to the concurrency event model.

`join` is not the only possible completion protocol, and its existence does not impose structured concurrency universally.

3. The controller and protected footprint have a valid, non-falsifiable association.
4. Shared observations intended for the controller do not conflict structurally with the protected exclusive authority.
5. The storage arrangement respects O8, including O8.3 when `guarded` is stored.
6. The synchronization controller's storage is declared appropriately for its mutation discipline.
7. The protected authority identity is not already registered as an administrative identity of another live administration under the candidate unified consistency guard.
8. `GrantDiscipline` is established and the entry begins in an available state.

The operation registers an entry with `grant = none`.

It creates no access authority over the protected value.

A reference representation may place the protected value in a distinct logical owned-storage root. No separate physical allocation is implied.

## C14. Concurrent Contract — `SyncAuthorized`
## C17. Reference Unlock — `unlock`

`unlock` is a derived library operation.

It requires:

1. a live entry with `grant = some g`;
2. `g` active and legally releasable under O3;
3. no active descendants preventing its release;
4. sufficient authority over the associated controller;
5. a permitted controller update under its declared shared-mutation discipline.

On success, O3 releases `g`, the registry records `grant = none`, and the controller is updated consistently.

No partial unsafe result may be exposed.

## C18. Abandoned Grants and Recovery

A grant may become inactive through an inherited legal release or frame exit without a corresponding `unlock`.

The registry may continue to record that grant.

This condition may leave the mutex unavailable indefinitely without, by itself, establishing a violation of memory safety.

`resetLock` is a proposed library recovery operation.

It requires:

1. `ExercisableAt(guarded, Modify)` under the ordinary rules of Spec 1 §43;
2. no active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, following the condition used by O19 (§78.2);
3. a valid, exclusive recovery contract;
4. preservation of the controller association and synchronization-state invariants.

Recovery restores the entry's available state and its corresponding controller state without invalidating surviving dependent authorities.

## C19. Synchronized Administration
## C21. Synchronization Invariant — `SyncInv`

For each live synchronization entry:

1. `guarded` is active, has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable place.
2. If `grant = some g`, then `origin(g) = guarded` and `footprint(g) = footprint(guarded)`.
3. The associated synchronization controller is valid.
4. Registry state and the permitted control operations remain coherent.
5. Applicable administration-identity consistency conditions hold.

A recorded grant need not remain active. The invariant must be preserved by legal releases, frame exits, and reanchoring transitions, without silently weakening item 2.

## C22. Derivation Discipline — `GrantDiscipline`

A synchronization abstraction must ensure that uncontrolled ordinary derivatives cannot compromise subsequent synchronized acquisition.

In particular:

```
live(e) ∧ e.grant = none
⇒ no active descendant of guarded
   covers a protected leaf
```

This is a proposed library invariant, conditional on justified encapsulation and preservation by every operation exposed through the abstraction.

The implication is not established merely by I1 or by the existence of a synchronization entry.

A correct safe abstraction must prevent permitted caller behavior from violating this contract.

The typing and encapsulation obligations remain explicit interfaces with Specs 4 and 10.

/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC3 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose

their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
view of `c`. -/
def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }

/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC3 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`

current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC3 C4 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC3 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC3 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
  new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/

    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC3 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/

hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC3 C4 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- WC3 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC3 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
  the creating frame. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
  new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC3 C4). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC3 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o

/-! ## State (WC2 C1–C3) -/

/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC2 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
inductive Life where
  | live
  | done
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Execution context (WC2 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
structure Ctx where
  stack : List Nat
  life : Life
  parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC2 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC2 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC2 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC2 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC2 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC2 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC2 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC2 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC2 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC2 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC2 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC2 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC2 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

theorem push_preserves {s : SC} {c top : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    {C' : List Ctx} (hk : KInvCA s) (hpar : ParamsOK (s.view c) ps)
    (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape)
    (hpush : Push s { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with C := C' } top)
    (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with C := C' }) :
    KInvCA { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with C := C' } := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hc, hh⟩ := view_facts hk c
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).F ↔
      f ∈ ({ s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with C := C' } : SC).frames := fun f => by
    rw [hpush.mem]
    show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
    rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]
  have hne : ({ s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with C := C' } : SC).frames ≠ [] := fun he => by
    have := (hpush.mem s.nF).2 (.inl rfl); rw [he] at this; cases this
  refine kInvCA_of (hpush.framesC hfr)
    (flat_facts rfl hmem hpush.nodup hne (enter_wf' hw hpar hsh) (Frames.enter_inv3base hw hb)
      (enter_noDangling' hw hd hsh) (enter_rootHeldConv' hw hpar hc) (enter_heldAnchored' hw hh))
    ?_ haoh

  have hqt : (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).Usable q :=
    (usable_mem_congr (t := enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) (fun f => (hmem f).symm)).1 hq
  change x ∈ (if (s.view c).P.length ≤ q then [] else (s.view c).D q) at hx
  by_cases hlt : q < (s.view c).P.length
  · simp only [show ¬ (s.view c).P.length ≤ q from Nat.not_le.2 hlt, ↓reduceIte] at hx
    have hq0 := Frames.enter_usable_back hw hqt hlt
    have hqf := view_usable_flat hq0
    have hok := hk.1.2.1.2.1 q hqf x hx
    have hxl : x < (s.view c).A.length := by
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hk.1.2.1.1.2.2.1 q hqf x hx; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := effAnchorOKC_get hok
    have he : (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).effAnchor x = (s.view c).effAnchor x :=
      Frames.effAnchor_congr (Frames.enter_ancs_lt hxl)
    have hrl : (s.view c).effAnchor x < (s.view c).A.length :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Frames.effAnchor_le _ x) hxl
    have hz₀ : (s.view c).A[(s.view c).effAnchor x]? = some z := hz
    have hro := Frames.effAnchor_root hw x
    have hnp : (s.view c).effAnchor x ∉ ps := fun hp => by

/-- `I1`–`I4` and `NoDangling` after a transfer (Spec 1 §50–§54, §63; the proof of the private
`transfer_inv3` without `AnchorOrder`, using §63.1 usability, §63.6 first half and §63.9). -/
theorem transfer_base' (hwf : WF3 s) (hb : Inv3base s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (hsrc : s.Usable src) (hdeps : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) :
    Inv3base (transferEff s src dst) ∧ NoDangling (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨⟨sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2, fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, ?_⟩
  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    change x ∈ (if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q) at hx
    split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx
      · obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hxr⟩ := mem_movedTo'.1 hx
        exact hdeps x (mem_movedDeps_part' hr hxr)
  · intro j y hy ya q hq l hl hly
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
    have hly₀ : l ∈ y₀.footprint := by split at hly <;> exact hly
    rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
    exact hnd j y₀ hy₀ ya₀ q (fun hu => hq (transfer_usable_fwd hwf hd' hu)) l hl hly₀

/-- `HeldAnchored` after a transfer (Spec 1 §44, §63; the proof of
`transfer_preserves_heldAnchored`, which uses §63.1 usability, §63.2 and §63.3). -/
theorem transfer_heldAnchored' (hwf : WF3 s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)
    (hdst : s.Usable dst) (hsh : SameShape s.P src dst) (hdis : ¬ overlap s.P src dst) :
    HeldAnchored (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x y q hy ya ho hh hq
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
  have ho₀ : y₀.origin ≠ none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src y₀.holder
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    cases e : y₀.holder with
    | frame _ => rw [e] at hc; exact hc.elim
    | place r =>
      rw [e] at hc hh
      obtain ⟨r', hcr, -⟩ := optP_false_iff'.1 (hsh.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hc.1) hc)
      simp only [mvTo, hcr, Option.getD_some, Holder.place.injEq] at hh
      subst hh
      have hr' := corr_partOf hwf hdst.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hcr
      have hxr := hheld x y₀ r hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ e
        (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc hsrc)
      change x ∈ (if partOf s.P r' src then [] else s.D r' ++ movedTo s src dst r')
      simp only [not_partOf_src' hwf hdis hr', ↓reduceIte]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (mem_movedTo'.2 ⟨r, hc, hcr, hxr⟩)
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hc; exact hc
    have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh (transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq)
    change x ∈ (if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q)
    simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq

/-- `transfer` executed by a context preserves the re-indexed invariant (Spec 1 §57, §63; WC2
C2, C20): §63.6 gives `AnchorOrderC`; `AnchorOrderHeldC` from §63.7 for moved held authorities,
from `AnchorOrderC` and `HeldAnchored` for unmoved derived ones, and from the frame of the
holder for unmoved root authorities (mirrors the private `transfer_anchorOrderHeld`). -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {s : SC} {c src dst : Nat} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (hpre : TransferPreC k s c src dst) : KInvCA (transferEffC s c src dst) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hc, hh⟩ := view_facts hk c
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1
  have hw' := transfer_wf3' hw hpre.srcUsable hpre.dstUsable hpre.dstUsableAfter
  obtain ⟨hb', hd'⟩ := transfer_base' hw hb hd hpre.srcUsable hpre.depsValid hpre.dstUsableAfter
  have hh' := transfer_heldAnchored' hw hh hpre.srcUsable hpre.dstUsable hpre.sameShape
    hpre.disjoint
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := fun _ =>
    SC.mem_view_F
  refine kInvCA_of (framesC_set hfr rfl)
    (flat_facts rfl hmem hfr.nodup (frames_ne (s := s) hfr) hw' hb' hd'
      (transfer_rootHeldConv' hc) hh') hpre.anchorOrder ?_
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh₁
  have hqt : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q := (set_usable hmem).1 hq
  have hy' := hy
  change (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]? = some y at hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have hpq : (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.pframe q = (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q :=
    S3.pframe_congr (s' := (transferEffC s c src dst).flat) (s := transferEff (s.view c) src dst)
      rfl q
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len (s.view c) src dst]; exact hqt.lt)) hqt
    have hy'' : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]? = some _ := hy'
    rw [hy''] at e
    rw [hpq]; exact e ya hh₁
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves (s.view c) src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn (s.view c).P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh₁ hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf (s.view c).P q src := by rw [hh₁] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    cases ho : y₀.origin with
    | none =>
      have horg : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).org x = none := by
        simp [S3.org, show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]? = some y₀ from hy', ho]
      have hex : (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.effAnchor x = x := by
        show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).effAnchor x = x
        simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none horg]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
      unfold EffAnchorOKC
      rw [hex, hy', pframe_iff.2 hf]
      simp only [OptP, hh₁, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
      exact ⟨hfF, .inl rfl⟩
    | some o =>
      have hxq := hh x y₀ q hy₀ ya (by rw [ho]; exact fun h => by cases h) hh₁
        (transfer_usable_back hw hpre.srcUsable hqt)
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEffC s c src dst).D q := by
        change x ∈ (if partOf (s.view c).P q src then [] else
          (s.view c).D q ++ movedTo (s.view c) src dst q)
        simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

/-! ## Theorem 2 (except `exitFrameC` and `terminate`) -/

/-- Theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23; Spec 1 §57 re-indexed): every inherited operation O1–O16 other than
O7, executed by a context with an `ok` outcome, preserves `KInvC` with the auxiliaries `KAux` and
`HeldAnchored` on the flat state, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, used by `split`). Fragment: the
concurrent kernel without synchronization; O7 (`exitFrameC`) is not covered here. -/
theorem opStepC_preservesC {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp}
    (hk : KInvCA s) (hnx : op ≠ .exit) (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) : KInvCA s' := by
  cases op with
  | exit => exact absurd rfl hnx
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact transfer_preserves hk hpre
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact depend_preserves hk hpre
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact store_preserves hk hpre

/-- The inductive invariant of theorem 2 (WC2 C20, C23): `KInvC` (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed) with the
auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` of Spec 1 `reachable_inv`, read on the flat state. -/
def KInvCA (s : SC) : Prop := KInvC s ∧ KAux s.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s.flat

/-! ## Membership transport (WC2 C2) -/

/-- `HeldAnchored` reads the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §44, §40). -/
theorem heldAnchored_mem_congr {t : S3} {F' : Frames} (h : HeldAnchored t)
    (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : HeldAnchored { t with F := F' } :=
  fun x y q hy ya ho hh hq => h x y q hy ya ho hh ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)

/-- The kernel facts of Spec 1 on the view of a context, from the re-indexed invariant (WC2
C2). -/
theorem view_facts {s : SC} (hk : KInvCA s) (c : Nat) :
    WF3 (s.view c) ∧ Inv3base (s.view c) ∧ NoDangling (s.view c) ∧ RootHeldConv (s.view c) ∧
      HeldAnchored (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, -⟩, hc, hh⟩ := hk
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.flat.F := fun f => SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨SC.wf3_view hfr hw, ⟨h1, h2, i3_mem_congr h3 hF, i4_always _⟩,
    noDangling_mem_congr hnd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- The flat state of `s'` is `t` with the globally live frames of `s'` (WC2 C2); the kernel
facts of Spec 1 on `t` carry to the flat state of `s'` when `t` lists the same frames. -/
theorem flat_facts {s' : SC} {t : S3} (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames })
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames) (hnd : s'.frames.Nodup) (hne : s'.frames ≠ [])
    (hw : WF3 t) (hb : Inv3base t) (hd : NoDangling t) (hc : RootHeldConv t)
    (hh : HeldAnchored t) :
    WF3 s'.flat ∧ I1 s'.flat ∧ I2 s'.flat ∧ I3 s'.flat ∧ NoDangling s'.flat ∧ KAux s'.flat ∧
      HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ s'.frames ↔ f ∈ t.F := fun f => (hmem f).symm
  rw [hflat]
  exact ⟨wf3_mem_congr hw hF hnd hne, hb.1, hb.2.1, i3_mem_congr hb.2.2.1 hF,
    noDangling_mem_congr hd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- Assembly of the re-indexed invariant (WC2 C20; Spec 1 §54: `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3`). -/
theorem kInvCA_of {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s)
    (hf : WF3 s.flat ∧ I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ NoDangling s.flat ∧ KAux s.flat ∧
      HeldAnchored s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s) (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) : KInvCA s :=
  ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hf.1⟩, ⟨⟨hf.2.1, hf.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.1, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, hao, hf.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
    haoh, noOrphan_of_wf3 hf.1⟩, hf.2.2.2.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩

/-- The live frames of a nonempty frame structure are nonempty (WC2 C3). -/
theorem frames_ne {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) : s.frames ≠ [] := by
  intro he
  have h0 := hfr.initial
  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0

  · exact h0.elim
