import Ern.Concurrency.Frames

/-!
# Provisional by-value transmission at `spawn` (WC3 C5)

The composite of WC3 C5, a single transition with four ordered phases:

1. create (WC3 C5.1): the new context, its initial frame, its locals and their root authorities,
   without yielding the parameters (`spawnCreate`);
2. transfer (WC3 C5.2): each by-value argument `(source, destination)` in its declared order, by
   the effect of O4 (Spec 1 §63) executed by the creating context on the state produced by the
   earlier transfers (`transfersEff`); the clauses of O4 that are not resulting-state conditions
   are evaluated at the start of the corresponding transfer (`ValTransferPre`);
3. yield (WC3 C5.3): the parameters change holder to the new frame (`yieldEff`);
4. final checks (WC3 C5.4) on the final state.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Effects (WC3 C5 effects) -/

/-- Phase 1 of WC3 C5 (create): the effect of `spawn` (WC3 C4) with no parameter yielded. -/
def spawnCreate (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC := spawnEff s c [] ls

/-- Phase 2 of WC3 C5 (transfer): the effects of O4 (Spec 1 §63) executed by `c`, in the declared
order, each on the state produced by the earlier ones. -/
def transfersEff (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → SC
  | t, [] => t
  | t, v :: vs => transfersEff c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Phase 3 of WC3 C5 (yield): the parameters `ps` change holder to the frame `f` (WC3 C4 effect,
Spec 1 §72 effect); no right is created. -/
def yieldEff (t : SC) (ps : List Nat) (f : Nat) : SC :=
  { t with A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame f } else y) 0 t.A }

/-- Effect of the composite (WC3 C5.1–C5.3): create, the transfers of `vs`, then the yield of `ps`
to the new frame `nF`. -/
def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    SC :=
  yieldEff (transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs) ps s.nF

/-! ## Preconditions (WC3 C4, C5) -/

/-- WC3 C5 item 2: `dst` is a fresh root local of the initial frame of the new context (its leaves
are `Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
construction of `spawnCreate`). -/
def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i

/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC3 C5 item 2). -/
instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance

/-- The clauses of O4 (Spec 1 §63) for the by-value argument `(src, dst)`, executed by the creating
context `c`, at the start of its transfer phase in state `t` (WC3 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4): those
of `TransferPreC` other than the exercisable `Modify` over the destination (replaced by C5 item 2,
WC3 C5 item 3) and the resulting-state clauses; §63.8 is evaluated on the final state `fin` (WC3
C5.4). -/
structure ValTransferPre (k : K) (fin : S3) (t : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC3 C5 item 1, Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : (t.view c).Usable src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : (t.view c).Usable dst
  /-- WC3 C5.2, C5 item 1, Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` of the creating frame over the
  source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight (t.view c) .modify src
  /-- WC3 C5.2, Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (t.view c).P src dst
  /-- WC3 C5 item 1, Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, (t.view c).I l = .init
  /-- WC3 C5 item 2, Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P dst, (t.view c).I l ≠ .init
  /-- WC3 C5.2, Spec 1 §63.3: disjoint footprints. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (t.view c).P src dst
  /-- WC3 C5.2, C5 item 4, Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from
  outside the source, except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its
  origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
      RightChain (t.view c) g j
  /-- WC3 C5 item 4, Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (t.view c).pin l = false
  /-- WC3 C5 item 4, Spec 1 §63.6, first half: dependencies of the usable places following the
  value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (t.view c) src, (t.view c).Active x
  /-- WC3 C5 item 4, C5.4, Spec 1 §63.8: no authority held before the transfer by a part of the
  source covers, in the final state, a leaf of its holder. -/
  noSelfLock : ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((t.view c).A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn (t.view c).P src y.holder) False → ¬ SelfLock fin j

/-- Decidability of `ValTransferPre` (WC3 C5). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (fin : S3) (t : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (ValTransferPre k fin t c src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((t.view c).Usable src ∧ (t.view c).Usable dst ∧
    HasRight (t.view c) .modify src ∧ SameShape (t.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, (t.view c).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P dst, (t.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (t.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
        RightChain (t.view c) g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (t.view c).pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (t.view c) src, (t.view c).Active x) ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((t.view c).A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn (t.view c).P src y.holder) False →
        ¬ SelfLock fin j))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩⟩

/-- WC3 C5.2: every by-value argument satisfies `ValTransferPre` at the start of its transfer
phase, in the declared order, on the state produced by the earlier transfers. -/
def ValTransfersPre (k : K) (fin : S3) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => ValTransferPre k fin t c v.1 v.2 ∧
      ValTransfersPre k fin c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Decidability of `ValTransfersPre` (WC3 C5.2). -/
instance instDecidableValTransfersPre (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (fin : S3) (c : Nat) :
    (t : SC) → (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) → Decidable (ValTransfersPre k fin c t vs)
  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
  | t, v :: vs =>
    haveI := instDecidableValTransfersPre k fin c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (ValTransferPre k fin t c v.1 v.2 ∧ _))

/-- Preconditions of the by-value composite executed by `c` (WC3 C4.1, C4.3, C4.5, C4.6, C5.1–C5.4
and C5 items 1–5). C4.2 (fresh identities), C4.4 and C5 item 6 (no duplication) hold by
construction of `spawnValEff`; the preservation obligations of WC3 C4 and C5 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnValPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- WC3 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC3 C4.3, C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every parameter is an active derived authority held by the
  creating frame before the composite. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC3 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC3 C5 item 2: every destination is a fresh root local of the new frame. -/
  freshDst : ∀ v ∈ vs, FreshRootLocal s ls v.2
  /-- WC3 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4: the transfer phases. -/
  transfers : ValTransfersPre k (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
  /-- WC3 C5 item 5: no parameter covers a leaf of a by-value source, on the declared source
  footprints before consumption. -/
  paramsApart : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ v ∈ vs, ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P v.1
  /-- WC3 C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): the transmission of every parameter remains legal at the yield
  phase. -/
  paramsAtYield : ∀ a ∈ ps,
    OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
      y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC3 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.6, second half: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)
  /-- WC3 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.9: every destination is usable in the final state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : ∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2
  /-- WC3 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.3: origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of
  the new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC3 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.4 (`AnchorOrderHeld` on `ancestorC`) in the final state, which
  includes Spec 1 §63.7 for the moved held authorities. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)

/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPre` (WC3 C4, C5). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (∀ v ∈ vs, FreshRootLocal s ls v.2) ∧
    ValTransfersPre k (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs ∧
    (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ v ∈ vs, ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P v.1) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ ps,
      OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
        y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
        y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩⟩

/-- The by-value composite executed by `c` (WC3 C5): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not
live. -/
def SpawnValStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) o

/-! ## Verdict of the milestone-1 case D2 (WC3 C5 item 5) -/

namespace TransferWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples

/-- Statics of Spec 1 `Examples.st` with frame 0 deriving a `Modify` authority (3) over leaf 0
(Spec 1 §60). -/
def w0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify)

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples in
/-- WC3 C5 item 5: in `w0`, context 0 spawns a context transmitting authority 3 (a `Modify`
derivative over leaf 0, held by frame 0) and moving the value of place 0 into a fresh one-leaf local
(place 3) of the new frame. Authority 3 covers leaf 0 of the source: the composite is rejected. -/
theorem spawnVal_covering_rejected :
    ¬ SpawnValPre K0 w0 0 [3] [(none, 0)] [(0, 3)] ∧
    SpawnValStep K0 w0 0 [3] [(none, 0)] [(0, 3)] .reject :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide)⟩

open TransferWitness Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples in
/-- Positive twin of `spawnVal_covering_rejected` (WC3 C5): the same composite without the
parameter covering the source is `ok`; in its final state the source leaf 0 is `Moved` and the
destination leaf 3 is `Init` (WC3 C5 effect, Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem spawnVal_apart_ok :
    SpawnValStep K0 w0 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(0, 3)] (.ok (spawnValEff w0 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(0, 3)])) ∧
    (spawnValEff w0 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(0, 3)]).I 0 = .moved ∧
    (spawnValEff w0 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(0, 3)]).I 3 = .init :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Preservation
import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer

/-!
# Theorem 2 for the by-value composite (WC3 C5)

`spawnVal_preservesC`: the composite of WC3 C5, with the preconditions `SpawnValPre`, preserves the
re-indexed kernel invariant with the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`).

The yield of the parameters commutes with the transfers (`yield_transfers`): the parameters are
held by frames, which O4 does not move (Spec 1 §63 effect). The composite is therefore `spawn`
(WC3 C4) followed by the transfers. The anchor orders come from the final checks of WC3 C5.4; the
other invariants are carried phase by phase from the Spec 1 lemmas used by `transfer_preserves`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace TransferPreserveAux

open PreservationAux

/-! ## Yield and transfer commute -/

/-- `mapI` followed by `map` is `map` followed by `mapI` when the two functions commute on each
element. -/
theorem mapI_map_comm {F : Nat → Authority → Authority} {G : Authority → Authority} :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List Authority),
      (∀ (k : Nat) (y : Authority), l[k]? = some y → G (F (i + k) y) = F (i + k) (G y)) →
      (mapI F i l).map G = mapI F i (l.map G)
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, y :: l, h => by
    have h0 : G (F i y) = F i (G y) := by simpa using h 0 y rfl
    have ih := mapI_map_comm (i + 1) l fun k z hz => by
      have := h (k + 1) z (by simpa using hz)
      rwa [show i + (k + 1) = i + 1 + k by omega] at this
    simp only [mapI, List.map_cons, h0, ih]

/-- The yield function of `yieldEff` (WC3 C5.3). -/
def yieldF (ps : List Nat) (f : Nat) (j : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame f } else y

/-- The holder map of the transfer effect (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
def moveF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if heldIn P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo P src dst y.holder } else y

/-- A parameter held by a frame is not moved by a transfer, and keeps being held by a frame. -/
theorem yield_move_comm {P : List Place} {ps : List Nat} {f src dst : Nat} {t : SC}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) (k : Nat) (y : Authority)
    (hy : t.A[0 + k]? = some y) :
    moveF P src dst (yieldF ps f (0 + k) y) = yieldF ps f (0 + k) (moveF P src dst y) := by
  unfold yieldF moveF
  by_cases hk : 0 + k ∈ ps
  · obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp _ hk y hy
    simp [hk, hg, heldIn]
  · simp [hk]

/-- WC3 C5.2–C5.3: when the parameters are held by frames, yielding them before or after one
transfer gives the same state. -/
theorem yield_transfer {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f c src dst : Nat}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) :
    transferEffC (yieldEff t ps f) c src dst = yieldEff (transferEffC t c src dst) ps f := by
  have hA : (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A).map (moveF t.P src dst) =
      mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 (t.A.map (moveF t.P src dst)) :=
    mapI_map_comm 0 t.A fun k y hy => yield_move_comm hp k y hy
  simp only [transferEffC, yieldEff, SC.set, SC.view, SC.flat, transferEff] at hA ⊢
  unfold yieldF moveF at hA
  rw [hA]

/-- A transfer keeps the authorities held by frames (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_frame_held {t : SC} {c src dst a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : (transferEffC t c src dst).A[a]? = some y) :
    ∃ y₀, t.A[a]? = some y₀ ∧ ((∃ g, y₀.holder = .frame g) → y.holder = y₀.holder) := by
  have h : (transferEff (t.view c) src dst).A[a]? = some y := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at h
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨y₀, hy₀, fun ⟨g, hg⟩ => ?_⟩
  simp [hg, heldIn]

/-- WC3 C5.2–C5.3: yielding before the transfers gives the state of the composite. -/
theorem yield_transfers {ps : List Nat} {f c : Nat} :
    ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)),
      (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) →
      transfersEff c (yieldEff t ps f) vs = yieldEff (transfersEff c t vs) ps f
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | t, v :: vs, hp => by
    simp only [transfersEff]
    rw [yield_transfer hp]
    refine yield_transfers (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs fun a ha y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀
    exact ⟨g, by rw [e ⟨g, hg⟩, hg]⟩

/-- `mapI` with a function that is the identity on the indices of a list. -/
theorem mapI_id {F : Nat → Authority → Authority} :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List Authority), (∀ k y, F (i + k) y = y) → mapI F i l = l
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, y :: l, h => by
    have h0 : F i y = y := by simpa using h 0 y
    have ih := mapI_id (i + 1) l fun k z => by
      have := h (k + 1) z; rwa [show i + (k + 1) = i + 1 + k by omega] at this
    simp only [mapI, h0, ih]

/-- `mapI` over an append. -/
theorem mapI_append {F : Nat → Authority → Authority} :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l m : List Authority), mapI F i (l ++ m) = mapI F i l ++ mapI F (i + l.length) m
  | i, [], m => by simp [mapI]
  | i, y :: l, m => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, mapI, mapI_append (i + 1) l m, List.length_cons]
    rw [show i + 1 + l.length = i + (l.length + 1) by omega]

/-- WC3 C5.1, C5.3: creating without parameters then yielding them is `spawn` with the
parameters (WC3 C4 effect), when the parameters are existing authorities. -/
theorem create_yield {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length) :
    yieldEff (spawnCreate s c ls) ps s.nF = spawnEff s c ps ls := by
  have h0 : mapI (fun j (y : Authority) => if j ∈ ([] : List Nat) then
      { y with holder := .frame (s.view c).nF } else y) 0 s.A = s.A :=
    mapI_id 0 s.A fun _ _ => by simp
  simp only [yieldEff, spawnCreate, spawnEff, SC.set, enterEff]
  rw [h0, mapI_append, mapI_id (F := fun j (y : Authority) =>
    if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) (0 + s.A.length) _ fun k y => by
      have : 0 + s.A.length + k ∉ ps := fun h => by have := hp _ h; omega
      simp [this]]
  rfl

/-! ## The kernel invariant without the anchor orders -/

/-- The clauses of `KInvCA` other than the anchor orders (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed, WC3 C20). -/
def KBase (s : SC) : Prop :=
  FramesC s ∧ (WF3 s.flat ∧ I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ NoDangling s.flat ∧
    KAux s.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s.flat)

/-- The kernel facts of Spec 1 on the view of a context, from `KBase` (WC3 C2). -/
theorem view_facts_base {s : SC} (hk : KBase s) (c : Nat) :
    WF3 (s.view c) ∧ Inv3base (s.view c) ∧ NoDangling (s.view c) ∧ RootHeldConv (s.view c) ∧
      HeldAnchored (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨hfr, hw, h1, h2, h3, hnd, hc, hh⟩ := hk
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.flat.F := fun f => SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨SC.wf3_view hfr hw, ⟨h1, h2, i3_mem_congr h3 hF, i4_always _⟩,
    noDangling_mem_congr hnd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- `spawn` (WC3 C4 effect) establishes `KBase` from `KInvCA`, without the resulting-state
condition §72.4 (WC3 C4.5), which the composite checks on its final state. -/
theorem spawn_base {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (hc : s.stk c ≠ []) (hpar : ParamsOK (s.view c) ps) (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape) :
    KBase (spawnEff s c ps ls) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hrc, hh⟩ := view_facts hk c
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1
  have hpush := spawn_push (ps := ps) (ls := ls) hfr hc
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).F ↔ f ∈ (spawnEff s c ps ls).frames :=
    fun f => by
      rw [hpush.mem]
      show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
      rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]
  have hne : (spawnEff s c ps ls).frames ≠ [] := fun he => by
    have := (hpush.mem s.nF).2 (.inl rfl); rw [he] at this; cases this
  exact ⟨hpush.framesC hfr, flat_facts rfl hmem hpush.nodup hne (enter_wf' hw hpar hsh)
    (Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Frames.enter_inv3base hw hb) (enter_noDangling' hw hd hsh)
    (enter_rootHeldConv' hw hpar hrc) (enter_heldAnchored' hw hh)⟩

/-- One transfer (Spec 1 §63 effect) keeps `KBase`, from §63.1 usability, §63.2, §63.3
disjointness, §63.6 first half and the usability of the destination after the step. -/
theorem transfer_base {t : SC} {c src dst : Nat} (hk : KBase t) (hsrc : (t.view c).Usable src)
    (hdst : (t.view c).Usable dst) (hdeps : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (t.view c) src, (t.view c).Active x)
    (hsh : SameShape (t.view c).P src dst) (hdis : ¬ overlap (t.view c).P src dst)
    (hd' : (transferEff (t.view c) src dst).Usable dst) : KBase (transferEffC t c src dst) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hc, hh⟩ := view_facts_base hk c
  have hw' := transfer_wf3' hw hsrc hdst hd'
  obtain ⟨hb', hd''⟩ := transfer_base' hw hb hd hsrc hdeps hd'
  have hh' := transfer_heldAnchored' hw hh hsrc hdst hsh hdis
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ (transferEff (t.view c) src dst).F ↔ f ∈ t.frames := fun _ =>
    SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨framesC_set hk.1 rfl, flat_facts rfl hmem hk.1.nodup (frames_ne hk.1) hw' hb' hd''
    (transfer_rootHeldConv' hc) hh'⟩

/-! ## Destinations -/

/-- Place `q` exists and is owned by a frame (Spec 1 §40). -/
def FrameOwned (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (P[q]?) (fun pl => ∃ g, pl.owner = .frame g) False

/-- A transfer keeps the places owned by frames (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_frameOwned {v : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (h : FrameOwned v.P q) :
    FrameOwned (transferEff v src dst).P q := by
  unfold FrameOwned at h ⊢
  rw [transfer_P_get]
  cases hq : v.P[q]? with
  | none => rw [hq] at h; exact h.elim
  | some pl =>
    rw [hq] at h
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h
    exact ⟨g, by simp [hg, heldIn]⟩

/-- A usable place owned by a frame stays usable after a transfer (Spec 1 §40, §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_usable_frameOwned {v : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (h : v.Usable q)
    (ho : FrameOwned v.P q) : (transferEff v src dst).Usable q := by
  cases h with
  | @frame q g pl hpl hd hog hf =>
    refine .frame (pl := pl) ?_ hd hog hf
    rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [hog, heldIn]
  | @place q o pl hpl hd hoo hu =>
    unfold FrameOwned at ho; rw [hpl] at ho
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ho; rw [hoo] at hg; cases hg

/-- The fresh root locals of `spawn` are owned by the new frame (Spec 1 §72 effect,
`LocalShape.toShape`). -/
theorem spawn_frameOwned {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {dst : Nat}
    (h : FreshRootLocal s ls dst) : FrameOwned (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h
  have hil : i < ls.length := by
    have := (List.mem_filter.1 hi).1
    simpa [LocalShape.toShape] using List.mem_range.1 this
  unfold FrameOwned
  show OptP ((enterP (s.view c) ls)[s.P.length + i]?) _ False
  simp only [enterP, shapeP, SC.view, SC.flat]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range
    (by simpa [LocalShape.toShape] using hil), Option.map_some, OptP]
  exact ⟨s.nF, by simp [shapeOwner, LocalShape.toShape, List.getElem?_map, hil]⟩

/-! ## The transfer phases -/

/-- The clauses of `ValTransferPre` read by `transfer_base` hold on the state where the
parameters are already yielded: they read neither holders nor exercise. -/
theorem yield_view {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f c : Nat} :
    (yieldEff t ps f).view c = { t.view c with A := mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A } := rfl

/-- `Active` is unchanged by the yield (WC3 C5.3). -/
theorem yield_active {v : S3} {ps : List Nat} {f x : Nat} :
    ({ v with A := mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A } : S3).Active x ↔ v.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    change (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A)[x]? = some y at hy
    rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    refine ⟨y₀, hy₀, ?_⟩
    unfold yieldF at ya; split at ya <;> exact ya
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    refine ⟨yieldF ps f (0 + x) y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A)[x]? = _
      rw [getElem?_mapI, hy]; rfl
    · unfold yieldF; split <;> exact ya

/-- Theorem 2 along the transfer phases (WC3 C5.2): from a state where the parameters are
yielded and `KBase` holds, the transfers keep `KBase`, given the destination of each transfer
owned by a frame. -/
theorem transfers_base {k : K} {fin : S3} {c f : Nat} {ps : List Nat} :
    ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)), ValTransfersPre k fin c t vs →
      KBase (yieldEff t ps f) → (∀ v ∈ vs, FrameOwned t.P v.2) →
      (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) →
      KBase (yieldEff (transfersEff c t vs) ps f)
  | _, [], _, hk, _, _ => hk
  | t, v :: vs, ⟨hpre, hrest⟩, hk, hown, hp => by
    simp only [transfersEff]
    have hu : ∀ q, ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).Usable q ↔ (t.view c).Usable q := fun q =>
      S3.Usable.congr rfl rfl rfl
    have hdeps : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps ((yieldEff t ps f).view c) v.1,
        ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).Active x := by
      intro x hx
      rw [yield_view, yield_active]
      have : movedDeps ((yieldEff t ps f).view c) v.1 = movedDeps (t.view c) v.1 := by
        unfold movedDeps
        congr 1
        exact List.filter_congr fun q _ => by rw [hu q]
      rw [this] at hx
      exact hpre.depsValid x hx
    have hown₀ : FrameOwned ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).P v.2 := hown v (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hk₁ := transfer_base hk ((hu _).2 hpre.srcUsable) ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hdeps
      hpre.sameShape hpre.disjoint
      (transfer_usable_frameOwned ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hown₀)
    rw [yield_transfer hp] at hk₁
    refine transfers_base (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs hrest hk₁ (fun w hw => ?_)
      (fun a ha y hy => ?_)
    · exact transfer_frameOwned (hown w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw))
    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀
      exact ⟨g, by rw [e ⟨g, hg⟩, hg]⟩

end TransferPreserveAux

open PreservationAux TransferPreserveAux

/-- Theorem 2 (WC3 C4, C5, C20, C23) for the by-value composite: `SpawnValPre` and `KInvCA` before
the composite give `KInvCA` after it. The anchor orders are the final checks of WC3 C5.4
(`SpawnValPre.anchorOrder`, `SpawnValPre.anchorOrderHeld`). -/
theorem spawnVal_preservesC {k : K} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} (hk : KInvCA s) (h : SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s')) :
    KInvCA s' := by

# Spec 2, jalon 1 — passe corrective WC3

Branche `formal/spec2-m1`, formalisation exploratoire. Candidate : `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC3_corrige.md` (WC3, non commitée), qui remplace WC2. Spec 1 : `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`.

Commits de la passe :

| Commit | Contenu |
|---|---|
| `c4c6e4d` | Définitions alignées sur WC3 (`Sync`, `SyncLib`, `Frames`, `Transfer`) et adaptation des modules dépendants |
| `e1e3a84` | Trace S4 |
| `b0af112` | Références WC2 → WC3 dans les docstrings ; P1 sur `SC.view` |
| `5b66e86` | `TransferPreserve.lean` : `spawnVal_preservesC` |
| `9c0e6f7` | `deriveSync_breaks_i2_false` |

Écart de méthode : la consigne « commit à chaque module compilant » n'a pas pu être suivie pour les quatre modules de définitions. Le changement de signature de `KC`, `NewMutexOk`, `ResetLockOk` et `DeriveSyncPre` casse tous les modules en aval. Le premier commit regroupe donc les quatre modules et leurs adaptations. C'est le premier état où `lake build` passe.

## 1. Passages lus

- **WC3** : lu en entier.
- **Spec 1** : §43, §44, §45, §46, §51, §55, §56, §57, §60, §61, §62, §63, §64, §65, §68, §72, §73, §78.

## 2. Définitions modifiées

| Définition | Avant (WC2) | Après (WC3) | Clause |
|---|---|---|---|
| `KC` (`Sync.lean:23`) | `structure KC extends K`, `SyncAuthorized : SC → Nat → Nat → Prop` | `structure KC (R : Type) extends K`, `SyncAuthorized : R → SC → Nat → Nat → Prop`. Le noyau n'importe pas `SyncLib` ; `libKC k L : KC SyncReg` | C2, C14 |
| `DeriveSyncPre` (`Sync.lean:36`) | 8 champs, `authorized : kc.SyncAuthorized s g top` | 9 champs : ajout de `mode : OptP (A[g]?) (fun y => Mode.modify.le y.mode) False` ; `authorized : kc.SyncAuthorized r s g top`. Le reste est inchangé | C15.1–C15.6 |
| `DeriveSyncStep`, `CStepS` | `kc` | `kc r` (registre explicite) | C14, C15 |
| `SyncInv` (`SyncLib.lean:169`) | `guarded`, `grant`, `control`, `unique` (C21.1, .2, .3, .5 de WC2) | 7 champs : `guarded` (C21.1), `grant` (C21.2), `control` (C21.3), `ctlUnique` (C21.4, 1ʳᵉ phrase, nouvelle définition `CtlUnique`), `unique` (C21.4, 2ᵉ phrase), `grantSubtree` (C21.5), `regBound` (C21.6, sur toutes les entrées) | C21 |
| `GrantSubtree`, `RegBound`, ancien `SyncState` (`SyncPreserve.lean`) | auxiliaires hors WC2 | supprimés, intégrés à `SyncInv`. `SyncState := SyncInv ∧ GrantDiscipline` | C21.5, C21.6 |
| `NewMutexPreBase` → `NewMutexPre` (`SyncLib.lean:209`) | 7 champs, sans `k` | paramètre `k : K`, 10 champs. Ajouts : C13.3, le contrôleur est aussi *utilisable* ; `disjointM`, `footprint(guarded) ∩ footprint(M) = ∅` avec `M = mutexOf s g`, le parent structurel de `slot` (C13.4) ; `sharedMutable : K.SharedMutable(ctl)` (C13.6) ; `ctlUnique`, pas d'autre entrée vivante sur `ctl` (C13.8). `available : NoCoveringDesc` est maintenant cité en C13.9 | C13 |
| `NewMutexOk` | `L adm s reg c g` | `k L adm s reg c g` | C13 |
| `UnlockOk` (`SyncLib.lean:274`) | inchangée | inchangée. Vérification clause par clause : C17.1 `e.Live ∧ grant = some g` ; C17.2 et C17.3 = `ReleasePre` (O3 §62.1–§62.4, dont `noActiveDesc` et `anchors`) ; C17.4 = `CtrlRight`. Aucun écart ; seule la docstring change (la mise à jour du contrôleur est une obligation de réalisation) | C17 |
| `ResetLockOk` (`SyncLib.lean:284`) | sans `L`, C18.1 et C18.2 | paramètre `L`, ajout de `OptP (ControlOf L s e) (Usable ∧ isLeaf) False` (C18.3, voir problème W3) | C18 |
| `Encap` (`SyncLib.lean:332`) | — | définition inchangée ; docstring : C22.1, C22.2, C22.3 ; C22.4 sans contenu dans `S_C` (Spec 1 §41) | C22 |
| `JoinStep` (`Frames.lean:407`) | constructeur `ok` seulement | ajout de `reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject` ; un contexte vivant n'a toujours pas d'issue | C8 |
| `SpawnPreBase` → `SpawnPre` (`Frames.lean:318`) | mêmes 5 champs | renommée ; docstrings C4.1, C4.3, C4.5 (voir §3) | C4 |
| Composite par valeur (`Transfer.lean`) | `spawnValEff` = `spawnEff` puis O4 ; `SpawnValPreBase` incomplète ; deux lectures `SrcRightBefore` et `SrcRightAfterSpawn` ; pas de relation | réécrit : `spawnCreate` (C5.1), `transfersEff` dans l'ordre déclaré (C5.2), `yieldEff` (C5.3), `spawnValEff` ; `ValTransferPre` évaluée au début de chaque phase de transfert ; `ValTransfersPre` récursive ; `SpawnValPre` (11 champs) ; relation `SpawnValStep`. `SrcRight*`, `readings_differ` et `readingA_final` sont supprimés | C4, C5 |

Détail de `SpawnValPre` (`Transfer.lean:130`) :

- **Avant le composite** : `creatorLive` (C4.1) ; `params` (C4.3, C5.3) ; `localsOK` (C4.5).
- **Destinations** : `freshDst` (C5 item 2).
- **Phases de transfert** (`transfers`, C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4) :
  - par argument : §63.1 côté source (usable, droit `Modify`) et côté destination (usable seulement) ;
  - §63.2, §63.3, §63.4, §63.5, et §63.6 première moitié ;
  - §63.8, lu sur l'état final.
- **Paramètres** : `paramsApart`, test sur les footprints des sources dans l'état avant le composite (C5 item 5) ; `paramsAtYield` (C5.3).
- **État final** (C5.4) :
  - `anchorOrder` (§63.6) ;
  - `dstUsableAfter` (§63.9) ;
  - `originHidden`, O6.3 vu depuis le contexte créé ;
  - `anchorOrderHeld`, O6.4, qui contient §63.7.

P1 (`Context.lean`, `Frames.lean`) :

- **Confirmation.** `alloc` exécuté par `c` passe par `ViewStep`, qui évalue `AllocStep` sur `s.view c`.
- **Théorèmes.** `alloc_ok_satisfiable` (`Frames.lean:282`) et `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable` l'énoncent.
- **Docstring.** Celle de `SC.view` cite C2 (P1).

## 3. `SpawnPre` comparée à `EnterPre`

| `EnterPre` (`Access/Ops.lean:498`) | `SpawnPre` | Différence |
|---|---|---|
| `callerLive : s.F ≠ []` (§72.1) | `creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []` (C4.1) | réindexation (pile locale de `c`) |
| `params` sur `s` (§72.1) | `params` sur `s.view c` (C4.3) | aucune autre |
| `localsOK` (§72.2) | `localsOK` (C4.5) | identique |
| `originHidden` sur `enterEff s ps ls` (§72.3) | `originHidden` sur `(spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length` (C4.5) | état final vu depuis le contexte créé (C4.5) au lieu du contexte appelant |
| `anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff …)` (§72.4) | `AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff …)` (C4.5) | sur `ancestorC` |

- **Clauses ajoutées.** Aucune : `SpawnPreBase` avait déjà les cinq clauses.
- **Placement sur la pile.** `spawnEff` crée une pile `[nF]` au lieu d'empiler `nF`.
- **§72.2 « modes, footprints, anchoring, parameter-passing ».** Cette partie n'est représentée ni dans `EnterPre` (sa docstring le dit) ni dans `SpawnPre`.
- **C4.2 et C4.4.** Elles tiennent par construction de `spawnEff`.

## 4. Théorèmes

Vérifications :

- `lake build` réussit, sans avertissement.
- Le `grep` d'`AGENTS.md` est vide ; aucun `noncomputable`.
- Audit `collectAxioms` sur les 746 théorèmes `Ern.Concurrency*` : aucun axiome hors `{propext, Quot.sound}`.
- `#print axioms` sur `spawnVal_preservesC`, `transfer_merges_controllers`, `realizability`, `encapsulated_inv`, `encapsulated_inv_noTransfer`, `lstep_ctlUnique`, `s4_detached_child`, `conservative_deriveSync`, `deriveSync_observe_rejected` et `deriveSync_breaks_i2_false` donne `[propext, Quot.sound]`.

### T1 (conservativité)

- **`syncAuthorized_false`, `conservative_deriveSync`** (`SyncLib.lean:376`) : re-prouvés.
  - Les deux portent maintenant sur `kc : KC SyncReg`.
  - Le registre passé à `SyncAuthorized` est celui de `SyncSound kc reg s` : `¬ kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f` et `¬ DeriveSyncStep kc reg s c g (.ok s')`.
- **Autres énoncés de `Conservativity.lean`** : inchangés. `git diff 14d2541 HEAD` ne montre que des docstrings dans `Conservativity.lean`, `Context.lean` et `Reparent.lean`.

### T2 (préservation de `KInvCA`)

- **`deriveSync_preservesC`** (`Preservation.lean:1857`) : re-prouvé sans l'hypothèse `hmode`, pour tout `R`, `kc : KC R` et `r : R`. Le mode vient de `DeriveSyncPre.mode` (C15.1). Énoncé modifié : une hypothèse en moins.
- **`lstep_kInvCA`** (`Reachable.lean:28`) : re-prouvé sans l'hypothèse `SyncInv`, qui ne servait qu'au mode. Énoncé modifié : une hypothèse en moins. Le lemme `guarded_mode` est supprimé.
- **`spawn_preservesC`** sur `SpawnPre` : preuve inchangée.
- **`join_preservesC`** : preuve inchangée ; le cas `reject` n'a pas d'issue `ok`.
- **`spawnVal_preservesC`** (`TransferPreserve.lean:299`) : **nouveau, prouvé**. `KInvCA s → SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s') → KInvCA s'`, sans hypothèse supplémentaire. Structure de la preuve :
  1. La cession commute avec chaque transfert (`yield_transfer`, `yield_transfers`) : les paramètres sont tenus par des frames, et O4 ne déplace que les autorités tenues par des parties de la source.
  2. Création puis cession égale `spawnEff` avec paramètres (`create_yield`).
  3. Les invariants hors ordres d'ancrage (`KBase`) passent de `spawn` aux transferts. La preuve réutilise `transfer_wf3'`, `transfer_base'`, `transfer_heldAnchored'` et `transfer_rootHeldConv'`.
  4. L'utilisabilité de chaque destination après son transfert vient de ce qu'elle appartient à une frame (`spawn_frameOwned`, `transfer_usable_frameOwned`).
  5. `AnchorOrderC` et `AnchorOrderHeldC` sont les vérifications finales de C5.4.

### T4 (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`)

**Réfuté pour la clause C21.4, première phrase (unicité des contrôleurs) ; prouvé pour toutes les autres clauses.** Contre-exemple : problème W1 (§6).

- **`lstep_preserves`** (`SyncPreserve.lean:1291`) : énoncé modifié.
  - Conclusion : `SyncCore`, toutes les clauses de `SyncInv` sauf `ctlUnique`, plus `GrantDiscipline`. Elle vaut pour tout pas sous `Encap`.
  - `SyncCore` (`SyncPreserve.lean:60`) et `syncState_iff : SyncState ↔ SyncCore ∧ CtlUnique` sont nouveaux.
- **`lstep_ctlUnique`** (`SyncPreserve.lean:1325`) : nouveau. Tout pas sous `Encap` dont l'étiquette n'est pas un `transfer` noyau préserve `CtlUnique`. `newMutex` utilise C13.8.
- **`lstep_syncState`** (nouveau) : `SyncState` est préservé par tout pas encapsulé qui n'est pas un `transfer`.
- **`trace_preserves`** : énoncé modifié, `SyncCore` le long de toute trace encapsulée.
- **`trace_syncState`** (nouveau) : `SyncState` le long des traces encapsulées sans `transfer`.
- **`trace_inv`, `encapsulated_inv`** (`Reachable.lean:52`, `:101`) : énoncés modifiés, conclusion `KInvCA` (ou `KInvC`) et `SyncCore`.
- **`trace_inv_noTransfer`, `encapsulated_inv_noTransfer`** (nouveaux) : `KInvC ∧ SyncInv ∧ GrantDiscipline` sur les traces encapsulées sans `transfer`.
- **`init_inv`** : re-prouvé avec `SyncState` étendu.

- `M′ = {slot′, lock′}`, champs `Uninit`, avec `T′` possédée par `slot′` : `guarded₂` = autorité racine 3, tenue par `slot′`.

# ERN — Concurrency Model Specification v0
## WC3.1 — Targeted Corrections

**Status:** Non-normative design candidate — pending validation and exploratory formalization.

**Basis:** Working Candidate 3 and formalization report `spec2-m1-wc3.md`.

These corrections replace only the corresponding provisions of WC3. All unaffected provisions remain unchanged.

### C13 — `newMutex` Construction

Add a construction precondition:

Every structural leaf in `footprint(M)` MUST be `Init` before `newMutex` succeeds. Construction does not implicitly initialize these leaves.

Storage merely owned by `M`, but not structurally included in `footprint(M)`, is not subject to this requirement solely by virtue of ownership.

### C21 — `SyncInv`

Add an initialization invariant:

For every live synchronization entry, all structural leaves of its `guarded`-holding field `slot`, and its associated controller leaf `ctl`, MUST remain `Init`.

Preservation of this property by every permitted transition is a proof obligation, not a transition precondition that may be assumed without justification.

### C22.3 — Encapsulation of Transfers

Replace the transfer restriction with:

While a synchronization entry is live, the safe mutex abstraction MUST prevent an independent `transfer` whose source is:

1. The field `slot` holding `guarded`;
2. Any strict structural subplace of `slot`;
3. The associated controller leaf `ctl`.

A transfer of the complete mutex value `M`, or of a structurally enclosing value, remains eligible for O4 under its own unchanged preconditions.

Preservation of `SyncInv`, including controller uniqueness, controller association, and initialization, by such transfers is a proof obligation.

This restriction belongs to the safe mutex abstraction. It does not modify the ordinary authorization rules or outcomes of O4.

### C15.3 — Authorization of `deriveSync`

Clarify:

`deriveSync` is authorized exclusively through `K_C.SyncAuthorized`.

Neither ordinary holder-based alternative of `ExercisableAt` independently authorizes `deriveSync`.

Ordinary derivation through O1 remains available under its unchanged preconditions.

The source activity, own-mode, origin-chain, effective-mode, and exclusivity requirements specified elsewhere in C15 remain unchanged.

### C18.3 — `resetLock` Controller Validity

Clarify:

The associated `ControlOf(entry)` MUST resolve to an existing usable controller leaf satisfying the controller-validity requirements of C21.

This condition does not replace the separate recovery-authority and active-descendant requirements.

### C5.3 — Value Transmission and Parameter Yielding

Clarify:

At the beginning of the parameter-yield phase, every transmitted authority MUST satisfy the active, derived, and creator-frame-held requirements corresponding to Spec 1 §72.1, evaluated in the state produced by the preceding value transfers.

All other conditions of the composite by-value `spawn` remain unchanged.

### Interface and Realization Obligations

The following provisions remain explicit interface or realization obligations, rather than properties claimed to be established by the abstract authority state `S_C` alone:

- C13.3: Non-falsifiability through the safe abstraction interface.
- C13.6: Enforcement of the controller synchronization protocol.
- C13.10: Correspondence with the initial physical controller state.
- C22.4: Exclusion of unauthorized ordinary writes to the physical controller.
- C17 and C18: Concrete synchronization-state updates and their atomic realization.

### Formalization Coverage

The combined trace model MUST include the by-value `spawn` transition in `LStep`.

The corrective verification must establish preservation of the complete `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline` for every transition admitted by the encapsulation contract, including `transfer` and by-value `spawn`.

In particular, the initialization invariant must be checked against every applicable inherited kernel operation O1–O16 and every new candidate transition.

If a permitted operation violates the invariant, the formalization MUST report a concrete counterexample, identify the enabling rule, and leave the corresponding corrective design decision open. No additional encapsulation restriction may be introduced silently.

A proof restricted to traces without `transfer`, without by-value `spawn`, or to a weakened synchronization invariant does not discharge this obligation.

---

**End of WC3.1 — Targeted Corrections.**

**No normative stabilization is proposed.**

result.output:
## 40. Logical Places, Leaves, and Ownership

A place has an identity, optionally a structural parent, an abstract `kind`, an owner `owner : Frame | Place`, and a logical death marker. Structural parenthood `partOf(p,q)` describes the subplaces of a value; `owner` describes **who keeps the storage** of a root place valid. An owned place may lie outside its owner's direct footprint; ownership and composition are therefore distinct.

A **leaf** is a place with no structural children. `footprint(p)` contains the leaves of `p`, and access rights over a place are evaluated on those leaves. Places transitively owned by a value are not automatically leaves of its `footprint`. A logical unit of the access discipline does not automatically constitute an additional allocation in the elementary memory machine.

A place `p` is **usable** (`Usable(s,p)`) if and only if:

1. `p` exists and is not marked dead;
2. if its owner is a frame, that frame belongs to the stack;
3. if its owner is a place `q`, then `q` is itself usable and the chain terminates at a frame in the stack.

An ownership cycle makes no place usable. `placeFrame(p)` is the terminal frame of this chain when `p` is usable. Structural parts share their parent's owner and death marker. A value may be logically ended by `endUse` without the place that contained it becoming unusable; the substorages it owned may, however, die.

## 49. WF3 — Well-Formedness of Frames, Places, and Authorities

`WF3(s)` is a **predicate on state `s`**. It jointly requires:

1. a nonempty, duplicate-free frame stack, every frame having a valid identity and, except for the base frame, a valid parent; frame-parent relations are well-founded;
2. a place structure whose composition links are valid and **acyclic**; every structural part shares its parent's owner and death marker;
3. valid owners of type frame or place, and **well-founded** ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place;
4. footprints consisting exclusively of leaves of existing places;
5. authorities with valid identities and modes, whose existing origins form **acyclic** chains ending at a root authority;
6. `RootChain`: every origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root of the **same structural root place** as that leaf;
7. `RootHeld`: every usable root place has its active root `Modify` authority, with no origin, held exactly by its owner;
8. holder validity: every active authority is held by a frame present in the stack or by a usable place.

Numerical ordering of identifiers, parent precedence over child in a list, and bounds on generated identifiers may be used **to represent or prove** this well-formedness in a formalization; they are not normative restrictions on place or authority identities. Preservation of `WF3` by a transition is a **required property of transitions**, not an additional clause of the state predicate. `WF3` does not impose any particular physical object layout: that belongs to refinement into the elementary memory machine.

## 50. I1 — Structural Exclusivity

For two active authorities **unrelated by derivation** covering the same leaf, their own modes must both be `Observe`. This rule also applies to leaves identified as `SharedMutable`; their particular mutation is governed by the `writeShared` contract and creates no exception to I1.

Exclusivity of **effective** modes (`effective_exclusive`) is a consequence of I1 and the definition of `effective`, not the definition of I1. On a leaf, two incompatible authorities cannot simultaneously possess incompatible effective rights. The only permitted independent ordinary coexistence is `Observe` / `Observe`.

## 69. O12 — Logical End of a Value's Use

**Preconditions**

1. `place` is usable and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over it.
2. No active descendant over the leaves of `place` **or storage that dies with it** is held outside the places dying with `place`, in a way that would prevent rights from returning or being invalidated. The authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`, namely the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain, are exempt from this check. Moreover, no authority that the effect makes inactive (held by `place` or by a place dying with it, transitively owned storage included) has an active descendant, whatever its footprint, that the same step does not make inactive.
3. No place **remaining usable after the effect** depends on an authority held by `place`, its root, or an authority that would become inactive when an owned holder dies.
4. **No leaf whose use ends, including transitively owned storage, is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). A dynamic pinning obligation must be legally removed by `unpin` before this step.

**`ok` effect:** The leaves of value `place` become `Uninit`; `place` **remains usable as a place** and may legally be reinitialized. Authorities held by `place` and dead substorages are released; dependencies of the ended value are removed; transitively owned places that cease to live are marked dead. The operation does not automatically trigger physical deallocation in the elementary memory machine: an unfreed allocation may constitute a leak, which this guarantee does not prohibit. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 70. O13 — Release of an Owned Storage Unit

**Preconditions**

1. `place` is a **root of storage owned by a value** (`OwnedRoot`), not an ordinary local directly owned by a frame and not part of an aggregate.
2. `K.Deallocable(place)` is established, and `K.FreeCompat(place,auth)` justifies deallocation authority `auth`; this identifier is opaque to the authority kernel.
3. The current frame has exercisable `Modify`; no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside holders that die; no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released region or of its dead holders. The authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`, namely the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain, are exempt from the check on active derivatives. Moreover, no authority that the effect makes inactive (an authority of the released region, its root included, or an authority whose holder dies) has an active descendant, whatever its footprint, that the same step does not make inactive.
4. No leaf of the released unit is statically or dynamically pinned. Ending external use does not silently turn a still-pinned leaf into a releasable unit.

**`ok` effect:** `place` and the storage that ceases to live are marked dead; authorities of those regions, including their corresponding roots, become inactive, as do authorities whose holders die. Surviving dependencies must remain valid. Every realization of `free` must satisfy the corresponding deallocation relation of the elementary memory machine (Part III). **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 71. O14 — Allocation of a New Storage Root

**Static preconditions**

1. `shape` is a **nonempty** abstract shape, represented like the local places of `enterFrame`; an allocation of **zero physical size** may be represented by a logical one-leaf shape.
2. The provider is a usable place, and **all leaves of the provider** are `Init`; updates to its metadata are permitted through exercisable `Modify` or a valid `writeShared` over `SharedMutable` metadata.
## 76. O17 — Creation of an Administered Arena

**Preconditions**

1. `storage` is an existing, usable place under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. It may be local, static, allocated, or a block issued by a previous arena.
2. `internal` is explicitly named by the caller, exists, is active, has own mode `Modify`, and `ExercisableAt(s,internal,Modify)` holds.
3. `internal` is **held by a place**: that place is the arena value; `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)`.
4. **Unified administration guard (Section 56):** no **live** administrative abstraction, whether an arena or a library instance such as a handle pool, already uses this `internal` identity. The relevant registries of library administrations are consulted before registration. Two distinct identities may cover common leaves: this is not in itself grounds for rejection.
5. All leaves of the arena value holding `internal` are already `Init`; construction does not initialize them implicitly.
6. Dependency, holder, storage, and administration relations respect, in the resulting state, `WF3`, I1, `AnchorOrder`, and `AnchorOrderHeld` over the whole kernel state, and the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (Section 55).

**`ok` effect:** A live entry `{storage, internal, available, issued}` is added; the initial `available` set represents the administered storage, and `issued` is initially empty. Registering the entry fabricates no place, access right, or `Init` state. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

The identity of `internal`, not the index of `storage`, is the key to preventing duplication of live administrations. No global constraint requires footprints of live arenas to be pairwise disjoint.

instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC3 C22). -/
def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded

/-- WC3 C21.4, first sentence: distinct live entries (by position in the registry) have distinct
`ControlOf` leaves. -/
def CtlUnique (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry) (ctl : Nat), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s → ControlOf L s e = some ctl → ControlOf L s e' = some ctl → i = j

/-- `SyncInv` (WC3 C21.1–C21.6), items 1–5 over live entries, item 6 over every entry. -/
structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
  /-- WC3 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
  place. -/
  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC3 C21.2: a recorded grant exists, has origin `guarded` and footprint
  `footprint(guarded)`. -/
  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  /-- WC3 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC3 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
  leaf. -/
  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC3 C21.4, first sentence: controller uniqueness among live entries. -/
  ctlUnique : CtlUnique L s reg
  /-- WC3 C21.4, second sentence (the guarded-identity uniqueness guard of WC3 C13.7): distinct
  live entries have distinct `guarded` identities. -/
  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
  /-- WC3 C21.5, `GrantSubtree`. -/
  grantSubtree : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  /-- WC3 C21.6, `RegBound`, over every entry: the registered `guarded` identity exists (Spec 1
  §38: identities are indices). -/
  regBound : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length

/-! ## Derived operations (WC3 C13, C16–C18) -/

/-- The mutex value `M` of WC3 C12, C13: the immediate structural parent of the place `slot`
holding `guarded`. -/
def mutexOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=

/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC3 C22, C23) -/

/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
inductive Label where
  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | terminate (c : Nat)
  | join (c d : Nat)
  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
  | acquire (c i : Nat)
  | unlock (c i : Nat)
  | resetLock (c i : Nat)

/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC3 C2, C4,
C6–C8, C13, C15–C18): kernel and frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` on the current registry (WC3 C14). -/
inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L) reg s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      NewMutexOk k L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'

/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC3 C22, C23): for each live
entry, WC3 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`) and C22.3 (`transfer` whose source
is the place holding `guarded`, compared by equality). WC3 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) has no
content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1 §41), and is not represented. -/
def Encap (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
      (st.1.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src)
  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
  | _ => True

/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : LRun k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib

/-!
# Preservation of the synchronization invariants (WC3 C21–C23)

Theorem 4 of the exploratory pass, preservation half, for `SyncInv` (WC3 C21.1–C21.6) and
`GrantDiscipline` (WC3 C22) under the encapsulation hypothesis `Encap` (WC3 C22.1–C22.3):

* every clause other than controller uniqueness (WC3 C21.4, first sentence) is preserved by every
  labelled step (`lstep_preserves`, on `SyncCore`);
* controller uniqueness is preserved by every labelled step other than a kernel `transfer`
  (`lstep_ctlUnique`); `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.transfer_merges_controllers` is an
  encapsulated `transfer(M, M′)` after which it fails.

The kernel facts about the states before and after a step (`WF3`) are hypotheses supplied by
theorem 2 (preservation of the re-indexed kernel invariant).

`newMutex_nonleaf_rejected` shows the role of the leaf clause of `NewMutexPre.control` (WC3 C12,
C13.3): a positional controller that is not a leaf would break `SyncInv.control`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The invariant of theorem 4: `SyncInv` (WC3 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC3 C22). -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg

def SyncCore (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg

/-- `SyncState` is `SyncCore` with controller uniqueness (WC3 C21, C22). -/
theorem syncState_iff {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    SyncState L s reg ↔ SyncCore L s reg ∧ CtlUnique L s reg := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hg⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => ⟨hi.guarded e he, hi.grant e he, hi.control e he, hg e he,
      hi.grantSubtree e he, hi.regBound e he⟩, hi.unique⟩, hi.ctlUnique⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨h, hu⟩, hc⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun e he => (h e he).guarded, fun e he => (h e he).grant,
      fun e he => (h e he).control, hc, hu, fun e he => (h e he).sub,
      fun e he => (h e he).bound⟩, fun e he => (h e he).disc⟩

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Controller -/

/-- Unfolding of the positional `ControlOf` (WC3 C12). -/
theorem controlOf_spec {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} {ctl : Nat}
      (by rw [hpar]; exact hm) (by rw [hkids]; exact hk), hkids, hkc]

/-- `transfer` preserves `SyncCore` under `Encap` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed). -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c src dst : Nat}
    {s s' : SC} (h : opStepC k (.transfer src dst) c s (.ok s'))
    (he : Encap (s, reg) (.kernel c (.transfer src dst))) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hw' : WF3 s'.flat)
    (hs : SyncCore L s reg) : SyncCore L s' reg := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hget : ∀ j : Nat, (transferEffC s c src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun (y : Authority) =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y :=
    fun j => transfer_A_get (s.view c) src dst j
  have hlen : (transferEffC s c src dst).A.length = s.A.length := by
    show (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A.length = _; simp [transferEff]; rfl
  have hsk : Skel s (transferEffC s c src dst) := by
    have horg : ∀ i, (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.org i = s.flat.org i := by
      intro i
      show ((transferEffC s c src dst).A[i]?).bind (·.origin) = (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
      rw [hget]; cases s.A[i]? with
      | none => rfl
      | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl
    have hancs : ∀ j, (transferEffC s c src dst).flat.ancs j = s.flat.ancs j :=
      fun j => chain_congr fun i _ => horg i
    refine ⟨by omega, fun j y' hy' _ => ?_, fun j _ x hx => by rwa [hancs] at hx,
      fun j _ _ x hx _ => by rwa [hancs], fun j y' hy' hj => by
        have := lt_of_getElem? hy'; omega⟩
    rw [hget] at hy'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy'
    refine ⟨y, hy, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> rfl, by split <;> exact id, fun o ho _ => ?_⟩
    split <;> exact ho
  refine kernel_step hsk hw' hs (src_none hlen) (fun e _ _ y y' hy hy' hu => ?_)
    (fun e hm hl ctl hc hleaf => ctl_transfer hw hpre.sameShape
      (he e hm (hsk.active (hs.1 e hm).bound hl)) hc hleaf)
  rw [hget, hy] at hy'
  simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy'
  subst hy'
  cases hq : y.holder with
  | frame f => rw [hq] at hu; exact hu.elim
  | place q => split <;> simp [hq, mvTo]

/-!
# Theorem 4 with controller uniqueness and initialization (WC3 C21.4, WC3.1 C21, C22.3)

Preservation of `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, WC3 C21.1–C21.6 and WC3.1 C21, with `GrantDiscipline`,
WC3 C22) by the labelled steps admitted by `Encap` (WC3 C22.1, C22.2, WC3.1 C22.3), `transfer` and
the by-value composite included.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace SyncInitAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Structural parts (Spec 1 §40, §49.2) -/

section Tree

variable {t : S3}

/-- Structural parthood is transitive (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_trans (hw : WF3 t) {a b c : Nat} (hab : partOf t.P a b) (hbc : partOf t.P b c) :
    partOf t.P a c := by
  have hlt : ∀ i o, parentOf t.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (WF3.parent_lt hw h).1
  refine ⟨hab.1, ?_⟩
  rcases hab.2 with rfl | hab'
  · exact hbc.2
  · rcases hbc.2 with rfl | hbc'
    · exact .inr hab'
    · exact .inr (chain_trans hlt (a + 1) a (Nat.lt_succ_self a) b hab' c hbc')

/-- The structural ancestors of a place are totally ordered (Spec 1 §40, §49.2: each place has at
most one structural parent). -/
theorem partOf_total (hw : WF3 t) : ∀ (n l : Nat), l < n → ∀ {a b : Nat},
    partOf t.P l a → partOf t.P l b → partOf t.P a b ∨ partOf t.P b a
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, l, hl, a, b, ha, hb => by
    rcases ha.2 with rfl | ha'
    · exact .inl hb
    rcases hb.2 with rfl | hb'
    · exact .inr ha
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpl, hap⟩ := mem_chain ha'
    obtain ⟨p', hp', -, hbp⟩ := mem_chain hb'
    rw [hp] at hp'; cases hp'
    have hpP : p < t.P.length := (WF3.parent_lt hw hp).2
    have ha₁ : partOf t.P p a := ⟨hpP, hap.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩
    have hb₁ : partOf t.P p b := ⟨hpP, hbp.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩
    exact partOf_total hw n p (by omega) ha₁ hb₁

/-- Two places sharing a leaf are structurally comparable (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem footprint_comparable (hw : WF3 t) {a b l : Nat} (ha : l ∈ footprint t.P a)
    (hb : l ∈ footprint t.P b) : partOf t.P a b ∨ partOf t.P b a := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, -, hla⟩ := mem_footprint.1 ha
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlb⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hb
  exact partOf_total hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hla hlb

/-- A strict ancestor of a place with parent `m` is an ancestor of `m` (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_parent (hw : WF3 t) {x a m : Nat} (h : partOf t.P x a) (hne : x ≠ a)
    (hm : parentOf t.P x = some m) : partOf t.P m a := by
  obtain ⟨o, ho, -, hor⟩ := mem_chain (h.2.resolve_left hne)
  rw [hm] at ho; cases ho
  exact ⟨(WF3.parent_lt hw hm).2, hor.elim (fun e => .inl e.symm) .inr⟩

/-- A leaf has no strict part (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_leaf (hw : WF3 t) : ∀ (n y : Nat), y < n → ∀ {x : Nat}, isLeaf t.P x →
    partOf t.P y x → y = x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, y, hy, x, hx, h => by
    rcases h.2 with e | hc
    · exact e
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpy, hor⟩ := mem_chain hc
    rcases hor with rfl | hor
    · exact absurd hp (hx y h.1)
    · have := partOf_leaf hw n p (by omega) hx ⟨(WF3.parent_lt hw hp).2, .inr hor⟩
      subst this
      exact absurd hp (hx y h.1)

/-- A leaf in the footprint of a place is a part of it (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem leaf_mem_footprint {x q : Nat} (hx : isLeaf t.P x) (h : partOf t.P x q) :
    x ∈ footprint t.P q :=
  mem_footprint.2 ⟨h.1, hx, h⟩

/-- A leaf in the footprint of a place is the place or a strict part of it (Spec 1 §40). -/
theorem partOf_of_mem_footprint {x q : Nat} (h : x ∈ footprint t.P q) : partOf t.P x q :=
  (mem_footprint.1 h).2.2

end Tree

/-! ## Corresponding parts of a transfer (Spec 1 §63.2) -/

/-- Membership gives a position (Spec 1 §63.2 `posIn`). -/
theorem getElem?_posIn : ∀ {l : List Nat} {x : Nat}, x ∈ l → l[posIn x l]? = some x
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | a :: l, x, h => by
    by_cases e : a = x
    · subst e; simp [posIn]
    · have hx : x ∈ l := (List.mem_cons.1 h).resolve_left (Ne.symm e)
      simp only [posIn, e, ↓reduceIte, List.getElem?_cons_succ]
      exact getElem?_posIn hx

/-- A corresponding part other than `dst` lies strictly below a part of `dst`: its parent is the
place corresponding to the parent of the original part (Spec 1 §63.2 `corr`). -/
theorem corr_parent {P : List Place} {src dst r p x : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src)
    (hp : parentOf P r = some p) (hlt : p < r) (hx : corr P src dst r = some x) :
    ∃ p', corr P src dst p = some p' ∧ parentOf P x = some p' ∧ x < P.length := by
  rw [corr_step hr hp hlt] at hx
  cases hc : corr P src dst p with
  | none => rw [hc] at hx; cases hx
  | some p' =>
    rw [hc, Option.bind_some] at hx
    have hm := mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hx)
    exact ⟨p', rfl, hm.2, hm.1⟩

/-- `corr` is injective on the parts of the source (Spec 1 §63.2: positional correspondence). -/
theorem corr_inj {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < t.P.length) :
    ∀ (n r q : Nat), r < n → q < n → ∀ {x : Nat}, corr t.P src dst r = some x →
      corr t.P src dst q = some x → partOf t.P r src → partOf t.P q src → r = q
  | 0, _, _, h, _, _, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, q, hr, hq, x, hxr, hxq, hrs, hqs => by
    -- a part other than `src` corresponds to a strict part of `dst`
    have strict : ∀ {y : Nat}, y < n + 1 → y ≠ src → partOf t.P y src →
        corr t.P src dst y = some x → x ≠ dst := by
      intro y _ hy hys hxy hxd
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpy, -⟩ := mem_chain (hys.2.resolve_left hy)
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hxp, -⟩ := corr_parent hy hp hpy hxy
      have hpd := corr_partOf hw hd (p + 1) p p' (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp'
      subst hxd
      have h1 := Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Frames.partOf_le hpd
      have h2 := (WF3.parent_lt hw hxp).1
      omega
    by_cases er : r = src
    · subst er
      rw [corr_src] at hxr; cases hxr
      by_cases eq : q = r
      · exact eq.symm
      · exact absurd rfl (strict hq eq hqs hxq)
    by_cases eq : q = src
    · subst eq
      rw [corr_src] at hxq; cases hxq
      exact absurd rfl (strict hr er hrs hxr)
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpr, -⟩ := mem_chain (hrs.2.resolve_left er)
    obtain ⟨pq, hpq, hpqq, -⟩ := mem_chain (hqs.2.resolve_left eq)
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa, -⟩ := corr_parent er hp hpr hxr
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hxb, -⟩ := corr_parent eq hpq hpqq hxq
    rw [hxa] at hxb; cases hxb
    have hps : partOf t.P p src := partOf_parent hw hrs er hp
    have hpqs : partOf t.P pq src := partOf_parent hw hqs eq hpq
    have hpp : p = pq := corr_inj hw hd n p pq (by omega) (by omega) ha hb hps hpqs
    subst hpp
    rw [corr_step er hp hpr, ha, Option.bind_some] at hxr
    rw [corr_step eq hpq hpqq, ha, Option.bind_some] at hxq
    have hi := posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hxr
    have hj := posIn_of_getElem (kids_pairwise _ _) hxq
    have hpos : posIn r (kids t.P p) = posIn q (kids t.P p) := by rw [← hi, hj]
    have hr' := getElem?_posIn (mem_kids.2 ⟨hrs.1, hp⟩)
    have hq' := getElem?_posIn (mem_kids.2 ⟨hqs.1, hpq⟩)
    rw [hpos, hq'] at hr'
    cases hr'; rfl

/-- The place corresponding to a leaf of the source is a leaf of the destination (the proof of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.corr_leaf`, Spec 1 §63.2). -/
theorem corr_leaf' {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) {src dst l l' : Nat} (hd : dst < t.P.length)
    (hsh : SameShape t.P src dst) (hl : l ∈ footprint t.P src)
    (hc : corr t.P src dst l = some l') : l' ∈ footprint t.P dst ∧ isLeaf t.P l' := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hls⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  have hp := corr_partOf hw hd (l + 1) l l' (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hc
  have hk := hsh.1 l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) hls
  rw [hc] at hk; simp only [OptP] at hk
  rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hlf] at hk
  have hleaf := kids_nil_iff.1 (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hk)
  exact ⟨mem_footprint.2 ⟨hp.1, hleaf, hp⟩, hleaf⟩

end SyncInitAux

end Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Steps keeping the `Init` leaves of existing places (Spec 1 §60–§75 effects) -/

/-- A step keeps the footprints of the existing places and their `Init` leaves. -/
structure InitFacts (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  fp : ∀ q, q < s.P.length → ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q
  keep : ∀ l, l < s.P.length → s.I l = .init → s'.I l = .init

/-- A step whose places and initialization states are unchanged. -/
theorem initFacts_same {s s' : SC} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hI : s'.I = s.I) : InitFacts s s' :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ => by rw [hP], fun _ _ h => by rw [hI]; exact h⟩

/-- A step of the kernel run on the view of `c` keeps the footprints of existing places
(`Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.kstep_fp`). -/
theorem view_fp {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3}
    (hR : op.Step k (s.view c) (.ok t)) {q : Nat} (hq : q < s.P.length) (l : Nat) :
    l ∈ footprint (s.set t).P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q :=
  Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.kstep_fp (kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hR⟩) hq l

/-- The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context, other than `transfer` and `endUse`,
keep the footprints of existing places and their `Init` leaves (Spec 1 §60–§75 effects
re-indexed: only `store`, `write`, `writeShared` change initialization states of existing places,
to `Init`; `enterFrame` and `alloc` append `Uninit` places). -/
theorem opStep_init {k : K} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst)
    (hne : ∀ p, op ≠ .endUse p) : InitFacts s s' := by
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
  | endUse p => exact absurd rfl (hne p)
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact initFacts_same rfl rfl
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hd := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd; split at hd
    · rename_i y hy
      refine ⟨fun _ _ _ => ?_, fun l _ hl => ?_⟩
      · show _ ∈ footprint (storeEff (s.view c) a p).P _ ↔ _
        rw [storeEff, hy]
      · show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).I l = .init
        rw [storeEff, hy]
        show (if l = p then InitSt.init else s.I l) = .init
        split
        · rfl
        · exact hl
    · exact hd.elim
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine ⟨fun q hq l => Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.footprint_shapeP hpre.localsOK hq l,
      fun l hl hi => ?_⟩
    show (if (s.view c).P.length ≤ l then InitSt.uninit else s.I l) = .init

import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit

# Theorems 2 and 4 on labelled steps and traces (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1)

Assembly of `Ern.Concurrency.Preservation`, `Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve`,
`Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` and `Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit`:

* theorem 2 for every labelled step of the kernel with the synchronization library, the by-value

* theorems 2 and 4 together along a `ProposedTrace` (an encapsulated trace whose steps also

context, `spawn`, the by-value composite, `terminate`, `join`, `deriveSync` under the library
instantiation, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`): the re-indexed kernel invariant with
the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`) is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, for `split`). -/
theorem lstep_kInvCA {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}

  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case exit => exact exitFrameC_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
    all_goals exact opStepC_preservesC hdd hk (fun e => by cases e) h
  | spawn h => exact spawn_preservesC hk h
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_preservesC hk h
  | terminate h => exact terminate_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
  | join h => exact join_preservesC hk h
  | deriveSync h => exact deriveSync_preservesC hk h
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, -, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
    exact deriveSync_preservesC (r := _) hk ⟨hc, .ok hpre⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, g, -, -, -, hrel, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact opStepC_preservesC (op := .release g) hdd hk (fun e => by cases e)
      ⟨hc, _, .ok hrel, rfl⟩
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC3 C20–C23, WC3.1) along a `ProposedTrace`: from a state satisfying
`KInvCA` and `SyncState`, every reached state satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hx hst _ ih =>
    have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd hst hk
    exact ih hk' (lstep_preserves hst he hx hk hk'.1.1.2 hs)

/-- Theorem 4 (WC3 C22, C23, WC3.1), trace form: along a `ProposedTrace` from a state satisfying
`KInvCA`, `SyncState` is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : ProposedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 :=
  (trace_inv hdd h hk hs).2

C12), satisfies `KInvCA` and `SyncState`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)

  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro i j e e' ctl h; simp at h
  · intro i j e e' h; simp at h
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he

initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registry) by a `ProposedTrace` satisfies the
re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1
§80) and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). The clause `EndUseExcl` of `ProposedTrace` is not part
of `Encap`; without it the statement is false
(`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.endUse_ctl_breaks_ctlInit`). -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : ProposedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2⟩

end Ern.Concurrency

theorem encap_transfer_iff (st : SC × SyncReg) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Encap st (.kernel c (.transfer src dst)) ↔
      ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → (st.1.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) ≠ some (.place src) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- In `e2`, `guarded` (authority 4) is held by `slot` (place 1), a field of `M` (place 0). -/
theorem guarded_in_slot : (e2.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 1) ∧
    parentOf e2.P 1 = some 0 := by decide

/-- Verdict (b): `Encap` admits `transfer(M, M′)` in both variants and excludes
`transfer(slot, Y)`. -/
theorem encap_verdicts : Encap (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    Encap (e3, reg2) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)) ∧
    ¬ Encap (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) := by
  refine ⟨fun e he _ => ?_, fun e he _ => ?_, fun h => h ⟨4, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) ?_⟩
  · simp only [reg1, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · simp only [reg2, List.mem_singleton] at he; subst he; decide
  · decide

/-! ## Encapsulated traces and invariants -/

/-- Variant A as an encapsulated trace from the initial state with an empty registry (WC3 C22,
C23). -/
theorem traceA : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 [],
     .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] (eA, reg1) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
  .cons encap_verdicts.1 (.kernel stepA_transfer) .nil

/-- Variant B as an encapsulated trace from the initial state with an empty registry (WC3 C22,
C23). -/
theorem traceB : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 [],
     .acquire 0 0, .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] (eB, reg2) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.acquire step_acquire.1) <|
  .cons encap_verdicts.2.1 (.kernel stepB_transfer) .nil

/-- The trace up to `newMutex` (WC3 C13), encapsulated. -/
theorem traceMutex : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 []] (e2, reg1) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <|
  .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) .nil

theorem ctlUnique_single (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : CtlUnique L s [e] := by
  intro i j _ _ _ hi hj _ _ _ _
  have h1 : i < 1 := lt_of_getElem? hi
  have h2 : j < 1 := lt_of_getElem? hj
  omega

theorem invA : KInvCA eA ∧ SyncState L0 eA reg1 ∧ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eA := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv ddK0 traceA hk (syncState_iff.1 hs).1
  exact ⟨hk', syncState_iff.2 ⟨hs', ctlUnique_single _ _ _⟩, by decide⟩

/-- Verdict (c), variant B (from `trace_inv`, `init_inv` and `ctlUnique_single`): after
`transfer(M, M′)`, `KInvC` (with the auxiliaries of Spec 1) and `SyncState` hold; the entry is
live and the grant 5 is still active and held by frame 0. -/
/-! ## `transfer(slot, Y)` without the exclusion -/

/-- WC3 S16, C22.3: without the transfer clause of `Encap`, `SyncInv` is not preserved: from `e2`
(reached by an encapsulated trace without transfer, so `KInvC` and `SyncState` hold),
`transfer(slot, Y)` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed; `Encap` excludes it (WC3 C22.3);
after it, the kernel invariant `KInvCA` holds, the entry is live, `guarded` is held by `Y`, which
has no structural parent, `ControlOf` is undefined, and `SyncInv` (WC3 C21.3 with the positional
`ControlOf` of WC3 C12) fails. -/
theorem slot_transfer_breaks_control :
    KInvCA e2 ∧ SyncState L0 e2 reg1 ∧ opStepC K0 (.transfer 1 7) 0 e2 (.ok eC) ∧
    ¬ Encap (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 1 7)) ∧ KInvCA eC ∧
