108	/-! ## Representation relation (§82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5, §9) -/
109	
110	/-- Representation relation between a kernel state `s3` and a state `s2` of the memory machine,
111	for the layout `L` and the deallocation tokens `rtok` recorded for the allocation of each root
112	place (`rtok r` for the root place `r`; §17 ¶4, §70.2):
113	- `adm`: `s2` is admissible (§9 ¶8: freshness, live disjointness, alignment);
114	- `layout`: the layout interface (§82.1, §23);
115	- `inj`: two distinct root places are in distinct allocations (§82.1: storage units and
116	  identities; §9 ¶5: subplaces are not new allocations, so parts share their root's);
117	- `tokens`: the allocation of a root place is registered and records the token `rtok r`
118	  (§82.4, §17 ¶4);
119	- `live`: the allocation of a usable root place is live (§82.5);
120	- `init`: the bytes of the range of an `Init` leaf are initialized (§82.3; `Uninit` and `Moved`
121	  impose nothing, §41).
122	It does not read the contract `K` (§48). -/
123	structure Repr (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
124	  /-- §9 ¶8: admissibility of the memory state. -/
125	  adm : Machine.Admissible s2
126	  /-- §82.1, §23: layout interface. -/
127	  layout : LayoutWF L s3 s2
128	  /-- §82.1, §9 ¶5: distinct root places, distinct allocations. -/
129	  inj : ∀ r r', RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' → (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc
130	  /-- §82.4, §17 ¶4: the allocation of a root place is registered with the token `rtok r`. -/
131	  tokens : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)
132	  /-- §82.5: the allocation of a usable root place is live. -/
133	  live : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → LiveAlloc s2 (L r).alloc
134	  /-- §82.3: the range of an `Init` leaf is initialized. -/
135	  init : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →
136	    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len

140	section Seq

142	variable {Ty : Type}
143	
144	/-- Effect of an `ok` raw operation (§20.2): a read leaves the state unchanged. -/
145	def opEff : Machine.Op Ty → Machine.State → Machine.State
146	  | .read _ _, s => s
147	  | .write ac _ w, s => s.write ac w
148	  | .dealloc id _, s => s.dealloc id
149	  | .alloc sp b sz al fa, s => s.alloc sp b sz al fa
150	
151	/-- State after a sequence of `ok` raw operations (§20.3 ¶3). -/
152	def run : Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty) → Machine.State
153	  | s, [] => s
154	  | s, o :: os => run (opEff o s) os
155	
156	/-- `p s o` holds for each operation `o` of the sequence in the state where it runs (§20.3). -/
157	def Along (p : Machine.State → Machine.Op Ty → Prop) :
158	    Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty) → Prop
159	  | _, [] => True
160	  | s, o :: os => p s o ∧ Along p (opEff o s) os
161	
162	/-- Decidability of `Along` for a decidable property (§20.3 ¶3). -/
163	instance decAlong (p : Machine.State → Machine.Op Ty → Prop) [h : ∀ s o, Decidable (p s o)] :
164	    (s : Machine.State) → (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) → Decidable (Along p s os)
165	  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
166	  | s, o :: os => @instDecidableAnd _ _ (h s o) (decAlong p (opEff o s) os)
167	
168	/-- The parametric obligations of a raw read or write hold, both parts (§15 ¶5, §16 ¶4,
169	§20.3 ¶1): explicit predicates of the execution context, never replaced by `True`. -/
170	def Obl (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (s : Machine.State) :
171	    Machine.Op Ty → Prop
172	  | .read ac t => ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t
173	  | .write ac t w => ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w
174	  | _ => True
175	
176	/-- The parametric obligations hold for every read and write of a sequence, in the state where it
177	runs (§20.3). -/
178	abbrev OblAlong (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) :
179	    Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty) → Prop :=
180	  Along (Obl ObR ObW)
181	
182	/-- The operation is an `ok` raw step from `s` to its effect (§20.1 ¶2). -/
183	def OkAt (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty)
184	    (s : Machine.State) (o : Machine.Op Ty) : Prop :=
185	  Machine.Step C ObR ObW o s (opEff o s)
186	
187	/-- A sequence of operations each `ok` where it runs is an execution (§20.3 ¶3). -/
188	theorem exec_of_along {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
189	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} :
190	    ∀ (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) (s : Machine.State), Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s os →
191	      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW os s (run s os)
192	  | [], s, _ => .nil s
193	  | _ :: os, _, ⟨h, hs⟩ => .cons h (exec_of_along os _ hs)
194	
195	/-- Composition of sequences (§20.3 ¶3). -/
196	theorem run_append (s : Machine.State) (os os' : List (Machine.Op Ty)) :
197	    run s (os ++ os') = run (run s os) os' := by
198	  induction os generalizing s with
199	  | nil => rfl
200	  | cons o os ih => exact ih _
201	
202	/-- `Along` over a composed sequence (§20.3 ¶3). -/
203	theorem along_append {p : Machine.State → Machine.Op Ty → Prop} {s : Machine.State}
204	    {os os' : List (Machine.Op Ty)} :
205	    Along p s (os ++ os') ↔ Along p s os ∧ Along p (run s os) os' := by
206	  induction os generalizing s with
207	  | nil => simp [Along, run]
208	  | cons o os ih => simp only [List.cons_append, Along, run, ih, and_assoc]
209	
210	/-- Executions compose (§20.3 ¶3). -/
211	theorem exec_append {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
212	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {os os' : List (Machine.Op Ty)} {s s' s'' : Machine.State}
213	    (h : Machine.Exec C ObR ObW os s s') (h' : Machine.Exec C ObR ObW os' s' s'') :
214	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (os ++ os') s s'' := by
215	  induction h with
216	  | nil => exact h'
217	  | cons hs _ ih => exact .cons hs (ih h')
218

221	/-! ## Allocations kept by raw operations (§13 ¶3, §16 ¶3, §17 ¶3) -/
222	
223	/-- `s'` keeps every allocation of `s` registered, with its base, size and deallocation token, and
224	every initialized byte initialized; liveness is not constrained (§13 ¶3, §16 ¶2, §16 ¶3,
225	§17 ¶3). -/
226	def Dom (s s' : Machine.State) : Prop :=
227	  ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → ∃ a', s'.allocs i = some a' ∧ a'.base = a.base ∧
228	    a'.size = a.size ∧ a'.freeAuth = a.freeAuth ∧ ∀ j, a.bytes j ≠ .uninit → a'.bytes j ≠ .uninit
229	
230	/-- `Dom` is reflexive (§13). -/
231	theorem Dom.refl (s : Machine.State) : Dom s s :=
232	  fun _ a h => ⟨a, h, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩
233	
234	/-- `Dom` is transitive (§13). -/
235	theorem Dom.trans {s s' s'' : Machine.State} (h : Dom s s') (h' : Dom s' s'') : Dom s s'' := by
236	  intro i a ha
237	  obtain ⟨a', ha', e1, e2, e3, hb⟩ := h i a ha
238	  obtain ⟨a'', ha'', f1, f2, f3, hb'⟩ := h' i a' ha'
239	  exact ⟨a'', ha'', f1.trans e1, f2.trans e2, f3.trans e3, fun j hj => hb' j (hb j hj)⟩
240	
241	/-- Transport of a property of a registered allocation along `Dom` (§13 ¶3). -/
242	theorem AllocP.dom {s s' : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {p : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
243	    (h : AllocP s i p) (hd : Dom s s')
244	    (hp : ∀ a a' : Machine.Alloc, a'.base = a.base → a'.size = a.size →
245	      a'.freeAuth = a.freeAuth → (∀ j, a.bytes j ≠ .uninit → a'.bytes j ≠ .uninit) →
246	      p a → p a') :
247	    AllocP s' i p := by
248	  obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := h
249	  obtain ⟨a', ha', e1, e2, e3, hb⟩ := hd i a ha
250	  exact ⟨a', ha', hp a a' e1 e2 e3 hb hpa⟩
251	
252	/-- Initialized ranges stay initialized along `Dom` (§16 ¶2). -/
253	theorem AllocP.dom_init {s s' : Machine.State} {i off len : Nat}
254	    (h : AllocP s i fun a => a.InitRange off len) (hd : Dom s s') :
255	    AllocP s' i fun a => a.InitRange off len :=
256	  h.dom hd fun _ _ _ _ _ hb h j hj => hb _ (h j hj)
257	
258	/-- Allocation entries after a write (§16 ¶2, ¶3). -/
259	theorem write_allocs (s : Machine.State) (ac : Machine.Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
260	    (i : Nat) :
261	    (s.write ac w).allocs i = if i = ac.prov then
262	      (s.allocs i).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w) else s.allocs i := rfl
263	
264	/-- Allocation entries after a deallocation (§17 ¶3). -/
265	theorem dealloc_allocs (s : Machine.State) (id i : Nat) :
266	    (s.dealloc id).allocs i = if i = id then
267	      (s.allocs i).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) else s.allocs i := rfl
268	
269	/-- Allocation entries after a creation (§9 ¶11, §13 ¶3). -/
270	theorem alloc_allocs (s : Machine.State) (sp b sz al : Nat) (fa : Option Nat) (i : Nat) :
271	    (s.alloc sp b sz al fa).allocs i = if i = s.next then
272	      some { space := sp, base := b, size := sz, align := al, live := true,
273	             bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth := fa } else s.allocs i := rfl

279	/-- Every `ok` effect keeps the allocations of a state with fresh identities (§13 ¶3, §16 ¶3,
280	§17 ¶3). -/
281	theorem dom_opEff {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) (o : Machine.Op Ty) :
282	    Dom s (opEff o s) := by
283	  intro i a ha
284	  cases o with
285	  | read => exact ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩
286	  | write ac t w =>
287	    show ∃ a', (s.write ac w).allocs i = some a' ∧ _
288	    rw [write_allocs]
289	    split
290	    · refine ⟨a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w, by rw [ha]; simp, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun j hj => ?_⟩
291	      simp only [Machine.Alloc.write]
292	      split
293	      · exact fun h => by cases h
294	      · exact hj
295	    · exact ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩
296	  | dealloc id au =>
297	    show ∃ a', (s.dealloc id).allocs i = some a' ∧ _
298	    rw [dealloc_allocs]
299	    split
300	    · exact ⟨{ a with live := false }, by rw [ha]; simp, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩
301	    · exact ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩
302	  | alloc sp b sz al fa =>
303	    show ∃ a', (s.alloc sp b sz al fa).allocs i = some a' ∧ _
304	    have hi : i ≠ s.next := fun e => by rw [e, hwf s.next (Nat.le_refl _)] at ha; cases ha
305	    rw [alloc_allocs, ite_eq_right hi]
306	    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩

308	/-- Every `ok` effect keeps freshness (§9 ¶7). -/
309	theorem wf_opEff {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) (o : Machine.Op Ty) :
310	    Machine.WF (opEff o s) := by
311	  cases o with
312	  | read => exact hwf
313	  | write ac t w => exact Machine.write_wf hwf ac w
314	  | dealloc id au => exact Machine.dealloc_wf hwf id
315	  | alloc sp b sz al fa => exact Machine.alloc_wf hwf sp b sz al fa

318	theorem wf_run : ∀ (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) (s : Machine.State), Machine.WF s →
319	    Machine.WF (run s os)
320	  | [], _, h => h
321	  | o :: os, _, h => wf_run os _ (wf_opEff h o)

324	theorem dom_run : ∀ (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) (s : Machine.State), Machine.WF s →
325	    Dom s (run s os)
326	  | [], s, _ => Dom.refl s
327	  | o :: os, _, h => (dom_opEff h o).trans (dom_run os _ (wf_opEff h o))

329	/-- An operation that deallocates no identity: a read, a write or a creation (§13 ¶3,
330	§16 ¶3). -/

332	  | .dealloc .. => False
333	  | _ => True

335	/-- An effect other than a deallocation keeps every live allocation live (§13 ¶3, §16 ¶3). -/
336	theorem live_opEff {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) {o : Machine.Op Ty}
337	    (ho : NoDealloc o) {i : Nat} (h : LiveAlloc s i) : LiveAlloc (opEff o s) i := by
338	  obtain ⟨a, ha, hl⟩ := h
339	  cases o with
340	  | read => exact ⟨a, ha, hl⟩
341	  | write ac t w =>
342	    show AllocP (s.write ac w) i _
343	    rw [AllocP, write_allocs]
344	    split
345	    · exact ⟨a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w, by rw [ha]; simp, hl⟩
346	    · exact ⟨a, ha, hl⟩
347	  | dealloc => exact ho.elim
348	  | alloc sp b sz al fa =>
349	    have hi : i ≠ s.next := fun e => by rw [e, hwf s.next (Nat.le_refl _)] at ha; cases ha
350	    show AllocP (s.alloc sp b sz al fa) i _
351	    rw [AllocP, alloc_allocs, ite_eq_right hi]
352	    exact ⟨a, ha, hl⟩

355	theorem live_run : ∀ (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) (s : Machine.State), Machine.WF s →
356	    (∀ o ∈ os, NoDealloc o) → ∀ {i : Nat}, LiveAlloc s i → LiveAlloc (run s os) i
357	  | [], _, _, _, _, h => h
358	  | o :: os, _, hwf, hn, _, h =>
359	    live_run os _ (wf_opEff hwf o) (fun o' ho' => hn o' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho'))
360	      (live_opEff hwf (hn o (List.mem_cons_self ..)) h)

362	/-- The base of a registered allocation is kept by every sequence of `ok` effects (§13 ¶3: no
363	allocation moves). -/
364	theorem baseOf_run {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) {i : Nat}
365	    (h : AllocP s i fun _ => True) : baseOf (run s os) i = baseOf s i := by
366	  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h
367	  obtain ⟨a', ha', e, -⟩ := dom_run os s hwf i a ha
368	  rw [baseOf_of ha, baseOf_of ha', e]

374	/-- `Repr` carries over to a kernel state with the same tree of places (same number of places
375	and same parents) and a memory state that keeps the allocations (`Dom`) and is admissible, when
376	every usable root place of the new state has a live allocation and every leaf that becomes `Init`
377	has its range initialized (§82.1, §82.3, §82.5). -/
378	theorem Repr.transport {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 s2' : Machine.State}
379	    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hadm : Machine.Admissible s2') (hd : Dom s2 s2')
380	    (hlen : s3'.P.length = s3.P.length) (hpar : parentOf s3'.P = parentOf s3.P)
381	    (hlive : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → s3'.Usable r → LiveAlloc s2' (L r).alloc)
382	    (hI : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → s3'.I l = .init →
383	      s3.I l = .init ∨ AllocP s2' (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len) :
384	    Repr L rtok s3' s2' := by
385	  have hleaf : ∀ l, isLeaf s3'.P l ↔ isLeaf s3.P l := fun l => by simp only [isLeaf, hlen, hpar]
386	  have hroot : ∀ r, RootPlace s3'.P r ↔ RootPlace s3.P r := fun r => by
387	    simp only [RootPlace, hlen, hpar]
388	  refine ⟨hadm, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
389	  · intro q r h; rw [hpar] at h; exact hR.layout.parts q r h
390	  · intro l l' hl hl' hf hf' hne he
391	    rw [hlen] at hl hl'; rw [hleaf] at hf hf'
392	    exact hR.layout.disjoint l l' hl hl' hf hf' hne he
393	  · intro l hl hf
394	    rw [hlen] at hl; rw [hleaf] at hf
395	    exact (hR.layout.within l hl hf).dom hd fun _ _ _ e _ _ h => e ▸ h
396	  · intro r r' hr hr' hne
397	    exact hR.inj r r' ((hroot r).1 hr) ((hroot r').1 hr') hne
398	  · intro r hr
399	    exact (hR.tokens r ((hroot r).1 hr)).dom hd fun _ _ _ _ e _ h => e ▸ h
400	  · intro r hr hu
401	    exact hlive r ((hroot r).1 hr) hu
402	  · intro l hl hf hi
403	    rw [hlen] at hl; rw [hleaf] at hf
404	    rcases hI l hl hf hi with h | h
405	    · exact (hR.init l hl hf h).dom_init hd
406	    · exact h

491	/-- The reads realizing `read(access, ls)` (§82.2, §66): one raw read per leaf, of the range of
492	the leaf, at the type `ty l` of the leaf. -/
493	def readOps {Ty : Type} (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) (ls : List Nat) :
494	    List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
495	  ls.map fun l => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)

497	/-- Safe read (§82.2, §66, §15): under `Repr`, `WF3` and the preconditions of `read` (§66), the
498	raw read of the range of each leaf read is `ok` when the parametric obligations of that read hold
499	(§15.4, §15.6, §15.7): its allocation is live, the range is initialized, and the read returns the
500	bytes of the range. -/
501	theorem r1_read {Ty : Type} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout}
502	    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
503	    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
504	    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
505	    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
506	      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
507	        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) := by
508	  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (hpre.usable l hl)
509	  obtain ⟨al, hal, hlive, hsz⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf hu
510	  obtain ⟨al', hal', hi⟩ := hR.init l hlP hlf (hpre.init l hl)
511	  rw [hal] at hal'; cases hal'
512	  refine ⟨al, hal, hlive, hi, ?_⟩
513	  have hc := canRead_leaf hal hlive hsz hi
514	  have hst := Machine.ReadStep.ok (ObR := ObR) (t := ty l) hal ⟨hc, hob.1, hob.2⟩
515	  rw [leafAcc_of hal] at hst ⊢
516	  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hst

520	    ∀ ls t, run t (readOps s2 L ty ls) = t
521	  | [], _ => rfl
522	  | _ :: ls, t => run_readOps s2 L ty ls t

524	/-- Realization of `read` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §66): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok` step of `read`
525	and the parametric obligations along the reads, the reads form an execution of `ok` raw steps
526	that leaves the memory state unchanged, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
527	theorem r6_read {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
528	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
529	    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
530	    (hw : WF3 s3) (h : Read3Step a ls s3 (.ok s3'))
531	    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :
532	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (readOps s2 L ty ls) s2 (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) ∧
533	      run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls) = s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) := by
534	  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
535	  rw [run_readOps]
536	  refine ⟨?_, rfl, hR⟩
537	  have key : ∀ ls', (∀ l ∈ ls', l ∈ ls) → OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls') →
538	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls') := by
539	    intro ls'
540	    induction ls' with
541	    | nil => intro _ _; trivial
542	    | cons l ls' ih =>
543	      intro hsub hob'
544	      obtain ⟨al, hal, -, -, hst⟩ := r1_read hR hw hpre (hsub l (List.mem_cons_self ..)) hob'.1
545	      exact ⟨.read hst, ih (fun l' hl' => hsub l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')) hob'.2⟩
546	  have := exec_of_along _ _ (key ls (fun _ h => h) hob)
547	  rwa [run_readOps] at this

580	/-- The writes of the ranges of leaves whose allocations are live and contain them are `ok` under
581	their parametric obligations (§16, §82.2), and afterwards every written range is initialized
582	(§16 ¶2). -/
583	theorem writes_ok {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
584	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {ty : Nat → Ty}
585	    {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} :
586	    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (s2 : Machine.State), Machine.WF s2 →
587	      (∀ l ∈ ls, AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size) →
588	      OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (writeOps s2 L ty w ls) →
589	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (writeOps s2 L ty w ls) ∧
590	        ∀ l ∈ ls, AllocP (run s2 (writeOps s2 L ty w ls)) (L l).alloc
591	          fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len
592	  | [], _, _, _, _ => ⟨trivial, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
593	  | l :: ls, s2, hwf, hls, hob => by
594	    obtain ⟨al, hal, hlive, hsz⟩ := hls l (List.mem_cons_self ..)
595	    have hex : AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun _ => True := ⟨al, hal, trivial⟩
596	    have hd₁ : Dom s2 (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) :=
597	      dom_opEff (Ty := Ty) hwf (.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (ty l) (w l))

599	      Machine.write_wf hwf _ _
600	    have hops : writeOps (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) L ty w ls =

602	      simp only [writeOps, List.map_inj_left]
603	      intro l' hl'
604	      obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := hls l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')
605	      rw [leafAcc_dom hd₁ ⟨b, hb, trivial⟩]
606	    have hls₁ : ∀ l' ∈ ls, AllocP (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) (L l').alloc
607	        fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l').off + (L l').len ≤ a.size := by
608	      intro l' hl'
609	      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbl, hbs⟩ := hls l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')
610	      obtain ⟨b', hb', -, e, -⟩ := hd₁ _ b hb
611	      refine ⟨b', hb', ?_, e ▸ hbs⟩
612	      have := live_opEff (Ty := Ty) (o := .write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (ty l) (w l)) hwf trivial
613	        ⟨b, hb, hbl⟩

615	      change (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)).allocs _ = _ at hb''
616	      rw [hb'] at hb''; cases hb''; exact hl''

618	        (writeOps (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) L ty w ls) := by
619	      rw [hops]; exact hob.2
620	    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := writes_ok (C := C) ls _ hwf₁ hls₁ hob₁
621	    rw [hops] at ih1 ih2
622	    refine ⟨⟨.write (.ok ⟨canWrite_leaf hal hlive hsz, hob.1⟩), ih1⟩, fun l' hl' => ?_⟩
623	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl' with rfl | hl'

767	/-- The elements of `range n` are increasing (§49, last paragraph: identities as indices). -/
768	theorem range_pairwise : ∀ n, (List.range n).Pairwise (· < ·)
769	  | 0 => by simp
770	  | n + 1 => by
771	    rw [List.range_succ, List.pairwise_append]

775	/-- Deallocations of the allocations of the root places `rs`, each presenting the token recorded
776	for it (§17, §73: automatic storage of an exiting frame). -/
777	def deallocOps {Ty : Type} (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (rs : List Nat) :
778	    List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
779	  rs.map fun r => .dealloc (L r).alloc (rtok r)

781	/-- Deallocations of distinct live allocations recording their tokens are `ok` when each token is
782	compatible with itself (§17.1, §17.2); afterwards they are dead and every other allocation is
783	unchanged (§17 ¶3). -/
784	theorem deallocOps_run {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
785	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
786	    (htc : ∀ r, C (rtok r) (rtok r)) :
787	    ∀ (rs : List Nat) (s2 : Machine.State), rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc) →
788	      (∀ r ∈ rs, AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)) →
789	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok rs) ∧
790	      (∀ i, (∀ r ∈ rs, (L r).alloc ≠ i) →
791	        (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok rs)).allocs i = s2.allocs i) ∧
792	      ∀ r ∈ rs, AllocP (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok rs)) (L r).alloc (·.live = false)
793	  | [], _, _, _ => ⟨trivial, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
794	  | r :: rs, s2, hp, hrs => by
795	    obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.1 hp
796	    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla, hfa⟩ := hrs r (List.mem_cons_self ..)
797	    have hrs' : ∀ r' ∈ rs, AllocP (s2.dealloc (L r).alloc) (L r').alloc
798	        fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r') := fun r' hr' => by
799	      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbl⟩ := hrs r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr')
800	      refine ⟨b, ?_, hbl⟩
801	      rw [dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm (hr r' hr')), hb]
802	    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2, ih3⟩ := deallocOps_run htc rs _ hp hrs'
803	    refine ⟨⟨.dealloc (.ok ⟨a, ha, hla, _, hfa, htc r⟩), ih1⟩, fun i hi => ?_, fun r' hr' => ?_⟩
804	    · change (run (s2.dealloc (L r).alloc) (deallocOps L rtok rs)).allocs i = _
805	      rw [ih2 i fun r' hr' => hi r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr'), dealloc_allocs,
806	        ite_eq_right (Ne.symm (hi r (List.mem_cons_self ..)))]
807	    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr' with rfl | hr'
808	      · refine ⟨{ a with live := false }, ?_, rfl⟩
809	        change (run (s2.dealloc (L r').alloc) (deallocOps L rtok rs)).allocs _ = _
810	        rw [ih2 _ fun r'' hr'' => Ne.symm (hr r'' hr''), dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_left rfl, ha]
811	        rfl
812	      · exact ih3 r' hr'

823	  simp only [exitRoots, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq, RootPlace]
824	  constructor

835	of the root places directly owned by the exiting frame are `ok` raw steps, those allocations are
836	dead afterwards, and `Repr` holds after the step. The storage owned by those places is not
837	deallocated (§73: "Exiting does not entail automatic physical deallocation of all dead

840	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3}
841	    {s2 : Machine.State} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (h : ExitStep k s3 (.ok s3'))

843	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (exitOps L rtok s3) s2 (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) ∧
844	      (∀ r ∈ exitRoots s3, AllocP (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) (L r).alloc

846	      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) := by
847	  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
848	  have hF : s3.F ≠ [] := fun e => hpre.hasCaller (by rw [e]; rfl)

850	    ((range_pairwise _).filter _).imp_of_mem fun {r r'} hr hr' hlt =>
851	      hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)

854	    obtain ⟨hrt, ho, hd⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hr
855	    cases hpl : s3.P[r]? with
856	    | none => rw [hpl] at ho; exact ho.elim
857	    | some pl =>
858	      rw [hpl] at ho
859	      exact (hR.live r hrt (.frame hpl hd ho (top_mem hF))).and (hR.tokens r hrt)
860	  obtain ⟨hok, hkeep, hdead⟩ := deallocOps_run (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) htc _ s2 hpw hlive
861	  have hex := exec_of_along _ _ hok
862	  refine ⟨hex, hdead, hR.transport (hex.admissible hR.adm) (dom_run _ _ hR.adm.wf) rfl rfl
863	    (fun r hr hu => ?_) fun l _ _ hi => .inl hi⟩
864	  have hu0 : s3.Usable r := S3.Usable.mono (s := s3) (s' := exitEff s3) rfl
865	    (fun f h => List.mem_of_mem_tail h) (fun _ h => h) hu
866	  have hnot : r ∉ exitRoots s3 := fun hm => by
867	    obtain ⟨-, ho, -⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hm
868	    have hnd := hw.frames.2.1
869	    cases hu with
870	    | frame hpl _ ho' hf =>
871	      change s3.P[r]? = some _ at hpl
872	      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
873	      have ht : s3.top ∈ s3.F.tail := hf
874	      unfold S3.top at ht
875	      cases hFe : s3.F with
876	      | nil => exact hF hFe
877	      | cons f F =>
878	        rw [hFe] at ht hnd
879	        exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1 ht
880	    | place hpl _ ho' _ =>
881	      change s3.P[r]? = some _ at hpl
882	      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
883	  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hR.live r hr hu0
884	  refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩
885	  change (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok (exitRoots s3))).allocs _ = _
886	  rw [hkeep _ fun r' hr' e => hR.inj r' r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 hr
887	    (fun e' => hnot (e' ▸ hr')) e, ha]

1296	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (copyOps L ty s2 ps) ∧
1297	        ∀ q ∈ ps, AllocP (run s2 (copyOps L ty s2 ps)) (L q.2).alloc

1300	  | (l, l') :: ps, s2, hwf, hsrc, hdst, hob => by
1301	    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla, hsa, hia⟩ := hsrc (l, l') (List.mem_cons_self ..)
1302	    obtain ⟨b, hb, hlb, hsb⟩ := hdst (l, l') (List.mem_cons_self ..)

1330	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
1331	    · exact (write_leaf_init ⟨b, hb, trivial⟩).dom_init (dom_run _ _ hwf₁)

1424	variable {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}

1426	/-- Number of places after appending a shape (§71, §72). -/
1427	theorem shapeP_len (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
1428	    (shapeP P hd ls).length = P.length + ls.length := by
1429	  simp [shapeP]
1430	
1431	/-- Old places are kept by appending a shape (§71, §72). -/
1432	theorem shapeP_get_lt {q : Nat} (hq : q < P.length) : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? = P[q]? := by
1433	  simp only [shapeP]; exact List.getElem?_append_left hq
1434	
1435	/-- The parent of a new place is the parent given by the shape (§71.1, §72). -/
1436	theorem shape_parentOf_new {i : Nat} (hi : i < ls.length) :
1437	    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) (P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
1438	  simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
1439	    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range hi, Option.map_some,
1440	    Option.bind_some]
1441	
1442	/-- Old places keep their parent (§71, §72). -/
1443	theorem shape_parentOf_lt {q : Nat} (hq : q < P.length) :
1444	    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = parentOf P q := by
1445	  simp only [parentOf, shapeP_get_lt hq]
1446	
1447	/-- A new place has a parent among the new places, under `ShapeOK` (§71.1, §72.2). -/
1448	theorem shape_parent_ge (hsh : ShapeOK P.length ls) {q r : Nat} (hq : P.length ≤ q)
1449	    (h : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = some r) : P.length ≤ r := by
1450	  have hql : q < (shapeP P hd ls).length := by
1451	    simp only [parentOf] at h
1452	    cases e : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? with
1453	    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
1454	    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? e
1455	  rw [shapeP_len] at hql
1456	  have hi : q - P.length < ls.length := by omega
1457	  have hp := shape_parentOf_new (P := P) (hd := hd) hi
1458	  rw [show P.length + (q - P.length) = q by omega, h] at hp
1459	  have := (hsh (q - P.length) (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
1460	  rw [← hp] at this; exact this.1

1463	theorem shape_isLeaf_old (hsh : ShapeOK P.length ls) {l : Nat} (hl : l < P.length) :
1464	    isLeaf (shapeP P hd ls) l ↔ isLeaf P l := by
1465	  constructor
1466	  · intro h r hr; rw [← shape_parentOf_lt hr]; exact h r (by rw [shapeP_len]; omega)
1467	  · intro h r _ e
1468	    by_cases hrn : r < P.length
1469	    · rw [shape_parentOf_lt hrn] at e; exact h r hrn e
1470	    · have := shape_parent_ge hsh (Nat.le_of_not_lt hrn) e; omega
1471

1476	  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> exact ⟨by omega, h2⟩

1491	/-! ## New allocations (§9 ¶11, §71, §72, §47, §82.4) -/
1492	
1493	/-- Geometry of a new allocation: address space, size, alignment (§9 ¶1). -/
1494	structure Geom where
1495	  /-- §9 ¶1: address space. -/
1496	  space : Nat
1497	  /-- §9 ¶1: extent in bytes. -/
1498	  size : Nat
1499	  /-- §9 ¶1: alignment. -/
1500	  align : Nat
1501	
1502	/-- Placement: the base address chosen for a new allocation of geometry `g` in the state `s`
1503	(§9 ¶11, §82.4). -/
1504	abbrev Placement := Machine.State → Geom → Nat
1505	
1506	/-- Obligation of a placement (§9 ¶11, §82.4): in every state with fresh identities, for every
1507	valid alignment, the chosen base satisfies the preconditions of raw creation. -/
1508	def PlacementOK (pl : Placement) : Prop :=
1509	  ∀ s g, Machine.WF s → 0 < g.align → Machine.Pow2 g.align →
1510	    Machine.AllocPre s g.space (pl s g) g.size g.align
1511	
1512	/-- Obligation of the geometries (§9 ¶1, ¶4): every alignment is strictly positive and a power of
1513	two. -/
1514	def GeomOK (g : Nat → Geom) : Prop := ∀ r, 0 < (g r).align ∧ Machine.Pow2 (g r).align
1515	
1516	/-- End of the allocation `i` of `s`, `0` if unregistered (§9 ¶3). -/
1517	def allocEnd (s : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
1518	  ((s.allocs i).map fun a => a.base + a.size).getD 0
1519	
1520	/-- Largest end of the allocations of identity below `n` (§9 ¶3). -/
1521	def maxEnd (s : Machine.State) : Nat → Nat
1522	  | 0 => 0
1523	  | n + 1 => max (maxEnd s n) (allocEnd s n)
1524	
1525	/-- Every allocation below `n` ends at most at `maxEnd s n` (§9 ¶3). -/
1526	theorem le_maxEnd (s : Machine.State) : ∀ n i, i < n → allocEnd s i ≤ maxEnd s n
1527	  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
1528	  | n + 1, i, h => by
1529	    simp only [maxEnd]
1530	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 h with h | rfl
1531	    · exact Nat.le_trans (le_maxEnd s n i h) (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
1532	    · exact Nat.le_max_right _ _
1533	
1534	/-- A placement above every registered allocation, on a multiple of the alignment (§9 ¶11; a
1535	witness that `PlacementOK` is satisfiable, `topPlacement_ok`). -/
1536	def topPlacement : Placement := fun s g => g.align * (maxEnd s s.next / g.align + 1)
1537	
1538	/-- `topPlacement` satisfies its obligation (§9 ¶11, §82.4). -/
1539	theorem topPlacement_ok : PlacementOK topPlacement := by
1540	  intro s g hwf h0 h2
1541	  refine ⟨hwf _ (Nat.le_refl _), h0, h2, Nat.mul_mod_right _ _, fun i a ha _ _ => ?_⟩
1542	  have hi : i < s.next := Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
1543	  have he : a.base + a.size ≤ maxEnd s s.next := by
1544	    have := le_maxEnd s s.next i hi; simpa [allocEnd, ha] using this
1545	  have hb := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (maxEnd s s.next) h0
1546	  exact Machine.rangeDisjoint_iff.2 (.inl (by simp only [topPlacement]; omega))
1547	
1548	/-- Justification of `Satisfiable` on the side of the memory machine (§82.4, §71, §9): addresses
1549	are unbounded naturals in this kernel (§9 ¶6), so every allocation of valid alignment has a valid
1550	placement in a state with fresh identities. A defined `fail` of `alloc` (§71) therefore comes from
1551	the provider's contract, never from the machine; address width belongs to §81 (Spec 11). -/
1552	theorem placement_exists {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) (g : Geom) (h0 : 0 < g.align)
1553	    (h2 : Machine.Pow2 g.align) : ∃ base, Machine.AllocPre s g.space base g.size g.align :=
1554	  ⟨_, topPlacement_ok s g hwf h0 h2⟩
1555	
1556	/-- The creations realizing new root places (§71, §72, §47): for each root element `i` of a shape
1557	appended after `n` places, in order, one allocation of geometry `g (n + i)` at the base chosen by
1558	`pl`, recording the token `rtok (n + i)`. -/
1559	def allocOps {Ty : Type} (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
1560	    Machine.State → List Nat → List (Machine.Op Ty)
1561	  | _, [] => []
1562	  | s, i :: is => .alloc (g (n + i)).space (pl s (g (n + i))) (g (n + i)).size (g (n + i)).align
1563	      (some (rtok (n + i))) :: allocOps pl g rtok n (s.alloc (g (n + i)).space (pl s (g (n + i)))
1564	        (g (n + i)).size (g (n + i)).align (some (rtok (n + i)))) is

1570	/-- The creations are `ok` under the placement and geometry obligations (§9 ¶11). -/
1571	theorem allocOps_ok {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
1572	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {pl : Placement} {g : Nat → Geom} (hpl : PlacementOK pl)
1573	    (hg : GeomOK g) : ∀ (is : List Nat) (s : Machine.State), Machine.WF s →
1574	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok n s is)
1575	  | [], _, _ => trivial
1576	  | _ :: is, s, h =>
1577	    ⟨.alloc (.ok (hpl s _ h (hg _).1 (hg _).2)),
1578	      allocOps_ok hpl hg is _ (Machine.alloc_wf h _ _ _ _ _)⟩

1580	/-- The creations keep every identity below the counter (§13 ¶3). -/
1581	theorem allocOps_old : ∀ (is : List Nat) (s : Machine.State) (i : Nat), i < s.next →
1582	    (run s (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok n s is)).allocs i = s.allocs i
1583	  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
1584	  | _ :: is, s, i, hi => by
1585	    show (run (s.alloc _ _ _ _ _) (allocOps pl g rtok n _ is)).allocs i = _
1586	    rw [allocOps_old is _ i (by simp only [Machine.State.alloc]; omega)]
1587	    simp [Machine.State.alloc, Nat.ne_of_lt hi]

1589	/-- The `j`-th creation registers the identity `next + j`, live, uninitialized, with the geometry
1590	of its root and its token (§9 ¶11, §10 ¶5, §13 ¶1). -/
1591	theorem allocOps_new : ∀ (is : List Nat) (s : Machine.State) (j i : Nat), is[j]? = some i →
1592	    ∃ b, (run s (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok n s is)).allocs (s.next + j) =
1593	      some ⟨(g (n + i)).space, b, (g (n + i)).size, (g (n + i)).align, true, fun _ => .uninit,
1594	        some (rtok (n + i))⟩
1595	  | [], _, _, _, h => by simp at h
1596	  | k :: is, s, 0, i, h => by
1597	    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1598	    refine ⟨pl s (g (n + k)), ?_⟩
1599	    show (run (s.alloc _ _ _ _ _) (allocOps pl g rtok n _ is)).allocs _ = _
1600	    rw [allocOps_old pl g rtok n is _ _ (by simp [Machine.State.alloc])]
1601	    simp [Machine.State.alloc]
1602	  | k :: is, s, j + 1, i, h => by
1603	    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h
1604	    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := allocOps_new is (s.alloc (g (n + k)).space (pl s (g (n + k)))
1605	      (g (n + k)).size (g (n + k)).align (some (rtok (n + k)))) j i h
1606	    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
1607	    show (run (s.alloc _ _ _ _ _) (allocOps pl g rtok n _ is)).allocs _ = _
1608	    rw [show s.next + (j + 1) = (s.alloc (g (n + k)).space (pl s (g (n + k))) (g (n + k)).size
1609	      (g (n + k)).align (some (rtok (n + k)))).next + j by simp only [Machine.State.alloc]; omega]
1610	    exact hb

1612	/-- The creations contain no deallocation (§9 ¶11). -/
1613	theorem allocOps_noDealloc : ∀ (s : Machine.State) (is : List Nat),
1614	    ∀ o ∈ allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok n s is, NoDealloc o
1615	  | _, [], _, h => nomatch h
1616	  | _, _ :: is, o, h => by
1617	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
1618	    · trivial
1619	    · exact allocOps_noDealloc _ is o h

1632	/-- Layout obligations of a shape appended after `n` places, whose root elements `roots` receive
1633	the fresh allocations `next`, `next + 1`, … (§82.1, §71, §72, §47): the `j`-th new root is in the
1634	allocation `next + j`; a new part is in the allocation of its parent; a new leaf is in the
1635	allocation of a new root, within its size; two distinct new leaves in one allocation have
1636	disjoint ranges. -/
1637	structure NewLayout (L : Layout) (P' : List Place) (n next : Nat) (g : Nat → Geom)
1638	    (roots : List Nat) : Prop where
1639	  /-- §82.1: the `j`-th new root lies in the allocation `next + j`. -/
1640	  rootAt : ∀ j < roots.length, OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => (L (n + i)).alloc = next + j) True
1641	  /-- §82.1: a new part lies in the allocation of its parent. -/
1642	  parts : ∀ q < P'.length, n ≤ q → OptP (parentOf P' q) (fun r => (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc) True
1643	  /-- §82.1: a new leaf lies in the allocation of a new root, within its size. -/
1644	  leaves : ∀ l < P'.length, n ≤ l → isLeaf P' l → ∃ j < roots.length,
1645	    OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => (L l).alloc = next + j ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ (g (n + i)).size)
1646	      False
1647	  /-- §23, §82.1: two distinct new leaves in one allocation have disjoint ranges. -/
1648	  disjoint : ∀ l < P'.length, ∀ l' < P'.length, NewDisjoint L P' n l l'
1649	
1650	/-- Decidability of `NewLayout` (§82.1). -/
1651	instance (L : Layout) (P' : List Place) (n next : Nat) (g : Nat → Geom) (roots : List Nat) :
1652	    Decidable (NewLayout L P' n next g roots) := by
1653	  haveI d1 : Decidable (∀ j < roots.length,
1654	      OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => (L (n + i)).alloc = next + j) True) := inferInstance
1655	  haveI d2 : Decidable (∀ q < P'.length, n ≤ q →
1656	      OptP (parentOf P' q) (fun r => (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc) True) := inferInstance
1657	  haveI d3 : Decidable (∀ l < P'.length, n ≤ l → isLeaf P' l → ∃ j < roots.length,
1658	      OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => (L l).alloc = next + j ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ (g (n + i)).size)
1659	        False) := inferInstance
1660	  haveI d4 : Decidable (∀ l < P'.length, ∀ l' < P'.length, NewDisjoint L P' n l l') :=
1661	    inferInstance
1662	  exact decidable_of_iff ((∀ j < roots.length,
1663	      OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => (L (n + i)).alloc = next + j) True) ∧
1664	    (∀ q < P'.length, n ≤ q → OptP (parentOf P' q) (fun r => (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc) True) ∧
1665	    (∀ l < P'.length, n ≤ l → isLeaf P' l → ∃ j < roots.length,
1666	      OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => (L l).alloc = next + j ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ (g (n + i)).size)
1667	        False) ∧
1668	    (∀ l < P'.length, ∀ l' < P'.length, NewDisjoint L P' n l l'))
1669	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

1940	      show l < (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))).length
1941	      rw [shapeP_len]; simpa using hl.1
1942	    obtain ⟨a, ha, hs⟩ := hR₁.layout.within l hlP hl.2.1

1961	active authority is an existing leaf whose allocation is live and contains its range: no active

1967	      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size := by

1969	  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlP
1970	  have hur : s3.Usable r := Decidable.of_not_not fun hn =>
1971	    hnd j y hy ya r hn l (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hlf, hlr⟩) hl

1998	/-- Disjointness of the bytes of two regions (§23, §82.1): every leaf of `r` and every leaf of `r'`
1999	are in different allocations or have disjoint ranges (§9 ¶3). -/
2000	def ByteDisjoint (L : Layout) (r r' : List Nat) : Prop :=
2001	  ∀ l ∈ r, ∀ l' ∈ r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc ∨
2002	    Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len
2003	
2004	/-- §23: leaf disjointness, the normative condition of `DeclaredDisjoint`, implies disjointness of
2005	the corresponding bytes under a layout satisfying `LayoutWF`. -/
2006	theorem byteDisjoint_of_leaves {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
2007	    (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) {r r' : List Nat} (hr : ∀ l ∈ r, l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l)
2008	    (hr' : ∀ l ∈ r', l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l) (hd : ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') :
2009	    ByteDisjoint L r r' := by
2010	  intro l hl l' hl'
2011	  by_cases e : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc
2012	  · exact .inr (hlw.disjoint l l' (hr l hl).1 (hr' l' hl').1 (hr l hl).2 (hr' l' hl').2
2013	      (fun h => hd l hl (h ▸ hl')) e)
2014	  · exact .inl e

2016	/-- Actual disjointness of `DeclaredDisjoint` declarations (§82.1, §23, §80 `DDSound`): under
2017	`DDSound(K)` and `LayoutWF`, two regions of leaves declared disjoint have disjoint bytes. -/
2018	theorem declaredDisjoint_bytes {k : K} {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
2019	    (hdd : DDSound k) (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) {r r' : List Nat} (hdecl : k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
2020	    (hr : ∀ l ∈ r, l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l)
2021	    (hr' : ∀ l ∈ r', l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l) : ByteDisjoint L r r' :=
2022	  byteDisjoint_of_leaves hlw hr hr' (hdd r r' hdecl)

2024	/-- `exclusive_bytes` (§82.8, §50, §23): under `LayoutWF` and `I1`, if authority `a` has the
2025	effective mode `Modify` on leaf `l`, no other authority has an effective mode on a leaf `l'` whose
2026	range overlaps the range of `l` in the same allocation: the memory justification of non-aliasing on
2027	the side of the kernel. -/
2028	theorem exclusive_bytes {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
2029	    (hI1 : I1 s3) {a b l l' : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
2030	    (hl' : l' < s3.P.length) (hlf' : isLeaf s3.P l') (ha : effective s3 a l = some .modify)
2031	    (hab : a ≠ b) (hsame : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc)
2032	    (hover : ¬ Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) :
2033	    effective s3 b l' = none := by
2034	  by_cases e : l = l'
2035	  · subst e; exact effective_exclusive hI1 hab ha
2036	  · exact absurd (hlw.disjoint l l' hl hl' hlf hlf' e hsame) hover

2041	`write` and `writeShared` are data of the program (§10 ¶4, §16 ¶2), carried by the operation; the

2043	inductive KOp where

2077	/-- The `ok` step of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75). -/
2078	def OpStep (k : K) : KOp → S3 → S3 → Prop
2079	  | .derive src region m, s, s' => DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')
2080	  | .split src rs, s, s' => SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')
2081	  | .release a, s, s' => ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')
2082	  | .transfer src dst, s, s' => TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')
2083	  | .depend q x, s, s' => DependStep q x s (.ok s')
2084	  | .enter ps ls, s, s' => EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')
2085	  | .exit, s, s' => ExitStep k s (.ok s')
2086	  | .read a ls, s, s' => Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')
2087	  | .write a ls _, s, s' => Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')
2088	  | .writeShared a ls _, s, s' => WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s')
2089	  | .pin p, s, s' => PinStep p s (.ok s')
2090	  | .unpin o, s, s' => UnpinStep k o s (.ok s')
2091	  | .endUse p, s, s' => EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')
2092	  | .free p auth, s, s' => FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')
2093	  | .alloc pr ow ls, s, s' => AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')
2094	  | .store a p, s, s' => StoreStep a p s (.ok s')

2098	  cases op with

2100	  | split => exact .split h
2101	  | release => exact .release h
2102	  | transfer => exact .transfer h
2103	  | depend => exact .depend h
2104	  | enter => exact .enter h
2105	  | exit => exact .exit h
2106	  | read => exact .read h
2107	  | write => exact .write h
2108	  | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
2109	  | pin => exact .pin h
2110	  | unpin => exact .unpin h
2111	  | endUse => exact .endUse h

2113	  | alloc => exact .alloc h

2118	/-- Parameters of the refinement, fixed once for a run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the layout of the places
2119	(§82.1), the deallocation token recorded for the allocation of each root place (§17 ¶4, §82.4),
2120	the placement and geometry of new allocations (§9 ¶11, §82.4), the type of each leaf (§15, §16;
2121	types belong to Spec 4), the encoding of references (§82.3; Spec 11), the initial representation
2122	of the static leaves (§47, §10 ¶5). -/
2123	structure Params (Ty : Type) where
2124	  /-- §82.1: layout of the places. -/
2125	  L : Layout
2126	  /-- §17 ¶4, §82.4: token recorded for the allocation of each root place. -/
2127	  rtok : Nat → Nat
2128	  /-- §9 ¶11, §82.4: placement of new allocations. -/
2129	  pl : Placement
2130	  /-- §9 ¶1: geometry of the allocation of each root place. -/
2131	  geom : Nat → Geom
2132	  /-- §15, §16: type of each leaf. -/
2133	  ty : Nat → Ty
2134	  /-- §82.3: encoding of references. -/
2135	  pe : PtrEnc
2136	  /-- §47, §10 ¶5: initial representation of the static leaves. -/
2137	  ival : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat
2138	
2139	/-- Obligations of the parameters (§9 ¶11, §17.2): a valid placement, valid alignments, and each
2140	recorded token compatible with itself (the automatic deallocation at `exitFrame` presents the
2141	recorded token, §73, §82.5). -/
2142	def ParamsOK {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params Ty) : Prop :=
2143	  PlacementOK π.pl ∧ GeomOK π.geom ∧ ∀ r, C (π.rtok r) (π.rtok r)

2145	/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from `s3`, the memory state being `s2` (§82
2146	preamble; §82.2–§82.5): computed from the parameters and the two states, nothing chosen per
2147	step. -/
2148	def opsOf {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : KOp → S3 → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
2149	  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps π.L π.ty s2 s3 src dst
2150	  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
2151	  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok s3
2152	  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L π.ty ls
2153	  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
2154	  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
2155	  | .free p auth, _, _ => freeOps π.L p auth
2156	  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
2157	  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty s3 a p
2158	  | _, _, _ => []

2160	/-- Obligations of one step (§20.3, §82): the parametric obligations of its reads and writes
2161	(§20.3, §15, §16); the layout of new places (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, §82.1, §23 `LayoutWF`); the
2162	instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` on the deallocation compatibility of the machine (`free`, §80,
2163	§70.2, §82.4). -/
2164	def StepObl {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
2165	    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
2166	    Prop :=
2167	  OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2) ∧
2168	    match op with
2169	    | .enter _ ls => NewLayout π.L (enterP s3 ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
2170	    | .alloc _ ow ls => NewLayout π.L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom
2171	        (rootIdx ls.toShape)
2172	    | .free p auth => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.rtok p auth
2173	    | _ => True

2856	def sstep (st : S3 × Machine.State) (op : KOp) : Option (S3 × Machine.State) :=

2858	  then some (opEff3 op st.1, run st.2 (opsOf π op st.1 st.2)) else none

2863	  | st, op :: ops => (sstep k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

2867	/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun` (§82 preamble). -/
2868	theorem srun_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
2869	    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
2870	    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]
2871	    [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)] {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
2872	    [DecidableRel C] {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty}
2873	    [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] {π : Params Ty} {statics : Statics} :
2874	    ∀ (ops : List KOp) (st st' : S3 × Machine.State),
2875	      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π st.1 st.2 → srun k C ObR ObW π st ops = some st' →
2876	      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π st'.1 st'.2
2877	  | [], st, st', h, he => by
2878	    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact h
2879	  | op :: ops, st, st', h, he => by
2880	    simp only [srun] at he
2881	    cases hs : sstep k C ObR ObW π st op with
2882	    | none => rw [hs] at he; cases he
2883	    | some st₁ =>
2884	      rw [hs] at he
2885	      simp only [Option.bind_some] at he
2886	      unfold sstep at hs
2887	      split at hs
2888	      · rename_i hc
2889	        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hs; subst hs
2890	        exact srun_sound ops _ st' (.step h (opStep_of_pre hc.1) hc.2) he
2891	      · cases hs

2912	/-- Number of root places below `r`: the identity of the allocation of the root `r` when every root
2913	place receives one allocation in index order (§9 ¶11, §82.1). -/
2914	def rootRank (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Nat :=
2915	  ((List.range r).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ parentOf P i = none)).length

2919	  ((List.range l).filter fun i => decide (isLeaf P i ∧ rootOf P i = rootOf P l)).length

2921	/-- Test layout for the places `P` (§82.1): a place in the allocation of its root; a leaf of 8

2925	  if rootOf P q ∈ z then ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 0, 0⟩
2926	  else ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 8 * leafRank P q, 8⟩

2937	/-- Test reference encoding (§82.3): 8 bytes, little-endian, each with the provenance. -/
2938	def pe8 : PtrEnc where
2939	  size := 8
2940	  enc addr prov i := ((addr / 256 ^ i % 256).toUInt8, prov)
2941	  decode f := (List.range 8).foldr (fun i acc => acc + (f i).1.toNat * 256 ^ i) 0
2942	  reads f g h := by
2943	    have key : ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ i ∈ l, i < 8) →
2944	        l.foldr (fun i acc => acc + (f i).1.toNat * 256 ^ i) 0 =
2945	          l.foldr (fun i acc => acc + (g i).1.toNat * 256 ^ i) 0 := by
2946	      intro l hl
2947	      induction l with
2948	      | nil => rfl
2949	      | cons a l ih =>
2950	        simp only [List.foldr_cons]
2951	        rw [ih fun i hi => hl i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi), h a (hl a (List.mem_cons_self ..))]

35	/-- An operation of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel operation O1–O16 of non-administrative
36	code (§60–§75), or one of the derived arena operations O17–O19 (§76–§78). -/
37	inductive LOp where
38	  /-- A kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75). -/
39	  | kernel (op : KOp)
40	  /-- O17 `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76); `others` are the other registries of live
41	  administrations consulted by the guard (§56, §76.4). -/
42	  | newArena (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat)
43	  /-- O18 `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` (§77). -/
44	  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
45	  /-- O19 `reset(arena)` of entry `i` (§78). -/
46	  | reset (i : Nat)

48	/-- The `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §58): a kernel step leaves the registry
49	unchanged (§46); the arena operations are the derived operations (`NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`,
50	`ResetD`). -/
51	def LOpStep (k : K) : LOp → LState → LState → Prop
52	  | .kernel op, L, L' => OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas
53	  | .newArena others st i, L, L' => NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')
54	  | .issue i region dst, L, L' => IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')
55	  | .reset i, L, L' => ResetD i L (.ok L')
56	
57	/-- A labelled library step is a library step (Part XIV, §76–§78). -/
58	theorem LOpStep.lstep {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
59	    LStep k L L' := by
60	  cases lop with
61	  | kernel op =>
62	    have h' : OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas := h
63	    obtain ⟨s', ar⟩ := L'
64	    obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := h'
65	    dsimp only at hs ha
66	    subst ha
67	    exact .kernel hs.kstep
68	  | newArena => exact .newArena h
69	  | issue => exact .issue h
70	  | reset => exact .reset h

72	/-- Every kernel step is the `ok` step of a kernel operation (§57, §58); the representations
73	carried by `write` and `writeShared` are not read by the kernel (§10 ¶4). -/
74	theorem kstep_labelled {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : ∃ op, OpStep k op s s' := by
75	  cases h with
76	  | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
77	  | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
78	  | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
79	  | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
80	  | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
81	  | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
82	  | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
83	  | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
84	  | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
85	  | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
86	  | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
87	  | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
88	  | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
89	  | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
90	  | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
91	  | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩

94	steps cover all library runs. -/
95	theorem LStep.labelled {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : ∃ lop, LOpStep k lop L L' := by
96	  cases h with
97	  | kernel hk =>
98	    obtain ⟨op, h⟩ := kstep_labelled hk
99	    exact ⟨.kernel op, h, rfl⟩
100	  | newArena hs => exact ⟨.newArena _ _ _, hs⟩
101	  | issue hs => exact ⟨.issue _ _ _, hs⟩
102	  | reset hs => exact ⟨.reset _, hs⟩
103	
104	/-- The kernel steps realizing a library operation from `L`, each with the kernel state it starts
105	from (Part XIV, §82.7): a kernel operation is its own step; `newArena` has none (§76: it registers
106	an administration without modifying the kernel); `issue` is `split` of `internal` on the region,
107	then `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (§77); `reset` is
108	`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, then `release` of the derived authority `|A|`
109	(§78). Without an entry, there is no step. -/
110	def kexp : LOp → LState → List (KOp × S3)
111	  | .kernel op, L => [(op, L.kern)]
112	  | .newArena .., _ => []
113	  | .issue i region dst, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
114	    | some E => [(.split E.internal [region], L.kern),
115	        (.store L.kern.A.length dst, splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])]
116	    | none => []
117	  | .reset i, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
118	    | some E => [(.derive E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify, L.kern),
119	        (.release L.kern.A.length,
120	          deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)]
121	    | none => []

124	inductive KPath (k : K) : S3 → List (KOp × S3) → S3 → Prop where
125	  | nil (s : S3) : KPath k s [] s
126	  | cons {op : KOp} {s s₁ s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} :

132	    KPath k L.kern (kexp lop L) L'.kern := by

150	      simp only [kexp, hE]

219	/-- The raw operations realizing a sequence of kernel steps (§82 preamble, §20.3): the raw
220	operations `opsOf` of each step, in the memory state reached by the previous ones. -/
221	def ktrace (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
222	  | [], _ => []
223	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 => opsOf π op s3 s2 ++ ktrace π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

226	def lopsOf (π : Params Ty) (lop : LOp) (L : LState) (s2 : Machine.State) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=

229	/-- The raw operations of composed kernel sequences are composed (§20.3 ¶3). -/
230	theorem ktrace_append (π : Params Ty) (t t' : List (KOp × S3)) (s2 : Machine.State) :
231	    ktrace π (t ++ t') s2 = ktrace π t s2 ++ ktrace π t' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by

233	  | nil => rfl
234	  | cons p t ih =>
235	    obtain ⟨op, s3⟩ := p
236	    simp only [List.cons_append, ktrace, ih, run_append, List.append_assoc]

238	/-- The obligations of each kernel step of a sequence (§20.3, §82; `StepObl`), in the memory

240	def KObl (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)

243	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>

253	/-- Realization of a kernel sequence (§82 preamble, R6 of each step): from states satisfying
254	`WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of each step, the raw operations of the sequence

256	theorem r6_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
257	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}

260	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 →
261	      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
262	        Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
263	  induction hp with
264	  | nil => intro s2 _ _ hR; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
265	  | cons h _ ih =>
266	    intro s2 hinv hob hR
267	    obtain ⟨hw, hnd⟩ := hinv _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
268	    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
269	    obtain ⟨hex, hR₁⟩ := r6 hπ hR hw hnd h hob₁
270	    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := ih (fun q hq => hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)) hob₂ hR₁
271	    simp only [ktrace]

276	state satisfies `WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of its kernel steps, the raw
277	operations of an `ok` library step form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after

279	theorem lr6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
280	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState}
281	    {s2 : Machine.State} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
282	    (hw : WF3 L.kern) (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (h : LOpStep k lop L L')
283	    (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2) :
284	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π lop L s2) s2 (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) ∧
285	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) :=
286	  r6_path hπ (kexp_path h) (kexp_inv h hw hnd) hob hR

289	invariant hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47); every step of the sequence
290	starts from a reachable state (`KPath.reach`), where `WF3` and `NoDangling` hold
291	(`Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
292	theorem r6_path_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}

656	      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →

672	      KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 → SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
673	  induction hp with
674	  | nil => intro s2 h _; exact h
675	  | cons h _ ih =>
676	    intro s2 hs hob
677	    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
678	    have := ih (SimRun.step hs h hob₁) hob₂
679	    simp only [ktrace]
680	    rw [run_append]

933	/-! ## A concrete library run (non-vacuity; §82.7, Part XIV) -/
934	
935	section Dec
936	
937	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
938	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
939	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
940	  {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
941	  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)
942	
943	/-- Decidability of the obligations of a kernel sequence (§20.3, §82). -/
944	instance kOblDec : (t : List (KOp × S3)) → (s2 : Machine.State) →
945	    Decidable (KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2)
946	  | [], _ => isTrue trivial
947	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
948	    @instDecidableAnd _ _ (stepOblDec k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) (kOblDec t _)
949	
950	end Dec
951	
952	namespace Runs
953	
954	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs
955	
956	/-- Memory state after the library operations `t`, each listed with the library state it starts
957	from, from the memory state `m` (§82.7). -/
958	def lrunM {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : List (LOp × LState) → Machine.State → Machine.State
959	  | [], m => m
960	  | (lop, L) :: t, m => lrunM π t (run m (lopsOf π lop L m))
961	
962	/-- The memory state after library operations is reached by the raw operations of their kernel
963	steps (§82.7). -/
964	theorem lrunM_eq {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) :
965	    ∀ (t : List (LOp × LState)) (m : Machine.State), lrunM π t m = run m (ktrace π (ltrace t) m)
966	  | [], _ => rfl
967	  | (lop, L) :: t, m => by
968	    rw [lrunM, lrunM_eq π t, ltrace, ktrace_append, run_append]
969	    rfl
970	
971	/-- A library run through every derived arena operation (Part XIV, §76–§78; the states of
972	`Arena.Witness`): `derive(1, [1], Modify)` and `store(3, 0)` prepare `internal` 3 held by the arena
973	value 0; `newArena(1, 3)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` (block 4 stored into 2); `write(4, [1])`;
974	`endUse(2)`; `reset(0)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` again (block 6). -/
975	def tA : List (LOp × LState) :=
976	  [(.kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify), Witness.w0), (.kernel (.store 3 0), Witness.w1),
977	   (.newArena [] 1 3, Witness.w2), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.w3),
978	   (.kernel (.write 4 [1] wv), Witness.r4), (.kernel (.endUse 2), Witness.r5),
979	   (.reset 0, Witness.r6), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.r7)]
980	
981	/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once (§82): the test layout of the three static places. -/
982	def πA : Params Unit := piOf (S3.init st).P []
983	
984	/-- Final memory state of the run (§82.7). -/
985	def finA : Machine.State := lrunM πA tA (minit πA st)
986	
987	/-- The run is a translated library run (§82.7, non-vacuity of `LSimRun`): each step is an `ok`
988	library step and its kernel steps satisfy their obligations under the fixed parameters. -/
989	theorem runA_lsim : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.r8 finA := by
990	  have h0 : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.w0 (minit πA st) :=
991	    .init (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
992	  have h1 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify)) (L' := Witness.w1) h0
993	    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
994	  have h2 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.store 3 0)) (L' := Witness.w2) h1
995	    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
996	  have h3 := LSimRun.step (lop := .newArena [] 1 3) (L' := Witness.w3) h2 (.ok (by decide))
997	    (by decide)
998	  have h4 := LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r4) h3
999	    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
1000	      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)
1001	  have h5 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.write 4 [1] wv)) (L' := Witness.r5) h4
1002	    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
1003	  have h6 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.endUse 2)) (L' := Witness.r6) h5
1004	    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
1005	  have h7 := LSimRun.step (lop := .reset 0) (L' := Witness.r7) h6
1006	    (ResetD.ok (E := Witness.rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide))
1007	    (by decide)
1008	  exact LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r8) h7
1009	    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
1010	      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)
1011	
1012	/-- Non-vacuity of the library simulation (§82.7, §82.3): the run is translated into an execution
1013	of `ok` raw steps from the empty state, `Repr` holds at its end, the final library state is
1014	library-reachable, and the machine trace is the trace of the kernel steps. The reference written
1015	into the arena value 0 and the one written into the destination 2 by the second issue decode to
1016	the address of the storage leaf 1, which is nonzero and whose allocation is live. The range of
1017	leaf 1 still holds the bytes written through block 4 before the `reset`: reissued in block 6, the
1018	leaf keeps its bytes in the memory machine (v0.1 §86: reissuance modifies neither the bytes,
1019	`issue_keeps_bytes`, nor the initialization state, `Arena.issue_keeps_init`; see
1020	`Arena.Witness.reissue_reads_former_value`). -/
1021	theorem runA_sim :
1022	    ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW ops Machine.State.empty finA) ∧
1023	      Refinement.Repr πA.L πA.rtok Witness.r8.kern finA ∧ LReach K0 st Witness.r8) ∧
1024	    finA = run (minit πA st) (ktrace πA (ltrace tA) (minit πA st)) ∧
1025	    decodedAt πA finA 0 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧ decodedAt πA finA 2 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧
1026	    leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ≠ 0 ∧ (finA.allocs (πA.L 1).alloc).map (·.live) = some true ∧
1027	    ∀ n < 8, bytesOf finA πA.L 1 n = wv 1 n :=
1028	  ⟨lsimulation (fun _ _ h => h.elim) (piOf_ok _ []) runA_lsim, lrunM_eq _ _ _, by decide,
1029	    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
1030	
1031	end Runs
1032	
1033	end Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants
5	
6	Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
7	candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC4.md` (WC4 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
8	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).
9	
10	* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC4 C1–C3);
11	* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
12	  `ancestorC` (WC4 C3);
13	* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC4 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
14	  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
15	  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC4 C24);
16	* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC4 C20; Spec 1 §44,
17	  §49–§57 re-indexed);
18	* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
19	  membership agree on every view (WC4 C2).
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.Concurrency
23	
24	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
25	
26	/-! ## State (WC4 C1–C3) -/
27	
28	/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC4 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
29	inductive Life where
30	  | live
31	  | done
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Execution context (WC4 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
35	state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
36	the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
37	structure Ctx where
38	  stack : List Nat
39	  life : Life
40	  parent : Option Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
44	stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
45	meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
46	structure SC where
47	  C : List Ctx
48	  nF : Nat
49	  P : List Place
50	  I : Nat → InitSt
51	  A : List Authority
52	  D : Nat → List Nat
53	  dead : Nat → Bool
54	  pins : List PinOb
55	
56	/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
57	def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False
58	
59	/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
60	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance
61	
62	/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
63	def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
64	  match s.C[c]? with
65	  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
66	  | none => []
67	
68	/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
69	def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)
70	
71	/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
72	def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk
73	
74	/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
75	references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
76	def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
77	  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
78	    pins := s.pins }
79	
80	/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
81	frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
82	view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
83	(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
84	def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
85	  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }
86	
87	/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
88	def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
89	  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }
90	
91	/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/
92	
93	/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
94	parent. -/
95	def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]
96	
97	/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
98	def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
99	  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
100	    pins := s.pins }
101	
102	/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
103	def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
104	  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
105	    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }
106	
107	/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/
108	
109	/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
110	the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1
111	§39). -/
112	def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
113	  | [] => none
114	  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest
115	
116	/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
117	def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
118	  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f
119	
120	/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC4 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
121	links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
122	def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
123	  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)
124	
125	/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC4 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
126	its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
127	paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
128	def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
129	  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)
130	
131	/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC4 C3). -/
132	instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
133	  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance
134	
135	/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC4 C2, C3) -/
136	
137	/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC4 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
138	`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
139	def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
140	  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
141	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False
142	
143	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
144	instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
145	  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance
146	
147	/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
148	place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
149	def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
150	  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)
151	
152	/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
153	theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
154	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
155	      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
156	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
157	
158	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
159	instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm
160	
161	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
162	active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
163	def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
164	  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
165	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)
166	
167	/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
168	for Spec 1 §44). -/
169	theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
170	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
171	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
172	        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
173	  constructor
174	  · intro h q _ hq x _
175	    unfold OptP; split
176	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
177	    · trivial

188	/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the

191	  /-- WC4 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
192	  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
193	  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
194	  /-- WC4 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
195	  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
196	  /-- WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
197	  nodup : s.frames.Nodup

199	  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF

202	  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
203	  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC4 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
204	  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/

212	depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/

214	  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)

233	theorem SC.live_of_stk {s : SC} {c : Nat} (h : s.stk c ≠ []) : s.Live c := by
234	  unfold SC.stk at h; unfold SC.Live
235	  split at h
236	  · rename_i x hx; rw [hx]; simp only [OptP]; split at h
237	    · assumption
238	    · exact absurd rfl h
239	  · exact absurd rfl h

242	theorem SC.mem_frames_of {s : SC} {c f : Nat} (h : f ∈ s.stk c) : f ∈ s.frames := by
243	  have hc : c < s.C.length := by
244	    unfold SC.stk at h; split at h
245	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
246	    · simp at h
247	  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨c, List.mem_range.2 hc, h⟩

249	/-- Globally live frames are the frames of some stack (WC4 C2). -/
250	theorem SC.mem_frames {s : SC} {f : Nat} : f ∈ s.frames ↔ ∃ c, f ∈ s.stk c := by
251	  constructor
252	  · intro h; obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h; exact ⟨c, hc⟩
253	  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact SC.mem_frames_of hc

257	  simp only [SC.view, SC.flat, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
258	  constructor
259	  · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩)
260	    · exact SC.mem_frames_of h
261	    · exact h
262	  · intro h
263	    by_cases hc : f ∈ s.stk c
264	    · exact .inl hc
265	    · exact .inr ⟨h, hc⟩

268	theorem nodup_of_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} :
269	    ∀ {l : List α} {a : α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → a ∈ l → (f a).Nodup
270	  | b :: l, a, h, ha => by
271	    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
272	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with rfl | ha
273	    · exact (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
274	    · exact nodup_of_flatMap (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1 ha
275

277	globally unique). -/

279	    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.flatMap f).Nodup → l.Nodup → ∀ {a a' : α} {x : β}, a ∈ l → a' ∈ l →
280	      x ∈ f a → x ∈ f a' → a = a'
281	  | b :: l, h, hl, a, a', x, ha, ha', hx, hx' => by
282	    rw [List.flatMap_cons] at h
283	    obtain ⟨-, h₂, h₃⟩ := List.nodup_append.1 h
284	    have hl' := (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).2
285	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with e₁ | h₁ <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha' with e₂ | h₂'
286	    · rw [e₁, e₂]
287	    · subst e₁; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a', h₂', hx'⟩))
288	    · subst e₂; exact absurd rfl (h₃ x hx' x (List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a, h₁, hx⟩))

311	/-! ## Membership congruence (WC4 C2)
312	
313	The clauses of `WF3`, `I1`–`I3`, `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (Spec 1 §49–§54) read the stack only
314	through membership; they agree on states that differ only by the order of the stack. -/

320	/-- Usability depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40). -/
321	theorem usable_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) {q : Nat} :

323	  ⟨S3.Usable.mono (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).1 h)
324	    (fun _ h => h),
325	   S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := { t with F := F' }) rfl (fun f h => (hF f).2 h)
326	    (fun _ h => h)⟩

329	theorem holderLive_mem_congr (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) (h : Holder) :
330	    HolderLive ({ t with F := F' } : S3) h ↔ HolderLive t h := by
331	  cases h with

333	  | place p => exact usable_mem_congr hF

336	(Spec 1 §49). -/

338	    (hne : F' ≠ []) : WF3 { t with F := F' } where
339	  frames := ⟨hne, hnd, fun f hf => hw.frames.2.2 f ((hF f).1 hf)⟩
340	  places := hw.places
341	  owners := ⟨hw.owners.1, hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => by
342	    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)
343	    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (s' := { t with F := F' }) (s := t) rfl).2 hf, (hF f).2 hfF⟩⟩
344	  footprints := hw.footprints
345	  origins := hw.origins
346	  rootChain := hw.rootChain
347	  rootHeld := fun r hr hu => hw.rootHeld r hr ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hu)
348	  holders := fun a y hy ya => (holderLive_mem_congr hF _).2 (hw.holders a y hy ya)

370	  intro he

372	  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
373	  · rename_i x hx

375	    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hs
376	    have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
377	    rw [he] at this; simp at this

3	/-!
4	# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions
5	
6	* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
7	  executed by a live context `c` (WC4 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
8	  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
9	  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
10	  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC4 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
11	  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
12	* `spawn` (WC4 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC4 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
13	  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC4 C8);
14	* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.
15	
16	Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled (WC4 C8).
17	-/

23	/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/
24	
25	/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
26	def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
27	  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
28	  | .reject => .reject
29	  | .fail => .fail
30	
31	/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/
32	
33	/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
34	membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
35	otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
36	def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
37	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃
