39	/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/
40	
41	/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/
42	def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)
43	
44	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC4 C2): the clauses of
45	`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
46	structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
47	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
48	  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
49	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
50	  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
51	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
52	  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
53	  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
54	  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
55	  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
56	  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
57	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
58	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
59	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
60	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
61	  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
62	  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
63	  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
64	  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
65	  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
66	    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
67	      RightChain (s.view c) g j
68	  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
69	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
70	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
71	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
72	  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
73	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
74	  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
75	  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
76	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
77	    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
78	      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
79	        y.holder = .place q →
80	          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
81	            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
82	  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
83	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
84	  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
85	  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst
86	
87	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63). -/
88	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
89	    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
90	  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
91	    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
92	    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
93	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
94	    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
95	      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
96	        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
97	    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
98	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
99	    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
100	    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
101	      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
102	        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
103	          y.holder = .place q →
104	            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
105	              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
106	    NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst ∧ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst)
107	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
108	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
109	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
110	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

137	/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC4 C2). -/

140	/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
141	structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
142	  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
143	  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
144	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
145	  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
146	  usable : (s.view c).Usable p
147	  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
148	  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p
149	  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
150	  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
151	  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
152	  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
153	    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
154	  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
155	  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
156	    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
157	      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
158	  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)

160	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)

181	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/
182	
183	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC4 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
184	the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
185	def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
186	  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
187	    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }
188	
189	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
190	structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
191	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
192	  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
193	  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
194	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
195	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
196	  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
197	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
198	  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
199	  executing context. -/
200	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
201	  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
202	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)
203	
204	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
205	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
206	    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
207	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
208	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
209	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
210	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
211	    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
212	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

214	/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC4 C6) -/
215	
216	/-- Reparenting (WC4 C6 effect): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
217	parent `p`. -/
218	def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
219	  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x
220	
221	/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC4 C6 effect): the effect of Spec 1 on
222	the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
223	is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
224	`f` are reparented to `p`; the other ancestry links are unchanged (WC4 C6 effect). -/
225	def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
226	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
227	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
228	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }
229	
230	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC4 C6, C6.1: O7.1
231	transposed, O7.2–O7.5 on the global state). The surviving frames are the other globally live
232	frames. -/
233	structure ExitPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
234	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC4 C6, first paragraph): the current frame of `c` is not the
235	  initial frame of its context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
236	  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
237	  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
238	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
239	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
240	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
241	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
242	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
243	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
244	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
245	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
246	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
247	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
248	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
249	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)
250	
251	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
252	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
253	  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
254	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
255	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
256	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
257	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
258	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
259	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
260	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
261	    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
262	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
263	
264	/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC4 C2) -/
265	
266	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
267	re-indexed, WC4 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
268	preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
269	nothing. -/
270	def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
271	  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
272	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
273	  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
274	  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
275	  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
276	    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
277	  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
278	  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o
279	
280	/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): the `K.Satisfiable` obligation of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c`
281	is evaluated on the view of `c`: an `ok` outcome entails it. -/
282	theorem alloc_ok_satisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : SC}
283	    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s (.ok s')) : k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
284	  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
285	  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
286	  cases hR with
287	  | ok _ hsat => exact hsat
288	  | fail => cases ho
289	  | reject => cases ho
290	
291	/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): a `fail` outcome of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c` entails that
292	`K.Satisfiable` fails on the view of `c`. -/
293	theorem alloc_fail_unsatisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s : SC}
294	    (h : opStepC k (.alloc pr ow ls) c s .fail) : ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls (s.view c) := by
295	  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
296	  change AllocStep k pr ow ls (s.view c) o₃ at hR
297	  cases hR with
298	  | ok => cases ho
299	  | fail _ hsat => exact hsat
300	  | reject => cases ho
301	
302	/-! ## `spawn` (WC4 C4, on Spec 1 §72) -/
303	
304	/-- Effect of `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4 effect): a new live context of identity `|C|` whose
305	stack is the fresh frame `nF`, parented to the creating frame; the locals of the new frame and
306	their root authorities, and the yielding of the parameters, are the effects of Spec 1 §72 on the
307	view of `c`. -/
308	def spawnEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
309	  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
310	    C := s.C ++ [⟨[s.nF], .live, (s.stk c).head?⟩] }
311	
312	/-- Preconditions of `spawn` without transmitted value (WC4 C4.1–C4.5): the clauses of `EnterPre`
313	(Spec 1 §72, `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops`) re-indexed as in `EnterPreC`, with O6.3 read from the
314	current frame of the new context. C4.2 (fresh identities) and C4.4 (yield without duplication)
315	hold by construction of `spawnEff`; C4.6 concerns `spawn` with a value
316	(`Ern.Concurrency.Transfer`); the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 are theorems, not
317	preconditions. -/
318	structure SpawnPre (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
319	  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
320	  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
321	  /-- WC4 C4.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every transmitted parameter is an active derived authority held by
322	  the creating frame. -/
323	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
324	    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
325	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals of the new frame form a well-formed shape. -/
326	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
327	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.3): origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of the
328	  new context. -/
329	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p
330	  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.4): `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
331	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls)
332	
333	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `spawn` (WC4 C4). -/
334	instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
335	    Decidable (SpawnPre s c ps ls) :=
336	  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
337	      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
338	    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
339	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnEff s c ps ls).view s.C.length) p) ∧
340	    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnEff s c ps ls))
341	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
342	
343	/-- `spawn` executed by `c` (WC4 C4): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
344	def SpawnStep (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
345	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnPre s c ps ls) (spawnEff s c ps ls) o
346	
347	/-! ## `terminate` (WC4 C7, on Spec 1 §73) -/
348	
349	/-- Effect of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`
350	for its initial frame `f`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; `c` leaves the
351	live-context set with the completed lifecycle state; the context-initial frames whose parent is
352	`f` are reparented to the parent of `f` (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
353	def termEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
354	  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
355	    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := [], life := .done })
356	      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0) }
357	
358	/-- Preconditions of `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7: the O7 validity requirements applied to
359	the initial frame of a terminating non-initial context, after its nested call frames have
360	ended). -/
361	structure TermPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
362	  /-- WC4 C7: a non-initial context (WC4 C3: the base frame never exits). -/
363	  nonInitial : c ≠ 0
364	  /-- WC4 C7: the nested call frames have ended; only the initial frame remains. -/
365	  initialOnly : (s.stk c).length = 1
366	  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed: the initial frame has a surviving parent. -/
367	  hasParent : OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False
368	  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
369	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
370	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
371	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
372	  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
373	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
374	    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
375	  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
376	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
377	    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
378	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
379	  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
380	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c)
381	
382	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
383	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (TermPre k s c) :=
384	  decidable_of_iff (c ≠ 0 ∧ (s.stk c).length = 1 ∧
385	    OptP (s.ctxParent c) (fun p => p ∈ s.frames ∧ p ∉ s.stk c) False ∧
386	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
387	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
388	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
389	      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
390	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
391	      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
392	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
393	    AnchorOrderHeldC (termEffC s c))
394	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
395	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
396	
397	/-- `terminate` executed by `c` (WC4 C7): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not live. -/
398	def TermStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
399	  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TermPre k s c) (termEffC s c) o
400	
401	/-! ## `join` (WC4 C8) -/
402	
403	/-- `join d` executed by `c` (WC4 C8): `reject` when `d` is unknown to the execution (no context
404	has identity `d`, identities being the indices of `C`); `ok` with the state unchanged when `d` has
405	the completed lifecycle state; no outcome while `d` is live (WC4 C8: awaiting completion is not an
406	`Outcome3` result). -/
407	inductive JoinStep (s : SC) (c d : Nat) : Outcome3 SC → Prop where
408	  | ok : s.Live c → OptP (s.C[d]?) (fun x => x.life = .done) False → JoinStep s c d (.ok s)
409	  | reject : s.Live c → s.C[d]? = none → JoinStep s c d .reject
410	
411	/-! ## Concurrent kernel steps -/
412	
413	/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel without synchronization (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8):
414	an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by a context, `spawn`, `terminate` or `join`. -/
415	inductive CStep (k : K) : SC → SC → Prop where
416	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} : opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
417	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
418	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
419	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} : TermStep k s c (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
420	  | join {s s' : SC} {c d : Nat} : JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → CStep k s s'
421	
422	end Ern.Concurrency
423

1	import Ern.Concurrency.Sync
2	import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer
3	
4	/-!
5	# Reference synchronization library
6	
7	Library state separate from `S_C` (WC4 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
8	1 §46, §55, §56):
9	
10	* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC4 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
11	  `ControlOf` relationship (WC4 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
12	* `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22);
13	* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized` on the registry (WC4 C14.1–C14.3), and the
14	  contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
15	  synchronization contract");
16	* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
17	* labelled library steps, the by-value composite included (WC4 C23), runs, and the encapsulation
18	  hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22.1–C22.3, C22.5; C23), a predicate on runs, never a
19	  precondition of a kernel operation.
20	-/
21	
22	namespace Ern.Concurrency
23	
24	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
25	
26	/-! ## Registry (WC4 C12) -/
27	
28	/-- Synchronization entry (WC4 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
29	structure SyncEntry where
30	  guarded : Nat
31	  grant : Option Nat
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Synchronization registry (WC4 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
35	abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry
36	
37	/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC4 C12: "at its declared field
38	position", `guardedField`, `controlField`): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
39	ordered children of the mutex value. -/
40	structure MutexLayout where
41	  guardedField : Nat
42	  controlField : Nat
43	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
44	
45	/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC4 C12). -/
46	def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded
47	
48	/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC4 C12). -/
49	instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
50	  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance
51	
52	/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
53	`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
54	of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
55	def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
56	  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
57	  | some (Holder.place h) =>
58	    match parentOf s.P h with
59	    | some m =>
60	      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
61	    | none => none
62	  | _ => none
63	
64	/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC4 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
65	Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
66	def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
67	  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }
68	
69	/-- WC4 C14.3: the frame `f` has effective and exercisable access to `ControlOf(e)` under the
70	condition of Spec 1 §68.2: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
71	present effective mode on the controller. -/
72	def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
73	  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
74	    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False
75	
76	/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
77	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
78	  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance
79	
80	/-- The authorization facts of WC4 C14 for an entry: C14.1 (live), C14.2 (`grant = none`), C14.3
81	(`CtrlRight`). -/
82	def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
83	  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f
84	
85	/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
86	instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
87	  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance
88	
89	/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the
90	library (WC4 C14, C25): an entry of the registry with the requested `guarded` identity satisfies
91	the authorization facts C14.1–C14.3. -/
92	def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
93	  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f
94	
95	/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
96	instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
97	    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
98	  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance
99	
100	/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library (WC4 C14, C25), the registry type being
101	`SyncReg` (WC4 C2). -/
102	def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : KC SyncReg :=
103	  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L }
104	
105	/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
106	instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
107	    Decidable ((libKC k L).SyncAuthorized reg s g f) :=
108	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))
109	
110	/-- Contract obligation of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
111	synchronization contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the
112	`guarded` of a live entry of `reg`. -/
113	def SyncSound (kc : KC SyncReg) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
114	  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s
115	
116	/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC4 C14. -/
117	theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
118	    SyncSound (libKC k L) reg s :=
119	  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩
120	
121	/-- The holder is a usable place (WC4 C12, C13.1, C21.1). -/
122	def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
123	  | .place q => t.Usable q
124	  | .frame _ => False
125	
126	/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC4 C12). -/
127	instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
128	  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance
129	
130	/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
131	of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC4 C13.5). -/
132	def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
133	  match y.holder with
134	  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
135	      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
136	  | .frame _ => True
137	
138	/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
139	instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
140	  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance
141	
142	/-- The place `slot` holding `guarded` (WC4 C12). -/
143	def slotOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
144	  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
145	  | some (Holder.place h) => some h
146	  | _ => none

148	/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C21, C22) -/
149	
150	/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
151	(WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C21.5, C22). -/
152	def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
153	  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g
154	
155	/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
156	instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
157	  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance
158	
159	/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C22). -/
160	def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j
161	
162	/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
163	instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
164	  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance
165	
166	/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22). -/
167	def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
168	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
169	
170	/-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: distinct live entries (by position in the registry) have distinct
171	`ControlOf` leaves. -/
172	def CtlUnique (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
173	  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry) (ctl : Nat), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
174	    e.Live s → e'.Live s → ControlOf L s e = some ctl → ControlOf L s e' = some ctl → i = j
175	
176	/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `slot`: for every live entry, every structural leaf of
177	the place holding `guarded` is `Init`. -/
178	def SlotInit (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
179	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
180	    OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.I l = .init) False
181	
182	/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `ctl`: for every live entry, the controller leaf
183	`ControlOf(entry)` is `Init`. -/
184	def CtlInit (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
185	  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.I ctl = .init) False
186	
187	/-- `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7): items 1–5 and 7 over live entries, item 6 over every entry. -/
188	structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
189	  /-- WC4 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
190	  place. -/
191	  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
192	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
193	  /-- WC4 C21.2: a recorded grant exists, has origin `guarded` and footprint
194	  `footprint(guarded)`. -/
195	  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
196	    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
197	  /-- WC4 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
198	  leaf. -/
199	  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
200	    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
201	  /-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: controller uniqueness among live entries. -/
202	  ctlUnique : CtlUnique L s reg
203	  /-- WC4 C21.4, second clause (the guarded-identity uniqueness guard of WC4 C13.7): distinct
204	  live entries have distinct `guarded` identities. -/
205	  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
206	    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
207	    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
208	  /-- WC4 C21.5, `GrantSubtree`. -/
209	  grantSubtree : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
210	    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
211	  /-- WC4 C21.6, `RegBound`, over every entry: the registered `guarded` identity exists (Spec 1
212	  §38: identities are indices). -/
213	  regBound : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length
214	  /-- WC4 C21.7: the structural leaves of `slot` are `Init`. -/
215	  slotInit : SlotInit s reg
216	  /-- WC4 C21.7: the controller leaf is `Init`. -/
217	  ctlInit : CtlInit L s reg
218	
219	/-! ## Derived operations (WC4 C13, C16–C18) -/
220	
221	/-- The mutex value `M` of WC4 C12, C13: the immediate structural parent of the place `slot`
222	holding `guarded`. -/
223	def mutexOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
224	  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
225	  | some (Holder.place h) => parentOf s.P h
226	  | _ => none
227	
228	/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13.1–C13.10), with `adm` the
229	identities used by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). The interface and realization
230	obligations of WC4 C13 (C13.3, C13.6, former C13.10) are not represented: WC4 C13 says they "are
231	not claimed to follow from the authority-only state `S_C`". -/
232	structure NewMutexPre (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
233	    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
234	  /-- WC4 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
235	  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
236	    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
237	  /-- WC4 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded` (Spec 1 §43). -/
238	  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
239	  /-- WC4 C13.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a
240	  usable leaf. -/
241	  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
242	  /-- WC4 C13.4: `footprint(guarded) ∩ footprint(M) = ∅`. -/
243	  disjointM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False
244	  /-- WC4 C13.10: every structural leaf of `footprint(M)` is `Init`. -/
245	  initM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False
246	  /-- WC4 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
247	  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
248	  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
249	  /-- WC4 C13.6: `K.SharedMutable(ctl)`. -/
250	  sharedMutable : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False
251	  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
252	  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
253	  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/
254	  otherAdmin : g ∉ adm
255	  /-- WC4 C13.8: no other live entry is associated with `ctl`. -/
256	  ctlUnique : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
257	    ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False
258	  /-- WC4 C13.9. -/
259	  available : NoCoveringDesc s g
260	
261	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC4 C13). -/
262	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC)
263	    (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) : Decidable (NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g) :=
264	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
265	      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
266	    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
267	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
268	    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False ∧
269	    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False ∧
270	    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
271	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False ∧
272	    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ adm ∧
273	    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
274	      ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False ∧
275	    NoCoveringDesc s g)
276	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩,
277	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩⟩
278	
279	/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
280	kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created (WC4 C13 effect). WC4 C13 states no outcome
281	other than success; only `ok` is defined. -/
282	def NewMutexOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
283	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
284	  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])
285	
286	/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C16): with the library instantiation of
287	`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` on the registry `reg` and the record of the
288	fresh grant identity `|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not
289	enabled; WC4 C16 states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
290	def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
291	    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
292	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
293	    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L) reg s c e.guarded ∧
294	    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })
295	
296	/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C17.1–C17.4): O3 releases the grant and the registry
297	records `grant = none` (WC4 C17 effect). C17.2 and C17.3 are the preconditions of O3 (Spec 1 §62);
298	C17.4 is `CtrlRight`. The controller update is a realization obligation (WC4 C17), not a
299	precondition; only `ok` is defined. -/
300	def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
301	    Prop :=
302	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
303	    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
304	    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })
305	
306	/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C18.1–C18.3): the entry becomes available; the
307	kernel state is unchanged (WC4 C18 effect). WC4 C18.3: "`ControlOf(entry)` resolves to an
308	existing, usable controller **leaf**, as required by C21.3"; the controller-initialization
309	invariant is not a precondition (WC4 C18.3: "established separately for every live entry by
310	C21.7"). Only `ok` is defined. -/
311	def ResetLockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
312	    Prop :=
313	  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
314	    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧
315	    OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
316	    st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })
317	
318	/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC4 C22, C23) -/
319	
320	/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
321	inductive Label where
322	  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
323	  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
324	  | terminate (c : Nat)
325	  | join (c d : Nat)
326	  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
327	  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
328	  | acquire (c i : Nat)
329	  | unlock (c i : Nat)
330	  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
331	  | spawnVal (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat))
332	
333	/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC4 C2, C4,
334	C5, C6–C8, C13, C15–C18; WC4 C23 for the by-value composite): kernel and
335	frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
336	library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` on the current registry (WC4 C14). -/
337	inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
338	  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
339	      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
340	  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
341	      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
342	  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
343	      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
344	  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
345	      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
346	  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
347	      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L) reg s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
348	  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
349	      NewMutexOk k L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
350	  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
351	      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
352	  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
353	      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
354	  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
355	      ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'
356	  | spawnVal {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
357	      {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} :
358	      SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) (s, reg) (s', reg)
359	
360	/-- WC4 C22.3 for the source `src` of a transfer in state `st`: for each live entry, `src` is
361	neither the place `slot` holding `guarded`, nor a strict structural subplace of `slot`, nor the
362	controller leaf `ctl`. -/
363	def TransferExcl (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Prop :=
364	  ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
365	    OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => ¬ partOf st.1.P src q) True ∧
366	      ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some src
367	
368	/-- Decidability of `TransferExcl` (WC4 C22.3). -/
369	instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Decidable (TransferExcl L st src) := by
370	  unfold TransferExcl; infer_instance
371	
372	/-- WC4 C22.3 for the transfers of the by-value composite (WC4 C23):
373	the source of every transfer phase satisfies `TransferExcl` in the state where that phase starts
374	(WC4 C5.2), the registry being `reg`. -/
375	def EncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
376	  | _, [] => True
377	  | t, v :: vs => TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ EncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
378	
379	/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC4 C22, C23): for each live
380	entry, WC4 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`), C22.3 (`transfer`, and the
381	transfer phases of the by-value composite) and C22.5 (`endUse` whose place is the controller leaf
382	`ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`). WC4 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) is a
383	realization/interface obligation (WC4 C22) with no content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1
384	§41), and is not represented. -/
385	def Encap (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
386	  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
387	  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
388	  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
389	  | .kernel _ (.endUse p) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some p ∧
390	      OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf st.1.P p q → p = q) True
391	  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
392	  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
393	  | _ => True
394	
395	/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
396	inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
397	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : LRun k L st [] st
398	  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
399	      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂
400	
401	/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23: "Any lemma conditional on encapsulation must expose that
402	condition in its theorem statement or the reachable-trace assumptions"): a run every step of which
403	satisfies `Encap` in the state where it is taken. -/
404	inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
405	    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
406	  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st

import Ern.Concurrency.Frames

/-!
# Concurrent contract `K_C` and the kernel transition `deriveSync`

* `KC R` (WC4 C2, C14): the Spec 1 contract `K` (§48, §80), reached by the projection `KC.toK`,
  extended with the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded,
  requesting_frame)`, whose registry argument has the type `R` of the library registry; the
  kernel does not depend on the library;
* `deriveSync` (WC4 C15): O1 (Spec 1 §60) on `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`,
  `mode = Modify`, executed by a live context;
* `CStepS`, the concurrent kernel steps with `deriveSync` for a given registry.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- External contract `K_C` (WC4 C2, C14): the unchanged Spec 1 contract `K` (§48), its
projection being `KC.toK`, and the opaque predicate `SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded,
requesting_frame)` of WC4 C14, the registry being an external argument of type `R` (WC4 C2: not a
component of `S_C`). Obligations of `K_C` are hypotheses of theorems, never fields. -/
structure KC (R : Type) extends K where
  SyncAuthorized : R → SC → Nat → Nat → Prop

/-- Effect of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C15 effect): a fresh active authority of mode
`Modify`, origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame of `c`;
this is the `ok` effect of O1 (Spec 1 §60) on the view of `c`. -/
def deriveSyncEff (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : SC :=
  s.set (deriveEff (s.view c) g ((s.view c).afp g) .modify)

/-- Preconditions of `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` with the registry `r` (WC4 C15.1–C15.6):
those of O1 (Spec 1 §60) for `source = guarded`, `region = footprint(guarded)`, `mode = Modify`,
on the view of `c`, with `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, r, guarded, current frame)` in place of
`ExercisableAt(source, Modify)` of §60.1 as the only authorization (WC4 C15.3). -/
structure DeriveSyncPre {R : Type} (kc : KC R) (r : R) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C15.1, Spec 1 §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : (s.view c).Active g
  /-- WC4 C15.1 (Spec 1 §43, §60.1): the own mode of `guarded` permits `Modify`. -/
  mode : OptP ((s.view c).A[g]?) (fun y => Mode.modify.le y.mode) False
  /-- WC4 C15.3: `deriveSync` is authorized exclusively through `K_C.SyncAuthorized`. -/
  authorized : kc.SyncAuthorized r s g (s.view c).top
  /-- WC4 C15.2, Spec 1 §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source` is active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x
  /-- WC4 C15.4, Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- WC4 C15.4, Spec 1 §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g
  /-- WC4 C15.4, Spec 1 §60.2: `Modify` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these
  leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify
  /-- WC4 C15.5, Spec 1 §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50). -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
      y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True
  /-- WC4 C15.6, Spec 1 §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `deriveSync` (WC4 C15). -/
instance {R : Type} (kc : KC R) (r : R) (s : SC) (c g : Nat)
    [Decidable (kc.SyncAuthorized r s g (s.view c).top)] : Decidable (DeriveSyncPre kc r s c g) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Active g ∧
    OptP ((s.view c).A[g]?) (fun y => Mode.modify.le y.mode) False ∧
    kc.SyncAuthorized r s g (s.view c).top ∧
    (∀ x ∈ (s.view c).ancs g, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ (s.view c).afp g) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, Allows (effective (s.view c) g l) .modify) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ g :: (s.view c).ancs g → (∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp g, l ∈ y.footprint) →
        y.mode = .observe ∧ Mode.modify = .observe) True) ∧
    (s.view c).top ∈ (s.view c).F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- `deriveSync(guarded)` executed by `c` with the registry `r` (WC4 C15): `ok` or `reject`; no
outcome if `c` is not live. -/
def DeriveSyncStep {R : Type} (kc : KC R) (r : R) (s : SC) (c g : Nat) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DeriveSyncPre kc r s c g) (deriveSyncEff s c g) o

/-- WC4 C15 effect: the authority created by `deriveSync` is an ordinary authority of mode `Modify`,
origin `guarded`, footprint `footprint(guarded)`, held by the current frame, active, of fresh
identity `|A|`. -/
theorem deriveSync_created {R : Type} {kc : KC R} {r : R} {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat}
    (h : DeriveSyncStep kc r s c g (.ok s')) :
    s'.A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some g, (s.view c).afp g, .frame (s.view c).top, true⟩] := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  rfl

/-- One `ok` transition of the concurrent kernel with the registry `r` (WC4 C2, C4, C6–C8, C15): a
step of `CStep` under the projection `K_C.toK`, or `deriveSync`. -/
inductive CStepS {R : Type} (kc : KC R) (r : R) : SC → SC → Prop where
  | base {s s' : SC} : CStep kc.toK s s' → CStepS kc r s s'
  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {c g : Nat} : DeriveSyncStep kc r s c g (.ok s') → CStepS kc r s s'

end Ern.Concurrency

/-!
# Provisional by-value transmission at `spawn` (WC4 C5)

The composite of WC4 C5, a single transition with four ordered phases:

1. create (WC4 C5.1): the new context, its initial frame, its locals and their root authorities,
   without yielding the parameters (`spawnCreate`);
2. transfer (WC4 C5.2): each by-value argument `(source, destination)` in its declared order, by
   the effect of O4 (Spec 1 §63) executed by the creating context on the state produced by the
   earlier transfers (`transfersEff`); the clauses of O4 that are not resulting-state conditions
   are evaluated at the start of the corresponding transfer (`ValTransferPre`);
3. yield (WC4 C5.3): the parameters change holder to the new frame (`yieldEff`);
4. final checks (WC4 C5.4) on the final state.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Effects (WC4 C5 effects) -/

/-- Phase 1 of WC4 C5 (create): the effect of `spawn` (WC4 C4) with no parameter yielded. -/
def spawnCreate (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC := spawnEff s c [] ls

/-- Phase 2 of WC4 C5 (transfer): the effects of O4 (Spec 1 §63) executed by `c`, in the declared
order, each on the state produced by the earlier ones. -/
def transfersEff (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → SC
  | t, [] => t
  | t, v :: vs => transfersEff c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Phase 3 of WC4 C5 (yield): the parameters `ps` change holder to the frame `f` (WC4 C4 effect,
Spec 1 §72 effect); no right is created. -/
def yieldEff (t : SC) (ps : List Nat) (f : Nat) : SC :=
  { t with A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame f } else y) 0 t.A }

/-- Effect of the composite (WC4 C5.1–C5.3): create, the transfers of `vs`, then the yield of `ps`
to the new frame `nF`. -/
def spawnValEff (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    SC :=
  yieldEff (transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs) ps s.nF

/-! ## Preconditions (WC4 C4, C5) -/

/-- WC4 C5 item 2: `dst` is a fresh root local of the initial frame of the new context (its leaves
are `Uninit`, it holds no derived authority and its root authority is held by that frame by
construction of `spawnCreate`). -/
def FreshRootLocal (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape, dst = s.P.length + i

/-- Decidability of `FreshRootLocal` (WC4 C5 item 2). -/
instance (s : SC) (ls : LocalShape) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (FreshRootLocal s ls dst) := by
  unfold FreshRootLocal; infer_instance

/-- The clauses of O4 (Spec 1 §63) for the by-value argument `(src, dst)`, executed by the creating
context `c`, at the start of its transfer phase in state `t` (WC4 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4): those
of `TransferPreC` other than the exercisable `Modify` over the destination (replaced by C5 item 2,
WC4 C5 item 3) and the resulting-state clauses; §63.8 is evaluated on the final state `fin` (WC4
C5.4). -/

/-!
# Theorems 2 and 4 on labelled steps and traces (WC4 C20–C23)

Assembly of `Ern.Concurrency.Preservation`, `Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve`,
`Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` and `Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit`:

* theorem 2 for every labelled step of the kernel with the synchronization library, the by-value
  composite included (`lstep_kInvCA`);
* theorems 2 and 4 together along an `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23): `KInvCA` and
  `SyncState` (`trace_inv`, `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Theorem 2 (WC4 C20, C23) on every labelled step (inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a
context, `spawn`, the by-value composite, `terminate`, `join`, `deriveSync` under the library
instantiation, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`): the re-indexed kernel invariant with
the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`) is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, for `split`). -/
theorem lstep_kInvCA {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hk : KInvCA st.1) : KInvCA st'.1 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case exit => exact exitFrameC_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
    all_goals exact opStepC_preservesC hdd hk (fun e => by cases e) h
  | spawn h => exact spawn_preservesC hk h
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_preservesC hk h
  | terminate h => exact terminate_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
  | join h => exact join_preservesC hk h
  | deriveSync h => exact deriveSync_preservesC hk h
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, -, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
    exact deriveSync_preservesC (r := _) hk ⟨hc, .ok hpre⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, g, -, -, -, hrel, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact opStepC_preservesC (op := .release g) hdd hk (fun e => by cases e)
      ⟨hc, _, .ok hrel, rfl⟩
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC4 C20–C23) along an `EncapsulatedTrace`: from a state satisfying
`KInvCA` and `SyncState`, every reached state satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd hst hk
    exact ih hk' (lstep_preserves hst he hk hk'.1.1.2 hs)

/-- Theorem 4 (WC4 C21–C23), trace form: along an `EncapsulatedTrace` from a state satisfying
`KInvCA`, `SyncState` is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 :=
  (trace_inv hdd h hk hs).2

/-- The initial state of Spec 1 §47 as a single-context state, with an empty registry (WC4 C3,
C12), satisfies `KInvCA` and `SyncState`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (L : MutexLayout) :
    KInvCA (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) ∧ SyncState L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro i j e e' ctl h; simp at h
  · intro i j e e' h; simp at h
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC4 C20–C23) from the initial state: every state reached from the initial
state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registry) by an `EncapsulatedTrace` satisfies the
re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80)
and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2⟩

end Ern.Concurrency

  /-- WC4 C5.2, C5 item 1, Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` of the creating frame over the
  source. -/

  /-- WC4 C5.2, Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (t.view c).P src dst
  /-- WC4 C5 item 1, Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, (t.view c).I l = .init
  /-- WC4 C5 item 2, Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P dst, (t.view c).I l ≠ .init
  /-- WC4 C5.2, Spec 1 §63.3: disjoint footprints. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (t.view c).P src dst
  /-- WC4 C5.2, C5 item 4, Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from
  outside the source, except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its
  origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
      RightChain (t.view c) g j
  /-- WC4 C5 item 4, Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (t.view c).pin l = false
  /-- WC4 C5 item 4, Spec 1 §63.6, first half: dependencies of the usable places following the
  value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (t.view c) src, (t.view c).Active x
  /-- WC4 C5 item 4, C5.4, Spec 1 §63.8: no authority held before the transfer by a part of the
  source covers, in the final state, a leaf of its holder. -/
  noSelfLock : ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((t.view c).A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn (t.view c).P src y.holder) False → ¬ SelfLock fin j

/-- Decidability of `ValTransferPre` (WC4 C5). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (fin : S3) (t : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (ValTransferPre k fin t c src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((t.view c).Usable src ∧ (t.view c).Usable dst ∧
    HasRight (t.view c) .modify src ∧ SameShape (t.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, (t.view c).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P dst, (t.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (t.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, Grounds (t.view c) .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (t.view c) src j →
        RightChain (t.view c) g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (t.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (t.view c).pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (t.view c) src, (t.view c).Active x) ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (t.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((t.view c).A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn (t.view c).P src y.holder) False →
        ¬ SelfLock fin j))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩⟩

/-- WC4 C5.2: every by-value argument satisfies `ValTransferPre` at the start of its transfer
phase, in the declared order, on the state produced by the earlier transfers. -/
def ValTransfersPre (k : K) (fin : S3) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => ValTransferPre k fin t c v.1 v.2 ∧
      ValTransfersPre k fin c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Decidability of `ValTransfersPre` (WC4 C5.2). -/
instance instDecidableValTransfersPre (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (fin : S3) (c : Nat) :
    (t : SC) → (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) → Decidable (ValTransfersPre k fin c t vs)
  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
  | t, v :: vs =>
    haveI := instDecidableValTransfersPre k fin c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (ValTransferPre k fin t c v.1 v.2 ∧ _))

/-- Preconditions of the by-value composite executed by `c` (WC4 C4.1, C4.3, C4.5, C4.6, C5.1–C5.4
and C5 items 1–5). C4.2 (fresh identities), C4.4 and C5 item 6 (no duplication) hold by
construction of `spawnValEff`; the preservation obligations of WC4 C4 and C5 are theorems, not
preconditions. -/
structure SpawnValPre (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C4.1: the creating context and its current frame are live. -/
  creatorLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C4.3, C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): every parameter is an active derived authority held by the
  creating frame before the composite. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C4.5 (Spec 1 §72.2): the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- WC4 C5 item 2: every destination is a fresh root local of the new frame. -/
  freshDst : ∀ v ∈ vs, FreshRootLocal s ls v.2
  /-- WC4 C5.2, C5 items 1, 3, 4: the transfer phases. -/
  transfers : ValTransfersPre k (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
  /-- WC4 C5 item 5: no parameter covers a leaf of a by-value source, on the declared source
  footprints before consumption. -/
  paramsApart : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ v ∈ vs, ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P v.1
  /-- WC4 C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): at the beginning of the yield phase, every parameter is active,
  derived and held by the creating frame, in the state produced by the transfers. -/
  paramsAtYield : ∀ a ∈ ps,
    OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
      y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- WC4 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.6, second half: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the final state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)
  /-- WC4 C5.4, Spec 1 §63.9: every destination is usable in the final state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : ∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2
  /-- WC4 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.3: origin protection in the final state, from the current frame of
  the new context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p
  /-- WC4 C4.5, C5.4, Spec 1 §72.4 (`AnchorOrderHeld` on `ancestorC`) in the final state, which
  includes Spec 1 §63.7 for the moved held authorities. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs)

/-- Decidability of `SpawnValPre` (WC4 C4, C5). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (∀ v ∈ vs, FreshRootLocal s ls v.2) ∧
    ValTransfersPre k (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs ∧
    (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ v ∈ vs, ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P v.1) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ ps,
      OptP (((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
        y.holder = .frame ((transfersEff c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs).view c).top ∧
        y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ vs, (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).flat.Usable v.2) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((spawnValEff s c ps ls vs).view s.C.length) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l⟩⟩

/-- The by-value composite executed by `c` (WC4 C5): `ok` or `reject`; no outcome if `c` is not
live. -/
def SpawnValStep (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
    (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (SpawnValPre k s c ps ls vs) (spawnValEff s c ps ls vs) o
