namespace PreservationAux

/-! ## Membership transport (WC4 C2) -/

/-- `HeldAnchored` reads the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §44, §40). -/
theorem heldAnchored_mem_congr {t : S3} {F' : Frames} (h : HeldAnchored t)
    (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) : HeldAnchored { t with F := F' } :=
  fun x y q hy ya ho hh hq => h x y q hy ya ho hh ((usable_mem_congr hF).1 hq)

/-- The kernel facts of Spec 1 on the view of a context, from the re-indexed invariant (WC4
C2). -/
theorem view_facts {s : SC} (hk : KInvCA s) (c : Nat) :
    WF3 (s.view c) ∧ Inv3base (s.view c) ∧ NoDangling (s.view c) ∧ RootHeldConv (s.view c) ∧
      HeldAnchored (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, -⟩, hc, hh⟩ := hk
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.flat.F := fun f => SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨SC.wf3_view hfr hw, ⟨h1, h2, i3_mem_congr h3 hF, i4_always _⟩,
    noDangling_mem_congr hnd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- The flat state of `s'` is `t` with the globally live frames of `s'` (WC4 C2); the kernel
facts of Spec 1 on `t` carry to the flat state of `s'` when `t` lists the same frames. -/
theorem flat_facts {s' : SC} {t : S3} (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames })
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames) (hnd : s'.frames.Nodup) (hne : s'.frames ≠ [])
    (hw : WF3 t) (hb : Inv3base t) (hd : NoDangling t) (hc : RootHeldConv t)
    (hh : HeldAnchored t) :
    WF3 s'.flat ∧ I1 s'.flat ∧ I2 s'.flat ∧ I3 s'.flat ∧ NoDangling s'.flat ∧ KAux s'.flat ∧
      HeldAnchored s'.flat := by
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ s'.frames ↔ f ∈ t.F := fun f => (hmem f).symm
  rw [hflat]
  exact ⟨wf3_mem_congr hw hF hnd hne, hb.1, hb.2.1, i3_mem_congr hb.2.2.1 hF,
    noDangling_mem_congr hd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- Assembly of the re-indexed invariant (WC4 C20; Spec 1 §54: `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3`). -/
theorem kInvCA_of {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s)
    (hf : WF3 s.flat ∧ I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ NoDangling s.flat ∧ KAux s.flat ∧
      HeldAnchored s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s) (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) : KInvCA s :=
  ⟨⟨⟨hfr, hf.1⟩, ⟨⟨hf.2.1, hf.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.1, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, hao, hf.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
    haoh, noOrphan_of_wf3 hf.1⟩, hf.2.2.2.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩

/-- The live frames of a nonempty frame structure are nonempty (WC4 C3). -/
theorem frames_ne {s : SC} (hfr : FramesC s) : s.frames ≠ [] := by
  intro he
  have h0 := hfr.initial
  unfold OptP at h0; split at h0
  · rename_i x hx
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, -, hzh, -⟩ := h.old _ z' hz' hel
  rw [hz] at hz₀; cases hz₀
  refine effAnchorOKC_of_same (s' := s.set t) (z' := z') hz
    (by show t.A[(s.set t).flat.effAnchor x]? = _; rw [he]; exact hz')
    ?_ (fun g f _ hg => hg) hok
  rw [hzh]; exact S3.hframe_congr h.P _

/-- Usability in the written-back state is usability in `t` (WC4 C2). -/
theorem set_usable {s : SC} {t : S3} (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames) {q : Nat} :
    (s.set t).flat.Usable q ↔ t.Usable q :=
  usable_mem_congr (t := t) (F' := s.frames) fun f => (hmem f).symm

/-- `AnchorOrderC` after a `SkelV` step (Spec 1 §44, §52; WC4 C2). -/
theorem SkelV.anchorOrderC {s : SC} {t : S3} (h : SkelV s t)
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames) (h3 : I3 s.flat) (hao : AnchorOrderC s) :
    AnchorOrderC (s.set t) := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq' := (set_usable hmem).1 hq
  have hx' := h.D q hq' x hx
  have hqs := h.usable q hq'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := h3 q hqs x hx'
  have hpf : (s.set t).flat.pframe q = s.flat.pframe q := S3.pframe_congr h.P q
  rw [hpf]
  exact h.effAnchorOKC (lt_of_getElem? hy) (hao q hqs x hx')

/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` after a `SkelV` step (Spec 1 §44; WC4 C2). -/
theorem SkelV.anchorOrderHeldC {s : SC} {t : S3} (h : SkelV s t)
    (hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames) (haoh : AnchorOrderHeldC s) :
    AnchorOrderHeldC (s.set t) := by
  intro q hq x y' hy' ya hh
  have hq' := (set_usable hmem).1 hq
  by_cases hx : x < s.A.length
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hyh, hya⟩ := h.old x y' hy' hx
    have hpf : (s.set t).flat.pframe q = s.flat.pframe q := S3.pframe_congr h.P q
    rw [hpf]
    exact h.effAnchorOKC hx (haoh q (h.usable q hq') x y hy (hya ya) (hyh ▸ hh))
  · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.new x y' hy' (Nat.le_of_not_lt hx)
    rw [hf] at hh; cases hh

/-- `FramesC` after a step that keeps the contexts and `nF` (WC4 C3). -/
theorem framesC_set {s : SC} {t : S3} (hfr : FramesC s) (hn : t.nF = s.nF) :
    FramesC (s.set t) where
  initial := hfr.initial
  nonempty := hfr.nonempty
  nodup := hfr.nodup
  bound := fun f hf => by show f < t.nF; rw [hn]; exact hfr.bound f hf
  rooted := hfr.rooted
  parent := hfr.parent

/-- A `SkelV` step on the view of a context with Spec 1 facts on its result preserves the
re-indexed invariant (WC4 C2, C20). -/
theorem set_preserves {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hk : KInvCA s) (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F)
    (hn : t.nF = s.nF) (hsk : SkelV s t) (hw : WF3 t) (hb : Inv3base t) (hd : NoDangling t)
    (hc : RootHeldConv t) (hh : HeldAnchored t) : KInvCA (s.set t) := by
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames := fun f => by rw [hF]; exact SC.mem_view_F
  exact kInvCA_of (framesC_set hfr hn)
    (flat_facts rfl hmem hfr.nodup (frames_ne (s := s) hfr) hw hb hd hc hh)
    (hsk.anchorOrderC hmem hk.1.2.1.1.2.2.1 hk.1.2.1.2.1)
    (hsk.anchorOrderHeldC hmem hk.1.2.2.1)

/-! ## Skeletons of the operations on the view (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§68, §74, §75 `ok` effects) -/

/-- Usability after a step on the view that keeps places and only adds death markers (Spec 1
§40; WC4 C2). -/
theorem usable_back {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} {q : Nat} (h : t.Usable q) (hP : t.P = s.P)
    (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F) (hd : ∀ q, t.dead q = false → s.dead q = false) :
    s.flat.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono (s' := t) (s := s.flat) hP (fun _ hf => SC.mem_view_F.1 (hF ▸ hf)) hd h

/-- Skeleton of a step on the view appending frame-held authorities (Spec 1 §60, §61 `ok`
effects; WC4 C15). -/
theorem skelV_append {s : SC} {c : Nat} {E : List Authority}
    (hE : ∀ y ∈ E, ∃ f, y.holder = .frame f) :
    SkelV s { s.view c with A := (s.view c).A ++ E } where
  P := rfl
  len := by simp [SC.view, SC.flat]
  old := fun x y' hy' hx => ⟨y', by
    have : x < (s.view c).A.length := hx
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left this] at hy'; exact hy', rfl, rfl, id⟩
  new := fun x y' hy' hx => hE y' (by
    have : (s.view c).A.length ≤ x := hx
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right this] at hy'; exact List.mem_of_getElem? hy')
  usable := fun _ h => usable_back (c := c) h rfl rfl (fun _ h => h)
  D := fun _ _ _ h => h

/-- Skeleton of a step on the view keeping authorities and anchors (Spec 1 §66–§68, §74, §75 `ok`
effects). -/
theorem skelV_same {s : SC} {c : Nat} {t : S3} (hP : t.P = s.P) (hF : t.F = (s.view c).F)
    (hA : t.A = s.A) (hD : t.D = s.D) (hd : t.dead = s.dead) : SkelV s t where
  P := hP
  · cases h with
    | ok hpre => rw [omap, he]; exact .ok (hp.1 hpre)
    | reject hn => exact .reject fun h => hn (hp.2 h)
  · cases h with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .ok (hp.2 hpre)⟩, by rw [omap, he]⟩
    | reject hn => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .reject fun h => hn (hp.1 h)⟩, rfl⟩

/-- The `ok` outcomes of the operations that do not read `ancestor` keep the stack (Spec 1
§60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75 effects). -/
theorem viewOp_F {t t' : S3} {op : KernelOp} (hop : op.Step k t (.ok t'))
    (hnot : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hnd : ∀ q x, op ≠ .depend q x)
    (hns : ∀ a p, op ≠ .store a p) (hne : ∀ ps ls, op ≠ .enter ps ls) (hnx : op ≠ .exit) :
    t'.F = t.F := by
  cases op with
  | transfer => exact absurd rfl (hnot _ _)
  | depend => exact absurd rfl (hnd _ _)
  | store => exact absurd rfl (hns _ _)
  | enter => exact absurd rfl (hne _ _)
  | exit => exact absurd rfl hnx
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | write => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | writeShared => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | endUse => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hop; rfl
  | alloc => cases hop; rfl

/-- `transfer` of the single context: preconditions (Spec 1 §63; WC4 C24). -/
    simp only [yieldF, this, ↓reduceIte]

/-! ## The kernel invariant without the anchor orders -/

/-- The clauses of `KInvCA` other than the anchor orders (Spec 1 §57 re-indexed, WC4 C20). -/
def KBase (s : SC) : Prop :=
  FramesC s ∧ (WF3 s.flat ∧ I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ NoDangling s.flat ∧
    KAux s.flat ∧ HeldAnchored s.flat)

/-- The kernel facts of Spec 1 on the view of a context, from `KBase` (WC4 C2). -/
theorem view_facts_base {s : SC} (hk : KBase s) (c : Nat) :
    WF3 (s.view c) ∧ Inv3base (s.view c) ∧ NoDangling (s.view c) ∧ RootHeldConv (s.view c) ∧
      HeldAnchored (s.view c) := by
  obtain ⟨hfr, hw, h1, h2, h3, hnd, hc, hh⟩ := hk
  have hF : ∀ f, f ∈ (s.view c).F ↔ f ∈ s.flat.F := fun f => SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨SC.wf3_view hfr hw, ⟨h1, h2, i3_mem_congr h3 hF, i4_always _⟩,
    noDangling_mem_congr hnd hF, hc, heldAnchored_mem_congr hh hF⟩

/-- `spawn` (WC4 C4 effect) establishes `KBase` from `KInvCA`, without the resulting-state
condition §72.4 (WC4 C4.5), which the composite checks on its final state. -/
theorem spawn_base {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hk : KInvCA s)
    (hc : s.stk c ≠ []) (hpar : ParamsOK (s.view c) ps) (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape) :
    KBase (spawnEff s c ps ls) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hrc, hh⟩ := view_facts hk c
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1
  have hpush := spawn_push (ps := ps) (ls := ls) hfr hc
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).F ↔ f ∈ (spawnEff s c ps ls).frames :=
    fun f => by
      rw [hpush.mem]
      show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
      rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]
  have hne : (spawnEff s c ps ls).frames ≠ [] := fun he => by
    have := (hpush.mem s.nF).2 (.inl rfl); rw [he] at this; cases this
  exact ⟨hpush.framesC hfr, flat_facts rfl hmem hpush.nodup hne (enter_wf' hw hpar hsh)
    (Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Frames.enter_inv3base hw hb) (enter_noDangling' hw hd hsh)
    (enter_rootHeldConv' hw hpar hrc) (enter_heldAnchored' hw hh)⟩

/-- One transfer (Spec 1 §63 effect) keeps `KBase`, from §63.1 usability, §63.2, §63.3
disjointness, §63.6 first half and the usability of the destination after the step. -/
theorem transfer_base {t : SC} {c src dst : Nat} (hk : KBase t) (hsrc : (t.view c).Usable src)
    (hdst : (t.view c).Usable dst) (hdeps : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (t.view c) src, (t.view c).Active x)
    (hsh : SameShape (t.view c).P src dst) (hdis : ¬ overlap (t.view c).P src dst)
    (hd' : (transferEff (t.view c) src dst).Usable dst) : KBase (transferEffC t c src dst) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hb, hd, hc, hh⟩ := view_facts_base hk c
  have hw' := transfer_wf3' hw hsrc hdst hd'
  obtain ⟨hb', hd''⟩ := transfer_base' hw hb hd hsrc hdeps hd'
  have hh' := transfer_heldAnchored' hw hh hsrc hdst hsh hdis
  have hmem : ∀ f, f ∈ (transferEff (t.view c) src dst).F ↔ f ∈ t.frames := fun _ =>
    SC.mem_view_F
  exact ⟨framesC_set hk.1 rfl, flat_facts rfl hmem hk.1.nodup (frames_ne (s := t) hk.1) hw' hb' hd''
    (transfer_rootHeldConv' hc) hh'⟩

/-! ## Destinations -/

/-- Place `q` exists and is owned by a frame (Spec 1 §40). -/
def FrameOwned (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
    · change (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A)[x]? = _
      rw [getElem?_mapI, hy]; rfl
    · unfold yieldF; split <;> exact ya

/-- Theorem 2 along the transfer phases (WC4 C5.2): from a state where the parameters are
yielded and `KBase` holds, the transfers keep `KBase`, given the destination of each transfer
owned by a frame. -/
theorem transfers_base {k : K} {fin : S3} {c f : Nat} {ps : List Nat} :
    ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)), ValTransfersPre k fin c t vs →
      KBase (yieldEff t ps f) → (∀ v ∈ vs, FrameOwned t.P v.2) →
      (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) →
      KBase (yieldEff (transfersEff c t vs) ps f)
  | _, [], _, hk, _, _ => hk
  | t, v :: vs, ⟨hpre, hrest⟩, hk, hown, hp => by
    simp only [transfersEff]
    have hu : ∀ q, ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).Usable q ↔ (t.view c).Usable q := fun q =>
      S3.Usable.congr (s' := (yieldEff t ps f).view c) (s := t.view c) rfl rfl rfl
    have hdeps : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps ((yieldEff t ps f).view c) v.1,
        ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).Active x := by
      intro x hx
      have hmd : movedDeps ((yieldEff t ps f).view c) v.1 = movedDeps (t.view c) v.1 := by
        unfold movedDeps
        congr 1
      rw [hmd] at hx
      exact (yield_active (v := t.view c) (ps := ps) (f := f)).2 (hpre.depsValid x hx)
    have hown₀ : FrameOwned ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).P v.2 := hown v (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hk₁ := transfer_base hk ((hu _).2 hpre.srcUsable) ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hdeps
      hpre.sameShape hpre.disjoint
      (transfer_usable_frameOwned ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hown₀)
    rw [yield_transfer hp] at hk₁
    refine transfers_base (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs hrest hk₁ (fun w hw => ?_)
      (fun a ha y hy => ?_)
    · exact transfer_frameOwned (hown w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw))
    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀
      exact ⟨g, by rw [e ⟨g, hg⟩, hg]⟩

end TransferPreserveAux

open PreservationAux TransferPreserveAux

/-- Theorem 2 (WC4 C4, C5, C20, C23) for the by-value composite: `SpawnValPre` and `KInvCA` before
the composite give `KInvCA` after it. The anchor orders are the final checks of WC4 C5.4
(`SpawnValPre.anchorOrder`, `SpawnValPre.anchorOrderHeld`). -/
theorem spawnVal_preservesC {k : K} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} (hk : KInvCA s) (h : SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s')) :
    KInvCA s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hpar : ParamsOK (s.view c) ps := hpre.params
  have hlt : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length := fun a ha => by
    have := hpre.params a ha
    unfold OptP at this; split at this
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · exact this.elim
  have hframe : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = some y →
      ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g := by
    intro a ha y hy
    have hp := hpre.params a ha
    have hy' : (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = s.A[a]? := by
      show (mapI _ 0 s.A ++ _)[a]? = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact hlt a ha), getElem?_mapI]
      cases s.A[a]? <;> simp
    rw [hy'] at hy
    have hy₂ : (s.view c).A[a]? = some y := hy
    rw [hy₂] at hp
    exact ⟨_, hp.2.1⟩
  have hb₀ : KBase (yieldEff (spawnCreate s c ls) ps s.nF) := by
    rw [create_yield hlt]; exact spawn_base hk hpre.creatorLive hpar hpre.localsOK
  have hb := transfers_base (spawnCreate s c ls) vs hpre.transfers hb₀
    (fun v hv => spawn_frameOwned (hpre.freshDst v hv)) hframe
  exact kInvCA_of hb.1 hb.2 hpre.anchorOrder hpre.anchorOrderHeld

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Preservation
import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer

/-!
# Theorem 2 for the by-value composite (WC4 C5)

`spawnVal_preservesC`: the composite of WC4 C5, with the preconditions `SpawnValPre`, preserves the
re-indexed kernel invariant with the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`).

The yield of the parameters commutes with the transfers (`yield_transfers`): the parameters are
held by frames, which O4 does not move (Spec 1 §63 effect). The composite is therefore `spawn`
(WC4 C4) followed by the transfers. The anchor orders come from the final checks of WC4 C5.4; the
other invariants are carried phase by phase from the Spec 1 lemmas used by `transfer_preserves`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace TransferPreserveAux

open PreservationAux

/-! ## Yield and transfer commute -/

/-- `mapI` followed by `map` is `map` followed by `mapI` when the two functions commute on each
element. -/
theorem yield_transfer {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f c src dst : Nat}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) :
    transferEffC (yieldEff t ps f) c src dst = yieldEff (transferEffC t c src dst) ps f := by
  have hA : (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A).map (moveF t.P src dst) =
      mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 (t.A.map (moveF t.P src dst)) :=
    mapI_map_comm 0 t.A fun k y hy => by rw [Nat.zero_add]; exact yield_move_comm hp k y hy
  exact sc_ext rfl rfl rfl rfl hA rfl rfl rfl

/-- A transfer keeps the authorities held by frames (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_frame_held {t : SC} {c src dst a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : (transferEffC t c src dst).A[a]? = some y) :
    ∃ y₀, t.A[a]? = some y₀ ∧ ((∃ g, y₀.holder = .frame g) → y.holder = y₀.holder) := by
  have h : (transferEff (t.view c) src dst).A[a]? = some y := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at h
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨y₀, hy₀, fun ⟨g, hg⟩ => ?_⟩
  simp [hg, heldIn]

/-- WC4 C5.2–C5.3: yielding before the transfers gives the state of the composite. -/
theorem yield_transfers {ps : List Nat} {f c : Nat} :
    ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)),
      (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) →
      transfersEff c (yieldEff t ps f) vs = yieldEff (transfersEff c t vs) ps f
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | t, v :: vs, hp => by
    simp only [transfersEff]
    rw [yield_transfer hp]
    refine yield_transfers (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs fun a ha y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀
    exact ⟨g, by rw [e ⟨g, hg⟩, hg]⟩

/-- `mapI` with a function that is the identity on the indices of a list. -/
theorem mapI_id {F : Nat → Authority → Authority} :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List Authority), (∀ k y, F (i + k) y = y) → mapI F i l = l
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, y :: l, h => by
    have h0 : F i y = y := by simpa using h 0 y
    have ih := mapI_id (i + 1) l fun k z => by
      have := h (k + 1) z; rwa [show i + (k + 1) = i + 1 + k by omega] at this
    simp only [mapI, h0, ih]

/-- `mapI` over an append. -/
theorem mapI_append {F : Nat → Authority → Authority} :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l m : List Authority), mapI F i (l ++ m) = mapI F i l ++ mapI F (i + l.length) m
  | i, [], m => by simp [mapI]
  | i, y :: l, m => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, mapI, mapI_append (i + 1) l m, List.length_cons]
    rw [show i + 1 + l.length = i + (l.length + 1) by omega]

/-- WC4 C5.1, C5.3: creating without parameters then yielding them is `spawn` with the
parameters (WC4 C4 effect), when the parameters are existing authorities. -/
theorem create_yield {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length) :
    yieldEff (spawnCreate s c ls) ps s.nF = spawnEff s c ps ls := by
  have h0 : mapI (fun j (y : Authority) => if j ∈ ([] : List Nat) then
      { y with holder := .frame (s.view c).nF } else y) 0 (s.view c).A = (s.view c).A :=
    mapI_id 0 _ fun _ _ => by simp
  refine sc_ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_ rfl rfl rfl
  show mapI (yieldF ps s.nF) 0 (enterEff (s.view c) [] ls).A = (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls).A
  simp only [enterEff]
  rw [mapI_append, h0]
  congr 1
  exact mapI_id (0 + (s.view c).A.length) _ fun k y => by
    have : 0 + (s.view c).A.length + k ∉ ps := fun h => by
      have h2 := hp _ h
      change 0 + s.A.length + k < s.A.length at h2
      omega
    simp only [yieldF, this, ↓reduceIte]
def FrameOwned (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (P[q]?) (fun pl => ∃ g, pl.owner = .frame g) False

/-- A transfer keeps the places owned by frames (Spec 1 §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_frameOwned {v : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (h : FrameOwned v.P q) :
    FrameOwned (transferEff v src dst).P q := by
  unfold FrameOwned at h ⊢
  rw [transfer_P_get]
  cases hq : v.P[q]? with
  | none => rw [hq] at h; exact h.elim
  | some pl =>
    rw [hq] at h
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h
    exact ⟨g, by simp [hg, heldIn]⟩

/-- A usable place owned by a frame stays usable after a transfer (Spec 1 §40, §63 effect). -/
theorem transfer_usable_frameOwned {v : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (h : v.Usable q)
    (ho : FrameOwned v.P q) : (transferEff v src dst).Usable q := by
  cases h with
  | @frame q g pl hpl hd hog hf =>
    refine .frame (pl := pl) ?_ hd hog hf
    rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [hog, heldIn]
  | @place q o pl hpl hd hoo hu =>
    unfold FrameOwned at ho; rw [hpl] at ho
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ho; rw [hoo] at hg; cases hg

/-- The fresh root locals of `spawn` are owned by the new frame (Spec 1 §72 effect,
`LocalShape.toShape`). -/
theorem spawn_frameOwned {s : SC} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {dst : Nat}
    (h : FreshRootLocal s ls dst) : FrameOwned (spawnEff s c ps ls).P dst := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h
  have hil : i < ls.toShape.length := List.mem_range.1 (List.mem_filter.1 hi).1
  unfold FrameOwned
  show OptP ((enterP (s.view c) ls)[s.P.length + i]?) _ False
  simp only [enterP, shapeP, SC.view, SC.flat]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_range hil]
  refine ⟨s.nF, ?_⟩
  simp only [shapeOwner, LocalShape.toShape, List.getElem?_map]
  cases ls[i]? <;> rfl

/-! ## The transfer phases -/

/-- The clauses of `ValTransferPre` read by `transfer_base` hold on the state where the
parameters are already yielded: they read neither holders nor exercise. -/
theorem yield_view {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f c : Nat} :
    (yieldEff t ps f).view c = { t.view c with A := mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 t.A } := rfl

/-- `Active` is unchanged by the yield (WC4 C5.3). -/
theorem yield_active {v : S3} {ps : List Nat} {f x : Nat} :
    ({ v with A := mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A } : S3).Active x ↔ v.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    change (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A)[x]? = some y at hy
    rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    refine ⟨y₀, hy₀, ?_⟩
    unfold yieldF at ya; split at ya <;> exact ya
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    refine ⟨yieldF ps f (0 + x) y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (mapI (yieldF ps f) 0 v.A)[x]? = _

/-- Shape of the frame structure after popping the top frame `f` of context `c`, whose parent is
`p`, with the reparenting of WC4 C6 effect: the stack of `c` loses `f`, other stacks are unchanged,
the initial frames whose parent was `f` get the parent `p`. -/
structure Pop (s s' : SC) (c f p : Nat) : Prop where
  head : (s.stk c).head? = some f
  stk : ∀ d, s'.stk d = if d = c then (s.stk c).tail else s.stk d
  len : s'.C.length = s.C.length
  nF : s'.nF = s.nF
  par : ∀ d, s'.Live d → s'.ctxParent d = repO f p (s.ctxParent d)
  live : ∀ d, s'.Live d → s.Live d
  pf : s.parC f = some p

section Pop

variable {s s' : SC} {c f p : Nat}

/-- The stack of `c` starts with `f` (WC4 C6). -/
theorem Pop.stk_c (h : Pop s s' c f p) : s.stk c = f :: (s.stk c).tail := by
  have := h.head
  cases e : s.stk c with
  | nil => rw [e] at this; cases this
  | cons a l => rw [e] at this; cases this; rfl

/-- The popped frame is live before the step (WC4 C6). -/
theorem Pop.f_mem (h : Pop s s' c f p) : f ∈ s.frames := by
  apply SC.mem_frames_of (c := c); rw [h.stk_c]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..

/-- The frames live after the step are those live before, except `f` (WC4 C6, C7). -/
theorem Pop.mem_frames (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (h : Pop s s' c f p) {y : Nat} :
    y ∈ s'.frames ↔ y ∈ s.frames ∧ y ≠ f := by
  have hc := h.stk_c
  have hfc : f ∈ s.stk c := by rw [hc]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  have hft : f ∉ (s.stk c).tail := by
    have := SC.stk_nodup hnd c; rw [hc] at this; exact (List.nodup_cons.1 this).1
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := SC.mem_frames.1 hy
    rw [h.stk d] at hd
    split at hd
    · subst d
      exact ⟨SC.mem_frames_of (List.mem_of_mem_tail hd), fun e => hft (e ▸ hd)⟩
    · rename_i hne
      exact ⟨SC.mem_frames_of hd, fun e => hne (stk_unique hnd hd (e ▸ hfc))⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy, hyf⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := SC.mem_frames.1 hy
    apply SC.mem_frames_of (c := d)
    rw [h.stk d]
    split
    · subst d; rw [hc] at hd
      exact (List.mem_cons.1 hd).resolve_left hyf
    · exact hd

/-- The frames live after the step are duplicate-free (WC4 C3). -/
theorem Pop.nodup (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (h : Pop s s' c f p) : s'.frames.Nodup := by
  refine hnd.sublist ?_
  unfold SC.frames; rw [h.len]
  refine sublist_flatMap fun d _ => ?_
  rw [h.stk d]; split
  · subst d; exact List.tail_sublist _
  · exact List.Sublist.refl _

  simp only [termEffC, reparent, List.getElem?_map, getElem?_modify']
  cases s.C[d]? <;> rfl

/-- `exitFrameC` pops the top frame of `c` and reparents to its caller (WC4 C6). -/
theorem exitEffC_pop (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (hcall : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []) :
    Pop s (exitEffC s c) c ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) := by
  obtain ⟨f, p, rest, hc⟩ : ∃ f p rest, s.stk c = f :: p :: rest := by
    cases e : s.stk c with
    | nil => rw [e] at hcall; exact absurd rfl hcall
    | cons f l => cases l with
      | nil => rw [e] at hcall; exact absurd rfl hcall
      | cons p rest => exact ⟨f, p, rest, rfl⟩
  have hfc : f ∈ s.stk c := by rw [hc]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  refine ⟨by rw [hc]; rfl, fun d => ?_, by simp [exitEffC, reparent], rfl, fun d hl => ?_,
    fun d hl => ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold SC.stk; rw [exitEffC_C_get]
    by_cases hcd : c = d
    · subst d; simp only [↓reduceIte]
      cases hx : s.C[c]? with
      | none => simp
      | some x => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> split <;> simp_all
    · simp only [hcd, ↓reduceIte, Ne.symm hcd]
      cases hx : s.C[d]? with
      | none => simp
      | some x => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> simp_all
  · unfold SC.Live at hl; unfold SC.ctxParent; rw [exitEffC_C_get] at hl ⊢
    cases hx : s.C[d]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at hl; exact hl.elim

      simp only [Option.map_some, OptP] at hl

  · unfold SC.Live at hl ⊢; rw [exitEffC_C_get] at hl
    cases hx : s.C[d]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at hl; exact hl.elim
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at hl
      simp only [Option.map_some, OptP] at hl ⊢
      by_cases hcd : c = d <;> simp_all <;> split at hl <;> simp_all
  · have e := ReparentAux.parC_of_mem hnd hfc
    rw [hc] at e ⊢
    simpa [parIn] using e

/-- `terminate` pops the initial frame of `c` and reparents to its parent (WC4 C7, C6 effect). -/
theorem termEffC_pop (hnd : s.frames.Nodup) (hone : (s.stk c).length = 1)

  obtain ⟨f, hc⟩ : ∃ f, s.stk c = [f] := by
    cases e : s.stk c with
    | nil => rw [e] at hone; cases hone
    | cons f l => cases l with
      | nil => exact ⟨f, rfl⟩
      | cons _ _ => rw [e] at hone; exact absurd (Nat.succ.inj hone) (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hpar
  have hfc : f ∈ s.stk c := by rw [hc]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  refine ⟨by rw [hc]; rfl, fun d => ?_, by simp [termEffC, reparent], rfl, fun d hl => ?_,
    fun d hl => ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold SC.stk; rw [termEffC_C_get]
    by_cases hcd : c = d
    · subst d; simp only [↓reduceIte]
      have hc' := hc; unfold SC.stk at hc'
      cases hx : s.C[c]? with

      | some x => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> simp_all

      | none => simp

    unfold SC.Live at hl; unfold SC.ctxParent; rw [termEffC_C_get] at hl ⊢
    cases hx : s.C[d]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at hl; exact hl.elim
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at hl
      simp only [Option.map_some, OptP] at hl
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, repO]
      by_cases hcd : c = d <;> simp_all <;> split <;> simp_all
  · unfold SC.Live at hl ⊢; rw [termEffC_C_get] at hl
    cases hx : s.C[d]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at hl; exact hl.elim
    | some x =>
      rw [hx] at hl
      simp only [Option.map_some, OptP] at hl ⊢
      by_cases hcd : c = d <;> simp_all <;> split at hl <;> simp_all
  · have e := ReparentAux.parC_of_mem hnd hfc
    rw [hc] at e ⊢
    simp only [parIn, ↓reduceIte, List.head?_nil, Option.none_or] at e
    show s.parC f = some ((s.ctxParent c).getD 0)
    rw [e, hp]; rfl

/-- After `terminate`, the terminated context is not live (WC4 C7). -/
theorem termEffC_not_live : ¬ (termEffC s c).Live c := by
  unfold SC.Live; rw [termEffC_C_get]
  cases hx : s.C[c]? with
  | none => simp [OptP]
  | some x => simp only [Option.map_some, OptP, ↓reduceIte]; split <;> simp

/-- WC4 C3, C6 preservation obligations, C20: `exitFrameC` keeps a well-founded frame structure. -/
theorem exitEffC_framesC (hfr : FramesC s) (hcall : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []) :
    FramesC (exitEffC s c) := by
  have h := exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hcall
  refine h.framesC hfr ?_ fun d hl => ?_
  · have h0 := hfr.initial
    rw [exitEffC_C_get]
    cases hx : s.C[0]? with
      else s.ctxParent d :=
  ⟨(termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).pf, (termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hone hpar).par⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC4 C6 effect; Spec 1 §73 effect): `exitFrameC` changes the kernel
components exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`; reparenting changes only the
contexts, so it creates, elevates, revives and reanchors nothing. -/
theorem exitEffC_kernel (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    (exitEffC s c).A = (exitEff (s.view c)).A ∧ (exitEffC s c).D = (exitEff (s.view c)).D ∧
    (exitEffC s c).P = s.P ∧ (exitEffC s c).I = s.I ∧ (exitEffC s c).dead = s.dead ∧
    (exitEffC s c).pins = s.pins ∧ (exitEffC s c).nF = s.nF :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC4 C6, C7; Spec 1 §73 effect): `terminate` changes the kernel components
exactly as the effect of Spec 1 §73 on the view of `c`. -/
theorem termEffC_kernel (s : SC) (c : Nat) :
    (termEffC s c).A = (exitEff (s.view c)).A ∧ (termEffC s c).D = (exitEff (s.view c)).D ∧
    (termEffC s c).P = s.P ∧ (termEffC s c).I = s.I ∧ (termEffC s c).dead = s.dead ∧
    (termEffC s c).pins = s.pins ∧ (termEffC s c).nF = s.nF :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end Steps

/-! ## Theorems 2 and 3 for `exitFrameC` and `terminate` -/

section Main

variable {k : K} {s s' : SC} {c : Nat}

/-- Theorem 3 (OB-C13; WC4 C6; Spec 1 §44, §73): an `ok` `exitFrameC` preserves `AnchorOrderC`
(not a precondition of O7) and establishes `AnchorOrderHeldC` (§73.5), with the reparented
initial frames. Fragment: states with the frame structure `FramesC`, `WF3` and `AnchorOrderC`
on the live frames. -/

    (h : opStepC k .exit c s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderC s' ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hg

import Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib
import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
import Ern.Concurrency.Conservativity
import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer

/-!
# Minimal traces (test module)

Concrete states and runs used by the theorems of the concurrent milestone (constructions and
counterexamples), checked by `decide`. The corpus of WC4 §V (S1a–S18) is covered only for S4, S9
(positive halves) and S16 (`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces`).

* a mutex value `m = {data, lock}` whose field `data` owns the protected storage `T` (WC4 C13),
  its registration by `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`;
* theorem 4, counterexample without encapsulation (WC4 C22.1): `derive(guarded, Observe, footprint(T))` by the
  exclusive owner makes `acquire` not enabled while `grant = none` (`acquire_blocked_by_derive`);
  the encapsulated twin enables it (`acquire_enabled`);
* theorem 5 needs the kernel invariant: a state with `SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline` and the library
  instantiation of `SyncAuthorized`, violating `I1`, where `deriveSync` is not enabled
  (`realizability_needs_i1`);
* frame transitions: `enterFrame`, `spawn`, `exitFrameC` with reparenting, `terminate`, `join`
  (`frames_run`); `join` on a live context has no outcome (`join_waits`), on an unknown identifier
  it is rejected (`join_unknown_rejected`);
* a second `newMutex` on a protected root owned by the same field, hence with the same controller,
  is rejected (`shared_controller_rejected`, WC4 C13.8); two mutex values with distinct
  controllers are both accepted (`distinct_controllers_ok`, WC4 S9);
* S4: a child receives a value through the by-value composite and survives the exit of the
  creating frame (`s4_detached_child`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Traces

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency

/-! ## Mutex value (WC4 C12, C13) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `m`, `1` its field `data`, `2` its field `lock`, `3`
the protected value `T`, a root owned by `data`; every leaf `Init`. -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

/-- The reference layout (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the first field, the controller is the
second. -/
def L0 : MutexLayout := ⟨0, 1⟩

/-- Initial single-context state (Spec 1 §47): root authority `0` of `m` held by frame 0, root
authority `1` of `T` held by `data` (place 1). -/
def c0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem mst_ok : StaticsOK mst := by decide

/-- After `newMutex(guarded = 1)` (WC4 C13). -/
def reg1 : SyncReg := [⟨1, none⟩]

/-- `newMutex(1)` executed by context 0 is enabled on `c0`; its controller is place 2. -/
theorem newMutex_ok : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] c0 [] 0 1 (c0, reg1) ∧
    ControlOf L0 c0 ⟨1, none⟩ = some 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩
  .cons trivial (.newMutex distinct_controllers_ok.2.1) .nil

/-! ## S4: a detached child survives its creator (WC4 S4, C5, C6) -/

/-- Statics: one `Init` static place (place 0), owned by frame 0. -/
def s4st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial single-context state of `s4st` (Spec 1 §47). -/
def q0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init s4st)
/-- Context 0 enters frame 1 with two locals, `v` (place 1) and `p` (place 2) (Spec 1 §72). -/
def q1 : SC := enterEffC q0 0 [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]
/-- `write` of `v` through its root authority 1 (Spec 1 §67). -/
def q2 : SC := q1.set (write3Eff (q1.view 0) [1])
/-- `write` of `p` through its root authority 2 (Spec 1 §67). -/
def q3 : SC := q2.set (write3Eff (q2.view 0) [2])
/-- `alloc(provider p, owner v, one leaf)` (Spec 1 §71): the root `T` (place 3) owned by `v`, its
root authority 3 held by `v`. -/
def q4 : SC := q3.set (allocEff (q3.view 0) 1 [(none, 0)])
/-- From frame 1, the by-value composite (WC4 C5) creates context 1 (frame 2) with one local `d`
(place 4) and moves `v` into `d`. -/
def q5 : SC := spawnValEff q4 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)]
/-- Frame 1 exits (WC4 C6); context 1 is reparented to frame 0. -/
def q6 : SC := exitEffC q5 0

/-- The steps of S4 are `ok` (Spec 1 §72, §67, §71; WC4 C5, C6). -/
theorem s4_steps : opStepC K0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]) 0 q0 (.ok q1) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.write 1 [1]) 0 q1 (.ok q2) ∧ opStepC K0 (.write 2 [2]) 0 q2 (.ok q3) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)]) 0 q3 (.ok q4) ∧
    SpawnValStep K0 q4 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)] (.ok q5) ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 q5 (.ok q6) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide) trivial, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- The steps of S4 as an `EncapsulatedTrace` from `q0` with an empty registry (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem s4_trace : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (q0, [])
    [.kernel 0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]), .kernel 0 (.write 1 [1]),
     .kernel 0 (.write 2 [2]), .kernel 0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)]),
     .spawnVal 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)], .kernel 0 .exit] (q6, []) :=
  .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.1) <| .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.1) <| .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons ⟨fun _ h => (by cases h), trivial⟩ (.spawnVal s4_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.2.2) .nil

/-- WC4 S4, positive: after the exit of the creating frame 1, the child context 1 is live, its
initial frame is reparented to frame 0, `d` (place 4) and the storage `T` it now owns (place 3)
are usable, the root authority of `T` is held by `d`, and the re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`
(hence `ConcurrentWF`) holds. -/
theorem s4_detached_child : q6.Live 1 ∧ q6.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧ q6.flat.Usable 4 ∧
    q6.flat.Usable 3 ∧ (q6.A[3]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) ∧ KInvC q6 ∧
    ConcurrentWF q6 := by
  have hk := (Ern.MemoryModel.Arena.KInvB.sound (s := q6.flat) (by decide)).1
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩, -, hnd⟩, -, hno⟩ := hk
  have hfr : FramesC q6 :=
    framesC_of (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hkc : KInvC q6 :=
    ⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨i1, i2, i3, fun _ => i4_always _⟩, by decide, hnd⟩, by decide, hno⟩
  exact ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, hkc, hkc.1⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.Traces

import Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
import Ern.Concurrency.Context

/-!
# Representation relation of the concurrent state (WC4 C2, C25; Spec 1 §82.1)

* `ReprC`: the representation relation `Repr` of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (Spec 1 §82.1,
  §82.3–§82.5) read on the kernel components of `S_C` with the globally live frames
  (`SC.flat`, WC4 C2).
* `repr_congr`, `repr_frames_congr`: `Repr` reads the frame stack only through membership; it
  depends neither on the order of the frames of `flat` nor on the executing context
  (`reprC_view`). Spec 1 §39: "no particular runtime representation is required" for frames;
  §9: the abstract machine is flat.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement

/-- The representation relation of `S_C` (WC4 C2, C25; Spec 1 §82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5): `Repr`
of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` between the kernel components of `s`, with the globally live
frames as the stack (`SC.flat`), and a state of the memory machine. -/
def ReprC (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (s : SC) (m : Machine.State) : Prop :=
  Repr L rtok s.flat m

/-- `Repr` (Spec 1 §82.1, §82.3–§82.5) reads the places, the initialization states, the death
markers and the stack, the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §40: usability). -/
theorem repr_congr {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t t' : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hR : Repr L rtok t m) (hP : t'.P = t.P) (hI : t'.I = t.I) (hd : t'.dead = t.dead)
    (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ t'.F ↔ f ∈ t.F) : Repr L rtok t' m :=
  hR.transport hR.adm (Dom.refl _) (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP])
    (fun r hr hu => hR.live r hr
      (S3.Usable.mono (s := t) (s' := t') hP (fun f hf => (hF f).1 hf) (fun q h => hd ▸ h) hu))
    fun _ _ _ h => .inl (hI ▸ h)

/-- `Repr` depends on the stack only through membership (Spec 1 §39: frames have no required
representation; §9: allocations are flat): it holds for the same kernel components with any stack
listing the same frames, in any order. -/
theorem repr_frames_congr {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : S3} {F' : Frames}
    {m : Machine.State} (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ F' ↔ f ∈ t.F) :
    Repr L rtok { t with F := F' } m ↔ Repr L rtok t m :=
  ⟨fun h => repr_congr h rfl rfl rfl fun f => (hF f).symm,
   fun h => repr_congr h rfl rfl rfl hF⟩

/-- `ReprC` does not depend on the executing context (WC4 C2; Spec 1 §39, §9): it is `Repr` on the
view of any context. -/
theorem reprC_view {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s : SC} {m : Machine.State} (c : Nat) :
    ReprC L rtok s m ↔ Repr L rtok (s.view c) m :=
  (repr_frames_congr (t := s.flat) (F' := (s.view c).F) fun _ => SC.mem_view_F).symm

/-- `ReprC` after writing back kernel components `t` that list the globally live frames (WC4 C2):
it is `Repr` on `t`. -/
theorem reprC_set {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s.frames) : ReprC L rtok (s.set t) m ↔ Repr L rtok t m :=
  repr_frames_congr (t := t) (F' := s.frames) fun f => (hF f).symm

/-- `ReprC` of a single-context state is `Repr` of its projection (WC4 C24). -/
theorem reprC_ofS3 {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State} :
    ReprC L rtok (SC.ofS3 t) m ↔ Repr L rtok t m := by
  have hF : (SC.ofS3 t).flat = { t with F := (SC.ofS3 t).frames } := rfl
  unfold ReprC
  rw [hF]
  exact repr_frames_congr fun f => by simp [SC.frames, SC.ofS3, SC.stk]

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Repr
import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable
import Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve

/-!
# Realization of the labelled concurrent steps in the memory machine (WC4 C2, C24, C25; Spec 1 §82)

Contexts interleave at the grain of abstract steps: the realization of one labelled step of a
context is a sequence of raw steps of the memory machine of Spec 1 Parts II–III, run without
interference from the other contexts. Every statement below is about this fragment only. Concurrent
byte accesses, physical atomicity, memory orders and `happens-before` (WC4 OB-C01–OB-C06) are outside
it, and so is the realization of the controller word (WC4 OB-C05). No unsafe region is modelled.

* `realize`: the raw operations of each label of `LStep`. An inherited operation O1–O16 executed by
  `c` is realized as in `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (`opsOf`) on the view of `c` (WC4 C2), the
  representations written by `write` and `writeShared` being data of the program; `spawn` by the
  creations of the locals of O6 (Spec 1 §72, §82.4); `terminate` as O7 (Spec 1 §73, §82.5);
  reparenting has no memory effect; the by-value composite (WC4 C5) by its phases in order: the
  creations, then the realizations of O4 (Spec 1 §63) by transfer in the declared order, the yield
  having none; `join`, `deriveSync`, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` by none.
* `StepOblC`: the obligations of one step, those of `Refinement.StepObl` (Spec 1 §20.3, §15, §16,
  §82.1, §82.4) on the view of the executing context, explicit and never replaced by `True`.
* R1 (`r1_lstep`): for every labelled step, the realization is an execution of `ok` raw steps that
  keeps `ReprC`.
* R5 (`r5_realize`): on a single-context state, the realization of an inherited operation is the
  realization of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` on the projection (WC4 C24).
* R2 (`simulationC`) and R3 (`concrete_safety`): every run of encapsulated labelled steps from the
  initial state of Spec 1 §47, with parameters fixed once per run, is realized by an execution of
  `ok` raw steps from the empty memory state, related by `ReprC`, none of whose raw steps is `ub`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
open PreservationAux TransferPreserveAux ReparentAux

/-! ## Realizations transferred from `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` -/

namespace RealizeAux

variable {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
  {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty}

/-- Realization of the effect of O4 (Spec 1 §63 effect, §82.2, §82.3), from the clauses §63.1
(usability of source and destination), §63.2 and §63.3 (source leaves `Init`) only: the proof of
`Refinement.r6_transfer`, which reads no other clause. -/
theorem realize_transfer {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : S3}
    {m : Machine.State} {src dst : Nat} (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) (hw : WF3 t)
    (hsu : t.Usable src) (hdu : t.Usable dst) (hsh : SameShape t.P src dst)
    (hsi : ∀ l ∈ footprint t.P src, t.I l = .init)
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW m (transferOps L ty m t src dst)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (transferOps L ty m t src dst) m (run m (transferOps L ty m t src dst)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr L rtok (transferEff t src dst) (run m (transferOps L ty m t src dst)) := by
  have hdl := hdu.lt
  have hsrc : ∀ q ∈ transferPairs t.P src dst, AllocP m (L q.1).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧
      (L q.1).off + (L q.1).len ≤ a.size ∧ a.InitRange (L q.1).off (L q.1).len := by
    rintro ⟨l, l'⟩ hq
    obtain ⟨hl, -⟩ := mem_transferPairs.1 hq
    obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hls⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    have hu := usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l src (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hls hsu
    obtain ⟨a, ha, h1, h2⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf hu
    obtain ⟨a', ha', h3⟩ := hR.init l hlP hlf (hsi l hl)
    rw [ha] at ha'; cases ha'
    exact ⟨a, ha, h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hdst : ∀ q ∈ transferPairs t.P src dst, AllocP m (L q.2).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧
      (L q.2).off + (L q.2).len ≤ a.size := by
    rintro ⟨l, l'⟩ hq
    obtain ⟨hl, hc⟩ := mem_transferPairs.1 hq
    obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hld⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (corr_leaf hw hdl hsh hl hc)
    exact hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf
      (usable_of_partOf hw (l' + 1) l' dst (Nat.lt_succ_self l') hld hdu)
  obtain ⟨hok, hinit⟩ := copyOps_run (C := C) _ m hR.adm.wf hsrc hdst hob
  have hex := exec_of_along _ _ hok
  refine ⟨hex, hR.transport (hex.admissible hR.adm) (dom_run _ _ hR.adm.wf)
    (transfer_len t src dst) (transfer_parentOf t src dst) (fun r hr hu => ?_)
    fun l _ _ hi => ?_⟩
  · exact live_run _ _ hR.adm.wf (copyOps_noDealloc L ty m _) (hR.live r hr
      (transfer_usable_back hw hsu hu))
  · simp only [transferEff] at hi
    split at hi
    · obtain ⟨l0, hq⟩ := corr_leaf_back hsh ‹_›
      exact .inr (hinit (l0, l) hq)
    · split at hi
      · cases hi
      · exact .inl hi

/-- Realization of the effect of O8 (Spec 1 §65 effect, §82.2, §82.3), from the clause §65.2
(`target` is a usable leaf) only: the proof of `Refinement.r6_store`, which reads no other
clause. -/
theorem realize_store {ty : Nat → Ty} {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : S3}
    {m : Machine.State} {a p : Nat} (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) (hw : WF3 t)
    (hu : t.Usable p) (hleaf : isLeaf t.P p)
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW m (storeOps pe m L ty t a p)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (storeOps pe m L ty t a p) m (run m (storeOps pe m L ty t a p)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr L rtok (storeEff t a p) (run m (storeOps pe m L ty t a p)) := by
  have htgt : LeafOfUsable t p :=
    ⟨p, List.mem_range.2 hu.lt, hu, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hu.lt, hleaf, hu.lt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  simp only [storeOps] at hob ⊢
  refine writes_repr hR hw (fun l hl => by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]; exact htgt)
    hob ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> unfold storeEff <;> split
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · intro l hl
    dsimp only at hl
    split at hl
    · exact .inr (List.mem_singleton.2 ‹_›)
    · exact .inl hl
  · exact fun l hl => .inl hl

/-- Realization of the effect of O6 (Spec 1 §72 effect, §82.4, §82.5), from the clause §72.2 (the
locals form a well-formed shape) only: the proof of `Refinement.r6_enter`, which reads no other
clause. The creations are those of the root locals. -/
theorem realize_enter {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {pl : Placement} {g : Nat → Geom}
    (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) (hw : WF3 t) (hsh : ShapeOK t.P.length ls.toShape)
    (hpl : PlacementOK pl) (hg : GeomOK g)
    (hlay : NewLayout L (enterP t ls) t.P.length m.next g (rootIdx ls.toShape)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (allocOps pl g rtok t.P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)) m
        (run m (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok t.P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape))) ∧
      Refinement.Repr L rtok (enterEff t ps ls)
        (run m (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok t.P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape))) := by
  refine repr_extend hR hpl hg rfl hsh
    (usable_old hw (fun q hq => shapeP_get_lt hq) (fun q hq => ?_) (fun f hf h => ?_))
    (fun l hl => ?_) (fun l hl => ?_) hlay
  · simp only [enterEff, Nat.not_le.2 hq, ↓reduceIte]
  · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
    · exact absurd hf (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
    · exact h
  · simp only [enterEff, Nat.not_le.2 hl, ↓reduceIte]
  · simp only [enterEff, hl, ↓reduceIte]; exact fun h => by cases h

/-- Realization of the effect of O7 (Spec 1 §73 effect, §82.5, §17), from a nonempty stack
only: the proof of `Refinement.r6_exit`, which reads no clause of §73 but the existence of a
current frame. The deallocations are those of the root places directly owned by the current
frame. -/
theorem realize_exit {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) (hw : WF3 t) (hF : t.F ≠ [])
    (htc : ∀ r, C (rtok r) (rtok r)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (exitOps L rtok t) m (run m (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok t)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr L rtok (exitEff t) (run m (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok t)) := by
  have hpw : (exitRoots t).Pairwise (fun r r' => (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc) :=
    ((range_pairwise _).filter _).imp_of_mem fun {r r'} hr hr' hlt =>
      hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)
  have hlive : ∀ r ∈ exitRoots t, AllocP m (L r).alloc
      fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r) := fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨hrt, ho, hd⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hr
    cases hpl : t.P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hpl] at ho; exact ho.elim
    | some pl =>
      rw [hpl] at ho
      exact (hR.live r hrt (.frame hpl hd ho (top_mem hF))).and (hR.tokens r hrt)
  obtain ⟨hok, hkeep, -⟩ := deallocOps_run (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) htc _ m hpw hlive
  have hex := exec_of_along _ _ hok
  refine ⟨hex, hR.transport (hex.admissible hR.adm) (dom_run _ _ hR.adm.wf) rfl rfl
    (fun r hr hu => ?_) fun l _ _ hi => .inl hi⟩
  have hu0 : t.Usable r := S3.Usable.mono (s := t) (s' := exitEff t) rfl
    (fun f h => List.mem_of_mem_tail h) (fun _ h => h) hu
  have hnot : r ∉ exitRoots t := fun hm => by
    obtain ⟨-, ho, -⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hm
    have hnd := hw.frames.2.1
    cases hu with
    | frame hpl _ ho' hf =>
      change t.P[r]? = some _ at hpl
      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
      have ht : t.top ∈ t.F.tail := hf
      unfold S3.top at ht
      cases hFe : t.F with
      | nil => exact hF hFe
      | cons f F =>
        rw [hFe] at ht hnd
        exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1 ht
    | place hpl _ ho' _ =>
      change t.P[r]? = some _ at hpl
      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hR.live r hr hu0
  refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩
  change (run m (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok (exitRoots t))).allocs _ = _
  rw [hkeep _ fun r' hr' e => hR.inj r' r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 hr
    (fun e' => hnot (e' ▸ hr')) e, ha]

end RealizeAux

open RealizeAux

/-! ## Transport of `ReprC` to the written-back state (WC4 C2) -/

/-- `ReprC` of a state whose kernel components are those of `t` with the globally live frames,
when `t` lists the same frames (WC4 C2; `repr_frames_congr`). -/
theorem reprC_of_flat {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s' : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames }) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames)
    (h : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok s' m := by
  unfold ReprC; rw [hflat]
  exact (repr_frames_congr fun f => (hF f).symm).2 h

/-- `ReprC` after a step that changes no place, initialization state or death marker, and no
context (WC4 C2; Spec 1 §82.1, §82.3, §82.5). -/
theorem reprC_set_same {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hP : t.P = s.P) (hI : t.I = s.I) (hd : t.dead = s.dead) (h : ReprC L rtok s m) :
    ReprC L rtok (s.set t) m :=
  repr_congr (t := s.flat) (t' := (s.set t).flat) h hP hI hd fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- `ReprC` is kept by the yield of WC4 C5.3, which changes holders only. -/
theorem reprC_yield {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f : Nat}
    {m : Machine.State} (h : ReprC L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok (yieldEff t ps f) m :=
  repr_congr (t := t.flat) (t' := (yieldEff t ps f).flat) h rfl rfl rfl fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-! ## Realization of the labels (WC4 C2, C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82.2–§82.5) -/

/-- The kernel operation of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (Spec 1 §60–§75) for an operation
O1–O16, with the representations `w` written by `write` and `writeShared` (Spec 1 §10 ¶4, §16 ¶2),
data of the program that the kernel does not read. -/
def kopOf : KernelOp → (Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → KOp
  | .derive src region m, _ => .derive src region m
  | .split src rs, _ => .split src rs
  | .release a, _ => .release a
  | .transfer src dst, _ => .transfer src dst
  | .depend q x, _ => .depend q x
  | .enter ps ls, _ => .enter ps ls
  | .exit, _ => .exit
  | .read a ls, _ => .read a ls
  | .write a ls, w => .write a ls w
  | .writeShared a ls, w => .writeShared a ls w
  | .pin p, _ => .pin p
  | .unpin o, _ => .unpin o
  | .endUse p, _ => .endUse p
  | .free p auth, _ => .free p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls, _ => .alloc pr ow ls
  | .store a p, _ => .store a p

/-- The `ok` step of `kopOf op w` is the `ok` outcome of `op` (Spec 1 §58, §60–§75). -/
theorem opStep_kopOf {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {t t' : S3} :
    OpStep k (kopOf op w) t t' ↔ op.Step k t (.ok t') := by
  cases op <;> exact Iff.rfl

/-- The raw operations of the transfer phases of the by-value composite (WC4 C5.2): for each
by-value argument in its declared order, the realization of O4 (Spec 1 §63, §82.2, §82.3,
`transferOps`) executed by `c` on the state produced by the earlier transfers, in the memory state
produced by the earlier copies. -/
def valOps {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (c : Nat) :
    SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | _, [], _ => []
  | t, v :: vs, m => transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2 ++
      valOps π c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs (run m (transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2))

/-- The raw operations realizing a labelled step from `s`, the memory state being `m` (WC4 C2,
C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82 preamble, §82.2–§82.5), at the grain of abstract steps:
- an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by `c`: the realization `opsOf` of
  `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` on the view of `c` (WC4 C2), with the written representations `w`;
- `spawn` (WC4 C4): the creations of the root locals of O6 (Spec 1 §72, §82.4); the yield of the
  parameters has no memory effect;
- the by-value composite (WC4 C5): its phases in order, the creations of the root locals (C5.1),
  then the realizations of O4 by transfer in the declared order (C5.2), the yield (C5.3) having
  none;
- `terminate` (WC4 C7): the realization of O7 on the view of `c` (Spec 1 §73, §82.5);
  reparenting (WC4 C6) has no memory effect;
- `join` (WC4 C8) and `deriveSync` (WC4 C15, O1 has no storage effect, Spec 1 §60): none;
- `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` (WC4 C13, C16–C18): none, the registry only; the
  physical controller and its correspondence with the registry are the realization obligation
  WC4 OB-C05, not modelled. -/
def realize {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    Label → SC → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .kernel c op, s, m => opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m
  | .spawn c _ ls, s, m => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs, s, m =>
    allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape) ++
      valOps π c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
        (run m (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)))
  | .terminate c, s, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok (s.view c)
  | .join .., _, _ => []
  | .deriveSync .., _, _ => []
  | .newMutex .., _, _ => []
  | .acquire .., _, _ => []
  | .unlock .., _, _ => []
  | .resetLock .., _, _ => []

/-- WC4 OB-C05: `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` and `resetLock` have no raw operation in this
realization; their physical controller update is not modelled. -/
theorem realize_sync {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    (s : SC) (m : Machine.State) (c g i : Nat) (adm : List Nat) :
    realize π w (.newMutex c g adm) s m = [] ∧ realize π w (.acquire c i) s m = [] ∧
      realize π w (.unlock c i) s m = [] ∧ realize π w (.resetLock c i) s m = [] :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The obligations of one labelled step (Spec 1 §20.3, §82; WC4 C2): for an inherited operation
executed by `c`, those of `Refinement.StepObl` on the view of `c` (the parametric obligations of
its reads and writes, §15, §16; the layout of new places, §82.1, §23; the instantiation of
`K.FreeCompat`, §80, §70.2, §82.4); for `spawn` and the by-value composite, the parametric
obligations of its raw operations and the layout of the new locals (§82.1, §23); for the other
labels, the parametric obligations of their raw operations. -/
def StepOblC {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Label → SC → Machine.State → Prop
  | .kernel c op, s, m => StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m
  | .spawn c ps ls, s, m => OblAlong ObR ObW m (realize π w (.spawn c ps ls) s m) ∧
      NewLayout π.L (enterP (s.view c) ls) (s.view c).P.length m.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .spawnVal c ps ls vs, s, m => OblAlong ObR ObW m (realize π w (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) s m) ∧
      NewLayout π.L (enterP (s.view c) ls) (s.view c).P.length m.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | lbl, s, m => OblAlong ObR ObW m (realize π w lbl s m)

/-! ## R1, step by step -/

section R1

variable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
  {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Refinement.Params Ty}
  {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}

/-- An `ok` outcome of an operation run on the view of `c` is the written-back `ok` outcome on the
view (WC4 C2). -/
theorem viewStep_ok {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : ViewStep R c s (.ok s')) : ∃ t', R (s.view c) (.ok t') ∧ s' = s.set t' := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  cases o₃ with
  | ok t' => injection ho with e; exact ⟨t', hR, e⟩
  | reject => cases ho
  | fail => cases ho

/-- R1 for the inherited operations that run on the view of `c` and keep the stack (Spec 1
§60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2): `Refinement.r6` on the view, transported to `S_C`. -/
theorem r1_viewStep {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC} {m : Machine.State}
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok s m) (hk : KInvCA s)
    (h : ViewStep (op.Step k) c s (.ok s'))
    (hF : ∀ t', op.Step k (s.view c) (.ok t') → t'.F = (s.view c).F)
    (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) m
        (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok s' (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) := by
  obtain ⟨t', hst, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hnd, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
  obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := r6 hπ ((reprC_view c).1 hR) hw hnd (opStep_kopOf.2 hst) hob
  refine ⟨hex, (reprC_set fun f => ?_).2 hR'⟩
  rw [hF t' hst]; exact SC.mem_view_F

/-- R1 for the inherited operations O1–O16 executed by `c` (WC4 C2, C6; Spec 1 §60–§75, §82):
the realization on the view of `c` is an execution of `ok` raw steps and `ReprC` holds after the
step. For `transfer`, `depend`, `store`, `enterFrame` and `exitFrameC`, whose preconditions are
re-indexed on `ancestorC`, the realization is proved from the clauses it reads
(`realize_transfer`, `realize_store`, `realize_enter`, `realize_exit`). -/
theorem r1_kernel {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC} {m : Machine.State}
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok s m) (hk : KInvCA s)
    (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) m
        (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok s' (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
  have hRv := (reprC_view c).1 hR
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_transfer (C := C) (ty := π.ty) hRv hw hpre.srcUsable
      hpre.dstUsable hpre.sameShape hpre.srcInit hob.1
    exact ⟨hex, (reprC_set fun _ => SC.mem_view_F).2 hR'⟩
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact ⟨.nil _, reprC_set_same rfl rfl rfl hR⟩
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_store (C := C) (ty := π.ty) (pe := π.pe) (a := a) hRv hw
      hpre.usable hpre.leaf hob.1
    refine ⟨hex, (reprC_set fun f => ?_).2 hR'⟩
    have : (storeEff (s.view c) a p).F = (s.view c).F := by unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl
    rw [this]; exact SC.mem_view_F
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_enter (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (ps := ps) hRv hw
      hpre.localsOK hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hob.2
    have hpush := enter_push (ps := ps) (ls := ls) hfr hpre.callerLive
    refine ⟨hex, reprC_of_flat rfl (fun f => ?_) hR'⟩
    rw [hpush.mem]
    show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
    rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hFv : (s.view c).F ≠ [] := by
      intro he
      have hc : s.stk c ≠ [] := fun e => hpre.hasCaller (by rw [e]; rfl)
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hc
      have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
      rw [he] at this; cases this
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_exit (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hRv hw hFv hπ.2.2
    exact ⟨hex, reprC_of_flat rfl
      (fun f => (exitEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.hasCaller).view_tail hfr.nodup) hR'⟩
  | derive => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | split => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | release => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | read => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | write => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | writeShared => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | pin => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | unpin => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | endUse => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | free => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob
  | alloc => exact r1_viewStep hπ hR hk h (fun _ h => viewOp_F h (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ _ e => by cases e)
      (fun e => by cases e)) hob

/-- R1 for the transfer phases of the by-value composite (WC4 C5.2; Spec 1 §63, §82.2, §82.3):
from a state whose yielded form satisfies the kernel invariant without the anchor orders
(`KBase`, the invariant carried phase by phase in `Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve`), each phase
is realized by `transferOps` on the view of the creating context, and `ReprC` is kept. -/
theorem realize_vals {fin : S3} {c f : Nat} {ps : List Nat} :
    ∀ (t : SC) (vs : List (Nat × Nat)) (m : Machine.State), ValTransfersPre k fin c t vs →
      KBase (yieldEff t ps f) → (∀ v ∈ vs, FrameOwned t.P v.2) →
      (∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g) →
      ReprC π.L π.rtok t m → OblAlong ObR ObW m (valOps π c t vs m) →
      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (valOps π c t vs m) m (run m (valOps π c t vs m)) ∧
        ReprC π.L π.rtok (transfersEff c t vs) (run m (valOps π c t vs m))
  | _, [], _, _, _, _, _, hR, _ => ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
  | t, v :: vs, m, ⟨hpre, hrest⟩, hk, hown, hp, hR, hob => by
    simp only [valOps] at hob ⊢
    rw [along_append] at hob
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    have hyw := (view_facts_base hk c).1
    have hRy : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok ((yieldEff t ps f).view c) m :=
      repr_congr ((reprC_view c).1 hR) rfl rfl rfl fun _ => Iff.rfl
    have hu : ∀ q, ((yieldEff t ps f).view c).Usable q ↔ (t.view c).Usable q := fun q =>
      S3.Usable.congr (s' := (yieldEff t ps f).view c) (s := t.view c) rfl rfl rfl
    obtain ⟨hex₁, hR₁⟩ := realize_transfer (C := C) (ty := π.ty) hRy hyw
      ((hu _).2 hpre.srcUsable) ((hu _).2 hpre.dstUsable) hpre.sameShape hpre.srcInit hob₁
    have hR₁' : ReprC π.L π.rtok (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2)
        (run m (transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2)) :=
      (reprC_set fun _ => SC.mem_view_F).2 (repr_congr hR₁ rfl rfl rfl fun _ => Iff.rfl)
    have hk₁ : KBase (yieldEff (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) ps f) :=
      transfers_base t [v] ⟨hpre, trivial⟩ hk
        (fun w hw => hown w (by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hw]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)) hp
    obtain ⟨hex₂, hR₂⟩ := realize_vals (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs _ hrest hk₁
      (fun w hw => transfer_frameOwned (hown w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)))
      (fun a ha y hy => by
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := transfer_frame_held hy
        obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hp a ha y₀ hy₀
        exact ⟨g, by rw [e ⟨g, hg⟩, hg]⟩) hR₁' hob₂
    rw [run_append]
    exact ⟨exec_append hex₁ hex₂, hR₂⟩

/-- **R1** (WC4 C2, C4–C8, C13–C18, C25; Spec 1 §82 preamble, §82.2–§82.5, §20.3), at the grain of
abstract steps: the realization of a labelled step of one context is a sequence of raw steps run
without interference from the other contexts. For every labelled step `LStep k L lbl st st'` and
every memory state `m` with `ReprC` of `st.1`, under the obligations of the parameters
(`Refinement.ParamsOK`), the kernel invariant `KInvCA` of `st.1` and the obligations of the step

theorem r1_lstep {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {m : Machine.State}
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m) (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hob : StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w lbl st.1 m) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (realize π w lbl st.1 m) m (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 m)) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok st'.1 (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 m)) := by
  cases h with
  | kernel h => exact r1_kernel hπ hR hk h hob
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_enter (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (ps := ps)
      ((reprC_view c).1 hR) hw hpre.localsOK hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hob.2
    have hpush := spawn_push (ps := ps) (ls := ls) hk.1.1.1 hpre.creatorLive
    refine ⟨hex, reprC_of_flat rfl (fun f => ?_) hR'⟩
    rw [hpush.mem]
    show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
    rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]
  | @spawnVal s s' reg c ps ls vs h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hob, hlay⟩ := hob
    simp only [realize] at hob ⊢
    rw [along_append] at hob
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
    obtain ⟨hex₁, hR₁⟩ := realize_enter (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (ps := [])
      ((reprC_view c).1 hR) hw hpre.localsOK hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hlay
    have hpush := spawn_push (ps := []) (ls := ls) hk.1.1.1 hpre.creatorLive
    have hR₁' : ReprC π.L π.rtok (spawnCreate s c ls) _ := reprC_of_flat rfl (fun f => by
      rw [hpush.mem]
      show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
      rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]) hR₁
    have hlt : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length := fun a ha => by
      have := hpre.params a ha
      unfold OptP at this; split at this
      · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
      · exact this.elim
    have hframe : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = some y →
        ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g := by
      intro a ha y hy
      have hp := hpre.params a ha
      have hy' : (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = s.A[a]? := by
        show (mapI _ 0 s.A ++ _)[a]? = _
        rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact hlt a ha), getElem?_mapI]
        cases s.A[a]? <;> simp
      rw [hy'] at hy
      have hy₂ : (s.view c).A[a]? = some y := hy
      rw [hy₂] at hp
      exact ⟨_, hp.2.1⟩
    have hb₀ : KBase (yieldEff (spawnCreate s c ls) ps s.nF) := by
      rw [create_yield hlt]; exact spawn_base hk hpre.creatorLive hpre.params hpre.localsOK
    obtain ⟨hex₂, hR₂⟩ := realize_vals (π := π) (spawnCreate s c ls) vs _ hpre.transfers hb₀
      (fun v hv => spawn_frameOwned (hpre.freshDst v hv)) hframe hR₁' hob₂
    rw [run_append]
    exact ⟨exec_append hex₁ hex₂, reprC_yield hR₂⟩
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
    have hfr := hk.1.1.1
    have hFv : (s.view c).F ≠ [] := by
      intro he
      have hc : s.stk c ≠ [] := fun e => by have := hpre.initialOnly; rw [e] at this; cases this
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hc
      have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
      rw [he] at this; cases this
    have hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none := fun e => by
      have := hpre.hasParent; rw [e] at this; exact this
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_exit (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW)
      ((reprC_view c).1 hR) hw hFv hπ.2.2
    exact ⟨hex, reprC_of_flat rfl
      (fun f => (termEffC_pop hfr.nodup hpre.initialOnly hpar).view_tail hfr.nodup) hR'⟩
  | join h => cases h; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
  | deriveSync h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact ⟨.nil _, reprC_set_same rfl rfl rfl hR⟩
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨.nil _, reprC_set_same rfl rfl rfl hR⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨-, e, g, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h
    refine ⟨.nil _, reprC_set_same ?_ ?_ ?_ hR⟩ <;> unfold releaseEff <;> split <;> rfl
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩

end R1

/-! ## R5: conservativity of the realizations (WC4 C24) -/

/-- **R5** (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §82): on a single-context state, the realization of an inherited
operation O1–O16 executed by the context is the realization `opsOf` of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` of the same operation on the projection `toS3`, its obligations are
those of `Refinement.StepObl` on the projection, and `ReprC` is `Repr` of the projection. -/
theorem r5_realize {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Refinement.Params Ty}
    {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s : SC} (hs : s.Single) (op : KernelOp)
    (m : Machine.State) :
    realize π w (.kernel 0 op) s m = opsOf π (kopOf op w) s.toS3 m ∧
      (StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w (.kernel 0 op) s m ↔
        StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) s.toS3 m) ∧
      (ReprC π.L π.rtok s m ↔ Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s.toS3 m) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view 0) m = _
    rw [single_view hs]
  · show StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view 0) m ↔ _
    rw [single_view hs]
  · unfold ReprC
    rw [single_flat hs]

/-- Extension of an encapsulated trace by one encapsulated step (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace.snoc {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st₀ st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {lbl : Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st₀ lbls st)
    (he : Encap L st lbl) (hs : LStep k L lbl st st') :
    EncapsulatedTrace k L st₀ (lbls ++ [lbl]) st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .cons he hs .nil
  | cons he' hs' _ ih => exact .cons he' hs' (ih he hs)

/-- Runs of encapsulated labelled steps from the initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty
registry, WC4 C3, C12), translated into the memory machine with the contract `K`, the
deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters `π` fixed once
for the run (Spec 1 §20.3 ¶3, §82; as `Refinement.SimRun`): the initial state with the creations
and writes of the statics (`Refinement.repr_init`); then each step of an `EncapsulatedTrace`
(WC4 C22, C23) under its obligations (`StepOblC`), the representations written by the step being
`w`, followed by its realization. Contexts interleave at the grain of abstract steps. -/
inductive SimRunC {Ty : Type} (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics)
    (π : Refinement.Params Ty) : SC × SyncReg → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [])
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))
  | step {lbl : Label} {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
      {m : Machine.State} : SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st m → Encap L st lbl →
      LStep k L lbl st st' → StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w lbl st.1 m →
      SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st' (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 m))

`DDSound(K)` (Spec 1 §80) and the obligations of the parameters, for every translated run of
encapsulated labelled steps, the memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of
`ok` raw steps, it is related to the concurrent state by `ReprC`, and the run is an
`EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state of Spec 1 §47. -/
theorem simulationC {Ty : Type} {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics}
    {π : Refinement.Params Ty} {st : SC × SyncReg} {m : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (h : SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st m) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty m) ∧ ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m ∧
      ∃ lbls, EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st := by
  have key : ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty m) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m ∧

    induction h with
    | init hst hlay hob =>

      obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := r1_lstep hπ hR hk hs hob
      exact ⟨⟨⟨_, exec_append hex hex'⟩, hR', _, htr.snoc he hs⟩, lstep_kInvCA hdd hs hk⟩
