import Ern.Concurrency.Sync
import Ern.Concurrency.Transfer

/-!
# Reference synchronization library

Library state separate from `S_C` (WC4 C2, C12), on the pattern of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec
1 §46, §55, §56):

* the registry of `SyncEntry { guarded, grant }` (WC4 C12), liveness of an entry, the positional
  `ControlOf` relationship (WC4 C12) for declared field positions `MutexLayout`;
* `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22);
* the library instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized` on the registry (WC4 C14.1–C14.3), and the
  contract obligation `SyncSound` of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
  synchronization contract");
* derived operations `newMutex` (C13), `acquire` (C16), `unlock` (C17), `resetLock` (C18);
* labelled library steps, the by-value composite included (WC4 C23), runs, and the encapsulation
  hypothesis `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22.1–C22.3, C22.5; C23), a predicate on runs, never a
  precondition of a kernel operation.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Registry (WC4 C12) -/

/-- Synchronization entry (WC4 C12): the protected authority `guarded` and the recorded grant. -/
structure SyncEntry where
  guarded : Nat
  grant : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Synchronization registry (WC4 C12), library state separate from `S_C`. -/
abbrev SyncReg := List SyncEntry

/-- Declared field positions of the reference mutex value (WC4 C12: "at its declared field
position", `guardedField`, `controlField`): the position of the field holding `guarded` and that of the controller, among the
ordered children of the mutex value. -/
structure MutexLayout where
  guardedField : Nat
  controlField : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An entry is live exactly while `guarded` is active (WC4 C12). -/
def SyncEntry.Live (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop := s.flat.Active e.guarded

/-- Decidability of liveness of an entry (WC4 C12). -/
instance (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Decidable (e.Live s) := by
  unfold SyncEntry.Live; infer_instance

/-- Positional `ControlOf` (WC4 C12): `guarded` is held by the field `h` at position
`guardedField` of the mutex value `m` (the structural parent of `h`); the controller is the child
of `m` at position `controlField`. -/
def ControlOf (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[e.guarded]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) =>
    match parentOf s.P h with
    | some m =>
      if (kids s.P m)[L.guardedField]? = some h then (kids s.P m)[L.controlField]? else none
    | none => none
  | _ => none

/-- The `S3` whose current frame is `f` (WC4 C14: `SyncAuthorized` names the requesting frame;
Spec 1 §43 reads the stack only through its top and membership). -/
def SC.viewAt (s : SC) (f : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := f :: s.frames.filter fun g => decide (g ≠ f) }

/-- WC4 C14.3: the frame `f` has effective and exercisable access to `ControlOf(e)` under the
condition of Spec 1 §68.2: some authority exercisable by `f` in a mode at least `Observe` has a
present effective mode on the controller. -/
def CtrlRight (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    (s.viewAt f).ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ effective s.flat a ctl ≠ none) False

/-- Decidability of the controller fact. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (CtrlRight L s e f) := by
  unfold CtrlRight; infer_instance

/-- The authorization facts of WC4 C14 for an entry: C14.1 (live), C14.2 (`grant = none`), C14.3
(`CtrlRight`). -/
def EntryAuth (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Prop :=
  e.Live s ∧ e.grant = none ∧ CtrlRight L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library authorization of an entry. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) (f : Nat) : Decidable (EntryAuth L s e f) := by
  unfold EntryAuth; infer_instance

/-- Instantiation of `K_C.SyncAuthorized(state, sync_registry, guarded, requesting_frame)` by the
library (WC4 C14, C25): an entry of the registry with the requested `guarded` identity satisfies
the authorization facts C14.1–C14.3. -/
def LibSyncAuthorized (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ EntryAuth L s e f

/-- Decidability of the library instantiation. -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f) := by
  unfold LibSyncAuthorized; infer_instance

/-- The contract `K_C` instantiated by the library (WC4 C14, C25), the registry type being
`SyncReg` (WC4 C2). -/
def libKC (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : KC SyncReg :=
  { k with SyncAuthorized := LibSyncAuthorized L }

/-- Decidability of the instantiated predicate. -/
instance (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) (g f : Nat) :
    Decidable ((libKC k L).SyncAuthorized reg s g f) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g f))

/-- Contract obligation of WC4 C14 ("cannot be used outside the corresponding valid
synchronization contract"), in state `s` with registry `reg`: `SyncAuthorized` holds only for the
`guarded` of a live entry of `reg`. -/
def SyncSound (kc : KC SyncReg) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ g f, kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f → ∃ e ∈ reg, e.guarded = g ∧ e.Live s

/-- The library instantiation satisfies the obligation of WC4 C14. -/
theorem libKC_sound (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (s : SC) :
    SyncSound (libKC k L) reg s :=
  fun _ _ ⟨e, he, hg, hl, _⟩ => ⟨e, he, hg, hl⟩

/-- The holder is a usable place (WC4 C12, C13.1, C21.1). -/
def PlaceUsable (t : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place q => t.Usable q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `PlaceUsable` (WC4 C12). -/
instance (t : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (PlaceUsable t h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold PlaceUsable <;> infer_instance

/-- Spec 1 §65.3 for an authority held by a place `q`: it covers neither a leaf of `q` nor a leaf
of storage transitively owned by `q` (WC4 C13.5). -/
def StoredOK (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  match y.holder with
  | .place q => ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ footprint P q ∧
      ∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, OwnedIn P q r → l ∉ footprint P r
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `StoredOK` (Spec 1 §65.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (y : Authority) : Decidable (StoredOK P y) := by
  unfold StoredOK; split <;> infer_instance

/-- The place `slot` holding `guarded` (WC4 C12). -/
def slotOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) => some h
  | _ => none

/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C21, C22) -/

/-- Active descendant of `guarded` covering a protected leaf, a leaf of `footprint(guarded)`
(WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C21.5, C22). -/
def CoveringDesc (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ s.flat.ancs j ∧ s.flat.Active j ∧ ∃ l ∈ s.flat.afp j, l ∈ s.flat.afp g

/-- Decidability of `CoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (CoveringDesc s g j) := by
  unfold CoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- No active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf (WC4 C13.9, C18.2, C22). -/
def NoCoveringDesc (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Prop := ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ CoveringDesc s g j

/-- Decidability of `NoCoveringDesc` (WC4 C22). -/
instance (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Decidable (NoCoveringDesc s g) := by
  unfold NoCoveringDesc; infer_instance

/-- `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22). -/
def GrantDiscipline (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded

/-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: distinct live entries (by position in the registry) have distinct
`ControlOf` leaves. -/
def CtlUnique (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry) (ctl : Nat), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s → ControlOf L s e = some ctl → ControlOf L s e' = some ctl → i = j

/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `slot`: for every live entry, every structural leaf of
the place holding `guarded` is `Init`. -/
def SlotInit (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
    OptP (slotOf s e.guarded) (fun q => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.I l = .init) False

/-- WC4 C21.7, initialization invariant for `ctl`: for every live entry, the controller leaf
`ControlOf(entry)` is `Init`. -/
def CtlInit (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.I ctl = .init) False

/-- `SyncInv` (WC4 C21.1–C21.7): items 1–5 and 7 over live entries, item 6 over every entry. -/
structure SyncInv (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C21.1: `guarded` is active (liveness), has own mode `Modify`, and is held by a usable
  place. -/
  guarded : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC4 C21.2: a recorded grant exists, has origin `guarded` and footprint
  `footprint(guarded)`. -/
  grant : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  /-- WC4 C21.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a usable
  leaf. -/
  control : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C21.4, first clause: controller uniqueness among live entries. -/
  ctlUnique : CtlUnique L s reg
  /-- WC4 C21.4, second clause (the guarded-identity uniqueness guard of WC4 C13.7): distinct
  live entries have distinct `guarded` identities. -/
  unique : ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' →
    e.Live s → e'.Live s →
    e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j
  /-- WC4 C21.5, `GrantSubtree`. -/
  grantSubtree : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  /-- WC4 C21.6, `RegBound`, over every entry: the registered `guarded` identity exists (Spec 1
  §38: identities are indices). -/
  regBound : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.guarded < s.A.length
  /-- WC4 C21.7: the structural leaves of `slot` are `Init`. -/
  slotInit : SlotInit s reg
  /-- WC4 C21.7: the controller leaf is `Init`. -/
  ctlInit : CtlInit L s reg

/-! ## Derived operations (WC4 C13, C16–C18) -/

/-- The mutex value `M` of WC4 C12, C13: the immediate structural parent of the place `slot`
holding `guarded`. -/
def mutexOf (s : SC) (g : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match (s.A[g]?).map (·.holder) with
  | some (Holder.place h) => parentOf s.P h
  | _ => none

/-- Preconditions of `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13.1–C13.10), with `adm` the
identities used by the other live administrations (Spec 1 §56). The interface and realization
obligations of WC4 C13 (C13.3, C13.6, former C13.10) are not represented: WC4 C13 says they "are
not claimed to follow from the authority-only state `S_C`". -/
structure NewMutexPre (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg)
    (c g : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C13.1: `guarded` is active, of own mode `Modify`, and held by a usable place. -/
  guarded : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  /-- WC4 C13.2: ordinary exercisable `Modify` over `guarded` (Spec 1 §43). -/
  exercisable : (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify
  /-- WC4 C13.3, with the positional `ControlOf` of WC4 C12: the controller exists and is a
  usable leaf. -/
  control : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C13.4: `footprint(guarded) ∩ footprint(M) = ∅`. -/
  disjointM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False
  /-- WC4 C13.10: every structural leaf of `footprint(M)` is `Init`. -/
  initM : OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False
  /-- WC4 C13.5: when `guarded` is stored (derived), Spec 1 §65.3 holds: it covers neither a leaf
  of its holder nor a leaf of storage transitively owned by it. -/
  stored : OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False
  /-- WC4 C13.6: `K.SharedMutable(ctl)`. -/
  sharedMutable : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False
  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live entry. -/
  unique : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g
  /-- WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §56: `guarded` is not the identity of another live administration. -/
  otherAdmin : g ∉ adm
  /-- WC4 C13.8: no other live entry is associated with `ctl`. -/
  ctlUnique : OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
    ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False
  /-- WC4 C13.9. -/
  available : NoCoveringDesc s g

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `newMutex` (WC4 C13). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC)
    (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat) : Decidable (NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
      PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False ∧
    (s.view c).ExercisableAt g .modify ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ s.flat.afp g, l ∉ footprint s.P m) False ∧
    OptP (mutexOf s g) (fun m => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P m, s.I l = .init) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none → StoredOK s.P y) False ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) k.SharedMutable False ∧
    (∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → e.guarded ≠ g) ∧ g ∉ adm ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s ⟨g, none⟩) (fun ctl => ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s →
      ControlOf L s e ≠ some ctl) False ∧
    NoCoveringDesc s g)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, j, l, m⟩⟩

/-- `newMutex(guarded)` executed by `c` (WC4 C13): registers the entry `⟨guarded, none⟩`; the
kernel state is unchanged and no authority is created (WC4 C13 effect). WC4 C13 states no outcome
other than success; only `ok` is defined. -/
def NewMutexOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (adm : List Nat) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c g : Nat)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ NewMutexPre k L adm s reg c g ∧ st' = (s, reg ++ [⟨g, none⟩])

/-- `acquire` on entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C16): with the library instantiation of
`SyncAuthorized` for the entry, `deriveSync(guarded)` on the registry `reg` and the record of the
fresh grant identity `|A|` in the entry. A taken controller (`grant ≠ none`) leaves `acquire` not
enabled; WC4 C16 states no other outcome than success, so only `ok` is defined. -/
def AcquireOk (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat)
    (st' : SC × SyncReg) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ EntryAuth L s e (s.view c).top ∧
    DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L) reg s c e.guarded ∧
    st' = (deriveSyncEff s c e.guarded, reg.set i { e with grant := some s.A.length })

/-- `unlock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C17.1–C17.4): O3 releases the grant and the registry
records `grant = none` (WC4 C17 effect). C17.2 and C17.3 are the preconditions of O3 (Spec 1 §62);
C17.4 is `CtrlRight`. The controller update is a realization obligation (WC4 C17), not a
precondition; only `ok` is defined. -/
def UnlockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e g, reg[i]? = some e ∧ e.Live s ∧ e.grant = some g ∧ ReleasePre (s.view c) g ∧
    CtrlRight L s e (s.view c).top ∧
    st' = (s.set (releaseEff (s.view c) g), reg.set i { e with grant := none })

/-- `resetLock` of entry `i` executed by `c` (WC4 C18.1–C18.3): the entry becomes available; the
kernel state is unchanged (WC4 C18 effect). WC4 C18.3: "`ControlOf(entry)` resolves to an
existing, usable controller **leaf**, as required by C21.3"; the controller-initialization
invariant is not a precondition (WC4 C18.3: "established separately for every live entry by
C21.7"). Only `ok` is defined. -/
def ResetLockOk (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (c i : Nat) (st' : SC × SyncReg) :
    Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ e, reg[i]? = some e ∧ (s.view c).ExercisableAt e.guarded .modify ∧
    NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded ∧
    OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl => s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False ∧
    st' = (s, reg.set i { e with grant := none })

/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC4 C22, C23) -/

/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
inductive Label where
  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | terminate (c : Nat)
  | join (c d : Nat)
  | deriveSync (c g : Nat)
  | newMutex (c g : Nat) (adm : List Nat)
  | acquire (c i : Nat)
  | unlock (c i : Nat)
  | resetLock (c i : Nat)
  | spawnVal (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (vs : List (Nat × Nat))

/-- Labelled `ok` step of the concurrent kernel with the synchronization library (WC4 C2, C4,
C5, C6–C8, C13, C15–C18; WC4 C23 for the by-value composite): kernel and
frame steps keep the registry; raw `deriveSync` runs under the
library instantiation of `SyncAuthorized` on the current registry (WC4 C14). -/
inductive LStep (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : Label → SC × SyncReg → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | kernel {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp} :
      opStepC k op c s (.ok s') → LStep k L (.kernel c op) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | spawn {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      SpawnStep s c ps ls (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawn c ps ls) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | terminate {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} :
      TermStep k s c (.ok s') → LStep k L (.terminate c) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | join {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c d : Nat} :
      JoinStep s c d (.ok s') → LStep k L (.join c d) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | deriveSync {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} :
      DeriveSyncStep (libKC k L) reg s c g (.ok s') → LStep k L (.deriveSync c g) (s, reg) (s', reg)
  | newMutex {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c g : Nat} {adm : List Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      NewMutexOk k L adm s reg c g st' → LStep k L (.newMutex c g adm) (s, reg) st'
  | acquire {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      AcquireOk k L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.acquire c i) (s, reg) st'
  | unlock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      UnlockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.unlock c i) (s, reg) st'
  | resetLock {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c i : Nat} {st' : SC × SyncReg} :
      ResetLockOk L s reg c i st' → LStep k L (.resetLock c i) (s, reg) st'
  | spawnVal {s s' : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
      {vs : List (Nat × Nat)} :
      SpawnValStep k s c ps ls vs (.ok s') → LStep k L (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) (s, reg) (s', reg)

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the source `src` of a transfer in state `st`: for each live entry, `src` is
neither the place `slot` holding `guarded`, nor a strict structural subplace of `slot`, nor the
controller leaf `ctl`. -/
def TransferExcl (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 →
    OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => ¬ partOf st.1.P src q) True ∧
      ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some src

/-- Decidability of `TransferExcl` (WC4 C22.3). -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Decidable (TransferExcl L st src) := by
  unfold TransferExcl; infer_instance

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the transfers of the by-value composite (WC4 C23):
the source of every transfer phase satisfies `TransferExcl` in the state where that phase starts
(WC4 C5.2), the registry being `reg`. -/
def EncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ EncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC4 C22, C23): for each live
entry, WC4 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`), C22.3 (`transfer`, and the
transfer phases of the by-value composite) and C22.5 (`endUse` whose place is the controller leaf
`ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`). WC4 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) is a
realization/interface obligation (WC4 C22) with no content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1
§41), and is not represented. -/
def Encap (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf st.1.P p q → p = q) True
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
  | _ => True

/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) : SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : LRun k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23: "Any lemma conditional on encapsulation must expose that
condition in its theorem statement or the reachable-trace assumptions"): a run every step of which
satisfies `Encap` in the state where it is taken. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      Encap L st lbl → LStep k L lbl st st₁ → EncapsulatedTrace k L st₁ lbls st₂ →
      EncapsulatedTrace k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- An encapsulated trace is a run. -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace.run {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') : LRun k L st lbls st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons _ hs _ ih => exact .cons hs ih

/-! ## Theorem 1, last part: `SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` without live entry (WC4 C14, C24) -/

/-- Theorem 1 (WC4 C14, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, the obligation of WC4
C14 makes `K_C.SyncAuthorized` false on that registry. Fragment: every state, single-context ones
included. -/
theorem syncAuthorized_false {kc : KC SyncReg} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC}
    (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s) (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (g f : Nat) :
    ¬ kc.SyncAuthorized reg s g f := fun h => by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -, hl⟩ := hsound g f h
  exact hnone e he hl

/-- Theorem 1 (WC4 C15, C24): in a state whose registry has no live entry, under the obligation
of WC4 C14, `deriveSync` on that registry is never enabled. -/
theorem conservative_deriveSync {kc : KC SyncReg} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC}
    (hsound : SyncSound kc reg s) (hnone : ∀ e ∈ reg, ¬ e.Live s) (c g : Nat) (s' : SC) :
    ¬ DeriveSyncStep kc reg s c g (.ok s') :=
  fun ⟨_, h⟩ => syncAuthorized_false hsound hnone g _ (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.authorized

/-! ## Theorem 6: exclusivity of grants (Spec 1 §50; WC4 C15) -/

/-- An ancestor of an authority whose origin is `g` is `g` or below `g` (Spec 1 §42, §49.5). -/
theorem ancs_le_origin {t : S3} (hw : WF3 t) {b g : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : t.A[b]? = some y)
    (hyo : y.origin = some g) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ t.ancs b) : x ≤ g := by
  have hgb : g < b := hw.origins b y g hy hyo
  have horg : t.org b = some g := by simp [S3.org, hy, hyo]
  rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons horg hgb] at hx
  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
  · exact Nat.le_refl _
  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt hx)

/-- Theorem 6 (Spec 1 §50, I1; WC4 C15, C21.2): two distinct active authorities of own mode
`Modify` whose origin is the same `guarded` and whose footprint is `footprint(guarded)`, nonempty,
cannot coexist. Fragment: states satisfying `WF3` and `I1` on the globally live frames. -/
theorem grants_exclusive {s : SC} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (h1 : I1 s.flat) {g a b : Nat}
    {x y : Authority} (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) (hy : s.A[b]? = some y)
    (xa : x.active = true) (ya : y.active = true) (xm : x.mode = .modify)
    (xo : x.origin = some g) (yo : y.origin = some g)
    (xf : ∀ l, l ∈ x.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp g) (yf : ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp g)
    {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ s.flat.afp g) : False := by
  have hga : g < a := hw.origins a x g hx xo
  have hgb : g < b := hw.origins b y g hy yo
  have hna : a ∉ s.flat.ancs b := fun h => by have := ancs_le_origin hw hy yo h; omega
  have hnb : b ∉ s.flat.ancs a := fun h => by have := ancs_le_origin hw hx xo h; omega
  have := h1 a b x y l hab hx hy xa ya ((xf l).2 hl) ((yf l).2 hl) hna hnb
  rw [xm] at this; cases this.1

/-! ## Theorem 5: realizability (WC4 C14, C25) -/

/-- Theorem 5 (WC4 C14, C15, C25): under `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, and the kernel invariant
re-indexed (`KInvC`: `WF3`, `I1` and `I2` are used), the library instantiation of
`SyncAuthorized` (the facts C14.1–C14.3 only) on the registry, for the current frame of a live
context, entails that no active descendant of `guarded` covers a protected leaf and all the
preconditions of `deriveSync` on that registry, in particular the own mode (C15.1), I1 for the
full-footprint grant (§60.3) and the validity of the origin chain (§60.1). Fragment: states
satisfying `KInvC`. -/
theorem realizability {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {s : SC} {c g : Nat}
    (hk : KInvC s) (hsi : SyncInv L s reg) (hgd : GrantDiscipline s reg) (hc : s.stk c ≠ [])
    (ha : LibSyncAuthorized L reg s g (s.view c).top) :
    NoCoveringDesc s g ∧ DeriveSyncPre (libKC k L) reg s c g := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hfr, hw⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩, -, -⟩, -, -⟩ := hk
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl, hl, hn, hcr⟩ := ha
  have hnc := hgd e he hl hn
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hl
  have hy' : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
  have hym : y.mode = .modify := by
    have := hsi.guarded e he ⟨y, hy, ya⟩; simp only [OptP, hy'] at this; exact this.1
  have hfp : s.flat.afp e.guarded = y.footprint := by simp [S3.afp, hy]
  have hafp : ∀ {j : Nat} {z : Authority}, s.A[j]? = some z → s.flat.afp j = z.footprint :=
    fun hz => by simp [S3.afp, SC.flat, hz]
  have hmo : OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => Mode.modify.le y.mode) False := by
    rw [hy', OptP, hym]; exact Mode.le_refl _
  refine ⟨hnc, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hmo,
    ⟨e, he, rfl, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hn, hcr⟩, ?_, ?_, fun l h => h, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact I2.ancs_active h2 ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  · intro l hl'
    have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
    exact hw.footprints _ y hy l hl''
  · intro l hl'
    have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
    have hd : descModes s.flat e.guarded l = [] := by
      apply nil_of_forall_not_mem
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨j, z, hz, za, hlz, hanc, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 hm
      exact hnc j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
        ⟨hanc, ⟨z, hz, za⟩, l, by rw [hafp hz]; exact hlz, hl'⟩
    change Allows (effective s.flat e.guarded l) .modify
    rw [effective_eq hy ya hl'', hd, hym]
    simp [effOf, Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
  · intro b _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i z hz
      intro za hnb hcov
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨l, hl', hlz⟩ := hcov
      have hb : b ≠ e.guarded := fun h => hnb (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
      have hnanc : b ∉ s.flat.ancs e.guarded := fun h => hnb (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
      by_cases hdesc : e.guarded ∈ s.flat.ancs b
      · exact hnc b (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz)) ⟨hdesc, ⟨z, hz, za⟩, l,
          by rw [hafp hz]; exact hlz, hl'⟩
      · have hl'' : l ∈ y.footprint := by rw [← hfp]; exact hl'
        have := h1 e.guarded b y z l (Ne.symm hb) hy hz ya za hl'' hlz hdesc hnanc
        rw [hym] at this; cases this.1
    · trivial
  · obtain ⟨f, rest, hf⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hc
    simp [SC.view, S3.top, hf]

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Arenas: the reference library abstraction (Part XIV)

Arenas of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, Part XIV (§76–§78), with §36, §46, §55,
§56, §58, §79, §86 and §88. An arena is a library abstraction (Part XIV): its entries live in a
library state separate from the kernel state `S₃` (§38, §46). `newArena` (O17) only registers an
entry; `issue` (O18) and `reset` (O19) are defined twice:

* as their contracts, clause by clause (§77, §78): `IssueC`, `ResetC`;
* as derived operations over the kernel steps (Part XIV): `issue` is its static checks, the
  availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` on the region and `store` of the block into the
  destination (`IssueD`); `reset` is `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the whole storage,
  then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3 (`ResetD`), which never rejects after an
  accepted `derive` on states satisfying I3 (`resetNoDeps_of_derive`).

On library-reachable states, `issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` show that both definitions
have the same outcomes and the same arrival states, `reset_iff_derive_release` that `reset` is
accepted or rejected exactly when `derive` then `release` is (Q7), and `lReach_inv` that every
live entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). Library reachability (`LReach`, `LReachNG`) uses the derived
operations, so its kernel states are kernel-reachable (`newArena_as_library`) and satisfy the
kernel invariant of §57 (`Access.reachable_kinv`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (§46) -/

/-- Arena entry (§46): administered storage, `internal` authority, available leaves and issued
regions with their block authorities. The sets of §46 are lists read by membership. -/
structure ArenaEntry where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§46, §38): the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena registry. -/
structure LState where
  kern : S3
  arenas : List ArenaEntry

/-- Initial library state (§47): the initial kernel state and an empty arena registry. -/
def LState.init (statics : Statics) : LState := ⟨S3.init statics, []⟩

/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-! ## `ArenaInv` (§55) -/

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55), required for live arenas. "Still-issued" is read as "with an active block
authority". The clause "anchor and ownership restrictions are respected" has no referent and is
not represented; "complying with exclusivity and validity rules" is left to the kernel
invariants (§57). -/
structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Decidability of `ArenaInv` (§55): the footprint equality is the two inclusions. -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ArenaInv s E) :=
  @decidable_of_iff (ArenaInv s E) ((s.Usable E.storage ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp E.internal, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage, l ∈ s.afp E.internal) ∧ s.Active E.internal ∧
    OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False) ∧
    ((∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage)) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
      ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2))
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, ⟨f, g⟩, h, i, j⟩ => ⟨a, fun l => ⟨b l, c l⟩, d, e, f, g, h, i, j⟩,
     fun h => ⟨⟨h.storageUsable, fun l => (h.fpEq l).1, fun l => (h.fpEq l).2, h.active,
      h.shape⟩, ⟨h.availableIn, h.issuedIn⟩, h.disjoint, h.notAvailable, h.derived⟩⟩
    (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance inferInstance))

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## A decision procedure for the kernel invariant on concrete states (§49–§54, §57)
/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/

/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5,
§76.6). §76.6 is read on the resulting state (v0.1 §76.6): its kernel component is `s`, since
`newArena` changes no kernel component (§76 `ok` effect, `newArena_kernel`), so `WF3`, `I1`,
`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are required of the whole kernel state `s`; the new entry is
the one `newArenaEff` registers, `available` holding the leaves of the storage and `issued`
empty, and it must satisfy `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True
  /-- §76.6: `WF3` (§49) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  wf3 : WF3 s
  /-- §76.6: `I1` (§50) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  i1 : I1 s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrder` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld s
  /-- §76.6: the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
  arenaInv : ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True ∧
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
    ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6 (read on the resulting state, v0.1 §76.6). -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §77.2: local self-blocking prevention, `destination` is not in `region`. -/
  dstNotIn : dst ∉ region

/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- §77.5: the effective mode of `internal` permits `Modify` on every leaf of the region. -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify

/-- Decidability of `IssueRight` (§77.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s E region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect): a block authority of fresh identity
`|A|`, derived from `internal`, of mode `Modify`, on the region, held by `destination`, which
receives the corresponding anchor; only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`. -/
def issueKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩]
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [s.A.length] else s.D q
    I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect; §46): the leaves of the region leave
`available`; the issuance joins `issued` with its authority. -/
def issueMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with
    available := E.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
    issued := (region, s.A.length) :: E.issued }

/-- Checks of `issue` on the simulated resulting state (§77.3, §77.6). -/
structure IssueArrival (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.3: `AnchorOrder` for the new anchor of `destination`, in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
    ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst)
  /-- §77.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst)
  /-- §77.6, O8.5: `destination` remains under exercisable `Modify` in the resulting state. -/
  keepsDst : HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst

/-- Decidability of `IssueArrival` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueArrival s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
      ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst) ∧
    HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- Library state after an `ok` issue of entry `i` (§77, `ok` effect). -/
def issueL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : LState :=
  ⟨issueKEff L.kern E region dst, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩

/-- The contract of `issue` on entry `i` (§77, §58): `reject` when the entry is missing or a
static precondition fails; `fail`, the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable (§77.4);
`reject` when the effective right (§77.5) or a check on the resulting state (§77.3, §77.6)
fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive IssueC (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueC i region dst L .fail
  | noRight {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → ¬ IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | noArrival {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → ¬ IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L (.ok (issueL L i E region dst))

/-- `issue` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §77): its static checks, then the availability
`fail` (§77.4), then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh
identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8); the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)

/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/

/-- §78.3 (v0.1): no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
`internal` that covers a leaf of the administered storage. Dependencies of contained values are
covered since parts are places. -/
def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage

/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`
  covering a leaf of the storage. -/
  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E

/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }

/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩

/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))

/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
      ResetD i L .reject
  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)

result.output:
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: state, frames, invariants

Exploratory formalization of the concurrent state `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` of the working
candidate `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC4.md` (WC4 C1–C3, C20) on top of the frozen kernel of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (Spec 1 §38–§45, §49–§57).

* contexts with lifecycle states, local stacks and the parent of their initial frame (WC4 C1–C3);
* globally live frames, current frame of a context, extended parent relation `parC` and
  `ancestorC` (WC4 C3);
* the `S3` seen by an executing context (`SC.view`, WC4 C2: current frame = top of its stack,
  liveness = globally live frames), the kernel components alone (`SC.flat`), and the projection
  `SC.toS3` on single-context states (WC4 C24);
* `ConcurrentWF`, `Inv3C`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC`, `NoOrphanC` (WC4 C20; Spec 1 §44,
  §49–§57 re-indexed);
* membership congruence: the kernel invariants of Spec 1 that read the stack only through
  membership agree on every view (WC4 C2).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## State (WC4 C1–C3) -/

/-- Lifecycle state of an execution context (WC4 C2, C7, C8): live, or completed. -/
inductive Life where
  | live
  | done
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Execution context (WC4 C1–C3): its local frame stack, current frame first; its lifecycle
state; the parent of its initial frame (`none` for the initial context, whose initial frame is
the base frame of Spec 1 §39). -/
structure Ctx where
  stack : List Nat
  life : Life
  parent : Option Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `S_C = (C, F_C, P, I, A, D)` (WC4 C2). `C` lists the contexts by identity (their index); their
stacks and the parents of their initial frames form `F_C`; `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` keep their Spec 1
meaning (§38); `nF`, `dead` and `pins` are the auxiliary components of `S3` (Spec 1 §38). -/
structure SC where
  C : List Ctx
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Context `c` is live (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.Live (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop := OptP (s.C[c]?) (fun x => x.life = .live) False

/-- Decidability of `SC.Live` (WC4 C2). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (s.Live c) := by unfold SC.Live; infer_instance

/-- Local stack of context `c` if it is live, empty otherwise (WC4 C2, C3). -/
def SC.stk (s : SC) (c : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match s.C[c]? with
  | some x => if x.life = .live then x.stack else []
  | none => []

/-- Parent of the initial frame of context `c` (WC4 C3). -/
def SC.ctxParent (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.C[c]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- Globally live frames: the frames of the stacks of live contexts (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.frames (s : SC) : List Nat := (List.range s.C.length).flatMap s.stk

/-- The kernel components of `s` as an `S3` whose stack lists the globally live frames (WC4 C2:
references to live frames consider the globally live frame structure). -/
def SC.flat (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.frames, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The `S3` seen by executing context `c` (WC4 C2): the stack of `c` first, so that the current
frame is the top of its local stack, followed by the other globally live frames. It is the `S₃`
view of WC4 C2 (candidate P1) on which `K.Satisfiable` of an `alloc` executed by `c` is evaluated
(`alloc_ok_satisfiable`, `alloc_fail_unsatisfiable`). -/
def SC.view (s : SC) (c : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s.flat with F := s.stk c ++ s.frames.filter fun f => decide (f ∉ s.stk c) }

/-- Kernel components of an `S3` written back into `s`; contexts unchanged (WC4 C2). -/
def SC.set (s : SC) (t : S3) : SC :=
  { s with nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D, dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Single-context states (WC4 C24) -/

/-- Single-context state (WC4 C24): exactly one context, the initial one, live, without
parent. -/
def SC.Single (s : SC) : Prop := ∃ stk, s.C = [⟨stk, .live, none⟩]

/-- Projection of a state to `S3` (WC4 C24): the stack of context 0. -/
def SC.toS3 (s : SC) : S3 :=
  { F := s.stk 0, nF := s.nF, P := s.P, I := s.I, A := s.A, D := s.D, dead := s.dead,
    pins := s.pins }

/-- The single-context state of an `S3` (WC4 C24). -/
def SC.ofS3 (t : S3) : SC :=
  { C := [⟨t.F, .live, none⟩], nF := t.nF, P := t.P, I := t.I, A := t.A, D := t.D,
    dead := t.dead, pins := t.pins }

/-! ## Extended frame-parent relation and ancestry (WC4 C3) -/

/-- Parent of frame `f` within a stack whose initial frame has parent `par`: the next frame of
the stack, or `par` for the initial frame; `none` if `f` is not in the stack (WC4 C3; Spec 1
§39). -/
def parIn (par : Option Nat) (f : Nat) : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | a :: rest => if a = f then rest.head?.or par else parIn par f rest

/-- The live context whose stack contains `f` (WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique). -/
def SC.ctxOf (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range s.C.length).find? fun c => (s.stk c).contains f

/-- Extended frame-parent relation `parC` (WC4 C3): the parent of a live frame, following the
links across contexts; `none` for the base frame and for frames that are not live. -/
def SC.parC (s : SC) (f : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (s.ctxOf f).bind fun c => parIn (s.ctxParent c) f (s.stk c)

/-- Extended `ancestor_C(f₁, f₂)` (WC4 C3; Spec 1 §39): `f₂` is live and `f₁` is `f₂` or one of
its ancestors along `parC`. Chains follow links to smaller identities (Spec 1 §49, last
paragraph: identity order represents well-foundedness, required by `FramesC.parent`). -/
def SC.ancestorC (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop :=
  f₂ ∈ s.frames ∧ (f₁ = f₂ ∨ f₁ ∈ chain s.parC f₂)

/-- Decidability of `ancestorC` (WC4 C3). -/
instance (s : SC) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (s.ancestorC f₁ f₂) := by
  unfold SC.ancestorC; infer_instance

/-! ## Anchor order on the extended ancestry (Spec 1 §44, §54 re-indexed; WC4 C2, C3) -/

/-- Spec 1 §44 re-indexed (WC4 C2, C3): the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is
`fd` or one of its ancestors along `ancestorC`. -/
def EffAnchorOKC (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.flat.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.flat.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => s.ancestorC g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOKC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOKC s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOKC; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable
place `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of `x` is an `ancestorC` of the frame of `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderC` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q,
      EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderC s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderC_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` re-indexed (Spec 1 §44, §54; WC4 C2): the rule of `AnchorOrderC` for every
active authority held by a usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeldC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeldC` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure
for Spec 1 §44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeldC_iff {s : SC} : AnchorOrderHeldC s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.flat.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOKC s x (s.flat.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeldC` (Spec 1 §44). -/
instance (s : SC) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeldC s) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeldC_iff.symm

/-! ## Invariants (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49–§57 re-indexed) -/

/-- Frame structure of `S_C` (WC4 C3, C20; Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed: "the stack" read as the
globally live frames). -/
structure FramesC (s : SC) : Prop where
  /-- WC4 C3: the initial context, context 0, is live and its initial frame, the base frame of
  Spec 1 §39, has no parent. -/
  initial : OptP (s.C[0]?) (fun x => x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = none) False
  /-- WC4 C3: every live context has a nonempty local stack. -/
  nonempty : ∀ c, s.Live c → s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- WC4 C3: frame identities are globally unique; Spec 1 §49.1: duplicate-free. -/
  nodup : s.frames.Nodup
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1: every frame has a valid identity (below `nF`). -/
  bound : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, f < s.nF
  /-- WC4 C3: the initial frame of a non-initial live context has a parent (the frame that
  created the context, or its reparenting target, WC4 C6). -/
  rooted : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → s.Live c → s.ctxParent c ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §49.1 re-indexed, WC4 C3: the parent of a live frame is live; the parent precedes
  its child, which represents well-foundedness (Spec 1 §49, last paragraph). -/
  parent : ∀ f ∈ s.frames, ∀ g, s.parC f = some g → g ∈ s.frames ∧ g < f

/-- `ConcurrentWF` (WC4 C20): the frame structure of `FramesC` and `WF3` (Spec 1 §49.1–§49.8)
read with "the stack" as the globally live frames. -/
def ConcurrentWF (s : SC) : Prop := FramesC s ∧ WF3 s.flat

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` re-indexed (Spec 1 §50–§53, §57; WC4 C2): `I4` reads `Read3Pre`, which
depends on the current frame, so it is required for every executing context. -/
def Inv3baseC (s : SC) : Prop :=
  I1 s.flat ∧ I2 s.flat ∧ I3 s.flat ∧ ∀ c, I4 (s.view c)

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` re-indexed (Spec 1 §57; WC4 C2). -/
def Inv3C (s : SC) : Prop := Inv3baseC s ∧ AnchorOrderC s ∧ NoDangling s.flat

/-- `NoOrphan` re-indexed (Spec 1 §54; WC4 C2): chains start at a globally live frame. -/
def NoOrphanC (s : SC) : Prop := NoOrphan s.flat

/-- The kernel invariant of Spec 1 §57 re-indexed (WC4 C20, C23):
`ConcurrentWF ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInvC (s : SC) : Prop := ConcurrentWF s ∧ Inv3C s ∧ AnchorOrderHeldC s ∧ NoOrphanC s

/-! ## Views: membership and current frame (WC4 C2) -/

/-- Unfolding of `stk` (WC4 C2). -/
theorem SC.stk_of {s : SC} {c : Nat} {x : Ctx} (h : s.C[c]? = some x) (hl : x.life = .live) :
    s.stk c = x.stack := by simp [SC.stk, h, hl]
