import Ern.Concurrency.Context

/-!
# Concurrent authority machine: inherited operations and frame transitions

* the kernel operations O1–O16 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` (§60–§75)
  executed by a live context `c` (WC4 C2): every operation reads the view of `c` (current frame =
  top of its stack, liveness = globally live frames); the clauses that read `ancestor` (§63.6,
  §63.7, §64.3, §65.4, §65.5, §72.4, §73.5) read `ancestorC` instead; O6 pushes the new frame on
  the stack of `c`; O7 is `exitFrameC` (WC4 C6: O7 and the reparenting of the context-initial
  frames whose parent is the exiting frame);
* `spawn` (WC4 C4, modeled on Spec 1 §72), `terminate` (WC4 C7, Spec 1 §73 on the initial frame
  of a non-initial context), `join` (WC4 C8);
* `CStep`, the union of their `ok` transitions.

Waiting (`join` on a live context) has no outcome: the transition is not enabled (WC4 C8).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Outcomes (Spec 1 §58) -/

/-- Image of an outcome (Spec 1 §58). -/
def omap {σ τ : Type} (f : σ → τ) : Outcome3 σ → Outcome3 τ
  | .ok s => .ok (f s)
  | .reject => .reject
  | .fail => .fail

/-! ## Operations that do not read `ancestor` (Spec 1 §60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2) -/

/-- An operation of Spec 1 that reads neither `ancestor` nor the stack beyond its top and its
membership, run by context `c` on its view and written back (WC4 C2). The context must be live;
otherwise the operation has no outcome. -/
def ViewStep (R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (c : Nat) (s : SC) (o : Outcome3 SC) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, R (s.view c) o₃ ∧ o = omap s.set o₃

/-! ## O4 `transfer` re-indexed (Spec 1 §63) -/

/-- Effect of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def transferEffC (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : SC := s.set (transferEff (s.view c) src dst)

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63 re-indexed, WC4 C2): the clauses of
`TransferPre` on the view of `c`, with §63.6 and §63.7 read on `ancestorC`. -/
structure TransferPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : (s.view c).Usable src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : (s.view c).Usable dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify src
  /-- Spec 1 §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init
  /-- Spec 1 §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source,
  except some authority grounding the `Modify` right over the source and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
      RightChain (s.view c) g j
  /-- Spec 1 §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §63.6 re-indexed: `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst)
  /-- Spec 1 §63.7 re-indexed: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` (on
  `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
        y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
            ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- Spec 1 §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst
  /-- Spec 1 §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreC k s c src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable src ∧ (s.view c).Usable dst ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify src ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify dst ∧
    SameShape (s.view c).P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, (s.view c).I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P dst, (s.view c).I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap (s.view c).P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, Grounds (s.view c) .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (s.view c) src j →
        RightChain (s.view c) g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ (s.view c).pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps (s.view c) src, (s.view c).Active x) ∧
    AnchorOrderC (transferEffC s c src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length, AnchorMoves (s.view c) src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
          y.holder = .place q →
            EffAnchorOKC (transferEffC s c src dst) x
              ((transferEff (s.view c) src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock (s.view c) src dst ∧ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-! ## O5 `depend` re-indexed (Spec 1 §64) -/

/-- Effect of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def dependEffC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : SC := s.set (dependEff (s.view c) q x)

/-- Preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure DependPreC (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify q
  /-- Spec 1 §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
  anchorActive : (s.view c).Active x
  /-- Spec 1 §64.3 re-indexed: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an
  `ancestorC` of it. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §64). -/
instance (s : SC) (c q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPreC s c q x) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.view c).Usable q ∧ HasRight (s.view c) .modify q ∧ (s.view c).Active x ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s x ((s.view c).pframe q))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-! ## O8 `store` re-indexed (Spec 1 §65) -/

/-- Effect of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 effect, WC4 C2). -/
def storeEffC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : SC := s.set (storeEff (s.view c) a p)

/-- Preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure StorePreC (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : (s.view c).Usable p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf (s.view c).P p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight (s.view c) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
    OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- Spec 1 §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
      l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q
  /-- Spec 1 §65.4 re-indexed: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` (on `ancestorC`)
  relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p)
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p
  /-- Spec 1 §65.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §65). -/
instance (s : SC) (c a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePreC s c a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top) False ∧ (s.view c).Usable p ∧ isLeaf (s.view c).P p ∧
    HasRight (s.view c) .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range (s.view c).A.length,
      OptP ((s.view c).A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range (s.view c).P.length, OwnedIn (s.view c).P p q →
        l ∉ footprint (s.view c).P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOKC s a ((s.view c).pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff (s.view c) a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC s c a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` re-indexed (Spec 1 §72) -/

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 effect, WC4 C2): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`; the new frame `nF` is pushed on the stack of `c`. -/
def enterEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : SC :=
  { s.set (enterEff (s.view c) ps ls) with
    C := s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := s.nF :: x.stack } }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72 re-indexed, WC4 C2). -/
structure EnterPreC (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed: the calling frame, the current frame of `c`, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.stk c ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
    y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- Spec 1 §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape. -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- Spec 1 §72.3 re-indexed: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state, for the
  executing context. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p
  /-- Spec 1 §72.4 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §72). -/
instance (s : SC) (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    Decidable (EnterPreC s c ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.stk c ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP ((s.view c).A[a]?) (fun y =>
      y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame (s.view c).top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
    ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden ((enterEffC s c ps ls).view c) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (enterEffC s c ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## O7 re-indexed: `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73; WC4 C6) -/

/-- Reparenting (WC4 C6 effect): every live context whose initial frame has parent `f` gets the
parent `p`. -/
def reparent (C : List Ctx) (f p : Nat) : List Ctx :=
  C.map fun x => if x.life = .live ∧ x.parent = some f then { x with parent := some p } else x

/-- Effect of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 effect; WC4 C6 effect): the effect of Spec 1 on
the view of `c`, whose surviving frames are the other live frames; the top `f` of the stack of `c`
is popped, its caller `p` becomes current again, and the context-initial frames whose parent is
`f` are reparented to `p`; the other ancestry links are unchanged (WC4 C6 effect). -/
def exitEffC (s : SC) (c : Nat) : SC :=
  { s.set (exitEff (s.view c)) with
    C := reparent (s.C.modify c fun x => { x with stack := x.stack.tail })
      ((s.stk c).headD 0) ((s.stk c).tail.headD 0) }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrameC` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §73 re-indexed; WC4 C6, C6.1: O7.1
transposed, O7.2–O7.5 on the global state). The surviving frames are the other globally live
frames. -/
structure ExitPreC (k : K) (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- Spec 1 §73.1 re-indexed (WC4 C6, first paragraph): the current frame of `c` is not the
  initial frame of its context and has a surviving caller in its stack. -/
  hasCaller : (s.stk c).tail ≠ []
  /-- Spec 1 §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
    (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- Spec 1 §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- Spec 1 §73.5 re-indexed: `AnchorOrderHeld` (on `ancestorC`) in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrameC` (Spec 1 §73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : SC) (c : Nat) : Decidable (ExitPreC k s c) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((s.stk c).tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail (x :: (s.view c).ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail a →
      (s.view c).org a ≠ none → firstSurv (s.view c) (s.view c).F.tail ((s.view c).ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (s.view c).Usable q →
      ¬ ({ s.view c with F := (s.view c).F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, (s.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (exitEffC s c))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-! ## The inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a context (WC4 C2) -/

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation O1–O16 executed by context `c` (Spec 1 §60–§75
re-indexed, WC4 C2). Operations reading `ancestor` or changing the stack have their re-indexed
preconditions and effects; the others run on the view of `c`. A context that is not live executes
nothing. -/
def opStepC (k : K) : KernelOp → Nat → SC → Outcome3 SC → Prop
  | .transfer src dst, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (TransferPreC k s c src dst) (transferEffC s c src dst) o
  | .depend q x, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (DependPreC s c q x) (dependEffC s c q x) o
  | .store a p, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (StorePreC s c a p) (storeEffC s c a p) o
  | .enter ps ls, c, s, o =>
    s.Live c ∧ Guarded (EnterPreC s c ps ls) (enterEffC s c ps ls) o
  | .exit, c, s, o => s.Live c ∧ Guarded (ExitPreC k s c) (exitEffC s c) o
  | op, c, s, o => ViewStep (op.Step k) c s o

/-- WC4 C2 (candidate P1): the `K.Satisfiable` obligation of `alloc` (Spec 1 §71) executed by `c`
is evaluated on the view of `c`: an `ok` outcome entails it. -/
theorem alloc_ok_satisfiable {k : K} {c pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : SC}

import Ern.Concurrency.Preservation
import Ern.Concurrency.Reparent
import Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit

/-!
# Theorems 2 and 4 on labelled steps and traces (WC4 C20–C23)

Assembly of `Ern.Concurrency.Preservation`, `Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve`,
`Ern.Concurrency.Reparent` and `Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit`:

* theorem 2 for every labelled step of the kernel with the synchronization library, the by-value
  composite included (`lstep_kInvCA`);
* theorems 2 and 4 together along an `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23): `KInvCA` and
  `SyncState` (`trace_inv`, `trace_preserves`, `encapsulated_inv`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Theorem 2 (WC4 C20, C23) on every labelled step (inherited operations O1–O16 executed by a
context, `spawn`, the by-value composite, `terminate`, `join`, `deriveSync` under the library
instantiation, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock`): the re-indexed kernel invariant with
the auxiliaries of Spec 1 (`KInvCA`) is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80, for `split`). -/
theorem lstep_kInvCA {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hk : KInvCA st.1) : KInvCA st'.1 := by
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case exit => exact exitFrameC_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
    all_goals exact opStepC_preservesC hdd hk (fun e => by cases e) h
  | spawn h => exact spawn_preservesC hk h
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_preservesC hk h
  | terminate h => exact terminate_preserves hk.1 hk.2.1 hk.2.2 h
  | join h => exact join_preservesC hk h
  | deriveSync h => exact deriveSync_preservesC hk h
  | newMutex h => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk
  | acquire h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, -, -, hpre, rfl⟩ := h
    exact deriveSync_preservesC (r := _) hk ⟨hc, .ok hpre⟩
  | unlock h =>
    obtain ⟨hc, e, g, -, -, -, hrel, -, rfl⟩ := h
    exact opStepC_preservesC (op := .release g) hdd hk (fun e => by cases e)
      ⟨hc, _, .ok hrel, rfl⟩
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC4 C20–C23) along an `EncapsulatedTrace`: from a state satisfying
`KInvCA` and `SyncState`, every reached state satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd hst hk
    exact ih hk' (lstep_preserves hst he hk hk'.1.1.2 hs)

/-- Theorem 4 (WC4 C21–C23), trace form: along an `EncapsulatedTrace` from a state satisfying
`KInvCA`, `SyncState` is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2 :=
  (trace_inv hdd h hk hs).2

/-- The initial state of Spec 1 §47 as a single-context state, with an empty registry (WC4 C3,
C12), satisfies `KInvCA` and `SyncState`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (L : MutexLayout) :
    KInvCA (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) ∧ SyncState L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro i j e e' ctl h; simp at h
  · intro i j e e' h; simp at h
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC4 C20–C23) from the initial state: every state reached from the initial
state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registry) by an `EncapsulatedTrace` satisfies the
re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80)
and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2⟩

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.DeriveSplitRelease

/-!
# Refinement of the derived arena operations into the memory machine (spec v0.1, §82.7)

Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, §82.7 with Part XIV (§76–§78), the §82
preamble, §82.2–§82.5 and §86.

* Library operations (`LOp`) and their `ok` steps (`LOpStep`): the kernel operations O1–O16 and
  the derived arena operations O17–O19 of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena`.
* The kernel steps realizing a library step (`kexp`, `kexp_path`, Part XIV): none for `newArena`,
  `split` then `store` for `issue`, `derive` then `release` for `reset`. The raw operations of a
  library step (`lopsOf`) are the raw operations of these kernel steps (`ktrace`).
* Per derived operation: realization, reads, writes and lifetimes (`arena_newArena`,
  `arena_issue`, `arena_reset`, `reset_split`, `issue_pointer_sound`); the bytes of an issued
  region are unchanged by the realization of `issue` (`issue_keeps_bytes`, §86). Theorems with
  invariant hypotheses on their pre-state have a `_reachable` corollary without them (§57).
* Library runs translated into the memory machine with parameters fixed once per run
  (`LSimRun`), with no invariant hypothesis: every such run is a kernel simulation run
  (`LSimRun.simRun`); `lsimulation`.
* §82.7: the machine trace of a library run is the trace of its kernel steps, and no kernel step
  after a legal `reset` uses an authority that the `reset` invalidated (`arena_realized`).

The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
-/

/-- An operation of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel operation O1–O16 of non-administrative

  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  /-- O19 `reset(arena)` of entry `i` (§78). -/
  | reset (i : Nat)

import Ern.Concurrency.Repr
import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable
import Ern.Concurrency.TransferPreserve
import Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-!
# Realization of the labelled concurrent steps in the memory machine (WC4 C2, C24, C25; Spec 1 §82)

Contexts interleave at the grain of abstract steps: the realization of one labelled step of a
context is a sequence of raw steps of the memory machine of Spec 1 Parts II–III, run without
interference from the other contexts. Every statement below is about this fragment only.
Concurrent byte accesses, physical atomicity, memory orders and `happens-before` (WC4
OB-C01–OB-C06) are outside it, and so is the realization of the controller word (WC4 OB-C05). No
unsafe region is modelled.

* `realize`: the raw operations of each label of `LStep`. An inherited operation O1–O16 executed by
  `c` is realized as in `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (`opsOf`) on the view of `c` (WC4 C2), the
  representations written by `write` and `writeShared` being data of the program; `spawn` by the
  creations of the locals of O6 (Spec 1 §72, §82.4); `terminate` as O7 (Spec 1 §73, §82.5);
  reparenting has no memory effect; the by-value composite (WC4 C5) by its phases in order: the
  creations, then the realizations of O4 (Spec 1 §63) by transfer in the declared order, the yield
  having none; `join`, `deriveSync`, `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` by none.
* `StepOblC`: the obligations of one step, those of `Refinement.StepObl` (Spec 1 §20.3, §15, §16,
  §82.1, §82.4) on the view of the executing context, explicit and never replaced by `True`.
* R1 (`r1_lstep`): for every labelled step, the realization is an execution of `ok` raw steps that
  keeps `ReprC`.
* R5 (`r5_realize`): on a single-context state, the realization of an inherited operation is the
  realization of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` on the projection (WC4 C24).
* R2 (`simulationC`) and R3 (`concrete_safety`): every run of encapsulated labelled steps from the
  initial state of Spec 1 §47, with parameters fixed once per run, is realized by an execution of
  `ok` raw steps from the empty memory state, related by `ReprC`, none of whose raw steps is `ub`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
open PreservationAux TransferPreserveAux ReparentAux

/-! ## Realizations transferred from `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` -/

namespace RealizeAux

variable {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
  {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty}

/-- Realization of the effect of O4 (Spec 1 §63 effect, §82.2, §82.3), from the clauses §63.1
(usability of source and destination), §63.2 and §63.3 (source leaves `Init`) only: the proof of
`Refinement.r6_transfer`, which reads no other clause. -/

/-! ## Transport of `ReprC` to the written-back state (WC4 C2) -/

/-- `ReprC` of a state whose kernel components are those of `t` with the globally live frames,
when `t` lists the same frames (WC4 C2; `repr_frames_congr`). -/
theorem reprC_of_flat {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s' : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hflat : s'.flat = { t with F := s'.frames }) (hF : ∀ f, f ∈ t.F ↔ f ∈ s'.frames)
    (h : Refinement.Repr L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok s' m := by
  unfold ReprC; rw [hflat]
  exact (repr_frames_congr fun f => (hF f).symm).2 h

/-- `ReprC` after a step that changes no place, initialization state or death marker, and no
context (WC4 C2; Spec 1 §82.1, §82.3, §82.5). -/
theorem reprC_set_same {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3} {m : Machine.State}
    (hP : t.P = s.P) (hI : t.I = s.I) (hd : t.dead = s.dead) (h : ReprC L rtok s m) :
    ReprC L rtok (s.set t) m :=
  repr_congr (t := s.flat) (t' := (s.set t).flat) h hP hI hd fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- `ReprC` is kept by the yield of WC4 C5.3, which changes holders only. -/
theorem reprC_yield {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f : Nat}
    {m : Machine.State} (h : ReprC L rtok t m) : ReprC L rtok (yieldEff t ps f) m :=
  repr_congr (t := t.flat) (t' := (yieldEff t ps f).flat) h rfl rfl rfl fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-! ## Realization of the labels (WC4 C2, C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82.2–§82.5) -/

/-- The kernel operation of `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` (Spec 1 §60–§75) for an operation
O1–O16, with the representations `w` written by `write` and `writeShared` (Spec 1 §10 ¶4, §16 ¶2),
data of the program that the kernel does not read. -/
def kopOf : KernelOp → (Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → KOp
  | .derive src region m, _ => .derive src region m
  | .split src rs, _ => .split src rs
  | .release a, _ => .release a
  | .transfer src dst, _ => .transfer src dst
  | .depend q x, _ => .depend q x
  | .enter ps ls, _ => .enter ps ls
  | .exit, _ => .exit
  | .read a ls, _ => .read a ls
  | .write a ls, w => .write a ls w
  | .writeShared a ls, w => .writeShared a ls w
  | .pin p, _ => .pin p
  | .unpin o, _ => .unpin o
  | .endUse p, _ => .endUse p
  | .free p auth, _ => .free p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls, _ => .alloc pr ow ls
  | .store a p, _ => .store a p

/-- The `ok` step of `kopOf op w` is the `ok` outcome of `op` (Spec 1 §58, §60–§75). -/
theorem opStep_kopOf {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {t t' : S3} :
    OpStep k (kopOf op w) t t' ↔ op.Step k t (.ok t') := by
  cases op <;> exact Iff.rfl

/-- The raw operations of the transfer phases of the by-value composite (WC4 C5.2): for each
by-value argument in its declared order, the realization of O4 (Spec 1 §63, §82.2, §82.3,
`transferOps`) executed by `c` on the state produced by the earlier transfers, in the memory state
produced by the earlier copies. -/
def valOps {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (c : Nat) :
    SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | _, [], _ => []
  | t, v :: vs, m => transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2 ++
      valOps π c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs (run m (transferOps π.L π.ty m (t.view c) v.1 v.2))

/-- The raw operations realizing a labelled step from `s`, the memory state being `m` (WC4 C2,
C4–C8, C13–C18; Spec 1 §82 preamble, §82.2–§82.5), at the grain of abstract steps:
- an inherited operation O1–O16 executed by `c`: the realization `opsOf` of
  `Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` on the view of `c` (WC4 C2), with the written representations `w`;
- `spawn` (WC4 C4): the creations of the root locals of O6 (Spec 1 §72, §82.4); the yield of the
  parameters has no memory effect;
- the by-value composite (WC4 C5): its phases in order, the creations of the root locals (C5.1),
  then the realizations of O4 by transfer in the declared order (C5.2), the yield (C5.3) having
  none;
- `terminate` (WC4 C7): the realization of O7 on the view of `c` (Spec 1 §73, §82.5);
  reparenting (WC4 C6) has no memory effect;
- `join` (WC4 C8) and `deriveSync` (WC4 C15, O1 has no storage effect, Spec 1 §60): none;
- `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock`, `resetLock` (WC4 C13, C16–C18): none, the registry only; the
  physical controller and its correspondence with the registry are the realization obligation
  WC4 OB-C05, not modelled. -/
def realize {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) :
    Label → SC → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .kernel c op, s, m => opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m
  | .spawn c _ ls, s, m => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs, s, m =>
    allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape) ++
      valOps π c (spawnCreate s c ls) vs
        (run m (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok (s.view c).P.length m (rootIdx ls.toShape)))
  | .terminate c, s, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok (s.view c)
  | .join .., _, _ => []
  | .deriveSync .., _, _ => []
  | .newMutex .., _, _ => []
  | .acquire .., _, _ => []
  | .unlock .., _, _ => []
  | .resetLock .., _, _ => []

/-- WC4 OB-C05: `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` and `resetLock` have no raw operation in this
realization; their physical controller update is not modelled. -/
theorem realize_sync {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    (s : SC) (m : Machine.State) (c g i : Nat) (adm : List Nat) :
    realize π w (.newMutex c g adm) s m = [] ∧ realize π w (.acquire c i) s m = [] ∧
      realize π w (.unlock c i) s m = [] ∧ realize π w (.resetLock c i) s m = [] :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The obligations of one labelled step (Spec 1 §20.3, §82; WC4 C2): for an inherited operation
executed by `c`, those of `Refinement.StepObl` on the view of `c` (the parametric obligations of
its reads and writes, §15, §16; the layout of new places, §82.1, §23; the instantiation of
`K.FreeCompat`, §80, §70.2, §82.4); for `spawn` and the by-value composite, the parametric
obligations of its raw operations and the layout of the new locals (§82.1, §23); for the other
labels, the parametric obligations of their raw operations. -/
def StepOblC {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
    (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Label → SC → Machine.State → Prop
  | .kernel c op, s, m => StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m
  | .spawn c ps ls, s, m => OblAlong ObR ObW m (realize π w (.spawn c ps ls) s m) ∧
      NewLayout π.L (enterP (s.view c) ls) (s.view c).P.length m.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .spawnVal c ps ls vs, s, m => OblAlong ObR ObW m (realize π w (.spawnVal c ps ls vs) s m) ∧
      NewLayout π.L (enterP (s.view c) ls) (s.view c).P.length m.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | lbl, s, m => OblAlong ObR ObW m (realize π w lbl s m)

/-! ## R1, step by step -/

section R1

variable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
  {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Refinement.Params Ty}
  {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}

/-- An `ok` outcome of an operation run on the view of `c` is the written-back `ok` outcome on the
view (WC4 C2). -/
theorem viewStep_ok {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : ViewStep R c s (.ok s')) : ∃ t', R (s.view c) (.ok t') ∧ s' = s.set t' := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  cases o₃ with
  | ok t' => injection ho with e; exact ⟨t', hR, e⟩
  | reject => cases ho
  | fail => cases ho

/-- R1 for the inherited operations that run on the view of `c` and keep the stack (Spec 1
§60–§62, §66–§71, §74, §75; WC4 C2): `Refinement.r6` on the view, transported to `S_C`. -/
theorem r1_viewStep {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC} {m : Machine.State}
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok s m) (hk : KInvCA s)
    (h : ViewStep (op.Step k) c s (.ok s'))
    (hF : ∀ t', op.Step k (s.view c) (.ok t') → t'.F = (s.view c).F)
    (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) m
        (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok s' (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) := by
  obtain ⟨t', hst, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h
  obtain ⟨hw, -, hnd, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c

/-- R1 for the inherited operations O1–O16 executed by `c` (WC4 C2, C6; Spec 1 §60–§75, §82):
the realization on the view of `c` is an execution of `ok` raw steps and `ReprC` holds after the

re-indexed on `ancestorC`, the realization is proved from the clauses it reads
(`realize_transfer`, `realize_store`, `realize_enter`, `realize_exit`). -/
theorem r1_kernel {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC} {m : Machine.State}
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok s m) (hk : KInvCA s)
    (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m) m
        (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok s' (run m (opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view c) m)) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
  have hRv := (reprC_view c).1 hR
  have hfr := hk.1.1.1

      hpre.dstUsable hpre.sameShape hpre.srcInit hob.1

      fun _ => SC.mem_view_F).2 hR'⟩

      hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)
  have hlive : ∀ r ∈ exitRoots t, AllocP m (L r).alloc
      fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r) := fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨hrt, ho, hd⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hr

/-- `s'` keeps the authorities of `s` (§42, §58): each keeps its mode and footprint, becomes
active only if it was, stays held by a place if it was, and keeps an origin `o` below it that is
active in `s'`. -/
def AKeep (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ j y, s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧
    y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
    (y'.holder.isPlace = false → y.holder.isPlace = false) ∧
    ∀ o, y.origin = some o → o < j → s'.Active o → y'.origin = some o

/-- Authorities are never reactivated (§42, §58). -/
theorem AKeep.active_back {s s' : S3} (h : AKeep s s') {x : Nat} (hx : s'.Active x)
    (hlt : x < s.A.length) : s.Active x := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hlt, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y', hy', -, -, ha, -⟩ := h x y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hx
  rw [hy'] at hz; cases hz; exact ⟨y, hy, ha za⟩

/-- Authorities are never removed (§42). -/
theorem AKeep.lt {s s' : S3} (h : AKeep s s') {x : Nat} (hlt : x < s.A.length) :
    x < s'.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy', -⟩ := h x _ (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hlt, rfl⟩)
  exact lt_of_getElem? hy'

/-- `AKeep` composes (§42). -/
theorem AKeep.trans {s s' s'' : S3} (h : AKeep s s') (h' : AKeep s' s'') : AKeep s s'' := by
  intro j y hy
  obtain ⟨y', hy', m, f, a, p, o⟩ := h j y hy
  obtain ⟨y'', hy'', m', f', a', p', o'⟩ := h' j y' hy'
  refine ⟨y'', hy'', m'.trans m, f'.trans f, fun h => a (a' h), fun h => p (p' h),
    fun x hx hxj hxa => o' x (o x hx hxj ?_) hxj hxa⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hxa
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, s'.A[x]? = some w := by
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ y₀, s.A[x]? = some y₀ :=
      ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨Nat.lt_trans hxj (lt_of_getElem? hy), rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw, -⟩ := h x y₀ hy₀; exact ⟨w, hw⟩
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -, -, ha, -⟩ := h' x w hw
  rw [hz] at hz'; cases hz'; exact ⟨w, hw, ha za⟩

/-- Unchanged authorities (§42). -/
theorem akeep_of_eq {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) : AKeep s s' := by
  intro j y hy
  refine ⟨y, by rw [hA]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, id, id, fun o ho _ _ => ho⟩

/-- Appended authorities (§60, §61, §71, §77, §78). -/
theorem akeep_append {s s' : S3} {l : List Authority} (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ l) : AKeep s s' := by
  intro j y hy
  refine ⟨y, by rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, id,
    id, fun o ho _ _ => ho⟩

/-- Authorities mapped by a function keeping mode, footprint, origin and place holders, and
activating nothing (§62, §63, §69, §70). -/
theorem akeep_map {s s' : S3} {f : Authority → Authority} (hA : s'.A = s.A.map f)
    (hf : ∀ y, (f y).mode = y.mode ∧ (f y).footprint = y.footprint ∧
      ((f y).active = true → y.active = true) ∧
      ((f y).holder.isPlace = false → y.holder.isPlace = false) ∧ (f y).origin = y.origin) :
    AKeep s s' := by
  intro j y hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hf y
  exact ⟨f y, by rw [hA, List.getElem?_map, hy]; rfl, h1, h2, h3, h4, fun o ho _ _ => h5 ▸ ho⟩

/-- One authority replaced by a record with the same mode, footprint and origin, active only if
it was, held by a place if it was (§62, §65). -/
theorem akeep_set {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {x x' : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (hA : s'.A = s.A.set a x') (hm : x'.mode = x.mode) (hf : x'.footprint = x.footprint)
    (ha : x'.active = true → x.active = true)
    (hp : x'.holder.isPlace = false → x.holder.isPlace = false) (ho : x'.origin = x.origin) :
    AKeep s s' := by
  intro j y hy
  by_cases hj : a = j
  · subst hj; rw [hx] at hy; cases hy
    exact ⟨x', by rw [hA, List.getElem?_set_self (lt_of_getElem? hx)], hm, hf, ha, hp,
      fun o h _ _ => ho ▸ h⟩
  · exact ⟨y, by rw [hA, List.getElem?_set_ne hj]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, id, id,
      fun o h _ _ => h⟩

/-- `EntryInv` carries over to a state keeping the authorities (`AKeep`), the footprint and the
usability of the storage, when the entry is still live (§55). -/
theorem entryInv_transport {s s' : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} (h : EntryInv s E) (hA : AKeep s s')
    (hfp : ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P E.storage ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage)
    (hus : s'.Usable E.storage) (hlive : s'.Active E.internal) : EntryInv s' E := by
  obtain ⟨hai, hsh⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨yi, hyi, -⟩ := hai.active
  obtain ⟨yi', hyi', mi, fi, -, pi, -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  have hafp : ∀ l, l ∈ s'.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ s.afp E.internal := by
    intro l; simp [S3.afp, hyi, hyi', fi]
  have old : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.2 < s.A.length := fun e he => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hsh e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  have act : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s'.Active e.2 → s.Active e.2 :=
    fun e he ha => hA.active_back ha (old e he)
  have hsh' : IssuedShape s' E := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hlt, hf, hm⟩ := hsh e he
    obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -, -, o'⟩ := hA e.2 y hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', o' _ ho hlt hlive, hlt, f'.trans hf, m'.trans hm⟩
  refine ⟨⟨hus, fun l => (hafp l).trans ((hai.fpEq l).trans (hfp l).symm), hlive, ?_,
    fun l hl => (hfp l).2 (hai.availableIn l hl),
    fun e he l hl => (hfp l).2 (hai.issuedIn e he l hl),
    fun e he e' he' hne ha ha' => hai.disjoint e he e' he' hne (act e he ha) (act e' he' ha'),
    fun e he ha => hai.notAvailable e he (act e he ha), fun e he ha => ?_⟩, hsh'⟩
  · have hs := hai.shape; rw [hyi] at hs; rw [hyi']
    refine ⟨mi.trans hs.1, ?_⟩
    cases e : yi'.holder.isPlace
    · exact absurd (pi e) (by rw [hs.2]; decide)
    · rfl
  · obtain ⟨y', hy', ho', hlt, -⟩ := hsh' e he
    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy', ho']) hlt]
    exact List.mem_cons_self ..

/-! ## Kernel steps keep the authorities and the footprints (§42, §58, §60–§75) -/

/-- `exitFrame` keeps the authorities (§73, `ok` effect): a surviving authority keeps an origin
that survives, the first surviving element of its chain. -/
theorem exit_akeep (s : S3) : AKeep s (exitEff s) := by
  intro j y hy
  have hA : ∀ x, (exitEff s).A[x]? = (s.A[x]?).map (exitG s s.F.tail x) := fun x => by
    simp only [exitEff, getElem?_mapI, Nat.zero_add]
  refine ⟨_, by rw [hA, hy]; rfl, ?_⟩
  unfold exitG
  by_cases hsv : Survives s s.F.tail j
  · have ya : y.active = true := by
      have h := hsv; unfold Survives at h; rw [hy] at h; exact h.1
    rw [ite_eq_left_of_eq_true _ _ (eq_true hsv)]
    split
    · exact ⟨rfl, rfl, fun _ => ya, id, fun o h _ _ => h⟩
    · rename_i o' ho'
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun _ => ya, id, fun o h hoj hoa => ?_⟩
      rw [ho'] at h; cases h
      obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hoa
      rw [hA] at hz
/-! ## `ArenaInv` preserved (§55) -/

/-- A step that only appends authorities and keeps places, stack and death markers keeps
`EntryInv` of every entry still live (§55). -/
theorem entryInv_append {s s' : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} {l : List Authority} (h : EntryInv s E)
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ l) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hlive : s'.Active E.internal) : EntryInv s' E :=
  entryInv_transport h (akeep_append hA) (fun _ => by rw [hP])
    ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 h.1.storageUsable) hlive

/-- A live entry registered by `newArena` satisfies `EntryInv`: `ArenaInv` by §76.6 (§55), and
`IssuedShape` since nothing is issued. -/
theorem newEntry_inv {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase s st i) :
    EntryInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ :=
  ⟨h.arenaInv, fun _ he => by cases he⟩

/-- On states satisfying the kernel invariant (§57), §76.1–§76.3 imply every conjunct of §76.6
(v0.1 §76.6, read on the resulting state, whose kernel component is `s`, `newArena_kernel`):
`WF3`, `I1`, `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are parts of `KInv`, and the new entry satisfies
`ArenaInv` (§55) by §76.1 (`storage` usable), §76.2 (`internal` active, of own mode `Modify`) and
§76.3 (`internal` held by a place, of the footprint of `storage`). The §76.6 fields of
`NewArenaBase` are thus redundant on such states. On reachable states:
`newArena_clause6_reachable`. -/
theorem newArena_clause6_of_kinv {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (hu : s.Usable st)
    (hia : OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False)
    (hpl : OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False)
    (hsub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp i, l ∈ footprint s.P st)
    (hsup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P st, l ∈ s.afp i) :
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
      ArenaInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ := by
  refine ⟨hk.1, hk.2.1.1.1, hk.2.1.2.1, hk.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  cases hy : s.A[i]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hia hpl
    refine ⟨hu, fun l => ⟨hsub l, hsup l⟩, ⟨y, hy, hia.1⟩, ?_, fun l hl => hl,
      fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he),
      fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩
    show OptP (s.A[i]?) _ False
    rw [hy]; exact ⟨hia.2, hpl⟩

/-- `newArena_clause6_of_kinv` on reachable states (§76.6, §57): under `DDSound` (§80) and
`StaticsOK` (§47), on every kernel-reachable state (the kernel state of a library-reachable state
is one, `LReachNG.reachable`), §76.1–§76.3 imply every conjunct of §76.6. -/
theorem newArena_clause6_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {s : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s) {st i : Nat}
    (hu : s.Usable st)
    (hia : OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False)
    (hpl : OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False)
    (hsub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp i, l ∈ footprint s.P st)
    (hsup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P st, l ∈ s.afp i) :
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
      ArenaInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ :=
  newArena_clause6_of_kinv (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr) hu hia hpl hsub hsup

/-- `newArena` without the guard preserves the library invariant (§55, §76). -/
theorem lInv_newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase L.kern st i) (hi : LInv L) :
    LInv (newArenaEff L st i) := by
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hF with hF | hF
  · exact hi F hF
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hF]
    have hia := h.internalAuth
    cases hy : L.kern.A[i]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
    | some y => exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hy, fun _ => newEntry_inv h⟩

/-- `issue` preserves the library invariant, for the issuing entry and every other entry (§55,
§77). -/
theorem lInv_issue {k : K} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hst hav hsp hsto =>
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
  rw [← issueKEff_eq]
  have hEm : E ∈ L.arenas := List.mem_of_getElem? hE
  have hright : IssueRight L.kern E region := fun l hl => by
    rw [hp.modifyOn region (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl]; exact allows_some_modify _
  have hil := (hi E hEm).1
  have hAe : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A =
      L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩] := rfl
  have hold : ∀ F ∈ L.arenas, F.internal < (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A.length ∧
      (Live (issueKEff L.kern E region dst) F → EntryInv (issueKEff L.kern E region dst) F) := by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi F hF
    refine ⟨by rw [hAe, List.length_append]; omega, fun hl => ?_⟩
    exact entryInv_append (hinv ((akeep_append hAe).active_back hl hlt)) hAe rfl rfl rfl hl
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
  · exact hold F hF
  · obtain ⟨hlt, hinv'⟩ := hold E hEm
    refine ⟨hlt, fun hl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hai, hsh⟩ := hinv' hl
    obtain ⟨hai0, hsh0⟩ := (hi E hEm).2 hst.live
    have hnew : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A[L.kern.A.length]? =
        some ⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ := by simp [hAe]
    have hold' : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.2 < L.kern.A.length := fun e he => by
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hsh0 e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
    have hact : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).Active e.2 → L.kern.Active e.2 :=
      fun e he ha => (akeep_append hAe).active_back ha (hold' e he)
    -- an active issued block and the new region are disjoint (§43, case 3; §77.5)
    have hdis : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, L.kern.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
      intro e he ha l hl hle
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, hf, hm⟩ := hsh0 e he
      obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha
      rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
      exact effective_ne_modify_of_desc hy ya (hf ▸ hle) (hai0.derived e he ⟨y, hy, ya⟩) hm
        (allows_modify_iff.1 (hright l hl))
    refine ⟨⟨hai.storageUsable, hai.fpEq, hai.active, hai.shape,
      fun l hl => hai.availableIn l (List.mem_filter.1 hl).1, fun e he l hl => ?_,
      fun e he e' he' hne ha ha' l hl hl' => ?_, fun e he ha l hl hla => ?_,
      fun e he ha => ?_⟩, fun e he => ?_⟩
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · exact hst.regionIn l hl
      · exact hai.issuedIn e he l hl
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 he' with rfl | he'
      · exact hne rfl
      · exact hdis e' he' (hact e' he' ha') l hl hl'
      · exact hdis e he (hact e he ha) l hl' hl
      · exact hai.disjoint e he e' he' hne ha ha' l hl hl'
    · have hla' := List.mem_filter.1 hla
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · simp at hla'; exact hla'.2 hl
      · exact hai.notAvailable e he ha l hl hla'.1
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · show E.internal ∈ (L.kern.addAuth ⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩).ancs
          L.kern.A.length
        rw [ancs_addAuth_self rfl hil]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact hai.derived e he ha
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · exact ⟨_, hnew, rfl, hil, rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact hsh e he

/-- `reset` preserves the library invariant, for the reset entry and every other entry (§55,
§78). -/
theorem lInv_reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) :
    LInv L' := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hd hrl _ =>
  obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
  rw [← resetKEff_eq]
  have hEm : E ∈ L.arenas := List.mem_of_getElem? hE
  have hAe : (resetKEff L.kern E).A = L.kern.A ++
      [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint L.kern.P E.storage, .frame L.kern.top, false⟩] := rfl
  have hold : ∀ F ∈ L.arenas, F.internal < (resetKEff L.kern E).A.length ∧
      (Live (resetKEff L.kern E) F → EntryInv (resetKEff L.kern E) F) := by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi F hF
    refine ⟨by rw [hAe, List.length_append]; omega, fun hl => ?_⟩
    exact entryInv_append (hinv ((akeep_append hAe).active_back hl hlt)) hAe rfl rfl rfl hl
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
  · exact hold F hF
  · obtain ⟨hlt, hinv'⟩ := hold E hEm
    refine ⟨hlt, fun hl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hai, -⟩ := hinv' hl
    exact ⟨⟨hai.storageUsable, hai.fpEq, hai.active, hai.shape, fun l hl => hl,
      fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he),
      fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩, fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩

/-- A kernel step of non-administrative code preserves the library invariant (§55), when the
state before satisfies `WF3` and the state after `NoDangling` (§57): the storage of a live arena
stays usable since `internal` covers it. -/
theorem lInv_kernel {k : K} {L : LState} {s' : S3} (hk : KStep k L.kern s') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling s') (hi : LInv L) : LInv ⟨s', L.arenas⟩ := by
  have hA := kstep_akeep hk
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi E hE
  refine ⟨hA.lt hlt, fun hlive => ?_⟩
  have hEI := hinv (hA.active_back hlive hlt)
  have hfp := kstep_fp hk hEI.1.storageUsable.lt
  refine entryInv_transport hEI hA hfp ?_ hlive
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (L.kern.P.length - E.storage + 1) E.storage (by omega)
    hEI.1.storageUsable.lt
  obtain ⟨yi, hyi, -⟩ := hEI.1.active
  obtain ⟨y', hy', -, hf', -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  obtain ⟨y'', hy'', ya''⟩ := hlive
  rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''
  have hli : l ∈ yi.footprint := by
    have := (hEI.1.fpEq l).2 hl; simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using this
  exact usable_of_covered hnd hy' ya'' (hf' ▸ hli) ((hfp l).2 hl)

/-- Every library step, with or without the guard of §56, preserves the library invariant (§55),
when the kernel state before satisfies `WF3` and the one after `NoDangling` (§57). -/
theorem lInv_stepNG {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStepNG k L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L'.kern) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact lInv_kernel hk hw hnd hi
  | newArena hb => exact lInv_newArena hb hi
  | issue hs => exact lInv_issue hs hi
  | reset hs => exact lInv_reset hs hi

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) on library runs, with or without the guard of §56: in every library state
reachable under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every registered `internal` exists and
every live entry satisfies `EntryInv`. The kernel states of such runs are kernel-reachable
(`LReachNG.reachable`), so they satisfy `WF3` and `NoDangling` (`Access.reachable_kinv`, §57),
which `lInv_stepNG` asks of them. -/
theorem lReachNG_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReachNG k statics L) : LInv L := by
  induction h with
  | init => intro E hE; cases hE
  | step hL hs ih =>
    exact lInv_stepNG hs (reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.reachable).1
      (reachable_kinv hdd hst (hL.step hs).reachable).2.1.2.2 ih

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) on library-reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
every live entry of a library-reachable state satisfies `ArenaInv` (`lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem lReach_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L.kern E → ArenaInv L.kern E :=
  fun E hE hl => ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst h.ng E hE).2 hl).1

`Arena.newArenaEff` is registered; the kernel state and the synchronization registry are
unchanged (§76 `ok` effect). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
def NewArenaStepC (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) (c storage internal : Nat)
    (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ Guarded (NewArenaPreC s reg ar c storage internal)
    (s, ar ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩]) o

/-- `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §77, §58; Part XIV: a
derived operation, on the pattern of `Arena.IssueD`): the static checks (§77.1, §77.2) and the
availability `fail` (§77.4) on the view of `c`; then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and
`store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8), both as executed by `c`
(`opStepC`; WC4 C2, C3: §65.4 and §65.5 read `ancestorC`); the metadata is updated on `ok`
(`Arena.issueMeta`). A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
inductive IssueStepC (k : K) (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (c i : Nat) (region : List Nat)
    (dst : Nat) : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg) → Prop where
  | noEntry : s.Live c → ar[i]? = none → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | static {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      ¬ Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | fail {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : s.Live c → ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → ¬ Arena.Avail E region →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .fail
  | split {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} : ar[i]? = some E → Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst →
      Arena.Avail E region → opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s .reject →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | store {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ .reject → IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst .reject
  | ok {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : SC} : ar[i]? = some E →
      Arena.IssueStatic (s.view c) E region dst → Arena.Avail E region →
      opStepC k (.split E.internal [region]) c s (.ok s₁) →
      opStepC k (.store s.A.length dst) c s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst (.ok (s₂, ar.set i (Arena.issueMeta s.flat E region)))

/-- `reset(arena)` of entry `i` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §78, §58; Part XIV): the derived operation
`Arena.ResetD` (`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, `release`, the check of §78.3)
on the view of `c`, written back (WC4 C2); `derive` and `release` read neither `ancestor` nor the
stack beyond its top and its membership. A context that is not live executes nothing. -/
def ResetStepC (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) (c i : Nat) (o : Outcome3 (SC × ArenaReg)) : Prop :=
  s.Live c ∧ ∃ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.view c, ar⟩ o₃ ∧
    o = omap (fun L' => (s.set L'.kern, L'.arenas)) o₃

/-- Theorem 4 (WC4 C21, C22, C23) on one labelled step: every labelled step taken under `Encap`
(WC4 C22.1–C22.3, C22.5), `transfer` and the by-value composite included, preserves `SyncState`
(`SyncInv`, WC4 C21.1–C21.7, and `GrantDiscipline`, WC4 C22). `KInvCA` before the step and `WF3`
after it are supplied by theorem 2. -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap L st lbl) (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat)

  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst =>
      obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
      exact transfer_syncState hpre.sameShape hpre.dstNotInit hpre.dstUsable.lt he hw hw' hs
    case endUse p => exact endUse_syncState h he hw hw' hs
    all_goals
      exact facts_syncState (opStep_facts (reg := reg) h he (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hw)
        (opStep_init h (fun _ _ h => by cases h) (fun _ h => by cases h)) hw hw' hs
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
    exact facts_syncState (spawnEff_facts hpre.params hpre.localsOK) (spawn_init hpre.localsOK)
      hw hw' hs
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    have hf := term_facts (reg := reg) hw h
    obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
    exact facts_syncState hf (initFacts_same rfl rfl) hw hw' hs
  | @join s s' reg c d h =>
    have hf := join_facts (reg := reg) h
    cases h
    exact facts_syncState hf (initFacts_same rfl rfl) hw hw' hs
  | deriveSync h => exact (deriveSync_excluded h he).elim
  | newMutex h => exact newMutex_syncState h hw hs
  | acquire h => exact acquire_syncState h hw hw' hs
  | unlock h => exact unlock_syncState h hw hw' hs
  | resetLock h => exact resetLock_syncState h hs
  | spawnVal h => exact spawnVal_syncState hk h he hs

/-- WC4 S18 (C21.7 with Spec 1 §63.3): under `SyncState`, a `transfer` whose destination contains
the mutex value of a live entry is rejected, its controller leaf being `Init`. Positive twins:
`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invA`, `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invB`. -/
theorem transfer_into_live_mutex_rejected {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg}
    {c src dst m : Nat} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg)
    (he : e ∈ reg) (hl : e.Live s) (hm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m)
    (hmd : partOf s.P m dst) : ¬ TransferPreC k s c src dst := by
  intro hpre
  have h3 := hs.1.control e he hl
  have h4 := hs.1.ctlInit e he hl
  cases hco : ControlOf L s e with
  | none => rw [hco] at h3; exact h3
  | some ctl =>
    rw [hco] at h3 h4; simp only [OptP] at h3 h4
    obtain ⟨y, q, m', hy, hh, hm', -, hkc⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.controlOf_spec hco
    have hy' : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    have hmm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m' := by simp [mutexOf, hy', hh, hm']
    rw [hm] at hmm; cases hmm
    have hcm : parentOf s.P ctl = some m := (mem_kids.1 (List.mem_of_getElem? hkc)).2
    have hcmp : partOf s.P ctl m := ⟨h3.1.lt, .inr (by
      rw [chain_cons hcm (WF3.parent_lt (s := s.flat) hw hcm).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
    have hcd : ctl ∈ footprint s.P dst :=
      SyncInitAux.leaf_mem_footprint (t := s.flat) h3.2
        (SyncInitAux.partOf_trans (t := s.flat) hw hcmp hmd)
    exact hpre.dstNotInit ctl hcd h4

end Ern.Concurrency

theorem parentOf_shapeP_lt {P : List Place} {hd : Holder}

    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) j = parentOf P j := by
  simp only [parentOf, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_left hj]

/-- The parent of an element appended by a well-formed shape is an appended element (§71.1,
§72.2). -/
theorem shapeP_parent_ge {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) {j r : Nat} (hj : P.length ≤ j)
    (h : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) j = some r) : P.length ≤ r := by
  unfold parentOf shapeP at h
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right hj, List.getElem?_map] at h
  cases hi : (List.range ls.length)[j - P.length]? with
  | none => rw [hi] at h; simp at h
  | some i =>
    rw [hi] at h
    obtain ⟨hlt, hii⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hi
    simp only [List.getElem_range] at hii
    subst hii
    simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some] at h
    have := (hok (j - P.length) (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hlt))).1
    rw [h] at this
    exact this.1

/-- The chain of an appended element stays among the appended elements (§71.1, §72.2). -/
theorem chainF_shapeP_ge {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) :
    ∀ k i, P.length ≤ i → ∀ x ∈ chainF (parentOf (shapeP P hd ls)) k i, P.length ≤ x
  | 0, _, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, hi, x, h => by
    simp only [chainF] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i o ho
      split at h
      · have hoP := shapeP_parent_ge hok hi ho
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
        · exact hoP
        · exact chainF_shapeP_ge hok k o hoP x h
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps the footprint of every former place (§40; §71, §72
effects). -/
theorem footprint_shapeP {P : List Place} {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) {q : Nat} (hq : q < P.length) (l : Nat) :
    l ∈ footprint (shapeP P hd ls) q ↔ l ∈ footprint P q := by
  rw [mem_footprint, mem_footprint]
  have hlen : P.length ≤ (shapeP P hd ls).length := by simp [shapeP]
  have hch : ∀ i, i < P.length →
      chain (parentOf (shapeP P hd ls)) i = chain (parentOf P) i := fun i hi =>
    chain_congr fun j hj => parentOf_shapeP_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hj hi)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hleaf, -, hpart⟩
    by_cases hlP : l < P.length
    · refine ⟨hlP, fun r hr => ?_, hlP, ?_⟩
      · have := hleaf r (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hr hlen); rwa [parentOf_shapeP_lt hr] at this
      · rcases hpart with rfl | hc
        · exact .inl rfl
        · exact .inr (by rwa [← hch l hlP])
    · exfalso
      rcases hpart with rfl | hc
      · exact hlP hq
      · have := chainF_shapeP_ge hok _ _ (Nat.le_of_not_lt hlP) _ hc; omega
  · rintro ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hpart⟩
    refine ⟨Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlP hlen, fun r hr => ?_, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlP hlen, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hrP : r < P.length
      · rw [parentOf_shapeP_lt hrP]; exact hleaf r hrP
      · intro h; have := shapeP_parent_ge hok (Nat.le_of_not_lt hrP) h; omega
    · rcases hpart with rfl | hc
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr (by rwa [hch l hlP])

/-- Every kernel step keeps the footprint of every existing place (§40; §60–§75 `ok` effects:
places are only appended, and `transfer` changes owners only). -/
theorem kstep_fp {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') {q : Nat} (hq : q < s.P.length) (l : Nat) :
    l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q := by
  cases h with
  | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | release hs =>
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
    rw [releaseEff_eq hx]
  | transfer hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; rw [transfer_footprint]
  | depend hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | enter hs =>
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact footprint_shapeP hp.localsOK hq l
  | exit hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | write hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | writeShared hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | pin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | unpin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | endUse hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | free hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact Iff.rfl
  | alloc hs => cases hs with
    | ok hst _ => exact footprint_shapeP hst.shapeOK hq l
  | store hs =>
    rename_i a p
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    have hd := hp.derivedHeld
    cases hy : s.A[a]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at hd; exact hd.elim
    | some y => rw [storeEff_eq hy]

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The invariant of theorem 4: `SyncInv` (WC4 C21) and `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22). -/
def SyncState (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  SyncInv L s reg ∧ GrantDiscipline s reg

namespace SyncPreserveAux

/-! ## Per-entry decomposition -/

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` about one entry (WC4 C21.1–C21.3, C21.5, C21.6, C22). -/
structure EntryOK (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (e : SyncEntry) : Prop where
  guarded : e.Live s → OptP (s.A[e.guarded]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧
    PlaceUsable s.flat y.holder) False
  grant : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → OptP (s.A[g]?) (fun y =>
    y.origin = some e.guarded ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ s.flat.afp e.guarded) False
  control : e.Live s → OptP (ControlOf L s e) (fun ctl =>
    s.flat.Usable ctl ∧ isLeaf s.P ctl) False
  disc : e.Live s → e.grant = none → NoCoveringDesc s e.guarded
  sub : e.Live s → ∀ g, e.grant = some g → s.flat.Active g →
    ∀ j, CoveringDesc s e.guarded j → j = g ∨ g ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  bound : e.guarded < s.A.length

/-- The guarded-identity uniqueness of `SyncState` (WC4 C21.4, second clause). -/
def Uniq (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (e e' : SyncEntry), reg[i]? = some e → reg[j]? = some e' → e.Live s →
    e'.Live s → e.guarded = e'.guarded → i = j

end SyncPreserveAux

open SyncPreserveAux

/-- The clauses of `SyncState` other than controller uniqueness (WC4 C21.4, first clause) and the
initialization invariant (WC4 C21.7): the per-entry clauses (WC4 C21.1–C21.3, C21.5, C21.6, C22)
and guarded-identity uniqueness (WC4 C21.4, second clause). -/
def SyncCore (L : MutexLayout) (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ reg, EntryOK L s e) ∧ Uniq s reg

/-- `SyncState` is `SyncCore` with controller uniqueness (WC4 C21.4) and the initialization
C4, C7, C8, C15: authorities are only added; an old authority keeps its footprint and mode, is
never reactivated, keeps an origin that stays active, and its origin chain only loses elements
(and keeps those that stay active, when it stays active); an added authority is a root or is
derived from an active authority within its footprint. -/
structure Skel (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  len : s.A.length ≤ s'.A.length
  old : ∀ j y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → j < s.A.length → ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧
    y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
    (∀ o, y.origin = some o → s'.flat.Active o → y'.origin = some o)
  ancsSub : ∀ j, j < s.A.length → ∀ x ∈ s'.flat.ancs j, x ∈ s.flat.ancs j
  ancsKeep : ∀ j, j < s.A.length → s'.flat.Active j → ∀ x ∈ s.flat.ancs j, s'.flat.Active x →
    x ∈ s'.flat.ancs j
  new : ∀ j y', s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = none ∨
    ∃ o, y'.origin = some o ∧ o < s.A.length ∧ s.flat.Active o ∧
      (∀ l ∈ y'.footprint, l ∈ s.flat.afp o) ∧ s'.flat.ancs j = o :: s.flat.ancs o

section SkelLemmas

variable {s s' : SC}

    · subst e; simp only [lt_of_getElem? hx, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hy'
      subst hy'; exact ⟨x, hx, hS⟩
    · simp only [e, ↓reduceIte] at hy'; exact ⟨y', hy', Same.refl _⟩

/-- `Skel`, holders, places and the encapsulated sources of new authorities after a step with an
unchanged registry. -/
structure StepFacts (reg : SyncReg) (s s' : SC) : Prop where
  skel : Skel s s'
  hold : HoldSame s s'
  pskel : PSkel s.P s'.P
  src : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
    y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded

/-- Constructor of `StepFacts`. -/
theorem StepFacts.of {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (h : Skel s s' ∧ HoldSame s s')
    (hP : PSkel s.P s'.P) (hsrc : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' →
      s.A.length ≤ j → y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded) : StepFacts reg s s' :=
  ⟨h.1, h.2, hP, hsrc⟩

/-- No authority is created (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_none {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} (hlen : s'.A.length = s.A.length) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded :=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ hy' hj _ => absurd (lt_of_getElem? hy') (by omega)

/-- Appended authorities are roots or derived from `src` (source condition from `Encap`). -/
theorem src_append {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {N : List Authority} {src : Nat}
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ N) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none ∨ z.origin = some src)
    (he : ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → src ≠ e.guarded) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e hm hl j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right hj] at hy'
  rcases hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy') with h | h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h
  · rw [ho] at h; cases h; exact he e hm hl

/-- Appended authorities are roots (source condition vacuous). -/
theorem src_roots {reg : SyncReg} {s s' : SC} {B N : List Authority} (hA : s'.A = B ++ N)
    (hlen : B.length = s.A.length) (hN : ∀ z ∈ N, z.origin = none) :
    ∀ e ∈ reg, e.Live s → ∀ j y' o, s'.A[j]? = some y' → s.A.length ≤ j →
      y'.origin = some o → o ≠ e.guarded := by
  intro e _ _ j y' o hy' hj ho
  rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy'
  rw [hN y' (List.mem_of_getElem? hy')] at ho; cases ho

/-- An `ok` outcome of an operation run on a view (WC4 C2). -/
theorem viewStep_ok {R : S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : ViewStep R c s (.ok s')) : ∃ t, R (s.view c) (.ok t) ∧ s' = s.set t := by
  obtain ⟨-, o₃, hR, ho⟩ := h
  cases o₃ with
  | ok t => cases ho; exact ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩
  | reject => cases ho
  | fail => cases ho

  /-- WC4 C4.1 (Spec 1 §72.1 re-indexed): the creating context and its current frame are live. -/

  /-- WC4 C5.3 (Spec 1 §72.1): at the beginning of the yield phase, every parameter is active,

/-- `split` of `internal` on one region adds one authority (§61, `ok` effect). -/
theorem splitEff_one (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) :
    splitEff s src [region] = s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩ := rfl

/-- The block added by `split` of `internal` on the region (§61, `ok` effect). -/
theorem split_block (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) :
    (splitEff s src [region]).A[s.A.length]? =
      some ⟨.modify, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩ := by
  simp [splitEff]

/-- The kernel part of the effect of `issue` is the arrival state of `split` of `internal` on the
region followed by `store` of the block into the destination (Part XIV, §77): literal
equality. -/
theorem issueKEff_eq (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    issueKEff s E region dst = storeEff (splitEff s E.internal [region]) s.A.length dst := by
  rw [storeEff_eq (split_block s E.internal region)]
  simp [issueKEff, splitEff, List.set_append_right]

import Ern.Concurrency.SyncInit

/-!
# The arena registry of the concurrent machine: `ArenaInv` and the §56 separation

Library invariants of the arena registry beside the synchronization registry (WC4 C2, C19;
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §46, §55, §56):

* every labelled step keeps the authorities (`Arena.AKeep`: none is removed, reactivated, or
  given another mode, footprint or non-place holder) and the footprints of the existing places
  (`lstep_keep`);
* `ArenaInvC`: `ArenaInv` (Spec 1 §55) of every live entry of the arena registry, with the
  auxiliaries of `Arena.LInv`, on the kernel components with the globally live frames (WC4 C2);
  theorem 7 (`lstep_arenaInv`): every labelled step preserves it;
* `AdminSep` (Spec 1 §56; WC4 C13.7, OB-C16) is preserved by every labelled step
  (`lstep_adminSep`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access SyncPreserveAux SyncInitAux

/-- `ArenaInv` (Spec 1 §55) on the arena registry of the concurrent machine (WC4 C2, C19): the
library invariant `Arena.LInv` of the registry `ar` over the kernel components with the globally
live frames, i.e. every registered `internal` exists and every live entry satisfies `ArenaInv`
with the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def ArenaInvC (s : SC) (ar : ArenaReg) : Prop := Arena.LInv ⟨s.flat, ar⟩

namespace ArenaAux

/-! ## Authorities and footprints kept by every labelled step (Spec 1 §42, §58) -/

/-- The parameters of `enterFrame` keep a frame holder and the locals are appended (Spec 1 §72
effect): the proof of the `enter` case of `Arena.kstep_akeep`, which reads only §72.1. -/
theorem akeep_enter {t : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hpar : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (t.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame t.top ∧
      y.origin ≠ none) False) :
    Arena.AKeep t (enterEff t ps ls) := by
  intro j y hy
  have hj := lt_of_getElem? hy
  refine ⟨if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame t.nF } else y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [enterEff]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact hj), getElem?_mapI, hy]
    simp
  · by_cases hjp : j ∈ ps
    · simp only [hjp, ↓reduceIte]
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, id, fun _ => ?_, fun o h _ _ => h⟩
      have := hpar j hjp; rw [hy] at this
      rw [this.2.1]; rfl
    · simp only [hjp, ↓reduceIte]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, id, id, fun o h _ _ => h⟩

/-- `transfer` executed by `c` keeps the authorities (Spec 1 §63 effect): the proof of the
`transfer` case of `Arena.kstep_akeep`, which reads no precondition. -/
theorem akeep_transfer (s : SC) (c src dst : Nat) :
    Arena.AKeep s.flat (transferEffC s c src dst).flat := by
  refine Arena.akeep_map (f := fun y => if heldIn (s.view c).P src y.holder then
    { y with holder := mvTo (s.view c).P src dst y.holder } else y) rfl fun y => ?_
  cases e : y.holder with
  | frame f => simp [heldIn, e, Holder.isPlace]
  | place r =>
    by_cases hc : partOf (s.view c).P r src <;> simp [heldIn, hc, mvTo, Holder.isPlace, e]

/-- The yield of WC4 C5.3 keeps the authorities when the yielded parameters are frame-held. -/
theorem akeep_yield {t : SC} {ps : List Nat} {f : Nat}
    (hpar : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, t.A[a]? = some y → y.holder.isPlace = false) :
    Arena.AKeep t.flat (yieldEff t ps f).flat := by
  intro j y hy
  refine ⟨if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame f } else y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (mapI _ 0 t.A)[j]? = _
    rw [getElem?_mapI, hy]; simp
  · by_cases hjp : j ∈ ps
    · simp only [hjp, ↓reduceIte]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, id, fun _ => hpar j hjp y hy, fun o h _ _ => h⟩
    · simp only [hjp, ↓reduceIte]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, id, id, fun o h _ _ => h⟩

/-- Authorities kept, footprints of the existing places kept, places not removed. -/
def Keep (s s' : SC) : Prop :=
  Arena.AKeep s.flat s'.flat ∧ s.P.length ≤ s'.P.length ∧
    ∀ q, q < s.P.length → ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- `Keep` composes. -/
theorem Keep.trans {s s' s'' : SC} (h : Keep s s') (h' : Keep s' s'') : Keep s s'' :=
  ⟨h.1.trans h'.1, Nat.le_trans h.2.1 h'.2.1, fun q hq l =>
    (h'.2.2 q (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hq h.2.1) l).trans (h.2.2 q hq l)⟩

/-- An unchanged kernel state. -/
theorem keep_same {s s' : SC} (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) : Keep s s' :=
  ⟨Arena.akeep_of_eq hA, by rw [hP]; exact Nat.le_refl _, fun _ _ _ => by rw [hP]⟩

/-- A kernel step run on the view of `c` and written back (WC4 C2): `Arena.kstep_akeep` and
`Arena.kstep_fp`. -/
theorem keep_view {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s : SC} {t : S3}
    (hR : op.Step k (s.view c) (.ok t)) : Keep s (s.set t) := by
  have hk := kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hR⟩
  refine ⟨Arena.kstep_akeep hk, ?_, fun q hq l => view_fp hR hq l⟩
  by_contra hlt
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, l ∈ footprint (s.view c).P s.P.length ∨ True := ⟨0, .inr trivial⟩
  clear hl
  have h0 : ∀ q, q < s.P.length → q < t.P.length := fun q hq => by
    have := (view_fp hR hq q).2
    by_cases hlf : isLeaf s.P q
    · exact (mem_footprint.1 (this (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hq, hlf, hq, .inl rfl⟩))).1
    · sorry
  sorry

/-- Every inherited operation executed by `c` keeps the authorities and the footprints of the
existing places (Spec 1 §60–§75 effects re-indexed, WC4 C2, C6). -/
theorem opStepC_keep {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC}
    (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) : Keep s s' := by
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine ⟨akeep_transfer s c src dst, ?_, fun q _ l => ?_⟩
    · show s.P.length ≤ (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).P.length
      rw [transfer_len]; exact Nat.le_refl _
    · show l ∈ footprint (transferEff (s.view c) src dst).P q ↔ _
      rw [transfer_footprint]; exact Iff.rfl
  | depend q x =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact keep_same rfl rfl
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hd := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd; split at hd
    · rename_i y hy
      have hy' : (s.view c).A[a]? = some y := hy
      have he := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy'
      refine ⟨Arena.akeep_set (x' := { y with holder := .place p }) hy' ?_ rfl rfl id
        (fun h => by simp [Holder.isPlace] at h) rfl, ?_, fun q _ l => ?_⟩
      · show (storeEff (s.view c) a p).A = _; rw [he]
      · show s.P.length ≤ (storeEff (s.view c) a p).P.length; rw [he]; exact Nat.le_refl _
      · show l ∈ footprint (storeEff (s.view c) a p).P q ↔ _; rw [he]; exact Iff.rfl
    · exact hd.elim
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact ⟨akeep_enter hpre.params, by simp [enterEffC, SC.set, enterEff, shapeP],
      fun q hq l => Arena.footprint_shapeP hpre.localsOK hq l⟩
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact ⟨Arena.exit_akeep (s.view c), Nat.le_refl _, fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  all_goals (obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := viewStep_ok h; exact keep_view hR)

end ArenaAux

end Ern.Concurrency

    eU.I 2 = .uninit ∧ ¬ SyncInv L0 eU reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 e2 (.ok eU) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨traceMutex, hst,
    fun h => (h ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)).1 (by decide),
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) (st := (e2, reg1))
      (st' := (eU, reg1)) (.kernel hst) inv2.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h.ctlInit ⟨4, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
