/-- `endUse(M = 0)` by context 0 after `newMutex` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def eM : SC := e2.set (endUseEff (e2.view 0) 0)

/-- Positive twin of `endUse_ctl_excluded` (WC4 C22.5, S17b positive): from `e2`, `endUse(M)` is
an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69 re-indexed admitted by `Encap`; the entry is live before the step and
not after it (`guarded`, held by `slot`, a place of `M`, becomes inactive), and the encapsulated
trace ending with it reaches a state where `KInvCA` and `SyncState` (`SyncInv`, `GrantDiscipline`)
hold (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem endUse_mutex_kills_entry :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 [],
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] (eM, reg1) ∧
    (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live e2 ∧ ¬ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eM ∧
    KInvCA eM ∧ SyncState L0 eM reg1 := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 0) 0 e2 (.ok eM) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have he : Encap L0 (e2, reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 0)) :=
    (by decide : ∀ e ∈ reg1, e.Live e2 → ControlOf L0 e2 e ≠ some 0 ∧
      OptP (slotOf e2 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf e2.P 0 q → 0 = q) True)
  have ht : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (e0, [])
      [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 1), .newMutex 0 4 [],
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 0)] (eM, reg1) :=
    .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel step_derive) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel step_store) <| .cons trivial (.newMutex step_newMutex.1) <|
    .cons he (.kernel hst) .nil
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 est_ok L0
  exact ⟨ht, by decide, by decide, trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs⟩

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M` with fields `1` (`slot`, a structure with the
leaves `2` and `3`) and `4` (`lock`), all leaves `Init`; `5` the root `T`, owned by `slot`. Root
authorities: `0` of `M`, `1` of `T` (held by `slot`, `guarded`). -/
def sst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), true),
   ((some 1, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true)]

----
/-- `endUse(2)`, a strict part of `slot`, by context 0 (Spec 1 §69). -/
def z1 : SC := z0.set (endUseEff (z0.view 0) 2)

/-- WC4 S17b, C22.5 (b): from the initial state of `sst`, after the encapsulated step
`newMutex(1)`, `endUse(2)` on a strict structural subplace of `slot` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69
re-indexed and `Encap` excludes it. Without the exclusion, after the step `KInvCA` holds, the
entry is live, leaf 2 of `slot` is `Uninit`, and `SyncInv` fails (`slotInit`, WC4 C21.7). -/
theorem endUse_slotPart_excluded :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (z0, []) [.newMutex 0 1 []] (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 z0 (.ok z1) ∧ ¬ Encap L0 (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) ∧
    KInvCA z1 ∧ (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live z1 ∧ slotOf z1 1 = some 1 ∧ z1.I 2 = .uninit ∧
    ¬ SyncInv L0 z1 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 z0 (.ok z1) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have hk0 := (init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 sst_ok L0).1
  have hk : KInvCA z0 := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (z0, [])) (.newMutex z_newMutex) hk0
  refine ⟨.cons trivial (.newMutex z_newMutex) .nil, hst, fun h => ?_,
    lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.endUse 2))
      (st := (z0, [⟨1, none⟩])) (st' := (z1, [⟨1, none⟩])) (.kernel hst) hk,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (h ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)).2
    revert this; decide
  · have := h.slotInit ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
    revert this; decide

/-- `endUse(slot = 1)` by context 0 after `newMutex(1)` (Spec 1 §69). -/
def z2 : SC := z0.set (endUseEff (z0.view 0) 1)

/-- Positive twin of `endUse_slotPart_excluded` (WC4 C22.5, S17b positive): from `z0` with the
entry of `newMutex(1)`, `endUse(slot)` of the structured `slot` is an `ok` step of Spec 1 §69
re-indexed admitted by `Encap`; the entry is live before the step and not after it (`guarded`,
held by `slot`, becomes inactive), and the encapsulated trace ending with it reaches a state where
`KInvCA` and `SyncState` hold (`trace_inv`). -/
theorem endUse_slot_kills_entry :
    EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (z0, []) [.newMutex 0 1 [], .kernel 0 (.endUse 1)]
      (z2, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live z0 ∧ ¬ (⟨1, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live z2 ∧
    KInvCA z2 ∧ SyncState L0 z2 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  have hst : opStepC K0 (.endUse 1) 0 z0 (.ok z2) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have he : Encap L0 (z0, [⟨1, none⟩]) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 1)) :=
    (by decide : ∀ e ∈ ([⟨1, none⟩] : SyncReg), e.Live z0 → ControlOf L0 z0 e ≠ some 1 ∧
      OptP (slotOf z0 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf z0.P 1 q → 1 = q) True)
  have ht : EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (z0, []) [.newMutex 0 1 [], .kernel 0 (.endUse 1)]
      (z2, [⟨1, none⟩]) :=
    .cons trivial (.newMutex z_newMutex) <| .cons he (.kernel hst) .nil
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 sst_ok L0
  exact ⟨ht, by decide, by decide, trace_inv ddK0 ht hk hs⟩

/-! ## Controller uniqueness after `endUse` (WC4 C21.4, C21.7, C22.3, C22.5) -/

/-- Statics: two mutex values `M₁ = {slot₁ = {a₁, b₁}, lock₁}` (places 0–4) and
`M₂ = {slot₂ = {a₂, b₂}, lock₂}` (places 5–9), all leaves `Init`; `T₁` (10) owned by `slot₁` and
----
then `transfer(M₁, M₂)` reaches a state where `KInvCA` holds, both entries are live, both have the
controller `lock₂` (place 9), and `SyncInv` fails. Its first `endUse` step is excluded by `Encap`
(WC4 C22.5 (b)), so the run is not an `EncapsulatedTrace` (`endUse_then_transfer_merges_false`). -/
theorem endUse_then_transfer_merges :
    LRun K0 L0 (u0, [])
      [.newMutex 0 2 [], .newMutex 0 3 [], .kernel 0 (.endUse 7), .kernel 0 (.endUse 8),
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 9), .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 5)] (u4, regU) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (u0, regU) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 7)) ∧ KInvCA u4 ∧
    (⟨2, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live u4 ∧ (⟨3, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live u4 ∧
    ControlOf L0 u4 ⟨2, none⟩ = some 9 ∧ ControlOf L0 u4 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 9 ∧
    ¬ SyncInv L0 u4 regU := by
  have h1 : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] u0 [] 0 2 (u0, [⟨2, none⟩]) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have h2 : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] u0 [⟨2, none⟩] 0 3 (u0, regU) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have h3 : opStepC K0 (.endUse 7) 0 u0 (.ok u1) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have h4 : opStepC K0 (.endUse 8) 0 u1 (.ok u2) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have h5 : opStepC K0 (.endUse 9) 0 u2 (.ok u3) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
  have h6 : opStepC K0 (.transfer 0 5) 0 u3 (.ok u4) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  have hr : LRun K0 L0 (u0, [])
      [.newMutex 0 2 [], .newMutex 0 3 [], .kernel 0 (.endUse 7), .kernel 0 (.endUse 8),
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 9), .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 5)] (u4, regU) :=
    .cons (.newMutex h1) <| .cons (.newMutex h2) <| .cons (.kernel h3) <| .cons (.kernel h4) <|
    .cons (.kernel h5) <| .cons (.kernel h6) .nil
  have hk0 := (init_inv (k := K0) ddK0 ust_ok L0).1
  have hk : KInvCA u4 := by
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u0, [])) (.newMutex h1) hk0
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u0, [⟨2, none⟩])) (.newMutex h2) this
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u0, regU)) (.kernel h3) this
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u1, regU)) (.kernel h4) this
    have := lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u2, regU)) (.kernel h5) this
    exact lstep_kInvCA ddK0 (L := L0) (st := (u3, regU)) (.kernel h6) this
  refine ⟨hr, fun h => ?_, hk, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (h ⟨3, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide)).2
    revert this; decide
  · have := h.ctlUnique 0 1 ⟨2, none⟩ ⟨3, none⟩ 9 rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide)
    cases this

/-- The run of `endUse_then_transfer_merges` is not an `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22.5 (b)): after
the two `newMutex` steps, whose results are determined, `Encap` excludes `endUse(a₂)`. -/
theorem endUse_then_transfer_merges_false (st : SC × SyncReg) :
    ¬ EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (u0, [])
      [.newMutex 0 2 [], .newMutex 0 3 [], .kernel 0 (.endUse 7), .kernel 0 (.endUse 8),
       .kernel 0 (.endUse 9), .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 5)] st := by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | cons _ h1 h2 =>
    cases h1 with
    | newMutex hn1 =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn1
      cases h2 with
      | cons _ h3 h4 =>
        cases h3 with
        | newMutex hn2 =>
          obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn2
          cases h4 with
          | cons he _ _ => exact endUse_then_transfer_merges.2.1 he

/-! ## `newMutex` on `Uninit` fields is rejected (WC4 C13.10) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M` with fields `1` (`slot`) and `2` (`lock`), both
`Init`; `3` the root `T`, owned by `slot`; `4` the mutex value `M′` with fields `5` (`slot′`) and
`6` (`lock′`), both `Uninit`; `7` the root `T′`, owned by `slot′`. -/
def mst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false), ((none, some 5, 0), true)]

/-- Initial single-context state of `mst`. -/
def m0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init mst)

/-- WC4 C13.10 (`initM`): in `m0`, `newMutex(1)` is accepted and `newMutex(3)` is rejected, the
fields of `M′` being `Uninit`. -/
theorem newMutex_uninit_rejected : NewMutexOk K0 L0 [] m0 [] 0 1 (m0, [⟨1, none⟩]) ∧
    ¬ NewMutexPre K0 L0 [] m0 [⟨1, none⟩] 0 3 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-- The labels `newMutex(1)`, `newMutex(3)`, `transfer(M, M′)` from `m0` form no run: the second
step, `newMutex(3)`, has no `ok` outcome (`newMutex_uninit_rejected`). -/
theorem transfer_merges_controllers_false (st : SC × SyncReg) :
    ¬ LRun K0 L0 (m0, []) [.newMutex 0 1 [], .newMutex 0 3 [], .kernel 0 (.transfer 0 4)] st := by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | cons h1 h2 =>
    cases h1 with
    | newMutex hn1 =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := hn1
      cases h2 with
      | cons h3 _ =>
        cases h3 with
        | newMutex hn2 => exact newMutex_uninit_rejected.2 hn2.2.1

theorem r1_lstep {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {m : Machine.State}
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m) (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hob : StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w lbl st.1 m) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (realize π w lbl st.1 m) m (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 m)) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok st'.1 (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 m)) := by
  cases h with
  | kernel h => exact r1_kernel hπ hR hk h hob
  | @spawn s s' reg c ps ls h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_enter (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (ps := ps)
      ((reprC_view c).1 hR) hw hpre.localsOK hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hob.2
    have hpush := spawn_push (ps := ps) (ls := ls) hk.1.1.1 hpre.creatorLive
    refine ⟨hex, reprC_of_flat rfl (fun f => ?_) hR'⟩
    rw [hpush.mem]
    show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
    rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]
  | @spawnVal s s' reg c ps ls vs h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hob, hlay⟩ := hob
    simp only [realize] at hob ⊢
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := (along_append (p := Obl ObR ObW)).1 hob
    obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
    obtain ⟨hex₁, hR₁⟩ := realize_enter (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (ps := [])
      ((reprC_view c).1 hR) hw hpre.localsOK hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hlay
    have hpush := spawn_push (ps := []) (ls := ls) hk.1.1.1 hpre.creatorLive
    have hR₁' : ReprC π.L π.rtok (spawnCreate s c ls) _ := reprC_of_flat rfl (fun f => by
      show f ∈ (enterEff (s.view c) [] ls).F ↔ f ∈ (spawnEff s c [] ls).frames
      rw [hpush.mem]
      show f ∈ s.nF :: (s.view c).F ↔ _
      rw [List.mem_cons, SC.mem_view_F]) hR₁
    have hlt : ∀ a ∈ ps, a < s.A.length := fun a ha => by
      have := hpre.params a ha
      unfold OptP at this; split at this
      · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
      · exact this.elim
    have hframe : ∀ a ∈ ps, ∀ y, (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = some y →
        ∃ g, y.holder = .frame g := by
      intro a ha y hy
      have hp := hpre.params a ha
      have hy' : (spawnCreate s c ls).A[a]? = s.A[a]? := by
        show (mapI _ 0 s.A ++ _)[a]? = _
        rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact hlt a ha), getElem?_mapI]
        cases s.A[a]? <;> simp
      rw [hy'] at hy
      have hy₂ : (s.view c).A[a]? = some y := hy
      rw [hy₂] at hp
      exact ⟨_, hp.2.1⟩
    have hb₀ : KBase (yieldEff (spawnCreate s c ls) ps s.nF) := by
      rw [create_yield hlt]; exact spawn_base hk hpre.creatorLive hpre.params hpre.localsOK
    obtain ⟨hex₂, hR₂⟩ := realize_vals (π := π) (spawnCreate s c ls) vs _ hpre.transfers hb₀
      (fun v hv => spawn_frameOwned (hpre.freshDst v hv)) hframe hR₁' hob₂
    rw [run_append]
    exact ⟨exec_append hex₁ hex₂, reprC_yield hR₂⟩
  | @terminate s s' reg c h =>
    obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨hw, -, -, -, -⟩ := view_facts hk c
    have hfr := hk.1.1.1
    have hFv : (s.view c).F ≠ [] := by
      intro he
      have hc : s.stk c ≠ [] := fun e => by have := hpre.initialOnly; rw [e] at this; cases this
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hc
      have := (SC.mem_view_F (c := c)).2 (SC.mem_frames_of hf)
      rw [he] at this; cases this
    have hpar : s.ctxParent c ≠ none := fun e => by

    obtain ⟨hex, hR'⟩ := realize_exit (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW)

  | acquire h =>

    exact ⟨.nil _, reprC_set_same rfl rfl rfl hR⟩
  | unlock h =>

    refine ⟨.nil _, reprC_set_same ?_ ?_ ?_ hR⟩ <;> unfold releaseEff <;> split <;> rfl
  | resetLock h => obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := h; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩

end R1

/-! ## R5: conservativity of the realizations (WC4 C24) -/

/-- **R5** (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §82): on a single-context state, the realization of an inherited
operation O1–O16 executed by the context is the realization `opsOf` of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement` of the same operation on the projection `toS3`, its obligations are
those of `Refinement.StepObl` on the projection, and `ReprC` is `Repr` of the projection. -/
theorem r5_realize {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Refinement.Params Ty}
    {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {s : SC} (hs : s.Single) (op : KernelOp)
    (m : Machine.State) :
    realize π w (.kernel 0 op) s m = opsOf π (kopOf op w) s.toS3 m ∧
      (StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w (.kernel 0 op) s m ↔
        StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) s.toS3 m) ∧
      (ReprC π.L π.rtok s m ↔ Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s.toS3 m) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show opsOf π (kopOf op w) (s.view 0) m = _
    rw [single_view hs]
  · show StepObl k C ObR ObW π (kopOf op w) (s.view 0) m ↔ _
    rw [single_view hs]
  · unfold ReprC
    rw [single_flat hs]

/-! ## R2 and R3: simulation of encapsulated runs (WC4 C22, C23, C25; Spec 1 §82 preamble) -/

/-- Extension of an encapsulated trace by one encapsulated step (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem EncapsulatedTrace.snoc {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st₀ st st' : SC × SyncReg}
    {lbls : List Label} {lbl : Label} (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st₀ lbls st)
    (he : Encap L st lbl) (hs : LStep k L lbl st st') :
    EncapsulatedTrace k L st₀ (lbls ++ [lbl]) st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .cons he hs .nil
  | cons he' hs' _ ih => exact .cons he' hs' (ih he hs)

/-- Runs of encapsulated labelled steps from the initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty
registry, WC4 C3, C12), translated into the memory machine with the contract `K`, the
deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters `π` fixed once
for the run (Spec 1 §20.3 ¶3, §82; as `Refinement.SimRun`): the initial state with the creations
and writes of the statics (`Refinement.repr_init`); then each step of an `EncapsulatedTrace`
(WC4 C22, C23) under its obligations (`StepOblC`), the representations written by the step being
`w`, followed by its realization. Contexts interleave at the grain of abstract steps. -/
inductive SimRunC {Ty : Type} (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics)
    (π : Refinement.Params Ty) : SC × SyncReg → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [])
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))
  | step {lbl : Label} {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {st st' : SC × SyncReg}
      {m : Machine.State} : SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st m → Encap L st lbl →
      LStep k L lbl st st' → StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w lbl st.1 m →
      SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st' (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 m))

/-- **R2** (WC4 C22, C23, C25; Spec 1 §82 preamble, §9 ¶9), at the grain of abstract steps: under
`DDSound(K)` (Spec 1 §80) and the obligations of the parameters, for every translated run of
encapsulated labelled steps, the memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of
`ok` raw steps, it is related to the concurrent state by `ReprC`, and the run is an
`EncapsulatedTrace` from the initial state of Spec 1 §47. -/
theorem simulationC {Ty : Type} {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics}
    {π : Refinement.Params Ty} {st : SC × SyncReg} {m : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (h : SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st m) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty m) ∧ ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m ∧
      ∃ lbls, EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st := by
  have key : ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty m) ∧
      ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m ∧
      ∃ lbls, EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), []) lbls st) ∧ KInvCA st.1 := by
    induction h with
    | init hst hlay hob =>
      obtain ⟨hex, hR⟩ := repr_init (C := C) hst hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hlay hob
      exact ⟨⟨⟨_, hex⟩, reprC_ofS3.2 hR, [], .nil⟩, (init_inv hdd hst L).1⟩
    | step _ he hs hob ih =>
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨ops, hex⟩, hR, lbls, htr⟩, hk⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := r1_lstep hπ hR hk hs hob
      exact ⟨⟨⟨_, exec_append hex hex'⟩, hR', _, htr.snoc he hs⟩, lstep_kInvCA hdd hs hk⟩
  exact key.1

/-- The raw operation `o` has no `ub` outcome in the state `s` (Spec 1 §20.1 ¶2). -/
def NoUB {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (s : Machine.State) : Machine.Op Ty → Prop
  | .read ac t => ¬ Machine.ReadStep ObR ac t s .ub
  | .write ac t w => ¬ Machine.WriteStep ObW ac t w s .ub
  | .dealloc id au => ¬ Machine.DeallocStep C id au s .ub
  | .alloc sp b sz al fa => ¬ Machine.AllocStep sp b sz al fa s .ub

/-- No raw step of an execution has a `ub` outcome where it runs (Spec 1 §20.1 ¶2–¶3: an
execution consists of `ok` steps and each raw operation has at most one outcome). -/
theorem exec_noUB {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ops : List (Machine.Op Ty)} {s s' : Machine.State}
    (h : Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops s s') : Along (NoUB C ObR ObW) s ops := by
  induction h with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons hs _ ih =>
    cases hs with
    | read h => exact And.intro (fun hu => nomatch Machine.ReadStep_det h hu) ih
    | write h =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Machine.WriteStep_ok_iff.1 h
      exact And.intro (fun hu => nomatch Machine.WriteStep_det h hu) ih
    | dealloc h =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Machine.DeallocStep_ok_iff.1 h
      exact And.intro (fun hu => nomatch Machine.DeallocStep_det h hu) ih
    | alloc h =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Machine.AllocStep_ok_iff.1 h
      exact And.intro (fun hu => nomatch Machine.AllocStep_det h hu) ih

/-- **R3**, one step (Spec 1 §20.1, §82; WC4 C25), on the fragment where contexts interleave at the
grain of abstract steps: under the hypotheses of R1, no raw operation of the realization of the
step has a `ub` outcome in the state where it runs. -/
theorem r3_step {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Refinement.Params Ty}
    {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label}
    {st st' : SC × SyncReg} {m : Machine.State} (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π)
    (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m) (hk : KInvCA st.1) (h : LStep k L lbl st st')
    (hob : StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w lbl st.1 m) :
    Along (NoUB C ObR ObW) m (realize π w lbl st.1 m) :=
  exec_noUB (r1_lstep hπ hR hk h hob).1

/-- **R3** (Spec 1 §20.1, §82; WC4 C25), corollary of R2 on the fragment where contexts interleave
at the grain of abstract steps: for every translated run of encapsulated labelled steps, the memory
state is reached from the empty state by an execution none of whose raw steps has a `ub` outcome.
It says nothing about concurrent byte accesses, atomicity, memory orders or data races (WC4
OB-C01–OB-C06). -/
theorem concrete_safety {Ty : Type} {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics}
    {π : Refinement.Params Ty} {st : SC × SyncReg} {m : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hπ : Refinement.ParamsOK C π) (h : SimRunC k L C ObR ObW statics π st m) :
    ∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty m ∧
      Along (NoUB C ObR ObW) Machine.State.empty ops := by
  obtain ⟨⟨ops, hex⟩, -, -⟩ := simulationC hdd hπ h
  exact ⟨ops, hex, exec_noUB hex⟩

/-! ## Non-vacuity: the run of WC4 S4 in the memory machine -/

section Dec

variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
  {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Refinement.Params Ty)
  (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)

/-- Decidability of the obligations of a labelled step (Spec 1 §20.3, §82). -/
instance stepOblCDec (lbl : Label) (s : SC) (m : Machine.State) :
    Decidable (StepOblC k C ObR ObW π w lbl s m) := by
  cases lbl <;> unfold StepOblC <;> infer_instance

end Dec

namespace RealizeWitness

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places (Spec 1 §82): the test layout and
geometry of `Refinement.Runs`. -/
def πS : Refinement.Params Unit := piOf q6.P []

/-- The memory state realizing the initial state of S4 (Spec 1 §47, `Refinement.repr_init`). -/
def mS0 : Machine.State :=
  run Machine.State.empty (initOps πS.pl πS.geom πS.rtok πS.L πS.ty πS.ival s4st)

/-- After `enterFrame` of context 0 (Spec 1 §72). -/
def mS1 : Machine.State :=
  run mS0 (realize πS wv (.kernel 0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)])) q0 mS0)
/-- After `write` of `v` (Spec 1 §67). -/
def mS2 : Machine.State := run mS1 (realize πS wv (.kernel 0 (.write 1 [1])) q1 mS1)
/-- After `write` of `p` (Spec 1 §67). -/
def mS3 : Machine.State := run mS2 (realize πS wv (.kernel 0 (.write 2 [2])) q2 mS2)
/-- After `alloc` (Spec 1 §71). -/
def mS4 : Machine.State := run mS3 (realize πS wv (.kernel 0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)])) q3 mS3)
/-- After the by-value composite (WC4 C5). -/
def mS5 : Machine.State := run mS4 (realize πS wv (.spawnVal 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)]) q4 mS4)
/-- After `exitFrameC` of frame 1 (WC4 C6). -/
def mS6 : Machine.State := run mS5 (realize πS wv (.kernel 0 .exit) q5 mS5)

/-- The trace of WC4 S4 (`Traces.s4_trace`) is a translated run: each step satisfies its
obligations under the fixed parameters (non-vacuity of `SimRunC`, Spec 1 §82). -/
theorem s4_simRun : SimRunC K0 L0 (· = ·) obR obW s4st πS (q6, []) mS6 := by
  have h0 : SimRunC K0 L0 (· = ·) obR obW s4st πS (q0, []) mS0 :=
    .init (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have h1 := SimRunC.step (w := wv) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0)]))
    (st' := (q1, [], [])) h0 trivial (.kernel s4_steps.1) (by decide)
  have h2 := SimRunC.step (w := wv) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.write 1 [1])) (st' := (q2, [], [])) h1
    trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.1) (by decide)
  have h3 := SimRunC.step (w := wv) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.write 2 [2])) (st' := (q3, [], [])) h2
    trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.1) (by decide)
  have h4 := SimRunC.step (w := wv) (lbl := .kernel 0 (.alloc 2 1 [(none, 0)])) (st' := (q4, [], []))
    h3 trivial (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.1) (by decide)
  have h5 := SimRunC.step (w := wv) (lbl := .spawnVal 0 [] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)]) (st' := (q5, [], []))
    h4 ⟨fun _ h => (by cases h), trivial⟩ (.spawnVal s4_steps.2.2.2.2.1) (by decide)
  exact SimRunC.step (w := wv) (lbl := .kernel 0 .exit) (st' := (q6, [], [])) h5 trivial
    (.kernel s4_steps.2.2.2.2.2) (by decide)

/-- Non-vacuity of R2 and R3 (WC4 S4, C5, C6; Spec 1 §82): the run of S4, where context 0 creates
context 1 by the by-value composite, moving `v` (place 1) into the local `d` (place 4) of the new
frame, then exits frame 1, is realized by an execution of `ok` raw steps from the empty state, none
`ub`, with `ReprC` at its end. The allocations of the locals `v` and `p` of the exited frame are
dead; the allocation of `d` is live and holds the bytes written into `v` before the composite. -/
theorem s4_realized :
    ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW ops Machine.State.empty mS6) ∧
      ReprC πS.L πS.rtok q6 mS6 ∧
      ∃ lbls, EncapsulatedTrace K0 L0 (SC.ofS3 (S3.init s4st), [], []) lbls (q6, [], [])) ∧
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW ops Machine.State.empty mS6 ∧
      Along (NoUB (· = ·) obR obW) Machine.State.empty ops) ∧
    (mS6.allocs (πS.L 1).alloc).map (·.live) = some false ∧
    (mS6.allocs (πS.L 2).alloc).map (·.live) = some false ∧
    (mS6.allocs (πS.L 4).alloc).map (·.live) = some true ∧
    ∀ n < 8, bytesOf mS6 πS.L 4 n = wv 1 n :=
  ⟨simulationC (k := K0) (fun _ _ h => h.elim) (piOf_ok _ []) s4_simRun,
    concrete_safety (k := K0) (fun _ _ h => h.elim) (piOf_ok _ []) s4_simRun, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide⟩

end RealizeWitness

end Ern.Concurrency

/-!
# Sequential conservativity (WC4 C24)

On single-context states (`SC.Single`: one context, the initial one, live, without parent) whose
frame structure satisfies `FramesC`:

* `ancestorC` coincides with `ancestor` of Spec 1 §39 on the stack of the context
  (`single_ancestorC`);
* `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC` and `KInvC` coincide with their Spec 1 counterparts on the
  projection `SC.toS3` (`single_anchorOrderC`, `single_anchorOrderHeldC`, `single_kInvC`);
* every inherited operation O1–O16 executed by the context has the outcomes of Spec 1 on the
  projection, and an `ok` outcome stays a single-context state whose projection is the Spec 1
  effect (`conservative_op`, `conservative_ok`).

The statement on `K_C.SyncAuthorized` and `deriveSync` is in `Ern.Concurrency.SyncLib`
(`conservative_deriveSync`).

  have hv := single_view hs
  have back : ∀ o₃, R s.toS3 o₃ → omap SC.toS3 (omap s.set o₃) = o₃ := by
    intro o₃ hR
    cases o₃ with
    | ok t => exact congrArg Outcome3.ok (toS3_set (hF t hR))
    | reject => rfl

  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, o₃, hR, ho⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ hR => ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, o₃, hv ▸ hR, rfl⟩,
    back o₃ hR⟩⟩
  rw [hv] at hR; rw [ho, back o₃ hR]; exact hR

  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, h⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ h => ?_⟩

/-- The raw operations realizing a sequence of kernel steps (§82 preamble, §20.3): the raw
operations `opsOf` of each step, in the memory state reached by the previous ones. -/
def ktrace (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | [], _ => []
  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 => opsOf π op s3 s2 ++ ktrace π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

/-- The raw operations realizing a library step (§82.7): those of its kernel steps. -/
def lopsOf (π : Params Ty) (lop : LOp) (L : LState) (s2 : Machine.State) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  ktrace π (kexp lop L) s2

/-- The raw operations of composed kernel sequences are composed (§20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem ktrace_append (π : Params Ty) (t t' : List (KOp × S3)) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    ktrace π (t ++ t') s2 = ktrace π t s2 ++ ktrace π t' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction t generalizing s2 with

theorem headD_mem {l : List Nat} {x d : Nat} (h : x ∈ l) : l.headD d ∈ l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons a l => exact List.mem_cons_self ..

/-- Every leaf covered by an authority lies in the allocation of its effective anchor (§44,
§49.6, §82.1, §82.3). -/
theorem anchorAlloc_eq {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    (hw : WF3 s3) {a l : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s3.A[a]? = some y) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) :
    anchorAlloc L s3 a = (L l).alloc := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr, hfp⟩ := effAnchor_footprint hw hy hl
  have hlP := (hw.footprints a y hy l hl)
  have hin : l ∈ s3.afp (s3.effAnchor a) := (hfp l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP.1, hlP.2, hlr⟩)
  have hh := (hfp _).1 (headD_mem (d := 0) hin)

  rw [hlw.alloc_part (mem_footprint.1 hh).2.2, hlw.alloc_part hlr]

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` (§82.2 pointer validity and its last sentence, §82.3; the
lowest-address rule, a non-normative reference realization): under `Repr`, `WF3`, `NoDangling`, an
`ok` step of `store(authority, target)` whose reference has the address `ad` (`ptrAddr`), the obligations of the
write, a target of pointer size (pointer-size rule, a stated hypothesis: types and ABI, §81) and the
obligation of the encoding for that reference, the range of `target` after the write decodes to
`ad` and carries the provenance of the allocation of the effective anchor. Every leaf of the region
lies in that allocation, which is live and contains the range of the leaf. For a region whose
leaves all have zero physical size, the empty region included, `ad` is the base of that allocation
(§82.2); otherwise `ad` is the address of a leaf of nonzero size of the region, the lowest among
them (lowest-address rule). -/
theorem pointer_sound_store {Ty : Type} {ty : Nat → Ty} {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a p ad : Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : StoreStep a p s3 (.ok s3')) (had : ptrAddr s2 L s3 a = ad)
    (hsz : (L p).len = pe.size) (henc : PtrEncAt pe ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) :
    pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).alloc = anchorAlloc L s3 a ∧
        AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧ ad = leafAddr s2 L l ∧
        ∀ l' ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr s2 L l') := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨hpP, hpf, hpu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (store_target hpre)
  obtain ⟨pa, hpa, -⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hpP hpf hpu
  have hrun : run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p) =
      s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) (pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) := by
    simp only [storeOps, had, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
  have hbytes : ∀ i, i < (L p).len →
      bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i =
      pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hrun]; exact bytesOf_write ⟨pa, hpa, trivial⟩ hi
  have hy : ∃ y, s3.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true := by
    have h := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at h
    split at h
    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, h.1⟩
    · exact h.elim
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hy
  have hafp : s3.afp a = y.footprint := by simp [S3.afp, hy]
  refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => by rw [hbytes i hi]; exact henc.2 i, fun l hl => ?_, fun hz => ?_,
    fun hne => ?_⟩
  · rw [pe.reads _ _ fun i hi => hbytes i (hsz ▸ hi)]; exact henc.1
  · rw [hafp] at hl
    refine ⟨(anchorAlloc_eq hR.layout hw hy hl).symm, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hlP, hlf⟩ := hw.footprints a y hy l hl
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlP
    have hur : s3.Usable r := Decidable.of_not_not fun hn =>
      hnd a y hy ya r hn l (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hlf, hlr⟩) hl
    exact hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf (usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlr hur)
  · rw [← had]; unfold ptrAddr
    split
    · rename_i l0 ls hf
      have : l0 ∈ (s3.afp a).filter (fun l => decide (0 < (L l).len)) := by
        rw [hf]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      have hpos := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.1 this).2
      rw [hz l0 (List.mem_filter.1 this).1] at hpos
      exact absurd hpos (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
    · rfl
  · unfold ptrAddr at had
    split at had
    · rename_i l0 ls hf
      have hmem : ∀ x, x ∈ l0 :: ls → x ∈ s3.afp a ∧ 0 < (L x).len := fun x hx => by
        rw [← hf] at hx; simpa using List.mem_filter.1 hx
      obtain ⟨hle0, hle⟩ := minOver_le (leafAddr s2 L) ls (leafAddr s2 L l0)
      have hlow : ∀ l' ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr s2 L l' := by
        intro l' hl' hpos
        have : l' ∈ l0 :: ls := by rw [← hf]; exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hl', by simpa using hpos⟩
        rw [← had]
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 this with rfl | h'
        · exact hle0
        · exact hle l' h'
      rcases minOver_mem (leafAddr s2 L) ls (leafAddr s2 L l0) with e | ⟨l', hl', e⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hmem l0 (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        exact ⟨l0, h1, h2, by rw [← had, e], hlow⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hmem l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')
        exact ⟨l', h1, h2, by rw [← had, e], hlow⟩

      have : l ∈ (s3.afp a).filter (fun l => decide (0 < (L l).len)) :=
        List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hl, by simpa using hpos⟩
      rw [hf] at this; cases this


/-! ## Transfer (§63, §82.2, §82.3) -/

/-- Pairs of corresponding leaves of a transfer (§63.2, §63 effect): each leaf `l` of `src` with
its corresponding part `corr(l)` of `dst`. -/
def transferPairs (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (footprint P src).filterMap fun l => (corr P src dst l).map fun l' => (l, l')

/-- A leaf in the allocation of a root place belongs to that root place (§82.1, `inj`). -/
theorem Repr.leaf_of_alloc {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) {l r : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l) (hr : RootPlace s3.P r) (he : (L l).alloc = (L r).alloc) :
    l ∈ footprint s3.P r := by
  obtain ⟨r', hr', hlr'⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hl
  have : r' = r := Decidable.of_not_not fun hne =>
    hR.inj r' r hr' hr hne (by rw [← hR.layout.alloc_part hlr', he])
  subst this
  exact mem_footprint.2 ⟨hl, hlf, hlr'⟩

/-- `pinned_address_stable` (§82.6, §74, §75; §63.5, §69.4, §70.4, §73.3): for every realized
kernel step (`r6`), a leaf covered by an active dynamic pinning obligation (§74: a leaf is pinned
while an active obligation covers it) or pinned by `K.Pinned`, whose allocation is live before the
step, keeps a live allocation and the same address after the raw operations of the step. The
memory machine never moves an allocation (§13); the content is that no deallocation of the step
touches a pinned leaf. -/
theorem pinned_address_stable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l)
    (hlive : LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc) :
    LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
  have hwf := hR.adm.wf
  have haddr : leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
    simp only [leafAddr]; rw [baseOf_run hwf _ (hlive.mono fun _ _ => trivial)]
  refine ⟨?_, haddr⟩
  have hnod : (∀ o ∈ opsOf π op s3 s2, NoDealloc o) →
      LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc :=
    fun hn => live_run _ _ hwf hn hlive
  have hpinned : ¬ (s3.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) := fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
    rcases hpin with h | h
    · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 h] at h1; cases h1
    · exact h2 h
  cases op with
  | transfer => exact hnod (copyOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _)
  | enter => exact hnod (allocOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _ _)
  | read =>
    refine hnod fun o ho => ?_
    obtain ⟨_, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ho
    trivial
  | write => exact hnod (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
  | writeShared => exact hnod (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
  | alloc => exact hnod (allocOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _ _)
  | store => exact hnod (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
  | free p auth =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hrt := (free_usable hw hnd hpre).1
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hlive
    refine ⟨_, ?_, hla⟩
    show (s2.dealloc (π.L p).alloc).allocs _ = _
    rw [dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_right fun e => hpinned ?_, ha]
    have hfp := hR.leaf_of_alloc hw hl hlf hrt e
    exact hpre.notPinned l (List.mem_range.2 hl) (.inl hfp)
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hF : s3.F ≠ [] := fun e => hpre.hasCaller (by rw [e]; rfl)
    have hpw : (exitRoots s3).Pairwise (fun r r' => (π.L r).alloc ≠ (π.L r').alloc) :=
      ((range_pairwise _).filter _).imp_of_mem fun {r r'} hr hr' hlt =>
        hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)
    have hlv : ∀ r ∈ exitRoots s3, AllocP s2 (π.L r).alloc
        fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (π.rtok r) := fun r hr =>
      (hR.live r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (exitRoots_dies hw hF hr).1).and
        (hR.tokens r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1)
    obtain ⟨-, hkeep, -⟩ := deallocOps_run (Ty := Ty) (C := fun _ _ => True)
      (ObR := ⟨fun _ _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩)
      (ObW := ⟨fun _ _ _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ _ => True⟩) (fun _ => trivial) _ s2 hpw hlv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hlive
    refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩
    change (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) π.L π.rtok (exitRoots s3))).allocs _ = _
    rw [hkeep _ fun r hr e => hpinned ?_, ha]
    obtain ⟨hdu, hdn⟩ := exitRoots_dies hw hF hr
    have hfp := hR.leaf_of_alloc hw hl hlf (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 e.symm
    exact hpre.notPinned r (List.mem_range.2 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1.1) hdu hdn l hfp
  | derive => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | split => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | release => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | depend => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | pin => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | unpin => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | endUse => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h

/-- A write keeps the base of every allocation (§16 ¶3, §13 ¶3: no allocation moves). -/
theorem baseOf_write (s : Machine.State) (ac : Machine.Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    (i : Nat) : baseOf (s.write ac w) i = baseOf s i := by
  simp only [baseOf, write_allocs]
  split <;> cases s.allocs i <;> rfl

import Ern.Concurrency.Realize
import Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena

/-!
# Sequential conservativity of the arena operations (WC4 C24)

On single-context states (`SC.Single`) whose frame structure satisfies `FramesC`, the arena
operations executed by the context coincide with the derived operations of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §76–§78, Part XIV) on the
projection `SC.toS3` with the same arena registry, outcome by outcome (extension of theorem 1):

* `newArena` with `Arena.NewArenaStep`, the synchronization registry being the other registry
  of live administrations consulted by the guard (Spec 1 §56, §76.4) (`conservative_newArena`);
* `issue` with `Arena.IssueD` (`conservative_issue`);
* `reset` with `Arena.ResetD` (`conservative_reset`);

and their realizations are those of `Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena.lopsOf` on the projection
(extension of R5, `r5_arena`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement

/-- Projection of a kernel state and an arena registry to the library state of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (Spec 1 §46; WC4 C24). -/
def projL (p : SC × ArenaReg) : Arena.LState := ⟨p.1.toS3, p.2⟩

section Single

variable {k : K} {s : SC}

/-- On a single-context state, the preconditions of `newArena` executed by the context are those
of `Arena.NewArenaPre` on the projection, the other registry of live administrations being the
synchronization registry (Spec 1 §56, §76; WC4 C24). -/
theorem newArenaPreC_single (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg)
    (st i : Nat) :
    NewArenaPreC s reg ar 0 st i ↔ Arena.NewArenaPre s.toS3 ar [liveGuardeds s reg] st i := by
  have hd := single_decreasing hs hfr
  have hv := single_view hs
  have hf := single_flat hs
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, h12, h13, h14⟩
    rw [hv] at h1 h2 h4
    rw [hf] at h6 h7 h8 h9 h10 h13 h14
    exact ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, (single_anchorOrderC hs hd).1 h11,
      (single_anchorOrderHeldC hs hd).1 h12, h13⟩, h14⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, h12, h13⟩, h14⟩
    refine ⟨by rw [hv]; exact h1, by rw [hv]; exact h2, h3, by rw [hv]; exact h4, h5,
      by rw [hf]; exact h6, by rw [hf]; exact h7, by rw [hf]; exact h8, by rw [hf]; exact h9,
      by rw [hf]; exact h10, (single_anchorOrderC hs hd).2 h11,
      (single_anchorOrderHeldC hs hd).2 h12, by rw [hf]; exact h13, by rw [hf]; exact h14⟩

/-- Theorem 1 for `newArena` (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §76, §58): on a single-context state with the frame
structure `FramesC`, `newArena` executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of
`Arena.NewArenaStep` on the projection, the synchronization registry being the other registry of
live administrations. -/
theorem conservative_newArena (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg)
    (st i : Nat) :
    (∀ o, NewArenaStepC s reg ar 0 st i o →
      Arena.NewArenaStep [liveGuardeds s reg] st i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ (omap projL o)) ∧
    (∀ o₃, Arena.NewArenaStep [liveGuardeds s reg] st i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ →
      ∃ o, NewArenaStepC s reg ar 0 st i o ∧ omap projL o = o₃) := by
  have hp := newArenaPreC_single hs hfr reg ar st i
  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, h⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ h => ?_⟩
  · cases h with
    | ok hpre => exact Guarded.ok (hp.1 hpre)
    | reject hn => exact Guarded.reject fun h => hn (hp.2 h)
  · cases h with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .ok (hp.2 hpre)⟩, rfl⟩
    | reject hn => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .reject fun h => hn (hp.1 h)⟩, rfl⟩

/-- An `ok` `split` of the context of a single-context state writes back the `split` of its view
(Spec 1 §61 effect), and keeps a single-context state with the frame structure `FramesC`. -/
theorem split_single {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} {s₁ : SC} (hs : s.Single)
    (h : opStepC k (.split src rs) 0 s (.ok s₁)) :
    s₁ = s.set (splitEff (s.view 0) src rs) ∧ s₁.Single := by
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.viewStep_ok h
  have hR' : SplitStep k src rs (s.view 0) (.ok t) := hR
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'
  exact ⟨rfl, hs⟩

/-- Theorem 1 for `issue` (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §77, §58, Part XIV): on a single-context state with
the frame structure `FramesC`, `issue` executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of the
derived operation `Arena.IssueD` on the projection, outcome by outcome, `fail` included. -/
theorem conservative_issue (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) (ar : ArenaReg) (i : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    (∀ o, IssueStepC k s ar 0 i region dst o → Arena.IssueD k i region dst ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ (omap projL o)) ∧
    (∀ o₃, Arena.IssueD k i region dst ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ →
      ∃ o, IssueStepC k s ar 0 i region dst o ∧ omap projL o = o₃) := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  have hst_iff : ∀ E, Arena.IssueStatic (s.view 0) E region dst ↔
      Arena.IssueStatic s.toS3 E region dst := fun E => by rw [hv]
  have hlive := single_live hs
  refine ⟨fun o h => ?_, fun o₃ h => ?_⟩
  · cases h with
    | noEntry _ hE => exact .noEntry hE
    | static _ hE hn => exact .static hE fun h => hn ((hst_iff _).2 h)
    | fail _ hE hst hav => exact .fail hE ((hst_iff _).1 hst) hav
    | split hE hst hav hsp =>
      exact .split hE ((hst_iff _).1 hst) hav ((conservative_op hs hfr _).1 _ hsp)
    | @store E s₁ hE hst hav hsp hsto =>
      have h1 := (conservative_op hs hfr _).1 _ hsp
      obtain ⟨rfl, hs₁⟩ := split_single hs hsp
      exact .store hE ((hst_iff _).1 hst) hav h1 ((conservative_op hs₁ hfr _).1 _ hsto)
    | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hst hav hsp hsto =>
      have h1 := (conservative_op hs hfr _).1 _ hsp
      obtain ⟨rfl, hs₁⟩ := split_single hs hsp
      exact .ok hE ((hst_iff _).1 hst) hav h1 ((conservative_op hs₁ hfr _).1 _ hsto)
  · cases h with
    | noEntry hE => exact ⟨_, .noEntry hlive hE, rfl⟩
    | static hE hn => exact ⟨_, .static hlive hE fun h => hn ((hst_iff _).1 h), rfl⟩
    | fail hE hst hav => exact ⟨_, .fail hlive hE ((hst_iff _).2 hst) hav, rfl⟩
    | split hE hst hav hsp =>
      obtain ⟨o, ho, he⟩ := (conservative_op hs hfr _).2 _ hsp
      cases o with
      | reject => exact ⟨_, .split hE ((hst_iff _).2 hst) hav ho, rfl⟩
      | ok _ => cases he
      | fail => cases he
    | @store E t₁ hE hst hav hsp hsto =>
      obtain ⟨o, ho, he⟩ := (conservative_op hs hfr _).2 _ hsp
      cases o with
      | ok s₁ =>
        cases he
        obtain ⟨rfl, hs₁⟩ := split_single hs ho
        obtain ⟨o', ho', he'⟩ := (conservative_op hs₁ hfr _).2 _ hsto
        cases o' with
        | reject => exact ⟨_, .store hE ((hst_iff _).2 hst) hav ho ho', rfl⟩
        | ok _ => cases he'
        | fail => cases he'
      | reject => cases he
      | fail => cases he
    | @ok E t₁ t₂ hE hst hav hsp hsto =>
      obtain ⟨o, ho, he⟩ := (conservative_op hs hfr _).2 _ hsp
      cases o with
      | ok s₁ =>
        cases he
        obtain ⟨rfl, hs₁⟩ := split_single hs ho
        obtain ⟨o', ho', he'⟩ := (conservative_op hs₁ hfr _).2 _ hsto
        cases o' with
        | ok s₂ =>
          cases he'
          exact ⟨_, .ok hE ((hst_iff _).2 hst) hav ho ho', rfl⟩
        | reject => cases he'
        | fail => cases he'
      | reject => cases he
      | fail => cases he

/-- An `ok` outcome of `Arena.ResetD` keeps the stack (Spec 1 §60, §62 effects). -/
theorem resetD_F {i : Nat} {L L' : Arena.LState} (h : Arena.ResetD i L (.ok L')) :
    L'.kern.F = L.kern.F := by
  cases h with
  | ok _ hd hrl _ =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
    rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; rfl

/-- Theorem 1 for `reset` (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §78, §58, Part XIV): on a single-context state,
`reset` executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of the derived operation `Arena.ResetD`
on the projection, outcome by outcome. -/
theorem conservative_reset (hs : s.Single) (ar : ArenaReg) (i : Nat) :
    (∀ o, ResetStepC s ar 0 i o → Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ (omap projL o)) ∧
    (∀ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ → ∃ o, ResetStepC s ar 0 i o ∧ omap projL o = o₃) := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  have back : ∀ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ →
      omap projL (omap (fun L' : Arena.LState => (s.set L'.kern, L'.arenas)) o₃) = o₃ := by
    intro o₃ h
    cases o₃ with
    | ok L' =>
      have hF := resetD_F h
      show Outcome3.ok (⟨(s.set L'.kern).toS3, L'.arenas⟩ : Arena.LState) = .ok L'
      rw [toS3_set hF]
    | reject => rfl
    | fail => rfl
  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, o₃, h, ho⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ h => ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, o₃, ?_, rfl⟩, back o₃ h⟩⟩
  · have h' : Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ := by rw [← hv]; exact h
    rw [ho, back o₃ h']; exact h'
  · rw [hv]; exact h

end Single

/-- R5 for the arena operations (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §82.7): on a single-context state, the
realization of `newArena`, `issue` and `reset` executed by the context is the realization
`RefinementArena.lopsOf` of the corresponding library operation on the projection. -/
theorem r5_arena {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    {s : SC} (hs : s.Single) (ar : ArenaReg) (m : Machine.State) (others : List (List Nat))
    (st i dst : Nat) (region : List Nat) :
    realize π w (.newArena 0 st i) s ar m =
        RefinementArena.lopsOf π (.newArena others st i) ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ m ∧
      realize π w (.issue 0 i region dst) s ar m =
        RefinementArena.lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ m ∧
      realize π w (.reset 0 i) s ar m = RefinementArena.lopsOf π (.reset i) ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ m := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [realize, RefinementArena.lopsOf, RefinementArena.kexp]
    cases ar[i]? with
    | none => rfl
    | some E =>
      dsimp only
      rw [SC.view_set rfl, hv]
      simp [RefinementArena.ktrace, kopOf]
  · simp only [realize, RefinementArena.lopsOf, RefinementArena.kexp]
    cases ar[i]? with
    | none => rfl
    | some E =>
      dsimp only
      rw [SC.view_set rfl, hv]
      simp [RefinementArena.ktrace, kopOf, opsOf]

end Ern.Concurrency

import Ern.Concurrency.Realize

/-!
# Pointer soundness and pinned addresses under `ReprC` (Spec 1 §82.3, §82.6; WC4 C25)

Extension of R1 (`Ern.Concurrency.Realize`) at the grain of abstract steps: contexts interleave
at the grain of abstract steps, and every statement below is about that fragment only.

* `pointer_sound_storeC` (`Refinement.pointer_sound_store` transported to `ReprC`, §82.2, §82.3):
  the realization of `store` executed by a context writes into the target leaf a reference that
  decodes to the address of the stored authority, with the provenance of the allocation of its
  effective anchor; `issue_pointer_soundC`: the same for the block stored by `issue` (Spec 1 §77,
  Part XIV).
* `pinned_address_stableC` (`Refinement.pinned_address_stable` transported to `ReprC`, §82.6): for
  every labelled step, a pinned leaf whose allocation is live before the step keeps a live
  allocation and the same address after the raw operations of the step.

The proofs of `Refinement` read the preconditions of `store` (§65.1, §65.2) and of `exitFrame`
(§73.1, §73.3) only; the copies below read the same clauses of their re-indexed forms
(`StorePreC`, `ExitPreC`, `TermPre`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
open PreservationAux

/-! ## §82.3: pointer soundness of `store` -/

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §82.2 pointer validity and its last
sentence, §82.3; WC4 C2, C25), at the grain of abstract steps: under `ReprC`, `FramesC`, `WF3` and
`NoDangling` of the globally live frames, an `ok` step of `store(authority, target)` executed by
`c` whose reference has the address `ad` (`ptrAddr` on the view of `c`), a target of pointer size
and the obligation of the encoding for that reference: the conclusions of
`Refinement.pointer_sound_store` on the view of `c`. The proof is that of
`Refinement.pointer_sound_store`, which reads §65.1 (the authority is active) and §65.2 (the
target is a usable leaf) only. -/
theorem pointer_sound_storeC {Ty : Type} {k : K} {ty : Nat → Ty} {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s s' : SC} {m : Machine.State} {c a p ad : Nat}
    (hR : ReprC L rtok s m) (hfr : FramesC s) (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hnd : NoDangling s.flat)
    (h : opStepC k (.store a p) c s (.ok s')) (had : ptrAddr m L (s.view c) a = ad)
    (hsz : (L p).len = pe.size) (henc : PtrEncAt pe ad (some (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a))) :
    pe.decode (bytesOf (run m (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe m L ty (s.view c) a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run m (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe m L ty (s.view c) a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a)) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, (L l).alloc = anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a ∧
        AllocP m (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf m (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧
        ad = leafAddr m L l ∧ ∀ l' ∈ (s.view c).afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr m L l') := by
  obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hRv := (reprC_view c).1 hR
  have hwv : WF3 (s.view c) := SC.wf3_view hfr hw
  have hndv : NoDangling (s.view c) := noDangling_mem_congr hnd fun _ => SC.mem_view_F
  have htgt : LeafOfUsable (s.view c) p := ⟨p, List.mem_range.2 hpre.usable.lt, hpre.usable,
    mem_footprint.2 ⟨hpre.usable.lt, hpre.leaf, hpre.usable.lt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨hpP, hpf, hpu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hwv htgt
  obtain ⟨pa, hpa, -⟩ := hRv.leaf_live hwv hpP hpf hpu
  have hrun : run m (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe m L ty (s.view c) a p) =
      m.write (leafAcc m L .write p) (pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a))) := by
    simp only [storeOps, had, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
  have hbytes : ∀ i, i < (L p).len →
      bytesOf (run m (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe m L ty (s.view c) a p)) L p i =
      pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a)) i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hrun]; exact bytesOf_write ⟨pa, hpa, trivial⟩ hi
  have hy : ∃ y, (s.view c).A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true := by
    have h := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at h
    split at h
    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, h.1⟩
    · exact h.elim
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hy
  have hafp : (s.view c).afp a = y.footprint := by simp [S3.afp, hy]
  refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => by rw [hbytes i hi]; exact henc.2 i, fun l hl => ?_, fun hz => ?_,
    fun hne => ?_⟩
  · rw [pe.reads _ _ fun i hi => hbytes i (hsz ▸ hi)]; exact henc.1
  · rw [hafp] at hl

    obtain ⟨hlP, hlf⟩ := hwv.footprints a y hy l hl

import Ern.Concurrency.Reachable
import Ern.Concurrency.Traces

/-!
# Mutex transfer, `endUse` and `Encap` (test module)

Concrete runs checking `Encap` (WC4 C22.3, C22.5) and the initialization invariant (WC4 C21.7)
against WC4 C12, S7, S16, S17 and S18:

* a mutex value `M = {slot, lock}` owning the protected root `T`; `guarded` is a `Modify`
  derivative of the root authority of `T`, stored in `slot` (Spec 1 §60, §65); `M′ = {slot′, lock′}`
  is a place of the same shape in the same frame; `Y` is a one-leaf place;
* variants A (`grant = none`) and B (an active grant): `transfer(M, M′)` is an `ok` step admitted
  by `Encap`, after which `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline` hold and `ControlOf` designates
  `lock′` (S16, positive half);
* `transfer(slot, Y)` and `transfer(lock, Y)`: `ok` kernel steps excluded by `Encap`, after which
  `SyncInv` fails (S16 and its extension);
* `endUse(lock)`, and `endUse` of a strict part of `slot` (S17a, S17b): `ok` kernel steps excluded
  by `Encap` (WC4 C22.5), after which `SyncInv` fails (`ctlInit`, `slotInit`); `endUse(M)` and
  `endUse(slot)`: `ok` steps admitted by `Encap` that end the entry, after which `SyncInv` holds;
* a run whose `endUse` steps break WC4 C21.7, followed by `transfer(M₁, M₂)`, gives two live
  entries the same controller (`endUse_then_transfer_merges`); it is not an `EncapsulatedTrace`
  (`endUse_then_transfer_merges_false`);
* `newMutex` on a mutex value whose fields are `Uninit` is rejected by WC4 C13.10
  (`newMutex_uninit_rejected`), so the run of `transfer_merges_controllers_false` is not a run.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## States -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M`, `1` its field `slot`, `2` its field `lock`
(`Init`), `3` the protected root `T` (`Init`), owned by `M`; `4` the place `M′` with fields `5`
(`slot′`) and `6` (`lock′`), `Uninit`; `7` the one-leaf place `Y`, `Uninit`. Root authorities: `0`
of `M`, `1` of `T` (held by `M`), `2` of `M′`, `3` of `Y`. -/

  have ha : NewArenaStepC a2 [] [] 0 4 4 (.ok (a2, arA)) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.spawn ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil

#eval (a6.C, a6.P.length)

    opStepC KF (.write 0 [0]) 0 p1 (.ok p2) ∧ opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .modify) 0 p2 (.ok p3) ∧
    SpawnStep p3 0 [1] [] (.ok p4) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §3): for two distinct live contexts, a

  ∀ c c', s.Live c → s.Live c' → c ≠ c' → ∀ (a b : Nat) (L L' : List Nat),

### R4 — `OrdinaryCrossContextNonConflict` : prouvé

`r4_nonConflict` (`NonConflict.lean:141`) : `KInvC s → OrdinaryCrossContextNonConflict k s`.

L'énoncé, dans les mots du brief : pour tous contextes vivants `c ≠ c′`, toutes autorités `a`, `b` et toutes listes de feuilles `L`, `L′`, si `Write3Pre (s.view c) a L` et `Read3Pre (s.view c′) b L′ ∨ Write3Pre (s.view c′) b L′`, alors toute feuille de `L` et de `L′` est `K.SharedMutable`.

La preuve passe par `cross_context_disjoint` (`:117`), qui donne la conclusion plus forte `∀ l ∈ L, l ∉ L′`. Elle n'utilise que `FramesC`, `WF3` et `I1` de `KInvC`.

- **`a ≠ b` :** I1 (§50) et le calcul des modes effectifs (§43.3–4), via `effective_exclusive`.
- **`a = b` :** `no_double_exercise` (`:55`), par récurrence sur la dérivation de `ExercisableAt` (§43). C'est la clause récursive :
  - une autorité tenue par une frame n'est exerçable que depuis cette frame, et les frames courantes de deux contextes distincts diffèrent (`view_tops_ne`, `:93`, par l'unicité des frames, WC4 C3) ;
  - une autorité tenue par une place `p` n'est exerçable en `Modify` depuis `c` qu'à travers une autorité `b` de mode effectif `Modify` sur une feuille de `p`. Elle n'est exerçable depuis `c′` qu'à travers une autorité `b′` de mode effectif présent sur la même feuille. I1 force `b = b′`, et la question se repose un cran plus bas.

  La chaîne est finie parce que `ExercisableAt` est un inductif. `NoOrphan` (§54), que le brief anticipait, n'est pas utilisé.

Non-vacuité : `r4_nonvacuous` (`:185`). Dans l'état final `q6` de S4, qui vérifie `KInvC`, les contextes 0 et 1 sont vivants. De plus :

- `Write3Pre (q6.view 0) 0 [0]` est vraie ;
- `Read3Pre (q6.view 1) 4 [4]` et `Write3Pre (q6.view 1) 4 [4]` sont vraies.

**Remarque sur l'énoncé.** La conclusion « `SharedMutable` » n'est jamais utilisée. Pour les hypothèses de R4, l'intersection `L ∩ L′` est toujours vide, qu'une feuille soit `SharedMutable` ou non. La raison : O10 exige un mode effectif `Modify` sur chaque feuille écrite (§67.1, `Write3Pre.effectiveModify`), et un mode effectif `Modify` exclut tout autre mode effectif sur la feuille (§43, §50). L'exception `SharedMutable` du brief (« O9 admet une lecture ordinaire … pendant un `writeShared` ») ne joue qu'avec O11, qui n'exige qu'un mode effectif présent (§68.2) ; or O11 n'est pas une hypothèse de R4. R4 est donc vrai, mais sa clause `SharedMutable` est vide. Un énoncé avec `writeShared` d'un côté serait un autre théorème : il n'est pas formalisé.

### Frontière de R4

R4 est l'absence de conflit au sens de l'adjacence dans un entrelacement de pas abstraits : deux pas ordinaires habilités dans deux contextes distincts ne touchent aucune feuille commune non `SharedMutable`.

Reste pour OB-C06 : chaque ordre que la machine d'autorités impose entre deux accès conflictuels doit être réalisé par une relation d'ordre mémoire. Exemples d'ordres imposés :

- la libération d'un grant avant sa ré-acquisition ;
- `terminate` avant `join`.

Les relations attendues sont `LockOrder` (OB-C04) et l'ordre de complétion (OB-C11). R4 n'est pas une preuve d'absence de data races.

### R4′ — corollaire d'octets : prouvé

### R5 — conservativité des réalisations : prouvé

`r5_realize` (`Realize.lean:561`). Pour `s.Single` et toute `op : KernelOp` :

| `ObW.dec`, `ObW.stat` de chaque écriture brute : §16.4, §16.5, §16.6 (règles de concurrence) | idem | Spec 1 §16 ¶4, §20.3 |
| `C` : compatibilité de désallocation, avec chaque jeton compatible avec lui-même | `Refinement.ParamsOK` | Spec 1 §17, §73 |
| placement et géométrie des allocations nouvelles | `Refinement.ParamsOK` | Spec 1 §9 ¶11 |
| disposition des places nouvelles | `StepOblC` (`NewLayout`) pour `enterFrame`, `alloc`, `spawn`, composite | Spec 1 §82.1, §23 |

Point essentiel : §15.7 et §16.6 sont des **hypothèses** de chaque pas brut. R1–R3 ne les établissent pas. Les établir est exactement OB-C01 à OB-C06.

## 5. Problèmes de WC4 ou de la Spec 1

Aucun bloquant. Pas de silence ni de contradiction qui aurait exigé un arrêt.

- **WC4 C5 et réalisation du composite.** Passage : C5, « This is a **single composite candidate transition** … not an ordinary sequential execution of O6 followed by O4 ». Le pas abstrait reste unique. Sa réalisation (prescrite par le brief) est une séquence : créations, puis copies. Les états mémoire intermédiaires correspondent aux états de phase (`spawnCreate`, préfixes de `transfersEff`), qui ne sont pas des états de `S_C` atteints par un pas étiqueté. Au grain des pas abstraits, aucun autre contexte ne les observe. Exemple : dans S4, entre la création de `d` et la copie de `v` dans `d`, la mémoire contient `d` alloué et non initialisé. C'est hors fragment (OB-C14, OB-C01).
- **Citation périmée dans le jalon 1.** La WC4 corrigée retire « (former C13.10) » de C13. La docstring de `NewMutexPre` (`SyncLib.lean:228-231`) cite toujours « former C13.10 ». Elle n'est pas modifiée : le brief interdit de toucher au jalon 1.
- **Contrôleur et registre (WC4 C13, C17, C25).** Les opérations de verrou n'ont pas de réalisation. La feuille `ctl` est une feuille ordinaire : `ReprC` exige seulement que ses octets soient initialisés quand elle est `Init`. Rien ne relie ses octets à l'état du registre, alors que C13 exige « the initial physical controller state must correspond to the newly available abstract registry entry ». Ce n'est pas un défaut : WC4 le classe sous OB-C05.

## 6. Décisions de représentation

1. **`ReprC`** est défini sur `s.flat`, comme le demande le brief. `reprC_view` montre l'équivalence avec `Repr` sur toute vue.
2. **Représentations écrites.** `Label.kernel c op` porte une `KernelOp`, sans les représentations que `Refinement.KOp.write` porte. `realize` prend donc un paramètre `w`. R1 vaut pour tout `w` ; `SimRunC.step` choisit `w` par pas. `kopOf` relie les deux types d'opérations.
3. **Réalisation unique.** Une opération héritée se réalise par `opsOf` sur la vue, y compris les opérations réindexées. Pour ces dernières, la preuve passe par des lemmes `realize_*` qui reprennent les preuves de `r6_*` avec les seules clauses lues (§ 3, R1).
4. **Composite.** La réalisation suit les états de phase non cédés. La preuve passe par les états cédés, où le jalon 1 établit `KBase`. Le passage est licite car `Repr` ne lit pas `A` et `transferOps` ne lit que `P`.
5. **`StepOblC`** réutilise `Refinement.StepObl` sur la vue pour les opérations héritées. Pour `spawn` et le composite, il ajoute `NewLayout` des locaux.
6. **`SimRunC`** reprend le schéma de `Refinement.SimRun` : obligations par pas, paramètres fixés une fois. L'état initial est l'état de la Spec 1 §47 en contexte unique, avec un registre vide, comme `init_inv` du jalon 1.
7. **R3** est exprimé par `NoUB`, l'absence d'issue `ub` là où l'opération s'exécute.
8. **R4** porte sur des listes de feuilles, car `Write3Pre` et `Read3Pre` prennent des listes. « État atteignable » est rendu par `KInvC`, que `encapsulated_inv` établit sur toute trace encapsulée depuis l'état initial.
9. **R4′** utilise `ByteDisjoint` de `Refinement.lean` sur les listes filtrées. Ses hypothèses sont `LayoutWF` et `KInvC`, sans `ReprC` complète.
10. **Noms.** Le brief écrit `LStep k L` et `LayoutWF` avec le même `L`. Dans le code, la disposition mémoire est `π.L : Layout` (ou `Lm`) et la disposition du mutex est `L : MutexLayout`.

Hypothèses du brief retirées, chacune parce qu'elle n'est pas utilisée (l'énoncé n'en est que plus fort) :

- `DDSound` en R1 ;
- `ReprC` en R4′, remplacée par sa partie `LayoutWF`.

## 7. Écarts avec la Spec 1

Aucun. Les réalisations des opérations héritées sont celles de `Refinement.lean`. R5 montre qu'elles coïncident avec elles en contexte unique.

## 8. OB-C05 et OB-C12

**OB-C05 (réalisation atomique de l'acquisition, du déverrouillage, de la reprise) : entièrement ouvert.**

- `newMutex`, `acquire`, `unlock` et `resetLock` ont une réalisation vide. R1 et R2 tiennent pour cette réalisation parce que le registre est un état de bibliothèque hors `S_C` et que `ReprC` ne le lit pas.
- Le jalon 2 ne dit donc rien de la correspondance entre registre et contrôleur physique (C13, C17, C18, C25), ni de l'atomicité.
- Une écriture ordinaire de `ctl` (C22.4, S12) se réalise comme toute écriture ordinaire. R1 la couvre comme pas mémoire sûr, mais le protocole du contrôleur reste une obligation d'interface.

**OB-C12 (correspondance concrète de la Spec 1 §82) : déchargée sur le fragment des pas abstraits, pour :**

- §82.1 : `ReprC` ; les frames n'ont pas de représentation (`repr_frames_congr`) ;
- §82.2–§82.5 : R1 et R2, pour toutes les étiquettes de `LStep`, composite compris ;
- §82.8 : R4′.

**Non couvert :**

- §82.6 (adresses épinglées) : `pinned_address_stable` n'est pas transporté au cas concurrent ;
- §82.7 (arènes) : `LStep` n'a pas d'étiquette d'arène ;
- §82.3 (adresse et provenance écrites par `store`) : `pointer_sound_store` n'est pas transporté ; R1 ne donne que `ReprC`.

Ces extensions n'étaient pas demandées.

## Ce qui n'est pas vérifié

- Aucune revue adversariale n'a été faite.
- Le témoin S4 n'exerce pas `spawn` sans valeur, `terminate`, `join`, ni les opérations de verrou. R1 et R2 les couvrent par preuve, sans exécution concrète.

# Spec 2, jalon 3 — complétude et validation adversariale

Branche `formal/spec2-m3`, créée depuis `e30355f` (tête de `formal/spec2-m2`). Exploratoire, jamais mergée ; rien n'est poussé.

Sources :

- WC4 corrigée, non commitée. Le brief la nomme `ERN_Concurrency_Model_WC4.md`. Ce fichier n'est pas sur le disque. Le texte lu est `~/Downloads/ERN_WC4.md`, la WC4 corrigée du jalon 2 : C13 n'y cite plus « former C13.10 ».
- `corpus-spec2-m3.md`, non commité : source des verdicts attendus.
- Spec 1 `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`.

**Fragment.** Les énoncés de réalisation (R1–R5 et leurs extensions A4) portent sur le fragment du jalon 2 : les contextes s'entrelacent **au grain des pas abstraits**. Les énoncés de l'étape B portent sur la machine d'autorités seule. Aucun n'est une preuve d'absence de data races.

## Commits

| Commit | Contenu |
|---|---|
| `3b9b7ff` | A1, A2, A3 : étiquettes d'arène dans `LStep`, état `(SyncReg, ArenaReg)`, garde §56 unifiée, `AdminSep`, `ArenaInvC`, T7, extension de T2, T4, R1. **Commit groupé** : le changement de type de l'état de bibliothèque casse tous les modules qui utilisent `LStep`. |
| `84d3ece` | A5 : conservativité des opérations d'arène (T1, R5). |
| `1fb106f` | A4 : §82.3 et §82.6 sous `ReprC`. |

| `e039840` | Corpus, frames (S1a, S1b, S4 négatif, S13, S14). |
| `917b77e` | Corpus : S10, W-C22.3 (b), jumeau de S17a, `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared`. |
| `602fea5` | `AdminSep` supposée pour `issue` et `reset` seulement dans `lstep_preserves` ; `libInv_nil` ; `adminSep_needed`. |
| `bf139f2` | coupure d'une ligne de docstring. |

Le rapport fait l'objet d'un commit séparé.

## Vérifications à `bf139f2`

- `lake build` réussit (66 jobs). Aucun avertissement : chaque module de `Ern/Concurrency/` et de `Ern/Concurrency/Corpus/` a été recompilé seul par `lake env lean`, sans sortie.
- Le `grep` d'`AGENTS.md` est vide ; aucun `noncomputable` dans `Ern/Concurrency`.
- Audit `collectAxioms` : 1089 théorèmes `Ern.Concurrency*`, dont 832 non internes. Aucun axiome hors `{propext, Quot.sound}`.
- Aucune ligne de plus de 100 caractères dans les fichiers ajoutés ou modifiés.

## Passages lus

- **Spec 1 :** §§36, 43, 45–46, 50, 54–58, 59–78 et 82, en entier.
- **WC4 corrigée :** en entier.
- **Corpus :** en entier.
- **Lean :** `Arena.lean` (O17–O19, `ArenaInv`, transport et préservation de `LInv`) ; `RefinementArena.lean` (`kexp`, `lopsOf`) ; dans `Refinement.lean`, `pointer_sound_store` et `pinned_address_stable` ; les modules des jalons 1 et 2 touchés.

---

# Partie A — le jalon 3

## A.1 Audit des axiomes d'`Arena.lean` et de `RefinementArena.lean`

Fait en premier, comme le demande le brief (script `AuditArena.lean`, `collectAxioms` sur les théorèmes de chaque module).

| Module | Théorèmes (non internes) | Hors `{propext, Quot.sound}` |
|---|---|---|
| `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` | 218 (176) | 0 |
| `Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena` | 99 (74) | 0 |

Aucune dépendance à `Classical.choice` : rien n'arrête le jalon.

## A.2 Étape A

### A1 — arènes dans `LStep`

| Définition | Module:ligne | Contenu | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ArenaReg` | `SyncLib.lean:229` | `List Arena.ArenaEntry`, état de bibliothèque séparé de `S_C` et du registre de synchronisation | Spec 1 §46 ; WC4 C2 |
| `NewArenaPreC s reg ar c storage internal` | `SyncLib.lean:344` | les clauses de `Arena.NewArenaBase` sur la vue de `c` ; §76.6 lu sur l'état noyau concurrent : `WF3` et `I1` de `s.flat`, `AnchorOrderC`, `AnchorOrderHeldC` ; la garde §76.4 (A3) | Spec 1 §76 ; WC4 C2, C3, C20 |
| `NewArenaStepC` | `SyncLib.lean:395` | `ok` (l'entrée d'`Arena.newArenaEff` est enregistrée) ou `reject` | Spec 1 §76, §58 |
| `IssueStepC k s ar c i region dst` | `SyncLib.lean:406` | forme d'`Arena.IssueD` : contrôles statiques (§77.1, §77.2) et `fail` de disponibilité (§77.4) sur la vue de `c`, puis `split` de `internal` et `store` du bloc, **tous deux exécutés par `c`** (`opStepC`) ; mise à jour `Arena.issueMeta` | Spec 1 §77, §58, Partie XIV ; WC4 C2, C3 |
| `ResetStepC s ar c i` | `SyncLib.lean:431` | `Arena.ResetD` sur la vue de `c`, réécrit dans `s` | Spec 1 §78, Partie XIV ; WC4 C2 |
| `Label` | `SyncLib.lean:496` | `.newArena c storage internal`, `.issue c arena region dst`, `.reset c arena` ; `.newMutex c g` perd la liste `adm` (A3) | WC4 C19, C23 |
| `LStep` | `SyncLib.lean:516` | état `SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg` ; les étiquettes du jalon 1 laissent le registre d'arènes inchangé ; les étiquettes d'arène laissent le registre de synchronisation inchangé | WC4 C2, C19, C23 |
| `LRun`, `EncapsulatedTrace` | `SyncLib.lean:588`, `:598` | sur le nouvel état ; `Encap` est lu sur `(st.1, st.2.1)` | WC4 C22, C23 |
| `newArenaStepC_ok`, `issueStepC_ok`, `resetStepC_ok` | `SyncLib.lean:447`, `:455`, `:467` | décomposition d'un pas `ok` en pas noyau | Partie XIV |

**`Encap` est inchangée.** Son texte est identique au caractère près ; les étiquettes d'arène tombent dans le cas `_ => True`. Aucune clause n'est nécessaire. T4 tient sur les étiquettes d'arène sous l'invariant `AdminSep`, qu'établit la garde A3 (§ A3). Il ne faut donc pas de restriction de trace.

**Décision : réindexation d'`issue` et de §76.6.** Le brief demande que les étiquettes d'arène soient « réalisées par les opérations dérivées de `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` sur `s.view c` ». Appliquée à la lettre, cette consigne fait lire à `IssueD` et `NewArenaBase` l'`ancestor` séquentiel de §39. Or celui-ci se calcule sur l'ordre de la pile de la vue. Deux points interviennent :

- §77.3 et §77.6 (`IssueArrival`), ainsi que §65.4 et §65.5 dans le `store` de `IssueD`, lisent `ancestor` ;
- §76.6 lit `AnchorOrder` et `AnchorOrderHeld` sur l'état entier.

WC4 C3 impose l'ancêtre étendu (« follows the frame-parent links, including links across contexts »). Le jalon 1 a déjà réindexé sur `ancestorC` les clauses des opérations héritées qui lisent `ancestor`, dont `store`. J'ai suivi cette convention :

- `issue` = `split` exécuté par `c` (vue) puis `store` exécuté par `c` (`StorePreC`, réindexé) ;
- §76.6 lu sur `AnchorOrderC` et `AnchorOrderHeldC` ;
- `reset` = `ResetD` littéral sur la vue, car `derive` et `release` ne lisent pas `ancestor`.

La lecture littérale change des verdicts. Le témoin est `S3_8_view_literal` (`Corpus/AR.lean:174`). Au pas 8 de S3, `Arena.IssueD` sur la vue du contexte 0 rejette le `store` : `¬ AnchorOrderHeld` sur la vue, car dans la pile `[0, 1]` de la vue, la frame 0 n'est pas ancêtre de la frame 1 qui tient `d1`. `AnchorOrderHeldC` tient, et `S3_8_ok` est `ok`, comme le corpus le prescrit. En contexte unique, les deux lectures coïncident (A5). Cette décision change des programmes acceptés par rapport à la lettre du brief : je la signale comme point à arbitrer (§ A.4, P1).

### A2 — `ArenaInvC`, T7, extension de T4

- **`ArenaInvC s ar := Arena.LInv ⟨s.flat, ar⟩`** (`ArenaPreserve.lean:27`). C'est `ArenaInv` (§55) de chaque entrée vivante, avec les auxiliaires de `Arena.LInv` : tout `internal` enregistré existe, et `IssuedShape` tient. `ArenaInv` seul n'est pas inductif : il faut `IssuedShape` pour `issue`, et la borne pour qu'une entrée morte ne redevienne pas vivante.
- **Préservation de base.** `lstep_keep` (`:176`) : tout `LStep` conserve les autorités (`Arena.AKeep`) et les empreintes des places existantes.
- **T7.** `lstep_arenaInv` (`:333`) : tout `LStep` préserve `ArenaInvC`. Hypothèses : `WF3` avant le pas et `NoDangling` après, comme `Arena.lInv_stepNG`. Cela couvre :
  - `transfer`, y compris le transfert de la valeur d'arène, par `AKeep` et les empreintes ;
  - `spawn`, `spawnVal`, `terminate` et `exitFrameC`, idem ;
  - `newArena`, par `NewArenaPreC.arenaInv` ;
  - `issue`, par `lInv_issue_core` ;
  - `reset`, par `Arena.lInv_reset` appliqué à la vue et `lInv_congrF`.
- **Forme trace.** `encapsulated_arenaInv` (`Reachable.lean:143`).
- **Extension de T4.** `lstep_preserves` (`SyncInit.lean:945`) traite les trois étiquettes d'arène :
  - `newArena` ne change ni `s` ni `reg` ;
  - `issue` et `reset` sont deux pas noyau, auxquels s'applique le lemme du jalon 1 (`kernel_syncState`, `:921`). La clause d'`Encap` du `split` ou du `derive` de `internal` (C22.1 : source ≠ `guarded` vivant) se déduit de `AdminSep`.
- **`AdminSep` n'est supposée que pour `issue` et `reset`** (hypothèse conditionnelle `lbl = .issue … ∨ lbl = .reset … → AdminSep …`). Pour les étiquettes du jalon 1, l'hypothèse est vide : l'énoncé du jalon 1 est retrouvé.
- **`LibInv L st := SyncState ∧ AdminSep ∧ ArenaInvC`** (`Reachable.lean:62`).
  - `lstep_inv` (`:75`) et `trace_inv` (`:87`) portent `KInvCA` et `LibInv`.
  - `libInv_nil` (`:67`) : avec un registre d'arènes vide, `LibInv` est `SyncState`. Les énoncés du jalon 1 correspondent à ce cas.
- **Préservation de `SyncState` par les étiquettes d'arène.** Dans `lstep_preserves` ci-dessus.

### A3 — garde §56 unifiée

- **`newMutex` consulte les `internal` des arènes vivantes.** `NewMutexPre.otherAdmin : g ∉ Arena.liveInternals s.flat ar` (`SyncLib.lean:249`). La liste fixe `adm` disparaît de `NewMutexPre`, `NewMutexOk` et `Label.newMutex`.
- **`newArena` consulte les `guarded` des entrées vivantes.** `NewArenaPreC.guard : Arena.Guard56 [Arena.liveInternals s.flat ar, liveGuardeds s reg] internal`, avec `liveGuardeds` (`SyncLib.lean:233`) l'image du registre de synchronisation en registre d'administrations vivantes.
- **Ce que `NewArenaPre.guard` d'`Arena.lean` permet sans modification.** Le paramètre `others : List (List Nat)` reçoit tout registre supplémentaire. Le passer à `[liveGuardeds s reg]` donne la garde unifiée, et `conservative_newArena` le montre en contexte unique : `NewArenaStepC` coïncide avec `Arena.NewArenaStep [liveGuardeds s reg]`. **Aucune modification d'`Arena.lean` n'est nécessaire.**

## A.4 Problèmes trouvés

- **P1 — lecture littérale des opérations dérivées sur la vue** (brief A1 ; WC4 C2, C3).
  - Passage du brief : « réalisées par les opérations dérivées de `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` sur `s.view c` ».

  - Choix fait : la convention du jalon 1, tirée de WC4 C3. Il faut confirmer qu'il est le bon.
- **P2 — S10 : désaccord entre le corpus et le modèle.**
  - **Clause citée par le corpus :** O4.7, avec la justification « `g` détenue par `f0`, son anchor effectif `root_T` passe en `f1` ».
  - **État :** `r3`. Depuis `MX₃`, `c0` a acquis `g` (autorité 4, tenue par la frame 0) puis est entré en `f1` en cédant `m := derive(root_M, Modify)`, avec un local `M′`.
  - **Verdict effectif :** `ok`. `S10_1_ok` (`S10.lean:43`) établit que `transfer(M, M′)` est `ok`. Après le pas, l'ancre effective de `g` est en `f1`, qui n'est pas ancêtre de la frame 0 (`¬ EffAnchorOKC r4 4 (some 0)`), et `exitFrameC(f1)` est rejeté.
  - **Cause :** la première phrase de §63.7 porte sur les autorités tenues **déplacées** (« All moved held authorities … satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` »). `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) ne porte que sur les autorités tenues par des places. `g` est tenue par une frame et ne bouge pas. Les autorités déplacées (`guarded` vers `slot′`, `root_T` vers `M′`) satisfont la règle en `f1`. La seconde phrase, « no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred », ne dit pas si elle couvre une autorité non déplacée dont l'ancre effective est déplacée. Le modèle de la Spec 1 (`Access`), sur le même cas séquentiel, lit §63.7 comme `TransferPreC`.
  - **Conséquence :** le pas n'est pas dangereux. L'état est bloqué : `f1` ne peut plus sortir. C'est un silence de la Spec 1 §63.7, à arbitrer ; ni le corpus ni le modèle ne sont corrigés.

  - Passage : « `c1 : enterFrame f1′` ; `acquire(e)` → `g` détenue par `f1′` ».
